title: Contextual Observer Grounding: Evaluating Situated Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
summary: Reasoning over language instructions in embodied tasks such as robotics often requires understanding spatial relations from a speaker's situated perspective. Humans infer such perspectives from shared environmental knowledge, activity context, and commonsense. Recent vision-language models (VLMs) appear capable of spatial reasoning, but their ability to infer a speaker's viewpoint from contextual cues and interpret situated spatial relations from that viewpoint remains unclear. We call this capability contextual observer grounding. To study this capability, we construct the Point-of-View Benchmark (POVBench), a dataset of 3D scenes and queries that disentangles Inferred, Stated, and Given forms of observer grounding in natural embodied communication. Given multi-view observations and a natural-language sentence, models must localize unseen or underspecified targets from situated spatial and contextual cues. Across state-of-the-art VLMs, localizing targets from directional language remains challenging, even when observer grounding is made explicit. We find that explicit breakdowns of observer-relative spatial reasoning improve target localization. Our project page is available at https://mimo-owl.github.io/POVBench/.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究具身任务中"情境观察者定位"能力，即模型能否从环境、活动与常识线索推断说话者视角，并据此解读空间关系。作者构建POVBench基准（多视角3D场景+自然语言），区分推断、陈述、给定三类观察者定位形式。实验显示当前最强VLM在方向性语言定位上仍困难，即便视角已显式给出；显式分解观察者相关空间推理可提升定位效果。
AI.motivation: 机器人在具身任务中理解语言指令，需要从说话者所处视角解读空间关系，而人类依赖共享环境知识、活动语境和常识来推断视角。近期视觉语言模型虽表现出空间推理能力，但其能否从语境线索推断说话者视角、并从该视角解读情境化空间关系尚不明确，这一能力被作者称为"情境观察者定位"。
AI.method: 作者提出POVBench基准：包含3D场景与查询，在自然具身交流中将观察者定位解耦为Inferred（推断）、Stated（陈述）、Given（给定）三种形式。任务设定为给定多视角观测与自然语言句子，模型需依据情境化空间与语境线索定位未见过或欠描述的目标，并据此系统评测多个先进VLM。
AI.result: 在多种最先进VLM上，依据方向性语言定位目标仍然困难，即使将观察者定位显式给出也依然如此；同时发现显式分解观察者相关空间推理有助于提升目标定位性能。
AI.conclusion: 当前VLM的情境观察者定位能力不足，方向性语言下的目标定位仍是开放挑战；显式拆解观察者相关空间推理是有效的改进方向。POVBench为研究该能力提供了基准与评测框架。

title: Scientific Agents: Evaluating Profession-Specific System Prompts on Scientific Tasks
comment: 46 pages (11 pages main text, references, 33-page appendix); 10 figures, 29 tables. Evaluated corpus: https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/scientific-agents (commit 48dedd2); evaluation code and item-level records are not released
summary: Detailed profession-specific system prompts raise token use and estimated cost per response without a consistent accuracy gain. We evaluate Scientific Agents, an open-source corpus of 503 profession-specific AGENTS.md profiles, with Gemini 3.8 Flash via OpenRouter in the Pi agent harness. We compare matched profiles with four controls: a minimal baseline ("You are a helpful assistant"), the profile's opening role sentence, a generic scientific rigor guide, and a profile from an unrelated domain. Across nine text-based science benchmarks (4,531 sampled questions, 100 matched profiles), 4,488 items completed all five conditions after API-error retries, scored with automated, rule-based grading. The average profile-baseline accuracy difference is -0.6 percentage points (95% bootstrap interval [-1.5, +0.2] across fixed tasks), and no benchmark shows a statistically clear improvement. Matched profiles produced 1.5-2.3 times as many output tokens and cost 2.2-4.5 times more per successful call. On 60 tool-using BioMysteryBench bioinformatics problems (three runs each for baseline and profile), mean solve rates were 46.7% with the profile and 56.7% at baseline, a difference of -10.0 percentage points (95% interval [-16.7, -3.3]) driven by more frequent token- and time-limit stops under the profile. Longer prompts had one unexpected operational advantage: on SuperGPQA, frequent provider API drops left the short baseline with a correct first-pass answer on only 54.0% of items, against 71.6% with the profile. Generic and mismatched prompts were about as reliable, so this gain comes from prompt length or formatting rather than domain expertise. For the tested model and tasks, loading full profession profiles by default does not improve accuracy and costs considerably more; whether selective retrieval of profile sections or open-ended scientific tasks would change this remains to be tested.

AI.tldr: 在503个职业特定AGENTS.md配置的对照实验中，加载完整职业配置未提升科学基准准确率（平均-0.6个百分点），但输出token增至1.5-2.3倍、单次成功率成本增至2.2-4.5倍；工具类任务中配置组解出率反而低10.0个百分点。
AI.motivation: 检验"职业特定系统提示"是否值得其额外token与成本。实践中普遍认为详细的专业角色提示能提升大模型表现，但缺乏跨基准、多对照的严格量化证据，作者希望明确这种提示带来的收益与代价。
AI.method: 以Scientific Agents语料库（503个职业特定的AGENTS.md配置）为对象，使用Gemini 3.8 Flash经OpenRouter在Pi agent harness中运行。对100个匹配配置设置五种条件：最小基线（"You are a helpful assistant"）、配置的开场角色句、通用科学严谨性指南、以及来自无关领域的配置。在9个文本科学基准（采样4,531题）上评测，经API错误重试后共4,488题完成全部五种条件，采用自动化规则评分；另在60个需工具调用的BioMysteryBench生物信息学问题上，对基线与配置各运行三次比较解出率。
AI.result: 文本基准上，配置与基线的平均准确率差为-0.6个百分点（95% bootstrap区间[-1.5, +0.2]），无任一基准显示统计上明确的提升；配置产生1.5-2.3倍输出token，每次成功调用成本为2.2-4.5倍。BioMysteryBench上配置组平均解出率46.7%，基线56.7%，差-10.0个百分点（95%区间[-16.7, -3.3]），主因是配置下更频繁触发token与时限中止。意外发现：在SuperGPQA上因频繁的供应商API中断，短基线仅54.0%的题目在首轮即得到正确答案，而配置组为71.6%；通用与不匹配提示的可靠性相近，说明该优势源自提示长度或格式而非领域专业性。
AI.conclusion: 对被测模型与任务而言，默认加载完整职业配置不提升准确率且成本显著更高，故不建议作为默认策略；更优方向可能是选择性检索配置中相关段落，或在开放式科学任务上重新评估，这些仍待验证。

title: Towards Bridging the Gap Between Offline and Iterative Alignment via Preference Distillation
comment: Accepted by Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR)
summary: Direct preference optimization DPO is a promising offline approach for aligning large language models (LLMs) due to its simplicity, computational efficiency, and implicit modeling of human preferences. Interestingly, iterative extensions of DPO have achieved stronger performance on academic benchmarks, raising two key questions: (i) Why do iterative methods generally outperform offline ones? (ii) Can their advantages be incorporated into offline alignment? To answer the first question, our controlled experiments reveal that the explicit preference model, additionally introduced in the iterative procedure, is a key factor behind its superiority over offline methods. This insight leads us to answer the second question affirmatively and propose Distilled Preference Probability Policy Optimization (DP3O), an effective and efficient offline alignment algorithm. DP3O first learns an explicit preference model using a helper class of LLMs and then distills its knowledge into policy optimization. Theoretically, we show that explicit preference modeling admits better estimation error control than implicit formulations, and that DP3O achieves a tighter generalization bound than hard-label DPO through variance reduction. Empirically, we evaluate DP3O on a wide range of chat-based and downstream tasks and show that it outperforms state-of-the-art offline methods, achieves performance comparable to iterative DPO, and reduces training time by about $42\%$, demonstrating both its effectiveness and efficiency.

AI.tldr: 该论文探究迭代DPO优于离线DPO的原因，发现显式偏好模型是关键，据此提出离线算法DP3O，在性能与效率上均优于现有离线方法并接近迭代DPO。
AI.motivation: DPO作为离线对齐方法简便高效，但迭代扩展在学术基准上表现更强。作者试图回答两个问题：(i) 迭代方法为何普遍优于离线方法；(ii) 能否将迭代方法的优势融入离线对齐。
AI.method: 通过受控实验发现迭代过程中额外引入的显式偏好模型是其优越性的关键。据此提出Distilled Preference Probability Policy Optimization (DP3O)：先借助一类辅助LLM学习显式偏好模型，再将其知识蒸馏到策略优化中。
AI.result: 理论上证明显式偏好建模比隐式建模具有更好的估计误差控制，且DP3O通过方差缩减获得比硬标签DPO更紧的泛化界。实验上，在多种对话与下游任务中，DP3O优于最先进离线方法，性能与迭代DPO相当，并将训练时间减少约42%。
AI.conclusion: 显式偏好建模是迭代DPO优势的核心来源，且可通过DP3O将其有效融入离线对齐，兼顾效果与效率，为离线对齐提供了新思路。

title: Dynamic-Programming-Guided Hierarchical BPE and Empirical Analysis of Vocabulary Pruning
summary: Byte Pair Encoding (BPE) constructs vocabularies through greedy pair merging, but the resulting merge order does not necessarily allocate a fixed model-visible vocabulary optimally for compression. We propose Dynamic-Programming-Guided Hierarchical BPE (DH-BPE), a vocabulary-construction method that combines token exposure under exact minimum-token segmentation with the hierarchical dependencies induced by BPE training. Starting from a modestly overshot BPE candidate vocabulary, DH-BPE uses dynamic programming to measure candidate utility and applies exposure-guided, dependency-aware pruning to select a fixed-size model-visible vocabulary. We compare DH-BPE against Standard BPE and recent vocabulary-optimization baselines, including Pruned BPE, MinGram, and MinGram-PP, in primary evaluations at 12K and 16K target vocabulary sizes, with an additional 18K evaluation against MinGram only. Across the primary 12K and 16K comparisons, DH-BPE consistently improves aggregate compression over Standard BPE, Pruned BPE, and MinGram under a shared exact minimum-token DP encoder. MinGram-PP achieves stronger aggregate compression in the primary comparisons, but DH-BPE outperforms it at overshoot factors f = 2.0 and f = 3.0 in cross-corpus evaluation; at 12K, MinGram-PP reverses this ordering only with the substantially larger candidate pools at f = 4.0 and f = 5.0. Qualitative analysis further shows that DH-BPE balances later, more complete BPE merges with reusable subword components, providing a practical approach to improving vocabulary allocation under a fixed model-visible vocabulary budget.

AI.tldr: 提出DH-BPE，用动态规划结合token曝光度与BPE层级依赖，从超配候选词表中剪枝出固定规模词表，在12K/16K下压缩效果优于Standard BPE、Pruned BPE与MinGram。
AI.motivation: BPE通过贪心合并构造词表，其合并顺序并不保证在固定模型可见词表规模下达到最优压缩。因此需要一种词表构造方法，在固定词表预算下更合理地分配词表容量以提升压缩性能。
AI.method: DH-BPE：从一个适度超配（overshoot）的BPE候选词表出发，在精确最小token切分（exact minimum-token segmentation）下度量候选token的曝光度（exposure），并结合BPE训练产生的层级依赖关系，用动态规划评估候选token效用，执行曝光引导、依赖感知的剪枝，选出固定大小的模型可见词表。
AI.result: 在12K与16K目标词表规模下，DH-BPE在共享的精确最小token DP编码器下，聚合压缩率一致优于Standard BPE、Pruned BPE与MinGram；18K额外对比MinGram。MinGram-PP在主要对比中聚合压缩更强，但在跨语料评测的过采样因子f=2.0与f=3.0时DH-BPE更优；12K下MinGram-PP仅在f=4.0与f=5.0的更大候选池时反超。定性分析显示DH-BPE兼顾了较晚、更完整的BPE合并与可复用子词成分。
AI.conclusion: DH-BPE为固定模型可见词表预算下的词表分配提供了实用改进方案，通过动态规划与层级依赖感知剪枝，在压缩性能上稳定超越标准BPE及相关词表优化基线，并在部分跨语料设定下优于MinGram-PP。

title: BEFORE THE FLIP: Measuring Hidden Score Shifts In Quantized Vision Language Models Before The Answer Changes for Visual Question Answering
summary: Quantization makes vision language models (VLMs) cheaper to store and run by using fewer bits to represent their weights. While unchanged answers on visual question answering (VQA) after compression are an expected behavior, they can still hide changes in the underlying scores (log probabilities). For example, a model may still answer yes after compression, even as the score gap between yes and no shrinks. We introduce BEFORE THE FLIP to measure these hidden changes. Our method compares the score change caused by compression with the change caused by replacing the image's internal representations, or image tokens, with one fixed average token. We then increase the precision of one weight group at a time to identify where extra bits help, and test whether choosing different groups for each question offers benefits beyond shuffled controls. Among 8,277 LLaVA questions where image token replacement measurably affects the scores, 4-bit compression shifts the yes or no score gap farther toward the replacement output than 8-bit compression. Qwen shows the same pattern, but with a smaller difference. Yet only 265 of 9,000 LLaVA answers change at 4 bits. In a separate study of 1,024 calibration questions, choosing weight groups separately for each question does not outperform both shuffled controls at any tested storage budget. These findings show that compression can alter the scores behind unchanged answers, but do not establish a reliable benefit from adjusting precision for each question.

AI.tldr: 提出BEFORE THE FLIP方法，通过比较压缩引起的分数变化与图像token替换引起的分数变化，检测量化对VLM潜在log概率的隐藏影响。
AI.motivation: 量化使VLM更省存储与算力，VQA答案不变被视为正常，但答案不变可能掩盖底层log概率的变化，需要一种度量这种隐藏变化的方法。
AI.method: 将压缩引起的分数变化与把图像token替换为固定平均token引起的变化对比；逐组提高某一权重组的精度，定位额外比特有效的组，并检验按问题选择不同权重组是否优于打乱对照。
AI.result: 8277个图像token替换可测得影响分数的LLaVA问题中，4-bit压缩使yes/no分数差比8-bit更偏向替换输出；Qwen呈相同但更小模式；9000个LLaVA答案中仅265个在4-bit下改变。1024个校准问题中，按问题选组在任何测试预算下均未优于两个打乱对照。
AI.conclusion: 压缩会改变答案不变背后的分数，但未能证明按问题调整精度有可靠收益。

title: Emo-DVS: A Multimodal Benchmark for Privacy-Aware Emotion Recognition with Event Cameras
summary: Emotion analysis is a fundamental task in computer vision, but its practical deployment remains constrained by the privacy risks inherent to conventional RGB cameras. Bio-inspired event cameras present a promising hardware-level solution because they capture asynchronous brightness changes, thereby reducing exposure of facial identity details while leveraging high dynamic range for robust perception under challenging illumination conditions. Despite these advantages, existing event-based methods struggle in complex real-world settings due to limited dataset scales, simple acquisition conditions, and reliance on single-modality visual cues. To address these, we establish a challenging tri-modal benchmark with event, audio, and text modalities and propose the Information-Guided Gated Fusion (IGF) framework, which first pre-trains an event encoder on the FAU subset of Emo-DVS to capture fine-grained facial dynamics, then employs adaptive modality gating to suppress modality-specific noise, and finally leverages mutual information maximization to align robust cross-modal representations. To alleviate data scarcity, we introduce Emo-DVS, the first large-scale event-based emotion analysis dataset, which couples dynamic illumination with the Facial Action Unit (FAU) subset and emotion subset. Extensive experiments demonstrate that IGF achieves state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出事件相机情绪分析框架IGF，并构建大规模Emo-DVS数据集与三模态基准，解决隐私、数据稀缺与复杂场景问题，取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: RGB相机情绪分析存在隐私风险，事件相机可在硬件层面减少面部身份细节暴露并具备高动态范围优势；但现有事件方法受限于数据集规模小、采集条件简单及仅依赖单模态视觉线索，难以应对复杂真实场景。
AI.method: 构建事件、音频、文本三模态基准；提出信息引导门控融合（IGF）框架：先在Emo-DVS的FAU子集上预训练事件编码器以捕获细粒度面部动态，再通过自适应模态门控抑制模态特有噪声，最后利用互信息最大化对齐鲁棒的跨模态表示；同时引入大规模Emo-DVS数据集（包含动态光照、FAU子集与情绪子集）。
AI.result: 大量实验表明IGF达到最先进（SOTA）性能。
AI.conclusion: IGF框架结合大规模Emo-DVS数据集与三模态基准，有效提升了复杂现实条件下事件驱动情绪分析的性能与鲁棒性。

title: Sub-Pixel Affine Registration of Space Debris Images via the Radon Point Spread Function
summary: Inter-frame affine misalignment caused by platform jitter and attitude adjustments poses a fundamental challenge for multi-frame analysis of point targets in optical surveillance. Conventional registration methods rely on spatial intensity correlations or distinctive image features, both of which are largely absent in low-signal-to-noise-ratio point target imagery. We introduce the Radon Point Spread Function (RPSF) to characterize point targets in the Radon-transformed domain, and derive a closed-form framework that jointly estimates inter-frame translation and rotation from as few as four scalar RPSF samples per frame pair. The method requires no iterative optimization, feature extraction or interpolation, which is suitable for resource-constrained onboard processing. Simulation results confirm sub-pixel translation accuracy and a mean rotation error of 0.2556° at 1° Radon angular resolution. Validation on five real space debris datasets including both ground-based and in-orbit observations yields a mean calibration error below 0.5 pixels, substantially exceeding the precision required for reliable multi-frame processing.

AI.tldr: 提出 Radon 点扩散函数（RPSF），在 Radon 变换域对点目标建模，闭式求解帧间平移与旋转；无需迭代、特征提取或插值，仿真达亚像素平移精度与 0.2556° 平均旋转误差，真实空间碎片数据平均标定误差小于 0.5 像素。
AI.motivation: 光学监视中平台抖动与姿态调整导致的帧间仿射失配，是多帧点目标分析的根本难题。传统配准依赖空间强度相关或显著图像特征，而低信噪比点目标图像中这两者基本缺失，现有方法失效。同时，星上处理资源受限，需要非迭代、轻量的配准方案。
AI.method: 引入 Radon 点扩散函数（RPSF），在 Radon 变换域刻画点目标；据此推导闭式估计框架，仅需每对帧各四个标量 RPSF 采样，即可联合估计帧间平移与旋转。方法不需要迭代优化、特征提取与插值，适用于资源受限的在轨处理。
AI.result: 仿真验证：平移精度达亚像素级，在 1° Radon 角分辨率下平均旋转误差为 0.2556°。在五组真实空间碎片数据集（含地基与在轨观测）上验证：平均标定误差低于 0.5 像素，显著优于可靠多帧处理所需精度。
AI.conclusion: RPSF 闭式配准框架为低信噪比点目标的多帧分析提供了一种高精度、低算力、免迭代的帧间仿射配准方案，仿真与真实空间碎片数据均验证其有效性，具备在轨部署潜力。

title: CARDEA: Auditable Reasoning Grounded in Spatial Evidence for End-to-End Coronary Angiography Interpretation
comment: 25 pages, 3 figures and 4 tables in the main text; supplementary appendix with 5 figures and 1 table. Model weights: https://huggingface.co/benbayibaurba/cardea-v0. Code: https://github.com/benbayibaurba/cardea
summary: Invasive coronary angiography (CAG) is the gold standard for diagnosing coronary artery disease, but interpretation varies substantially among observers. Existing AI systems can improve consistency but lack auditable decision processes and are limited in comprehensive open-ended assessment, undermining clinician trust and clinical adoption readiness. We developed CARDEA, a unified large vision-language model that serves as the inference core of a CAG pipeline. It was trained solely on public datasets and closed-ended tasks in three stages: visual feature alignment, a self-distilled Chain-of-Box (CoB) cold start, and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) with a CoB reward encouraging bounding-box use in the reasoning trace. We assessed its two study-level diagnoses, dominance classification and complexity assessment, against a dedicated classifier and two interventional cardiologists. Report generation was excluded from training and evaluated zero-shot across stages on an external cohort using vessel-severity macro-$F_1$. CARDEA trailed the classifier on in-distribution dominance but drew level under domain shift (accuracy, 0.91 [95% confidence interval (CI), 0.86 to 0.95]) and was comparable to the cardiologists on complexity assessment (accuracy, 0.90 [CI, 0.82 to 0.97]). Only RLVR improved zero-shot report generation, raising its vessel-severity macro-$F_1$ (0.686 [CI, 0.664 to 0.707]) above the untuned base model (0.513) and over twice the always-normal floor (0.312). CARDEA runs an end-to-end CAG pipeline from raw multi-view videos through keyframe selection to study-level diagnosis while exposing auditable spatial evidence behind its conclusions. RLVR on verifiable closed-ended tasks surfaced open-ended reporting ability that supervised imitation did not. Clinical use requires prospective validation against expert cardiologists.

AI.tldr: CARDEA是一个统一的大型视觉-语言模型，作为CAG全流程的推理核心，仅用公开数据与封闭式任务训练（视觉对齐、CoB自蒸馏冷启动、RLVR），可端到端完成关键帧选取与诊断，并提供可审计的空间证据；仅RLVR提升了零样本报告生成能力。
AI.motivation: 有创冠状动脉造影（CAG）是冠心病诊断金标准，但观察者间判读差异大。现有AI系统虽能提升一致性，却缺乏可审计的决策过程，且开放式综合评估能力有限，削弱了临床医生信任与临床落地准备度。
AI.method: 构建CARDEA统一大型视觉-语言模型作为CAG流水线推理核心。仅使用公开数据集与封闭式任务，分三阶段训练：视觉特征对齐；自蒸馏Chain-of-Box（CoB）冷启动；带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR），并设置CoB奖励以鼓励推理轨迹中使用边界框。部署为端到端流程：从原始多视角视频到关键帧选择再到研究级诊断，输出可审计的空间证据。
AI.result: 两项研究级诊断（优势分类与复杂度评估）对比专用分类器与两名介入心脏病学家。在分布内优势分类上CARDEA略逊于分类器，但域偏移下持平（准确率0.91，95% CI 0.86–0.95）；复杂度评估与心脏病学家相当（准确率0.90，CI 0.82–0.97）。报告生成未参与训练，在外部队列以血管-严重度macro-F1零样本评估：仅RLVR带来提升，达0.686（CI 0.664–0.707），高于未微调基座模型（0.513）及"始终正常"下限（0.312）的两倍以上。
AI.conclusion: CARDEA可运行从原始多视角视频经关键帧选取到研究级诊断的端到端CAG流水线，并暴露结论背后可审计的空间证据。在可验证封闭式任务上的RLVR能够激发监督式模仿学习未能带来的开放式报告能力。临床使用仍需针对专家心脏病学家开展前瞻性验证。

title: PRG-Fusion: Orchestrating Generative Priors with Reconstruction Evidence for Driving View Synthesis
summary: Synthesizing photorealistic driving videos along specified trajectories is essential for scalable closed-loop simulation. Reconstruction-based methods leverage neural rendering to synthesize geometrically consistent views, but often exhibit diverse artifacts and missing content when the viewpoint deviates from the training trajectory. In contrast, generative models can synthesize realistic views along arbitrary trajectories from vehicle sensor data, yet often struggle to maintain temporal and geometric consistency across frames. To combine the strengths of both, we propose PRG-Fusion, a framework for driving view synthesis that uses reconstruction evidence to orchestrate generative priors across regions. Specifically, we extract region-wise degradation evidence from reconstructed driving scenes and convert it into Preserve, Repair, and Generate (PRG) labels. At inference, these labels serve as a unified routing policy for region-aware spatiotemporal synthesis, orchestrating 3DGS appearance preservation, LiDAR-guided structural correction, and video-prior-driven content completion across Preserve, Repair, and Generate regions, respectively. We then follow a two-stage training paradigm, first establish geometric control from sparse LiDAR projections and subsequently learning appearance control from dense 3DGS renderings. Extensive experiments on Waymo demonstrate that PRG-Fusion achieves state-of-the-art overall performance in novel trajectory video synthesis, with superior visual quality and geometric fidelity while maintaining competitive view consistency under large trajectory shifts.

AI.tldr: 提出PRG-Fusion框架，利用重建证据（退化区域标签）来调度生成先验，实现区域感知的驾驶视角合成，在Waymo上达到新轨迹视频合成的最优性能。
AI.motivation: 新轨迹驾驶视频合成对闭环仿真的可扩展性至关重要。基于重建的方法（如神经渲染）在视角偏离训练轨迹时会出现伪影与内容缺失；生成模型虽能从车载传感器数据合成任意轨迹的逼真视角，却难以保持帧间时序与几何一致性。因此需要融合两者优势。
AI.method: 从重建驾驶场景中提取区域级退化证据，并转化为Preserve、Repair、Generate（PRG）三类标签。推理时，这些标签作为统一的路由策略进行区域感知的时空合成：分别以3DGS外观保持、LiDAR引导的结构校正、视频先验驱动的补全来处理三类区域。训练采用两阶段范式，先从稀疏LiDAR投影建立几何控制，再从稠密3DGS渲染中学习外观控制。
AI.result: 在Waymo数据集上的大量实验表明，PRG-Fusion在新轨迹视频合成上取得最先进的总体性能，视觉质量与几何保真度更优，并在大轨迹偏移下保持有竞争力的视角一致性。
AI.conclusion: 通过以重建证据调度生成先验，PRG-Fusion有效融合了重建方法的几何一致性与生成模型的逼真合成能力，为高质量的新轨迹驾驶视角合成提供了可行方案。

title: Joint-Conditioned Stereo Surface Reasoning for Interaction Field Estimation
summary: Predicting hand--object interaction fields requires locating the nearest object-surface point for each hand joint, often from small and partially occluded image regions. We view this task as joint-conditioned surface-endpoint estimation: each joint has its own nearest endpoint, while endpoints from the same hand can draw on shared local surface evidence. This structure motivates Joint-Conditioned Stereo Surface Reasoning (JSSR). A temporal-stereo network jointly predicts 3D joints, a direct interaction field, and per-view endpoint evidence. Calibrated candidate search evaluates endpoint hypotheses using joint-specific image compatibility and cross-view correspondence. A hand-shared candidate support lets joints draw on common surface evidence, and a learned residual gate controls the geometric correction when observations are ambiguous. Our system built on this method ranked third on the SHOW3D Interaction Field Challenge leaderboard.

AI.tldr: 该文提出联合条件立体表面推理（JSSR），将手-物交互场预测建模为关节条件化的表面端点估计，在SHOW3D挑战赛中位列第三。
AI.motivation: 手-物交互场预测需为每个手部关节定位最近的物体表面点，但观测常来自小而部分遮挡的图像区域，导致定位困难。作者注意到不同关节的最近端点可共享同一手部的局部表面证据，这一结构未被充分利用。
AI.method: 将任务建模为关节条件化的表面端点估计。采用时序-立体网络联合预测3D关节、直接交互场以及各视角的端点证据；用标定候选搜索，基于关节专属图像兼容性与跨视角对应关系评估端点假设；引入手部共享候选支持，使关节可利用共同表面证据；并用学习到的残差门控在观测模糊时调节几何校正。
AI.result: 基于该方法的系统在SHOW3D Interaction Field Challenge排行榜上获得第三名。
AI.conclusion: 联合条件化的表面推理结合共享候选支持与残差门控，可有效提升手-物交互场预测精度，并在公开挑战赛中取得有竞争力的成绩。

title: MSSP: Multi-Scale Spatially-Constrained Partition for Unsupervised Semantic Segmentation of 3D Point Clouds
comment: Accepted by the International Conference on Image and Graphics (ICIG 2025), Springer LNCS
summary: 3D point cloud semantic segmentation is essential for real-world spatial understanding, yet the prohibitive cost of human annotations motivates unsupervised approaches that require no labels. Existing superpoint-based methods typically rely on spectral analysis at a fixed granularity, failing to capture the hierarchical semantic structures inherent in complex indoor scenes. To bridge this gap, we present a Multi-Scale Spatially-Constrained Partition (MSSP) framework that combines multi-scale spectral analysis with spatially-constrained clustering. Multi-scale spectral analysis constructs enriched superpoint descriptors across multiple clustering granularities; however, the resulting high-dimensional feature space calls for a structural prior to translate into cleaner segmentation. Spatially-constrained clustering supplies this prior by restricting superpoint merging to physically adjacent regions, imposing the spatial coherence needed for multi-scale features to be effective. Extensive experiments on S3DIS and ScanNet show that MSSP achieves the best mIoU among unsupervised methods on the main benchmarks, with particularly significant gains on S3DIS. Notably, our ablation reveals a regularize-then-enrich interaction: multi-scale features alone do not improve final segmentation, yet become highly effective when coupled with spatial regularization, underscoring that spatial coherence is aprerequisite for multi-scale representations in superpoint clustering.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MSSP框架，将多尺度谱分析与空间约束聚类相结合，用于无监督3D点云语义分割，在S3DIS和ScanNet上取得无监督方法中最佳mIoU。
AI.motivation: 3D点云语义分割对现实空间理解至关重要，但人工标注成本极高，因此需要无标签的无监督方法。现有基于超点的方法通常在固定粒度上依赖谱分析，无法捕捉复杂室内场景中固有的层次化语义结构。
AI.method: 提出多尺度空间约束划分（MSSP）框架：多尺度谱分析在多个聚类粒度上构建丰富的超点描述子；针对由此产生的高维特征空间，引入空间约束聚类作为结构先验，将超点合并限制在物理相邻区域内，从而施加多尺度特征有效所需的空间一致性。
AI.result: 在S3DIS和ScanNet上的大量实验表明，MSSP在主要基准上取得了无监督方法中最佳的mIoU，在S3DIS上提升尤为显著。消融实验揭示了"先正则化后增强"的交互关系：仅使用多尺度特征并不能提升最终分割效果，但与空间正则化结合后变得非常有效。
AI.conclusion: 空间一致性是超点聚类中多尺度表示发挥作用的前提条件，多尺度特征需与空间正则化耦合才能有效提升无监督3D点云语义分割性能。

title: DPSF-Net: A Dual-Prior Spatial-Frequency Network for Real-World Remote Sensing Image Dehazing
summary: Real-world remote sensing image dehazing (RSID) remains challenging because atmospheric scattering, spatially non-uniform haze and colour distortion jointly degrade structural and spectral information. Most deep learning methods rely on RGB inputs and spatial-domain feature extraction, which limits their ability to separate global background haze from local surface details. Here, we propose DPSF-Net, a dual-prior spatial-frequency network built on MCAF-Net for real-world RSID. The network uses hazy RGB images and dark channel prior (DCP) maps as joint inputs, allowing physical degradation cues to guide end-to-end feature learning. A spatial-frequency residual interaction block introduces a FourierUnit branch into multi-directional spatial interaction to model large-scale haze components. A prior-guided feature attention module adaptively fuses prior and attention features to reduce colour shift and structural distortion. A selective kernel complementary fusion module screens multi-scale skip features through bidirectional residual complementary gating and selective kernel fusion. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DPSF-Net achieves state-of-the-art performance on the real-world RRSHID remote sensing image dehazing benchmark and remains competitive across multiple synthetic datasets. Moreover, the proposed method strikes a favourable balance among restoration quality, parameter count and computational complexity, supporting the effectiveness of dual-prior spatial-frequency modelling.

AI.tldr: 提出DPSF-Net双先验空频网络用于真实遥感图像去雾，在RRSHID基准取得SOTA，并在多个合成数据集上保持竞争力，兼顾恢复质量、参数量与计算复杂度。
AI.motivation: 真实遥感图像去雾面临大气散射、空间非均匀雾和颜色失真对结构与光谱信息的联合退化。现有深度学习方法多依赖RGB输入和空间域特征提取，难以分离全局背景雾与局部地表细节。
AI.method: 以MCAF-Net为基础构建双先验空频网络。输入为含雾RGB图像与暗通道先验(DCP)图，用物理退化线索引导端到端特征学习。设计三模块：空频残差交互块（在多方空间交互中引入FourierUnit分支以建模大尺度雾分量）、先验引导特征注意力模块（自适应融合先验与注意力特征，减轻色偏与结构失真）、选择性核互补融合模块（通过双向残差互补门控与选择性核融合筛选多尺度跳跃特征）。
AI.result: 在真实RRSHID遥感去雾基准上达到SOTA，在多个合成数据集上具有竞争力，并在恢复质量、参数量和计算复杂度之间取得良好平衡。
AI.conclusion: 双先验空频建模对真实遥感图像去雾有效，验证了融合物理先验与频域建模的可行性。

title: TurEngMix: A Text Corpus and Benchmark for Turkish-English Code-Mixed Language Identification and Named Entity Recognition
comment: Accepted to W-NUT 2026 (11th Workshop on Natural User-generated Text), co-located with EMNLP 2026. 15 pages, 4 figures, 12 tables
summary: Natural language processing systems underperform on code-mixed text, particularly for low-resource language pairs. Turkish-English poses a further challenge: it lets English stems combine with Turkish suffixes to form single mixed-language tokens. We introduce TurEngMix, a corpus of 5.5K noisy, naturally occurring social media posts (486,974 tokens) rich in Turkish-English code-mixing. From this corpus, we construct a new Turkish-English benchmark for code-mixed language identification (LID) and named entity recognition (NER), comprising 15K expert-annotated tokens. Evaluating both decoder LLM and fine-tuned encoder baselines, we find that monolingual Turkish and English tokens are labeled reliably, but all models have high error rates on mixed-language tokens for both LID and NER. For morphologically integrated tokens, NER error rates were 5.2x and 6.3x higher for GPT-4o and Qwen, respectively. This highlights how morphological integration remains a challenge. We release the corpus, annotations, and code to support future computational and sociolinguistic research on Turkish-English code-mixing.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了土耳其语-英语代码混合语料库TurEngMix（5.5K帖文、486,974词元），并基于此建立15K专家标注的LID与NER基准，评测发现模型在形态整合的混合词元上错误率显著更高（GPT-4o为5.2倍、Qwen为6.3倍）。
AI.motivation: NLP系统在代码混合文本上表现不佳，低资源语言对尤甚。土耳其语-英语具有特殊性：英语词干可与土耳其语后缀组合成单一混合语言词元，这种形态整合现象给语言识别与命名实体识别带来额外挑战，而现有资源与基准匮乏。
AI.method: 构建TurEngMix语料库，收集5.5K条自然发生的噪声社交媒体帖文（共486,974词元），富含土耳其语-英语代码混合；从中构建包含15K专家标注词元的LID与NER基准；评测解码器式大语言模型与微调编码器基线。
AI.result: 单语土耳其语和英语词元标注较为可靠，但所有模型在混合语言词元上的LID与NER错误率均很高；对于形态整合词元，NER错误率在GPT-4o和Qwen上分别高出5.2倍和6.3倍。
AI.conclusion: 形态整合仍是代码混合处理的核心挑战。作者公开语料、标注与代码，以支持未来关于土耳其语-英语代码混合的计算与社会语言学研究。

title: Multi-View Structure-from-Motion Enables Oriented Projective Shape Analysis in Three Dimensions
summary: Projective shape analysis provides a geometric framework for studying landmark configurations in digital images acquired by pinhole cameras. In the classical projective shape (PS) model, three-dimensional configurations ($k$-ads) are represented as points in $(\mathrm{RP}^3)^q$, $q = k - 5$. A nonparametric test is developed in Patrangenaru et al. [12], for this framework, to determine whether an object matches a design blueprint, with each configuration reconstructed from a single uncalibrated stereo pair. Such two-view reconstructions are identified only up to a 3D projective transformation, which may reverse orientation, so that the sign-blind PS summary was the only available, before oriented projective shape (OPS) was recently considered. Multi-view Structure-from-Motion (SfM) technology removes this obstruction: its bundle adjustment is identified up to an orientation-preserving projective transformation. In this paper we revisit a well-cited three-cube object, from Patrangenaru et al. [12], with $n = 8$ SfM reconstructions built in Agisoft Metashape Professional 2.3.0, and validate our implementation by reproducing the published stereo construction from the original data. This allows us to perform what is to the best of our knowledge the first three-dimensional OPS analysis, compute its extrinsic total-variance index and perform statistical inference in this novel setting. Due to the high concentration of SfM data, the OPS index is asymptotically one-half the PS index, a structural consequence of concentration rather than a property of the object. Here our blueprint hypothesis is not rejected for any of the $q = 14$ non-frame landmarks, while the SfM reconstructions are about 26 times more concentrated than the stereo ones, a substantial gain in reconstruction precision. Sample-size, photograph-count, and frame-ordering analyses support the robustness of these conclusions.

AI.tldr: 本文首次开展三维有向投影形状（OPS）分析，利用SfM重建数据对三立方体对象进行蓝图假设检验，并给出外蕴总方差指标及统计推断。
AI.motivation: 经典投影形状（PS）模型中，两视图重建仅能确定到可能反转方向的3D投影变换，因此只能使用符号盲的PS摘要；多视图SfM的捆绑调整可确定到保向投影变换，从而消除该障碍，使有向投影形状（OPS）分析成为可能。
AI.method: 在Agisoft Metashape Professional 2.3.0中构建n=8个SfM重建，复现原数据的立体构造以验证实现；对三立方体对象进行三维OPS分析，计算外蕴总方差指标，并在该新框架下进行非参数统计推断（蓝图假设检验）。
AI.result: q=14个非框架地标的蓝图假设均未被拒绝；因SfM数据高度集中，OPS指标渐近为PS指标的一半（集中性导致的结构结果）；SfM重建的集中度约为立体重建的26倍，重建精度显著提升；样本量、照片数量和框架顺序分析支持结论的稳健性。
AI.conclusion: 多视图SfM使首个三维OPS分析得以实现，其统计推断验证了蓝图假设且精度显著优于立体方法；OPS与PS指标的二分之一关系源于数据集中性而非对象本身属性。

title: MOLE: Detecting Insider Threats in AI Agents
summary: Model misalignment, prompt injection, or operator misuse could lead AI agents operating frontier-lab accounts to exfiltrate model weights, poison training data, or weaken release gates. Existing benchmarks do not test whether defenders can detect this activity among routine work under a limited review budget. We introduce MOLE, an open benchmark of 150 AI-operated accounts sharing 9 stateful services over 30 workdays, with 12 threats and 8 corpora from four models totaling roughly 20 billion tokens. Of 39 agent models, 72% complete most assigned harmful objectives and agent refusal does not predict completion. MOLE enables comparison of 40 monitors across corpus generators, observability levels, and threats; even the best evaluated monitor in our single-day audit-event comparison misses nearly half of completed harm. MOLE also enables monitor development: benchmark-guided search improves a mid-tier monitor by 49-64%, while selective use of a stronger monitor improves budget-AUC by 10% over applying it to every account-day at comparable modeled cost.

AI.tldr: MOLE 是一个开放基准，用150个AI操作账户、9个有状态服务、30个工作日、12类威胁与8个语料库（约200亿token）来评测防御者在有限审查预算下能否在日常工作中检出智能体危害行为；结果显示72%的智能体模型能完成多数被指派的有害目标，且拒绝行为无法预测完成情况，最佳单日审计事件监控仍漏检近一半已完成危害。
AI.motivation: 现有基准不检验防御者能否在有限审查预算下、于日常工作中识别出模型错位、提示注入或操作员滥用所导致的危害行为（如窃取模型权重、污染训练数据、削弱发布门禁），因此缺少对防御侧可检测性的系统评估。
AI.method: 构建开放基准MOLE：150个AI操作账户共享9个有状态服务，覆盖30个工作日；包含12类威胁与来自四个模型的8个语料库，总计约200亿token；在此环境上对39个智能体模型和40个监控器进行评测，跨语料生成器、可观测性水平和威胁类型比较，并进行单日审计事件对比与监控器开发实验（基准引导搜索、按预算选择性使用强监控器）。
AI.result: 39个智能体模型中72%完成了多数被指派的有害目标，且智能体拒绝并不能预测目标完成；40个监控器评测中，最佳单日审计事件监控仍漏检近一半已完成危害；基准引导搜索使中档监控器提升49-64%；在同等建模成本下，选择性使用更强监控器比逐账户-日全量使用提升budget-AUC约10%。
AI.conclusion: MOLE提供了可同时用于防御评估与监控器开发的开放基准，揭示当前监控在有限预算下存在显著漏检缺口，并证明基准引导的搜索与选择性监控部署能有效提升检测效能与预算效率。

title: Re-calibrated Contrastive Loss for Transformation-Aware Prompt Conditioning in Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted by British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC) 2026
summary: Ensuring effective transfer learning for vision-language models without compromising their generalization performance is crucial. However, many existing methods overlook data characteristics and simply reuse the training strategies adopted during pre-training. Specifically, they treat same-class samples as distinct instances and transform images independently of their paired text prompts, which makes model learning more difficult. We address these limitations through transformation-aware prompt conditioning and a re-calibrated contrastive loss. Fixed text descriptors identify the transformations applied to paired images, providing transformation-level consistency without altering class semantics. This design aligns the image and text branches at the transformation level, enabling richer representations while preserving the models' ability to generalize. In addition, our loss function mitigates positive-gradient dilution in soft-target cross-entropy when each anchor has multiple valid positives. During transfer, our approach treats same-class samples as positives rather than distinct instances, enabling the model to learn domain-specific features more effectively. Experiments across distribution shift, transfer learning, and few-shot settings demonstrate consistent improvements over existing approaches. Source code for our method is available at https://github.com/SoongE/ReCalCon.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对视觉-语言模型迁移学习中忽视数据特性的问题，提出变换感知提示条件化（transformation-aware prompt conditioning）与重校准对比损失（re-calibrated contrastive loss），在保持泛化能力的同时提升迁移效果。
AI.motivation: 现有迁移方法忽视数据特性，直接沿用预训练阶段的训练策略：将同类样本视为不同实例，并独立地变换图像而不考虑其配对文本提示，从而增加学习难度、损害泛化性能。
AI.method: 方法包含两部分：(1) 变换感知提示条件化——用固定文本描述符标识施加于配对图像的变换，提供变换层级的语义一致性而不改变类别语义，从而在变换层面实现图像与文本分支的对齐；(2) 重校准对比损失——缓解软目标交叉熵中当每个锚点存在多个有效正例时的正梯度稀释问题。迁移时把同类样本视为正例而非独立实例。
AI.result: 在分布偏移、迁移学习和少样本等设置下的实验表明，方法相较现有方法取得一致的性能提升。源码已公开于 https://github.com/SoongE/ReCalCon。
AI.conclusion: 通过变换层级对齐与正例重校准，可在不牺牲泛化能力的前提下实现更有效的迁移学习，并学习到更具判别力的领域特定特征。

title: CantoneseLLM v2: Reasoning in a Low-Resource Language
summary: Cantonese is widely spoken but remains low-resource in written data, with no large corpus of native Cantonese reasoning traces available for model training. We develop and release CantoneseLLM v2, comprising models based on Qwen3 8B and 30B-A3B. The models are trained through CPT on 784 million Cantonese and Hong Kong-related tokens, chat-vector merging, SFT, DPO, and RLVR. Evaluation across the training stages shows that chat-vector merging transfers instruction following but preserves the donor model's reasoning language, while SFT with limited Cantonese reasoning data substantially shortens or removes reasoning traces and reduces benchmark performance. DPO restores the reasoning-block format, particularly for the 8B model, but recovers only part of the lost performance. The RLVR training with Cantonese language and Traditional Chinese scripts as multiplicative constraints introduced Cantonese language alignment and restored the lost performance. The 30B-A3B model reaches 73.16 on HKCanto-Eval, within 1.20 points of its merged checkpoint, while retaining the Cantonese reasoning behaviour absent from that checkpoint. We release the model checkpoints, the training environments, and a thirteen-year Traditional Chinese Common Crawl dataset. The models can be accessed at https://huggingface.co/collections/hon9kon9ize/cantonesellm-v20

AI.tldr: 本文发布 CantoneseLLM v2（基于 Qwen3 8B 与 30B-A3B），通过 CPT、chat-vector merging、SFT、DPO 和 RLVR 构建粤语推理模型，并以粤语语言与传统中文脚本作为乘性约束恢复推理能力。
AI.motivation: 粤语使用广泛但书面数据资源稀缺，缺乏大规模母语粤语推理轨迹语料用于模型训练。
AI.method: 基于 Qwen3 8B 和 30B-A3B，采用 7.84 亿粤语及香港相关 token 的持续预训练（CPT）、chat-vector merging、SFT、DPO 与 RLVR；RLVR 以粤语语言和传统中文字符作为乘性约束。
AI.result: chat-vector merging 可迁移指令跟随能力但保留供体模型的推理语言；有限粤语推理数据的 SFT 显著缩短或消除推理轨迹并降低基准表现；DPO 恢复推理块格式（尤其 8B）但仅部分恢复性能；RLVR 实现粤语语言对齐并恢复损失性能。30B-A3B 在 HKCanto-Eval 上达 73.16，距合并检查点仅 1.20 分，同时保留该检查点缺失的粤语推理行为。
AI.conclusion: 多阶段训练管线可在低资源粤语场景下兼顾语言对齐与推理能力，并开源模型检查点、训练环境及十三年传统中文 Common Crawl 数据集。

title: Train Overcomplete, Deploy Compact: Scaling Recovery Capacity for Structured LLM Pruning
comment: Accepted by the Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP) 2026
summary: Large language models achieve strong performance across diverse tasks, but deployment remains costly because of memory, latency, and energy demands. Structured pruning reduces these costs by removing architectural components, yet its recovery stage is often limited by a mismatch between the recovery module's representational capacity and the complexity of the removed knowledge. We call this bottleneck the capacity-knowledge asymmetry and propose OverRep, an Overcomplete Reparameterization framework for structured LLM pruning. Following the principle of "train overcomplete, deploy compact", OverRep temporarily overparameterizes the recovery module during training to absorb complex knowledge distilled from the original model. After recovery, the overcomplete re-parameterization is algebraically merged into a mathematically equivalent compact module, preserving the pruned model's inference-time architecture and computational cost. OverRep further introduces an annealed activation that enables nonlinear training dynamics while converging to a linear regime for exact algebraic merging. Across three backbone families, OverRep improves retained reasoning performance over strong recovery baselines by up to 5.5 and 8.4 points at 25% and 50% pruning, respectively, while keeping memory usage and TFLOPs comparable to existing recovery methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/mmai-laboratory/OverRep.

AI.tldr: 提出OverRep框架解决结构化剪枝恢复阶段的"容量-知识不对称"瓶颈，通过训练时过参数化、部署时等价合并的机制，在25%和50%剪枝率下分别提升保留推理性能最多5.5和8.4个点。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型虽性能强劲，但部署受限于内存、延迟与能耗。结构化剪枝可降低成本，但其恢复阶段存在恢复模块表征能力与被移除知识复杂度之间的不匹配，即作者所称的"容量-知识不对称"瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出OverRep（Overcomplete Reparameterization）过完备重参数化框架，遵循"训练过完备、部署紧凑"原则：训练时对恢复模块临时过参数化以吸收从原模型蒸馏的复杂知识；恢复后该过完备重参数化被代数合并为数学等价的紧凑模块，保持剪枝模型的推理架构与计算开销。同时引入退火激活（annealed activation），实现非线性训练动态并收敛至线性区域以支持精确代数合并。
AI.result: 在三个主干模型家族上，OverRep在25%和50%剪枝率下，相比强恢复基线分别最多提升保留推理性能5.5和8.4个点，且内存占用与TFLOPs与现有恢复方法相当。
AI.conclusion: OverRep通过过完备重参数化有效缓解了结构化剪枝恢复中的容量-知识不对称问题，在不增加推理时架构与计算成本的前提下显著提升剪枝后模型性能，代码已开源。

title: AnomalyCraft-700K: Component-Level Controllable and Verifiable Synthetic Anomalies for Fine-Grained Video Anomaly Understanding
summary: Progress in video anomaly understanding (VAU) has long been limited by inherent deficiencies of real-world anomaly videos, which are hard to collect and offer little control over their content. Synthetic anomaly approaches partially alleviate data scarcity, yet their generation remains largely controlled at the category or prompt level. They also lack component-level verification of video-text consistency and provide insufficient hard normal samples near the normal-anomaly boundary. To address this, we present AnomalyCraft-700K, a component-controllable synthetic anomaly dataset for fine-grained VAU, containing over 40K videos and over 700K task-level textual annotations. From fine-grained semantic components and a progressive three-stage pipeline, we craft anomaly events that are richly detailed, semantically controlled, and temporally structured, and additionally construct per-category hard normal samples to prompt the model to discriminate based on anomaly semantics rather than surface visual cues. Moreover, using the components as verification units, AnomalyCraft-700K further performs component-wise correction of video-text discrepancies introduced during generation, providing reliable annotations with verified cross-modal alignment for six tasks that progress from anomaly detection, through anomaly retrieval and captioning, to fine-grained anomaly reasoning. Evaluations of widely used methods under both traditional and MLLM-based protocols demonstrate that AnomalyCraft-700K serves as an effective source of supervision, from anomaly detection to fine-grained anomaly understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AnomalyCraft-700K，一个组件可控的合成视频异常数据集，含4万余视频和70万余任务级文本标注，通过细粒度语义组件与三阶段生成流程构建异常事件，并逐类构造困难正常样本、执行组件级跨模态校正，为六项从检测到细粒度推理的任务提供可靠监督，验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 真实异常视频难以采集、内容几乎不可控，导致视频异常理解（VAU）进展受限；现有合成异常方法多只能在类别或提示层面控制生成，缺少组件级的视频-文本一致性验证，也缺少靠近正常-异常边界的困难正常样本。因此需要构建更细粒度可控、标注可靠的合成异常数据资源。
AI.method: 构建AnomalyCraft-700K数据集：基于细粒度语义组件与渐进式三阶段流水线，生成细节丰富、语义可控、时序结构化的异常事件；并针对每一类别构造困难正常样本，促使模型依据异常语义而非表面视觉线索进行判别；同时以组件为验证单元，对生成过程中产生的视频-文本不一致进行组件级校正，产出跨模态对齐经验证的高质量标注，覆盖六项任务。
AI.result: 数据集包含超过4万个视频与超过70万条任务级文本标注，覆盖从异常检测、异常检索与描述，到细粒度异常推理的六项递进任务；在传统协议与基于MLLM的协议下对多种常用方法进行评估，表明其能作为有效的监督来源。
AI.conclusion: AnomalyCraft-700K通过组件可控生成、困难正常样本与组件级跨模态校正，缓解了合成异常数据在可控性、标注可靠性与边界样本方面的不足，可作为从异常检测到细粒度异常理解的有效监督资源。

title: AV-SafetyBench: A Safety Benchmark for Text-to-Audio-Video Generation
summary: Recent text-to-audio-video (T2AV) models jointly generate video, speech, sound effects, and ambience from a single text prompt. This capability poses new challenges for safety evaluation, as unsafe content may be conveyed through the audio track or arise only when the visual and audio tracks are interpreted jointly. Existing safety benchmarks largely focus on either generated video or generated audio in isolation and are therefore not designed to capture these risks. To close this gap, we introduce AV-SafetyBench, the first safety benchmark developed specifically for T2AV generation. AV-SafetyBench comprises a four-axis, 13-category taxonomy and 5,200 manually reviewed prompts that specify visual scenes, speech, and non-speech audio. Our evaluation protocol assesses each output under three views: Full-AV, Video-Only, and Audio-Only. It then uses the Video-Only and Audio-Only judgments to assign Full-AV unsafe outputs to one of four risk sources: Video-Only, Audio-Only, AV-Both, or AV-Joint. We evaluate five open-source T2AV models and validate the automated Full-AV judgments against human annotations. Across the five models, Full-AV Unsafe Rates range from 25.1% to 49.4%. Beyond these aggregate rates, risk-source analysis reveals that, for four of the five models, Audio-Only and AV-Joint cases-unsafe outputs missed by video-only evaluation-account for 41.6-48.3% of Full-AV unsafe outputs for which a risk source could be assigned. In the Cross-Modal Harm Emergence category, AV-Joint accounts for 87.5% of unsafe outputs withan assigned risk source. Together, these findings demonstrate the value of AV-SafetyBench for evaluating T2AV safety across the visual and audio modalities and their interaction.

AI.tldr: 提出首个面向文本到音视频（T2AV）生成的安全基准 AV-SafetyBench，含四轴13类分类体系与5,200条人工审核提示，通过Full-AV/Video-Only/Audio-Only三视角评估并划分四类风险来源，揭示现有单模态评估遗漏的音频侧与跨模态风险。
AI.motivation: T2AV模型可由单一文本提示联合生成视频、语音、音效与环境声，不安全内容可能仅存在于音轨，或仅在视听联合解读时才出现。现有安全基准多孤立评估生成视频或生成音频，无法捕捉此类风险，因此需要专门针对T2AV生成的安全评测工具。
AI.method: 构建AV-SafetyBench：设计四轴、13类别的分类体系，并提供5,200条人工审核、同时指定视觉场景、语音与非语音音频的提示。评估协议对每个输出在Full-AV、Video-Only、Audio-Only三种视角下判定，再用后两者结果将Full-AV不安全输出归因至四类风险来源：Video-Only、Audio-Only、AV-Both、AV-Joint。对五个开源T2AV模型进行评测，并以人工标注验证自动化Full-AV判定。
AI.result: 五个模型的Full-AV不安全率为25.1%–49.4%。风险来源分析显示，在其中四个模型上，Audio-Only与AV-Joint（即仅看视频评估会漏检的不安全输出）占可归因Full-AV不安全输出的41.6%–48.3%。在跨模态危害涌现（Cross-Modal Harm Emergence）类别中，AV-Joint占可归因不安全输出的87.5%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明AV-SafetyBench在评估T2AV跨视觉与音频模态及其交互的安全风险方面具有重要价值，可弥补现有单模态基准的评测盲区，为T2AV生成安全研究提供系统化评测基础。

title: LatentMD: Benchmarking Markdown Boundary Failures in LLM-Generated Text
comment: v2: Appendix L adds five additional analyses (realistic-condition decomposition, downstream harm, newer models, expanded natural-prompt set, effective diversity)
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly generate Markdown that is consumed by renderers, agents, code extractors, and structured downstream pipelines. Yet existing evaluations often conflate content quality with format adherence, leaving Markdown boundary failures under-measured. We introduce LatentMD, a benchmark and evaluation protocol for diagnosing CommonMark-level fence-boundary failures in LLM-generated Markdown. LatentMD separates content correctness from boundary correctness, enabling detection of outputs that are content-correct but boundary-broken. The benchmark contains 4,179 prompts and a CLI for scoring arbitrary model outputs. Across 9 LLMs and roughly 37,600 generations, we find that Markdown boundary failures are widespread: 38.0% of valid main-grid outputs are content-correct but boundary-broken, with substantial boundary breakage under unspecified prompts and in a small human-authored validation set. Ablations show that failures are driven primarily by same-family symmetric-delimiter collisions rather than nesting alone, are only partially mitigated by prompt hints, and generalize to Python triple-quote docstrings while JSON remains robust as an asymmetric-delimiter control. LatentMD provides a reproducible diagnostic target for parser-sensitive LLM evaluation.

AI.tldr: LatentMD 提出面向 LLM 生成 Markdown 的围栏边界失败诊断基准与评测协议，将内容正确性与边界正确性解耦，覆盖 4,179 条提示、9 个模型约 37,600 次生成，发现 38.0% 的有效主网格输出"内容正确但边界破损"。
AI.motivation: LLM 生成的 Markdown 被渲染器、Agent、代码抽取器等下游管线消费，但现有评测常将内容质量与格式遵循混为一谈，导致 Markdown 边界失败测量不足。
AI.method: LatentMD 作为诊断 CommonMark 层级围栏边界失败的基准与评测协议：①将内容正确性与边界正确性分离，识别"内容正确但边界破损"的输出；②构建含 4,179 条提示的基准及可为任意模型输出打分的 CLI；③在 9 个 LLM、约 37,600 次生成上进行评测；④通过消融实验分析失败成因，并将结论外推至 Python 三引号 docstring，以 JSON 作为非对称分隔符对照。
AI.result: 38.0% 的有效主网格输出属"内容正确但边界破损"；在未指定提示及小规模人工撰写验证集上边界破损同样显著；消融表明失败主要源于同族对称分隔符碰撞而非单纯嵌套；提示提示仅能部分缓解；该现象可推广至 Python 三引号 docstring，而 JSON 作为非对称分隔符对照保持稳健。
AI.conclusion: Markdown 边界失败广泛存在且被现有评测忽视，LatentMD 为解析器敏感的 LLM 评测提供了可复现的诊断目标，提示内容与边界的解耦评测是必要的。

title: CGSM: Concept-Guided Segmentation Model for Precise Pulmonary Lesion Delineation
summary: Accurate segmentation of pulmonary lesions is essential for effective clinical diagnosis and treatment strategies. Existing segmentation approaches often lack task-specific semantic guidance, as text-based annotations typically offer coarse localization of lesions, leading to inadequate delineation of lesion boundaries and poor performance on small-scale lesions. To address this, we propose CGSM, a Concept-Guided Segmentation Model that integrates LLM-generated and clinically reviewed concepts into the segmentation process. Specifically, we design a Concept-Visual Alignment Module (CVAM) to activate relevant tokens within the concepts that align with visual features, enhancing the interaction between textual and visual information. In addition, we introduce a Concept Modulated Decoder (CM-Decoder), which uses concepts from CVAM as modulation signals to facilitate the adaptive fusion of image and text features, improving the segmentation accuracy. Extensive experiments on two public datasets show that CGSM achieves state-of-the-art performance, with results of 91.59% Dice and 84.49% mIoU on the QaTa-COV19 dataset, demonstrating its effectiveness in pulmonary lesion segmentation.

AI.tldr: 提出概念引导的肺病灶分割模型CGSM，通过LLM生成并经临床审核的概念，结合概念-视觉对齐模块与概念调制解码器，在QaTa-COV19数据集上取得91.59% Dice和84.49% mIoU的最优性能。
AI.motivation: 肺病灶的精准分割对临床诊断与治疗策略至关重要。现有方法缺乏任务特定的语义引导，因为基于文本的标注通常只能提供病灶的粗略定位，导致病灶边界刻画不足，且在小尺度病灶上表现较差。
AI.method: 提出CGSM（Concept-Guided Segmentation Model），将LLM生成并经临床审核的概念融入分割过程。设计概念-视觉对齐模块（CVAM），激活与视觉特征对齐的概念相关token，增强文本与视觉信息的交互；引入概念调制解码器（CM-Decoder），以CVAM输出的概念作为调制信号，自适应融合图像与文本特征以提升分割精度。
AI.result: 在两个公开数据集上的大量实验表明，CGSM达到最先进性能，在QaTa-COV19数据集上取得91.59% Dice和84.49% mIoU，验证了其在肺病灶分割中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: CGSM通过概念引导的语义调制机制有效弥补了传统文本标注语义粗糙的不足，在肺病灶分割任务上实现了领先的分割精度，证明了引入LLM生成并经临床审核的概念用于医学图像分割的可行性与有效性。

title: GIFT: Goal-Injected Fine-Tuning for Efficient Manipulation Policy Adaptation
summary: Compared with relying solely on initial observations and language instructions, predicting goal images with generative models as high-level visual guidance can significantly enhance the robustness of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. However, most existing foundation models have not systematically incorporated goal image conditioning due to the high computational training cost. To this end, we propose Goal-Injected Fine-Tuning (GIFT), a lightweight and efficient fine-tuning framework that seamlessly integrates generated goal images into multiple representative pretrained VLA models. Our approach introduces goal image features into observations via a zero-initialized convolution which progressively grows parameters from zero and prevents harmful noise from disrupting the pretrained policy during fine-tuning. As training proceeds, goal information is gradually incorporated, enabling efficient goal understanding without disrupting model stability. We further introduce a refined image editing method to generate semantically and visually consistent goal images from initial observations and task instructions. Experiments show that goal-aware VLA models achieve substantial performance gains across tasks: with only a single epoch of fine-tuning, GIFT outperforms the base model by 6.0% and 13.4% on two SIMPLER settings, and by 4.7% on LIBERO, demonstrating both efficiency and effectiveness.

AI.tldr: GIFT：一种轻量高效的微调框架，将生成的目标图像无缝注入预训练VLA模型，通过零初始化卷积渐进引入目标信息，单轮微调即显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型多以初始观测和语言指令为条件，而用生成模型预测目标图像作为高层视觉引导可显著提升鲁棒性；但受训练计算成本高所限，多数基础模型未系统性地融入目标图像条件。为此需要一种轻量高效、不破坏预训练策略稳定的目标图像条件注入方案。
AI.method: 提出GIFT（Goal-Injected Fine-Tuning）微调框架：1）通过零初始化卷积将目标图像特征引入观测，参数从零渐进增长，避免有害噪声在微调初期干扰预训练策略，随训练推进逐步融入目标信息，实现高效目标理解且保持模型稳定；2）提出精细化的图像编辑方法，从初始观测和任务指令生成语义与视觉一致的目标图像；该框架可无缝集成到多个代表性预训练VLA模型中。
AI.result: 仅需单轮（epoch）微调，GIFT在两个SIMPLER设置上分别比基线模型提升6.0%和13.4%，在LIBERO上提升4.7%，兼顾效率与有效性。
AI.conclusion: GIFT验证了以生成目标图像作为高层视觉引导、并通过零初始化卷积渐进注入的有效性，可在极低微调成本下为多种VLA模型带来一致性性能增益，具备良好的通用性与实用性。

title: LatentPort: Beyond KV Cache - Cross-Model Transfer of Recurrent Memory in Hybrid Language Models: A 4B-to-9B Hybrid-State Handoff Without Target Prefix Replay
summary: Can one language model hand its live memory to another without the receiver rereading the context? We demonstrate useful persistent hybrid-state transfer across one architecture-matched Qwen3.5 4B-to-9B sibling pair. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstrated cross-model handoff of persistent recurrent inference state between differently sized hybrid language models without target prefix replay. Translated attention KV alone leaves a large gap; adding the Gated DeltaNet (GDN) persistent-state package lowers teacher-forced negative log-likelihood (NLL), the average next-token log-loss, by 0.747 nats/token (95% paired document bootstrap CI [0.6921, 0.8047]), improving all 64 PG19 documents. Direct recurrent and convolution reuse outperforms the tested learned GDN maps, consistent with partial functional compatibility of persistent-state coordinates. A fresh component factorial selects translated KV with direct recurrent and convolution state. An additional 434,176-parameter correction improves that base on 64 fresh web documents: continuation loss is 0.076 nats/token above native 9B (excess NLL), Jensen-Shannon (JS) divergence is 0.022, and native context recovery (NCR) is 0.918. Corrected 9B significantly beats continued 4B inference while processing zero historical prefix tokens. Evidence covers one direction, one geometry-matched Base-model pair, and 4K teacher-forced continuation; the near-native gate failed, the 16K branch was not run, and free-generation equivalence and a general state interface remain unproven.

AI.tldr: 该论文首次演示了不同规模混合语言模型之间持久推理状态的跨模型移交：将一个Qwen3.5 4B的实时记忆传给9B，而接收方无需重读上下文前缀。
AI.motivation: 探讨语言模型能否在无需目标模型重读上下文的情况下，把自身的运行时（持久）记忆直接移交给另一模型，从而实现跨模型、跨规模的状态复用，避免前缀重放带来的重复计算。
AI.method: 采用架构匹配的Qwen3.5 4B→9B兄弟模型对，在4K教师强制续写设置下进行单向混合状态迁移。仅迁移注意力KV存在明显差距；额外打包Gated DeltaNet（GDN）持久状态。通过新组件因子实验，选取"翻译后的KV+直接循环状态+卷积状态"组合，并附加434,176参数的校正模块。
AI.result: 加入GDN持久状态后，教师强制NLL下降0.747 nats/token（95%配对文档bootstrap CI [0.6921, 0.8047]），全部64篇PG19文档均有改善。直接复用循环与卷积状态优于所测试的学习式GDN映射。校正后在64篇新web文档上：续写损失仅比原生9B高0.076 nats/token，JS散度为0.022，原生上下文恢复（NCR）为0.918，且显著优于持续运行的4B推理，同时处理的历史前缀token数为零。
AI.conclusion: 持久混合状态跨模型移交可行，且直接复用循环/卷积状态与翻译KV的组合最优，印证了持久状态坐标具有部分功能兼容性。但证据仅限单向、单一几何匹配的Base模型对及4K教师强制续写；近原生门槛未通过，16K分支未运行，自由生成等价性与通用状态接口仍未被证实。

title: NeuCME: Toward Dynamic Multimodal Continual Learning via Neural Combinatorics of Multiple Experts
summary: Multimodal continual learning has recently shown great potential for developing agents with human-like intelligence by continuously learning new tasks across multiple modalities. However, existing methods typically assume that the set of modalities per task is predefined and fixed. In this paper, we investigate a more realistic learning setting, referred to as dynamic multimodal continual learning, in which the set of modalities may vary across tasks rather than remaining fixed. This setting involves two primary challenges: (i) spatio-temporal catastrophic forgetting and (ii) adaptive multimodal fusion. To address these challenges, we propose NeuCME (as shorthand for \textbf{Neu}ral \textbf{C}ombinatorics of \textbf{M}ultiple \textbf{E}xperts), a novel framework designed to effectively learn and integrate knowledge across tasks with varying modalities. The proposed NeuCME model comprises three key components, namely modality-combinational rehearsal, multi-gated mixture-of-experts, and task relevance-guided distillation. Furthermore, we formulate an evaluation metric to quantify the dynamism of task sequences and then set up a comprehensive benchmark with different degrees of dynamism. Extensive experiments using four real-world datasets demonstrate that the proposed NeuCME outperforms state-of-the-art methods markedly.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出动态多模态持续学习这一更现实的学习设定（任务间模态集合可变），并针对时空灾难性遗忘与自适应多模态融合两大挑战提出NeuCME框架，包含模态组合排练、多门控混合专家与任务相关性引导蒸馏三部分，并构建了量化任务序列动态性的指标与基准。实验表明NeuCME显著优于现有最优方法。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态持续学习方法通常假设每个任务的模态集合是预定义且固定的，这与现实中模态集合随任务变化的情形不符。论文因此研究更现实的"动态多模态持续学习"设定，其中的核心挑战是（i）时空灾难性遗忘和（ii）自适应多模态融合。
AI.method: 提出NeuCME（Neural Combinatorics of Multiple Experts）框架，包含三个关键组件：模态组合排练（modality-combinational rehearsal）、多门控混合专家（multi-gated mixture-of-experts）、任务相关性引导蒸馏（task relevance-guided distillation）。此外，提出量化任务序列动态性的评价指标，并据此构建具有不同动态程度的综合基准。
AI.result: 在四个真实世界数据集上进行的大量实验表明，NeuCME显著优于当前最先进的方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将多模态持续学习推广到模态集合随任务动态变化的现实设定，通过NeuCME的三组件设计有效应对时空遗忘与自适应融合问题，并提供了动态性度量与基准，为后续研究奠定基础。

title: Fine-Grained Visual Preprocessing and Dual-Stream Temporal Modeling for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis on Social Media
summary: Multimodal sentiment analysis often remains text-dominant due to raw-video noise and insufficient temporal modeling. Using CH-SIMS v2.0S, this study proposes three improvements: the NAPS pipeline---a seven-stage system integrating face tracking,identity embedding, and normalized lip-motion analysis to reduce visual noise;DS-TANet, combining an EfficientNetB2 static stream, RAFT optical-flow motion stream, motion-guided attention, and Bi-GRU temporal modeling; and DS-TAFNet, fusing visual and MacBERT-Base textual representations via concatenation fusion. With NAPS, the static visual baseline achieves 80.98\% Macro F1, comparable to the text baseline of 80.55\%; DS-TANet improves visual Macro F1 to 82.58\%;and DS-TAFNet achieves 87.49\% accuracy and 87.48\% Macro F1. These results demonstrate that improving visual input quality and temporal representation is more effective than increasing fusion complexity under limited-data conditions.

AI.tldr: 该研究在CH-SIMS v2.0S数据集上提出NAPS、DS-TANet与DS-TAFNet三项改进，提升多模态情感分析的视觉与融合性能，最终DS-TAFNet达到87.49%准确率与87.48% Macro F1。
AI.motivation: 多模态情感分析常因原始视频噪声大、时序建模不足而呈现文本主导，视觉模态贡献受限，因此需要提升视觉输入质量与时序表征能力。
AI.method: 提出三项改进：NAPS七阶段流程（人脸跟踪、身份嵌入、归一化唇动分析）以降低视觉噪声；DS-TANet结合EfficientNetB2静态流、RAFT光流运动流、运动引导注意力与Bi-GRU时序建模；DS-TAFNet通过拼接融合视觉与MacBERT-Base文本表征。
AI.result: 经NAPS处理后，静态视觉基线达80.98% Macro F1，接近文本基线80.55%；DS-TANet将视觉Macro F1提升至82.58%；DS-TAFNet取得87.49%准确率与87.48% Macro F1。
AI.conclusion: 在有限数据条件下，提升视觉输入质量与时序表征比增加融合复杂度更有效。

title: AstraMoE-SR: Trajectory-Guided Diffusion for Blind Satellite Jitter Deblurring and Super-Resolution
summary: Pushbroom satellite imaging couples limited spatial resolution with platform attitude instability. Platform jitter produces spatially varying motion blur because each scan line is acquired under a different instantaneous attitude, while perspective geometry causes the same perturbation to induce different pixel displacements across the field of view. Existing blind restoration methods that assume a spatially invariant kernel and satellite jitter correction methods that rely on auxiliary observations are therefore not directly applicable. We present AstraMoE-SR, a single-image framework that jointly restores motion blur and spatial resolution without auxiliary measurements. Rather than estimating a blur kernel, we infer how the camera moved by reparameterizing degradation as a local exposure trajectory under pushbroom geometry. A conditional diffusion model estimates the trajectory distribution, mitigating the over-smoothing of high-frequency jitter by deterministic point estimation. The predicted trajectory conditions a pretrained latent diffusion backbone through trajectory-guided geometric alignment and spatially adaptive reconstruction. We further show that the remaining point-wise trajectory error is consistent with intrinsic jitter-phase ambiguity that is not resolved by increasing estimator capacity. On all 1,411 DOTA-v1.0 images degraded using our physically motivated forward model, AstraMoE-SR is the only evaluated method to outperform the no-restoration baseline across every fidelity metric, improving on StableSR by 0.64 dB PSNR, 15.2% LPIPS, and 0.091 DINO feature similarity. Reconstructions conditioned on predicted trajectories differ negligibly from those using ground-truth trajectories, indicating that the estimates retain the degradation information required for effective restoration.

AI.tldr: 提出AstraMoE-SR，通过将推扫式成像退化重参数化为局部曝光轨迹，利用条件扩散模型估计轨迹并引导潜空间扩散骨干，实现单幅图像的运动模糊与空间分辨率联合恢复。
AI.motivation: 推扫式卫星成像中，空间分辨率有限且平台姿态不稳定：抖动使每条扫描线在不同瞬时姿态下成像，导致空间变化的运动模糊；透视几何又使同一扰动在视场内产生不同像素位移。因此，假设空间不变核的盲复原方法和依赖辅助观测的抖动校正方法均不适用，且缺乏辅助数据。
AI.method: 提出单图像框架AstraMoE-SR，无需辅助测量，联合恢复运动模糊与空间分辨率。不估计模糊核，而是在推扫几何下把退化重参数化为局部曝光轨迹；用条件扩散模型估计轨迹分布，以避免确定性点估计造成的抖动高频过平滑；将预测轨迹通过轨迹引导的几何对齐与空间自适应重建，条件化预训练的潜空间扩散骨干。同时分析指出残余逐点轨迹误差对应固有的抖动相位模糊，增大估计器容量亦无法消除。
AI.result: 在1411幅经物理驱动前向模型退化的DOTA-v1.0图像上，AstraMoE-SR是唯一在所有保真度指标上均超过无复原基线的方法；相比StableSR提升0.64 dB PSNR、15.2% LPIPS和0.091 DINO特征相似度。基于预测轨迹与基于真值轨迹的重建差异可忽略，表明预测轨迹保留了有效复原所需的退化信息。
AI.conclusion: 以局部曝光轨迹替代模糊核估计可有效应对推扫几何下空间变化的运动模糊，条件扩散建模结合轨迹引导的潜扩散复原在单图像设定下优于现有方法，且预测轨迹质量已足够支撑复原，残余误差受固有相位模糊限制。

title: ARNAI: Artifact Removal Network based on Autoencoding and Inpainting for Robust Spinal Image Segmentation and Measurement
summary: Purpose: This study aims to develop an AI framework applicable for postoperative imaging for automated measurement of spinopelvic parameters on radiographs with robustness to the presence of spinal implants. Materials and Methods: We retrospectively reviewed lateral lumbar spine radiographs from two institutions (Internal: January 2017--December 2024; External: October 2021--September 2025). We developed the Restore, Segment, and Measure (RSM) framework, incorporating a novel Artifact Removal Network based on Autoencoding and Inpainting (ARNAI) to mitigate implant-related artifacts in postoperative radiographs. Segmentation and spinopelvic parameter (PT, LL, SS, SCA) measurement performance were assessed using Wilcoxon signed-rank tests and intraclass correlation coefficients. Results: When ARNAI was added to a recent Transformer-based segmentation model, FCBFormer, the mean DSC increased to 0.870 from 0.814, with marked gains at L3--L5 and smaller improvements at L1--L2. On 91 radiographs with implants, the mean L4--L5 segmental Cobb angle error decreased to 4.7 ° from 15.6--16.2 °, an average error reduction of 70%. The ICC for L4--L5 segmental Cobb angle improved to 0.54 (Rater 1) and 0.59 (Rater 2) from 0.18, and ICCs for pelvic tilt, lumbar lordosis, and sacral slope all exceeded 0.70. The improvement in L4--L5 segmental Cobb angle error was statistically significant in the internal implant-containing cohort after correction for multiple comparisons. Conclusion: The proposed RSM framework improved automated spinopelvic parameter measurement in implant-containing postoperative radiographs. By mitigating implant-related artifacts, ARNAI improved segmentation and downstream measurement accuracy, with the greatest benefit observed for L4--L5 segmental Cobb angle estimation, where the mean error was reduced by approximately 70%.

AI.tldr: 提出RSM框架，含ARNAI去伪影网络，提升含内固定腰椎X线片上脊柱骨盆参数的自动测量精度。
AI.motivation: 术后腰椎X线片常含金属内固定伪影，干扰分割与脊柱骨盆参数自动测量，现有方法鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: 回顾双中心侧位腰椎X线片（内部2017.01–2024.12；外部2021.10–2025.09），构建"修复-分割-测量"（RSM）框架，其核心为基于自编码与图像修复的伪影去除网络ARNAI；以Transformer分割模型FCBFormer为基线，采用Wilcoxon符号秩检验与组内相关系数（ICC）评估分割及PT、LL、SS、SCA测量性能。
AI.result: 加入ARNAI后FCBFormer平均DSC由0.814升至0.870，L3–L5提升显著、L1–L2较小；91例含内固定片L4–L5节段Cobb角平均误差由15.6–16.2°降至4.7°（约降70%）；其ICC由0.18升至0.54/0.59，PT、LL、SS的ICC均>0.70；内部含内固定队列中该误差改善经多重比较校正后具统计学意义。
AI.conclusion: RSM框架通过ARNAI抑制内固定相关伪影，改善分割与下游测量精度，尤其显著降低L4–L5节段Cobb角误差，适用于含内固定的术后影像自动测量。

title: LoGAN: Multilingual Font Localization with Generative Agents
summary: Localizing a font into new languages is a highly intricate task requiring precise design adaptation of glyphs, color/texture, and spacing/kerning, from source to target languages. Most existing methods focus on single glyph generation with limited capability in handling multilingual font rendering. In this work, we propose LoGAN, a VLM-based agentic framework for few-shot multilingual font localization, which takes in a small number of individual glyphs from a font or letters from a logo and uses them to generate complete character sets in other languages. LoGAN breaks down this task into multiple components: a glyph-level diffusion model, a style finetuning module, a spacing and kerning transfer algorithm, and a texture expansion model, with a VLM agent coordinator. LoGAN achieves broad language coverage for font localization with various styles, including Chinese/Korean/Japanese (CJK). We evaluate our approach on both font and real-world logo datasets spanning more than 27 languages and compare it against both specialized font generation and state-of-the-art image editing models with strong text rendering capabilities (e.g., FLUX, Nano-Banana). Our approach yields higher glyph fidelity while maintaining better style, texture, and kerning consistency according to both quantitative and qualitative evaluations.

AI.tldr: 提出LoGAN，一个基于VLM的智能体框架，用于少样本多语言字体本地化，从少量字形或Logo字母生成其他语言的完整字符集。
AI.motivation: 字体本地化需精确迁移字形、颜色纹理与字距，任务复杂；现有方法多聚焦单一字形生成，多语言字体渲染能力有限。
AI.method: LoGAN将任务分解为字形级扩散模型、风格微调模块、字距与kerning迁移算法、纹理扩展模型，并由VLM智能体协调，实现少样本生成。
AI.result: 在覆盖27种以上语言的字体与真实Logo数据集上，与专用字体生成及FLUX、Nano-Banana等先进图像编辑模型相比，字形保真度更高，风格、纹理与字距一致性更优。
AI.conclusion: LoGAN通过多组件与VLM协调实现了广泛语言（含CJK）的字体本地化，在定量与定性评估中均优于现有方法。

title: Aha-Flow Distillation: Flow Markers Matter in LLM Reasoning
summary: We identify the Flow Moment, a reasoning pattern characterized by sustained, process-confirming verbalizations such as I'm doing, in contrast to the revision- and backtracking-oriented Aha Moment. We refer to their corresponding linguistic expressions as Flow Markers and Aha Markers, respectively. Based on this observation, we construct Flow-CoT by rewriting the discourse markers of original reasoning traces while preserving their underlying reasoning content, and use it as auxiliary supervision for on-policy self-distillation (OPSD). We further propose \textbf{Aha-Flow Distillation (AFD)}, a dual-mode extension of OPSD that pairs different forms of privileged information with corresponding reasoning instructions. The Aha branch retains concise solution-based supervision, while the Flow branch introduces rewritten Flow-CoT under a direct and confident reasoning instruction. At inference time, the model uses only the standard reflective instruction, so Flow-style reasoning serves purely as a training signal. Experiments on AIME25 and HMMT25 show consistent improvements across Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-4B: AFD improves Avg@12 from 60.8 to 61.3 on Qwen3-8B and from 57.5 to 58.6 on Qwen3-4B over our reproduced OPSD baselines. Controlled ablations further show that, with the same Flow-CoT/Aha-CoT composition, dual-mode training improves Avg@12 from 59.5 to 60.1, indicating that the benefit comes not only from introducing heterogeneous reasoning supervision, but also from how it is organized during self-distillation. The code is available at https://github.com/Wang-Xiaodong1899/Aha-Flow-Distillation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Flow Moment（持续过程确认型推理模式）与Aha Moment（修订回溯型推理模式）的概念，并据此构建Flow-CoT作为辅助监督，用于在线策略自蒸馏，进一步提出双模式蒸馏方法AFD，在AIME25和HMMT25上取得稳定提升。
AI.motivation: 现有推理模型的自蒸馏与思维链监督多依赖单一的反思—回溯式推理模式（Aha Moment），而忽视了另一种持续、过程确认式的推理模式（Flow Moment）。作者希望利用两种异质推理模式的差异化组织方式，提升自蒸馏效果。
AI.method: 1）识别Flow Moment与Aha Moment两种推理模式，并定义对应的Flow Markers与Aha Markers；2）通过重写原始推理痕迹的话语标记、保留推理内容，构建Flow-CoT；3）将Flow-CoT作为在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）的辅助监督；4）提出Aha-Flow Distillation（AFD），为不同特权信息配对相应推理指令——Aha分支保留简洁的基于解答的监督，Flow分支引入重写Flow-CoT并配以直接自信的推理指令；5）推理时仅使用标准反思式指令，Flow式推理仅作训练信号。
AI.result: 在AIME25和HMMT25上，Qwen3-8B与Qwen3-4B均取得一致提升：相比复现的OPSD基线，AFD将Qwen3-8B的Avg@12从60.8提升至61.3，将Qwen3-4B从57.5提升至58.6。受控消融显示，在相同Flow-CoT/Aha-CoT组成下，双模式训练将Avg@12从59.5提升至60.1，说明收益不仅来自引入异质推理监督，也来自其在自蒸馏过程中的组织方式。
AI.conclusion: 异质推理监督（Flow与Aha两种模式）及其在自蒸馏中的组织方式均对模型推理能力提升有贡献；AFD作为一种双模式自蒸馏扩展方法，在多个模型与基准上验证了有效性，且Flow式推理仅在训练阶段发挥作用，不影响推理时的标准反思式指令。

title: FreqDoor: A Hidden Trojan in the Frequency Domain for Backdoor Attacks on Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have recently shown excellent progress in open-ended image-to-text generation. However, their multimodal nature makes them persistently vulnerable to backdoor attacks. Existing backdoor triggers for VLMs are either spatial, textual, or bimodal, which may yield localized or recognizable trigger patterns. In this work, we explore a different attack surface and propose \ textsc {FreqDoor}, a training-time backdoor attack that implants triggers in the frequency domain. \ textsc {FreqDoor} mixes amplitude-spectrum components from a trigger-source image selectively while preserving the phase of a clean image to generate a spatially distributed and visually imperceptible trigger without modifying the textual input. We evaluate the attack on BLIP-2, InstructBLIP, and LLaVA for image captioning and visual question answering. On Flickr8k, \ textsc {FreqDoor} achieves attack success rates of $99.6\%$, $99.8\%$, and $98.4\%$ on the three models, respectively, while preserving the semantic quality of the generated captions. On VQAv2, the corresponding attack success rates are $99.6\%$, $92.4\%$, and $79.6\%$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FreqDoor，一种在频域植入触发器的训练期后门攻击，对 BLIP-2、InstructBLIP 和 LLaVA 在图像描述与视觉问答任务上实现高攻击成功率，同时保持生成文本的语义质量。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在开放式图像到文本生成中进展显著，但其多模态特性使其持续易受后门攻击。现有针对 VLM 的后门触发器多为空间域、文本域或双模态，容易产生局部化或可识别的触发模式，因此需要探索新的攻击面。
AI.method: 提出 FreqDoor，一种训练期后门攻击，将触发器植入频域。该方法选择性地混合来自触发源图像的幅度谱分量，同时保留干净图像的相位，从而生成空间分布、视觉上不可察觉的触发器，且不修改文本输入。
AI.result: 在 BLIP-2、InstructBLIP、LLaVA 三个模型上评估图像描述与视觉问答任务。在 Flickr8k 上攻击成功率分别为 99.6%、99.8%、98.4%，同时保持生成描述语义质量；在 VQAv2 上攻击成功率分别为 99.6%、92.4%、79.6%。
AI.conclusion: 频域触发器为 VLM 提供了一种空间分布且视觉不可察觉的新型后门攻击面，在多种模型与任务上取得高攻击成功率，揭示了频域后门对 VLM 的严重威胁。

title: Large Discrete Policy: Advancing Explicit Behavior Modeling with Stochastic Iterative Scoring
summary: Behavior policies are often formulated as continuous generative models, whose iterative denoising processes are expressive but difficult to interpret and prone to producing implausible actions. We propose the Large Discrete Policy (LDiP), a fully discrete behavior modeling framework that selects actions from a large vocabulary of physically plausible candidates. Rather than perturbing actions, LDiP improves expressivity through stochastic iterative scoring: it progressively re-scores and prunes candidates with score-space stochasticity, enabling fine-grained ranking and exploration among plausible actions while preserving an explicit decision process. Across end-to-end planning, closed-loop driving, robotic manipulation, and vision-language-action settings, LDiP consistently outperforms strong discrete and continuous baselines in autonomous driving, and exceeds or matches continuous generative policies in robotic manipulation. These results show that discrete policies, when equipped with effective scoring mechanisms, offer an expressive, plausible, and interpretable alternative for behavior modeling. Project website: https://zhenxinli.net/LargeDiscretePolicy/.

AI.tldr: 提出LDiP，一种完全离散的行为建模框架，通过在大规模物理可行动作词表上进行随机迭代评分与剪枝，实现富有表现力、物理可行且可解释的策略。
AI.motivation: 连续生成式行为策略（如基于迭代去噪的扩散/流匹配模型）虽表达能力强，但其迭代去噪过程难以解释，且容易生成物理上不可行的动作。作者希望保留生成模型的表达能力，同时获得可解释的显式决策过程与物理可行性。
AI.method: 构建完全离散的行为建模框架LDiP：从大规模物理可行候选动作词表中选择动作；不通过扰动动作来提升表达力，而是采用随机迭代评分机制——在评分空间中引入随机性，对候选动作逐步重打分与剪枝，从而在可行动作集合内实现细粒度排序与探索，并保持显式的决策过程。
AI.result: 在端到端规划、闭环驾驶、机器人操作以及视觉-语言-动作（VLA）等任务上，LDiP在自动驾驶中一致优于强离散与连续基线；在机器人操作中超过或持平连续生成式策略。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，当配备有效的评分机制时，离散策略可作为兼具表达力、物理可行性与可解释性的行为建模替代方案，为行为策略设计提供新思路。

title: A Hyperbolicity Atlas of Large Language Model Hidden States
summary: LLM hidden states are ordinary vectors, but the distances among those vectors may still show hierarchical structure. To our knowledge, this paper is the first systematic study of whether prompt-token hidden states in contemporary LLMs exhibit Gromov Hyperbolicity (GH), a distance-based measure of tree-likeness. Using 818,904 sample-layer measurements from ten open-weight models across MATH500, HumanEval, WinoGrande, and TruthfulQA, we build a GH map over four axes: parameter scale, layer depth, model family, and input domain. The clearest pattern is depth, not scale: middle layers usually form a high-relative-hyperbolicity plateau, while final layers often become substantially more tree-like. Scale effects are weak and non-monotonic, matched 7/8B model families differ strongly, and domains interact with model specialization. These findings make GH useful as a practical diagnostic: it shows where hierarchical distance structure appears, how specialization changes it, and which model-layer-domain comparisons deserve closer analysis.

AI.tldr: 该文首次系统研究当代LLM中提示词token隐状态的Gromov双曲性（GH），基于10个开放权重模型、4个数据集、818,904个样本-层测量，绘制了参数规模、层深、模型家族、输入域四轴GH图谱。核心发现：层深而非规模是最清晰的影响因素，中间层呈高相对双曲性平台，末层更接近树状。
AI.motivation: LLM隐状态是普通向量，但其向量间距离可能仍具层次结构。作者希望验证当代LLM的提示词token隐状态是否表现出Gromov双曲性（一种基于距离的树状性度量），并系统刻画其在不同维度上的变化规律。
AI.method: 使用来自10个开放权重模型、覆盖MATH500、HumanEval、WinoGrande、TruthfulQA四个数据集的818,904个样本-层测量，构建沿四个轴（参数规模、层深、模型家族、输入域）的GH图谱。
AI.result: 最清晰的模式是层深而非规模：中间层通常形成高相对双曲性平台，最终层往往显著更接近树状结构。规模效应弱且非单调；相同规模的7/8B模型家族之间差异显著；不同输入域与模型专业化存在交互作用。
AI.conclusion: GH可作为实用诊断工具：它能揭示层次化距离结构出现的位置、专业化如何改变这种结构，以及哪些模型-层-域组合值得进一步深入分析。

title: CNsEMD: An Expert-Annotated Multi-Field-Strength MRI Dataset and a Hyperspherical Manifold Network for Multimodal Cranial Nerve Parcellation
summary: Cranial nerves (CNs) play essential roles in sensory, motor, and autonomic functions. Accurate CN parcellation from multimodal magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is crucial for neuroanatomical analysis and neurosurgical planning. However, accurate CN parcellation remains extremely challenging because CNs are very small, exhibit low image contrast, and have slender tubular morphologies and complex anatomical trajectories. Moreover, the lack of publicly available, expert-annotated datasets has impeded the development and fair benchmarking of learning-based CN analysis methods. In this work, we introduce CNsEMD, an expert-annotated multimodal dataset for CN parcellation. It comprises data from 202 subjects acquired on 3T, 5T, and 7T MRI scanners. We further propose the projective hyperspherical manifold network (PHM-Net), which learns cross-modal representations by capturing angular relationships in a shared hyperspherical embedding space. Rather than performing multimodal fusion in Euclidean space, the proposed Hyperspherical cross-modal interaction (HCI) module enables bidirectional feature exchange between T1-weighted (T1w) and direction-encoded color (DEC) representations on a unit hypersphere. The Magnitude-preserving projective hyperspherical orientation representation (PHOR) captures the axial nature of DEC orientations while preserving diffusion magnitude. The hyperspherical prototype segmentation head (HPSH) further extends angular similarity to voxel-wise classification using normalized voxel embeddings and learnable class prototypes. Extensive experimental results on the CNsEMD dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of our PHM-Net against state-of-the-art methods. CNsEMD establishes a reproducible benchmark for multimodal CN imaging, while PHM-Net provides a geometry-consistent solution for CN parcellation across diverse MRI acquisitions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出专家标注的多模态颅神经数据集CNsEMD，并设计了投射超球流形网络PHM-Net，通过在超球面嵌入空间捕获跨模态角度关系实现颅神经分割，在多种MRI场强下优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 颅神经对感觉、运动及自主神经功能至关重要，其精确分割对神经解剖分析和神经外科手术规划意义重大。但颅神经体积微小、图像对比度低、呈细长管状形态且解剖轨迹复杂，分割极具挑战；同时缺乏公开的专家标注数据集，阻碍了基于学习的颅神经分析方法的发展与公平评测。
AI.method: 1) 构建CNsEMD数据集：涵盖202名受试者、3T/5T/7T多场强MRI的专家标注多模态数据。2) 提出投射超球流形网络PHM-Net，在共享超球嵌入空间中捕获角度关系以学习跨模态表征：HCI模块在单位超球面上实现T1w与DEC表征的双向特征交换；PHOR保留DEC方向的轴向特性并保持扩散幅值；HPSH通过归一化体素嵌入与可学习类原型，将角度相似度扩展到体素级分类。
AI.result: 在CNsEMD数据集上的大量实验表明，PHM-Net相比当前最优方法具有显著有效性。
AI.conclusion: CNsEMD为多模态颅神经成像建立了可复现的评测基准，PHM-Net为跨不同MRI采集条件下的颅神经分割提供了几何一致的解决方案。

title: SpatialBlock: Enhancing Spatial Intelligence in LVLMs via Synthetic Block-Stacking Problem
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved strong performance on diverse visual tasks, yet their ability to reconstruct and reason about the 3D structure of the scene depicted in 2D images -- referred to as spatial intelligence -- remains limited. Existing approaches attempt to address this gap by using real-scene spatial question answering datasets that require dense geometric annotations. However, constructing such labels is costly, time-consuming, and often noisy due to reliance on external perception modules. In this work, we propose a novel paradigm inspired by human cognitive development: learning foundational spatial skills through structured block-manipulation tasks. We introduce SpatialBlock-15k, a synthetic dataset of 15,000 block-stacking problems covering 3D-to-2D projection, viewpoint transformation, and structural combination. The dataset further incorporates controlled color modulation as visual cues to encourage anchor-based reasoning in visually complex conditions. Experiments demonstrate that LVLMs trained on our dataset through either direct answering or reasoning-based prediction significantly outperform baselines and generalize to real-world spatial tasks, despite the dataset's synthetic and compact nature. Code and data are available at https://github.com/rsoohyun/SpatialBlock.

AI.tldr: 提出SpatialBlock-15k合成积木数据集，以认知发展启发的方式训练LVLM基础空间技能，显著提升空间推理并泛化到真实任务。
AI.motivation: LVLM在2D图像上的空间智能（重建与推理3D结构）仍然有限。现有方法依赖真实场景空间问答数据集，需要密集几何标注，构建成本高、耗时长，且因依赖外部感知模块而存在噪声。
AI.method: 受人类认知发展启发，通过结构化积木操作任务学习基础空间技能。构建SpatialBlock-15k合成数据集，包含15,000个积木堆叠问题，覆盖3D-to-2D投影、视角变换、结构组合三类任务；并引入受控颜色调制作为视觉线索，促进视觉复杂条件下的基于锚点的推理。采用直接回答与基于推理的预测两种方式训练LVLM。
AI.result: 在所提数据集上训练的LVLM显著优于基线，并能泛化到真实世界空间任务，尽管数据集为合成且规模紧凑。
AI.conclusion: 结构化积木操作任务的合成数据可有效培养LVLM的基础空间技能，是替代昂贵真实密集标注范式的可行路径。代码与数据已开源。

title: Continuous Token-Level Spatio-Temporal Context Modeling for Visual Object Tracking
summary: Spatio-temporal context has become increasingly crucial for visual tracking. However, most existing approaches extract spatio-temporal cues via discrete sampling strategies, which inherently deviate from the continuity of spatio-temporal context, thereby deteriorating tracking performance. To address this challenge, we propose TLCTrack, a novel tracking framework that models token-level spatio-temporal context through continuously updated salient tokens, enabling more accurate target representation. Specifically, TLCTrack incorporates three components: Masked Unidirectional Attention (MUA), Spatial Salient Token Collection (SSTC), and Temporal Salient Token Bank (TSTB) modules. By explicitly integrating spatio-temporal context, MUA extracts discriminative targetaware spatial features in the search region. To avoid the negative impact of background on feature learning, SSTC progressively suppresses background interference, thereby enhancing target spatial representation. Finally, TSTB captures high-quality spatio-temporal information through continuous salient token updates. Extensive experiments on five benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves superior performance over state-of-the-art trackers. Code and models are available at https://github.com/xiading123/TLCTrack.

AI.tldr: 提出TLCTrack跟踪框架，通过连续更新的显著性token建模token级时空上下文，避免离散采样偏差，在五个基准上超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: 时空上下文对视觉跟踪日益关键，但现有方法多通过离散采样策略提取时空线索，本质上偏离了时空上下文的连续性，导致跟踪性能下降。
AI.method: 框架包含三个模块：掩码单向注意力（MUA）显式整合时空上下文，提取搜索区域中具有判别性的目标感知空间特征；空间显著Token收集（SSTC）逐步抑制背景干扰，增强目标空间表征；时序显著Token库（TSTB）通过持续更新的显著token捕获高质量时空信息。
AI.result: 在五个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法性能优于当前最先进的跟踪器。
AI.conclusion: 以连续更新的token级时空上下文建模替代离散采样，可有效提升目标表征与跟踪精度；代码与模型已开源。

title: Detect Anything in Graphic Design: Element-Level Rewards for Autoregressive Detection
summary: Graphic designs, such as posters, advertisements, and infographics, are an important medium for communicating information and shaping understanding. Unlike natural images, they consist of layered elements with explicit compositional order. However, existing object detection models treat these elements as an unordered set, leaving compositional order unexploited. To address this limitation, we present Detect Anything in Graphic Design (DAD), a model that formulates graphic design detection as compositional deconstruction. It decodes elements in compositional order, using lower-layer elements to better detect higher-layer ones. The key feature of DAD is amodal detection, which predicts the full bounding box of each element, including regions occluded by elements placed above it. Building on this formulation, we propose Element Relative Policy Optimization (EleRPO), which extends GRPO from sequence-level supervision to element-level optimization. EleRPO provides fine-grained training signals that capture how each detected element contributes to overall detection quality, and works synergistically with compositional order to improve detection performance. To support training and evaluation, we build a dataset of 10 million graphic designs. Experiments show that DAD outperforms all baselines and achieves human-level performance in amodal detection, supporting effective image-to-layer decomposition.
