EleRPO consistently improves over GRPO across nine detection benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DAD模型,将平面设计检测形式化为"构图式解构",按图层顺序解码元素,并利用amodal检测预测被遮挡元素的完整边界框;同时提出EleRPO优化方法,在元素级提供细粒度训练信号。实验表明DAD在amodal检测上达到人类水平,EleRPO在九个基准上稳定优于GRPO。
AI.motivation: 平面设计(如海报、广告、信息图)由具有明确构图顺序的图层化元素构成,与自然图像不同。然而现有目标检测模型将这些元素视为无序集合,忽略了构图顺序这一重要信息。因此需要一种能够利用图层顺序、并处理元素遮挡关系的检测方法。
AI.method: 提出DAD(Detect Anything in Graphic Design)模型,将平面设计检测建模为构图式解构,按构图顺序解码元素,用低层元素辅助检测高层元素;核心特性是amodal检测,预测每个元素被上层元素遮挡部分的完整边界框。此外提出EleRPO(Element Relative Policy Optimization),将GRPO从序列级监督扩展到元素级优化,提供细粒度训练信号,刻画每个检测元素对整体检测质量的贡献,并与构图顺序协同工作。同时构建了包含1000万平面设计的数据集。
AI.result: DAD在所有基线方法中表现最优,在amodal检测上达到人类水平,有效支持图像到图层的分解。EleRPO在九个检测基准上一致优于GRPO。
AI.conclusion: 通过将平面设计检测形式化为构图式解构并结合amodal检测与元素级优化,可有效利用图层顺序信息,提升检测性能并实现接近人类的amodal检测能力,为图像到图层分解提供了有效方案。

title: One for All: Generalist Foundation Model for Cross-Sensor Skeleton Representation Learning
comment: Please visit our project page at https://kaist-viclab.github.io/SOfA_site/
summary: For learning generalizable motion representations from large-scale unlabeled data, Self-supervised learning (SSL) has become a widely adopted methodology. However, existing approaches are primarily limited by the inherent heterogeneity of skeleton data---characterized by varying joint counts, indexing protocols, and topological structures across different sensors---which typically necessitates training separate, sensor-specific, or even entirely dataset-specific models. To overcome this, we introduce SOfA (Skeleton One for All), the first generalist foundation model designed to achieve sensor-unified skeleton representation learning across diverse sensors. To accommodate the dimensional gap caused by varying joint counts, we introduce a fixed-size set of learnable Canonical Joint Slots, acting as a universal vessel that seamlessly accommodates arbitrary skeletal topologies. SOfA fills these slots via an attention mechanism that dynamically aggregates skeletal information from sensor-specific inputs. Furthermore, we resolve joint index misalignment between various sensors by introducing a Semantic Joint Embedding derived from a pre-trained text encoder, rather than relying on absolute positional embeddings. To validate our approach, we standardized ten 3D skeleton datasets for unified training. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SOfA can serve as a truly universal encoder, achieving state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance across a wide range of downstream tasks and sensor types, often outperforming dataset-specific specialist models with a single foundation model.

AI.tldr: 提出SOfA——首个实现跨传感器统一骨架表征学习的通用基座模型，通过可学习的规范关节槽与语义关节嵌入解决关节数量与索引异质性问题，单一模型在10个标准化3D骨架数据集上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有骨架自监督学习方法受限于骨架数据的固有异质性：不同传感器在关节数量、索引协议与拓扑结构上各不相同，通常需要为每种传感器甚至每个数据集单独训练模型，缺乏通用性。
AI.method: 1）引入固定大小的可学习"规范关节槽"（Canonical Joint Slots）作为通用容器，通过注意力机制动态聚合传感器特定输入的骨架信息，以容纳任意维度的骨架拓扑；2）用预训练文本编码器生成的"语义关节嵌入"替代绝对位置嵌入，解决不同传感器间的关节索引错位问题；3）标准化10个3D骨架数据集进行统一训练。
AI.result: SOfA可作为真正的通用编码器，在多种下游任务和传感器类型上达到SOTA性能，其单一基座模型常能超越针对特定数据集训练的专家模型。
AI.conclusion: SOfA验证了构建传感器统一的骨架基座模型的可行性，为跨传感器、跨数据集的通用运动表征学习提供了新范式。

title: Comparing Self-Supervised and Domain-Invariant Features for Cross-Domain Voice Phishing Detection
summary: Voice phishing detection faces three critical challenges: real criminal recordings are unavailable due to privacy constraints; when available, only a handful of samples exist, insufficient for fine-tuning; and lightweight acoustic-only detection is needed as an alternative to large self-supervised models. We compare domain-invariant prosodic features and self-supervised representations (HuBERT, wav2vec2.0) through cross-domain evaluation-training on scenario-based actor recordings and testing on authentic criminal calls. Domain-invariant prosodic features achieve 69.5% F1 zero-shot and 71.0% with 5-shot learning. HuBERT achieves highest performance (94.2% F1, 5-shot), while wav2vec2.0 exhibits a precision-oriented detection profile (90.2% F1 with 99.4% precision, 5-shot). These findings reveal fundamental trade-offs: domain-invariant features enable zero-shot deployment when no real data exists, while SSL methods achieve higher performance but require real samples and compute.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对语音钓鱼（voice phishing）检测中真实犯罪录音稀缺的问题，对比了域不变韵律特征与自监督表示（HuBERT、wav2vec2.0）在跨域评测下的表现，揭示了两者在零样本部署与高性能检测之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 语音钓鱼检测面临三大挑战：因隐私限制无法获取真实犯罪录音；即便获取到，样本量也极少，不足以微调；并且需要轻量级的纯声学检测方法，作为大型自监督模型的替代方案。
AI.method: 采用跨域评测策略：在基于情景的演员录音上进行训练，在真实犯罪通话上进行测试，对比域不变韵律特征与自监督表示（HuBERT、wav2vec2.0）的检测效果。
AI.result: 域不变韵律特征实现69.5% F1（零样本）和71.0% F1（5-shot）；HuBERT性能最高（94.2% F1，5-shot）；wav2vec2.0呈现偏精确率的检测特征（90.2% F1，精确率99.4%，5-shot）。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了根本性权衡：当缺乏真实数据时，域不变特征支持零样本部署；而自监督学习方法虽能达到更高性能，但需要真实样本和计算资源。

title: SupGRPO: Enhancing GRPO with Matching-based Online SFT for Text Spotting
summary: Text spotting requires both accurate text recognition and precise spatial localization. Current specialised spotters excel at predicting tight bounding boxes in natural scenes, but falter on complex or artistic text, whereas multimodal large language models (MLLMs) possess strong recognition capabilities yet remain weak at localisation. To equip the text spotter with general and powerful recognition capabilities and to maximize its localization ability, we explore two MLLM-based fine-tuning methods: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning fine-tuning based on Group Relative Policy Optimisation (GRPO). An interesting finding is that SFT is less effective than GRPO at enhancing recognition, while GRPO is less effective than SFT at enhancing detection. To compensate for each other's shortcomings, we introduce a joint training strategy, SupGRPO, which simultaneously optimizes the model using both SFT and GRPO. SupGRPO employs the specially designed reward functions and develops a matching-based online SFT applied solely to coordinate tokens. It both mitigates the reward sparsity problem of GRPO and avoids the instance order dependency problem of SFT. To evaluate particularly challenging cases, we curate ATS, a dataset for artistic text spotting. Experiments demonstrate that SupGRPO improves both text recognition and detection, and attains superior performance. Our code and dataset will be released at https://github.com/Psycho-9/SupGRPO.

AI.tldr: 论文提出SupGRPO联合训练策略，结合SFT与GRPO微调MLLM，同时提升文本识别与定位能力，并构建艺术文本检测数据集ATS。
AI.motivation: 现有专用文本检测器在自然场景中能预测紧致边界框，但在复杂或艺术文本上表现不佳；而多模态大语言模型（MLLM）识别能力强但定位能力弱。作者希望同时赋予文本检测器通用强大的识别能力并最大化其定位能力。
AI.method: 探索两种基于MLLM的微调方法：监督微调（SFT）和基于组相对策略优化（GRPO）的强化学习微调。发现SFT提升识别效果不如GRPO，而GRPO提升检测效果不如SFT。为此提出联合训练策略SupGRPO，同时使用SFT和GRPO优化模型，设计专用奖励函数，并提出仅作用于坐标token的匹配式在线SFT，以缓解GRPO的奖励稀疏问题和SFT的实例顺序依赖问题。同时构建艺术文本检测数据集ATS用于评估。
AI.result: 实验表明SupGRPO同时提升文本识别与检测性能，取得更优表现。代码与数据集将在https://github.com/Psycho-9/SupGRPO发布。
AI.conclusion: SupGRPO通过联合SFT与GRPO，兼顾识别与定位，缓解各自缺陷，是一种有效的MLLM文本检测微调方案。

title: Single Image to Textured 3D Object Generation in Frequency Domain: From Theory to Pipeline
summary: Single-view 3D reconstruction, also known as image-to-3D, is a persistently challenging task due to the extreme lack of information. Recently, diffusion models pre-trained on large-scale datasets served as 2D priors are used to solve the ill-posed task but suffer from color deviation and view inconsistency, which can be curbed by using diffusion models fine-tuned with 3D annotated data served as 3D priors. However, 3D priors lack high-frequency details, which cannot be solved by direct complementation with 2D priors in spatial domain for introducing erroneous low-frequency 2D prior guidance. In this paper, we revisit the characteristics of different diffusion priors from the frequency perspective. Based on our observations, we theoretically present a unified framework of hybrid optimization using multiple diffusion priors in frequency domain. Under this framework, we further propose Morpheus3D, a pipeline of 3D object generation from any single unposed image in the wild. Morpheus3D enhances 3D prior with high-pass image-prompt 2D prior guidance to reconstruct high-quality 3D objects while effectively suppressing view inconsistency, low-frequency color deviation, and high-frequency lacking problems. Both quantitative and qualitative experiments on the public and our collected datasets with complex textures show that our method exhibits significant improvements in generation quality.

AI.tldr: 本文从频率视角重新审视2D与3D扩散先验的特性，提出频域下多先验混合优化的统一框架，并据此设计了Morpheus3D，实现从野外任意单张无位姿图像生成高质量3D物体。
AI.motivation: 单视图3D重建（image-to-3D）因信息极度匮乏而极具挑战。基于大规模数据预训练的2D扩散先验虽能求解该病态问题，却存在颜色偏差与视角不一致；用3D标注数据微调的3D先验可缓解上述问题，但缺乏高频细节。直接在空间域用2D先验补充会引入错误的低频2D先验引导，无法解决高频缺失问题，因此需要从频率角度重新审视不同扩散先验的特性。
AI.method: 作者从频率视角分析不同扩散先验的特性，理论上提出一个在频域中融合多种扩散先验的混合优化统一框架。在该框架下提出Morpheus3D流水线：以高通图像提示（high-pass image-prompt）形式的2D先验引导来增强3D先验。
AI.result: Morpheus3D在重建高质量3D物体的同时，有效抑制了视角不一致、低频颜色偏差和高频缺失问题。在公开数据集及自建的复杂纹理数据集上，定量与定性实验均显示生成质量有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 从频率域统一混合多种扩散先验是一种有效的优化思路；Morpheus3D验证了3D先验结合高通2D图像提示引导可在单张无位姿图像输入下生成高质量、视角一致的3D物体。

title: Conditioned Initialization for Attention
summary: Transformers are a dominant architecture in modern machine learning, powering applications across vision, language, and beyond. At the core of their success lies the attention layer, where the query, key, and value matrices determine how token dependencies are captured. While considerable work has focused on scaling and optimizing Transformers, comparatively little attention has been paid to how the weights of the queries, keys and values are initialized. Common practice relies on random initialization or alternatives such as mimetic initialization, which imitates weight patterns from converged models, and weight selection, which transfers weights from a teacher model. In this paper, we argue that initialization can introduce an optimization bias that fundamentally shapes training dynamics. We propose conditioned initialization, a principled scheme that initializes attention weights to improve the spectral properties of the attention layer. Theoretically, we show that conditioned initialization can potentially reduce the condition number of the attention Jacobian, leading to more stable optimization. Empirically, it accelerates convergence and improves generalization across diverse applications, highlighting conditioning as a critical yet underexplored area for advancing Transformer performance. Importantly, conditioned initialization is simple to apply and integrates seamlessly into a wide range of Transformer architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"条件初始化"（conditioned initialization），通过初始化注意力权重来改善注意力层的谱性质，从而降低注意力雅可比矩阵的条件数，加速收敛并提升泛化性能。
AI.motivation: Transformer的核心在于注意力层，其中query、key、value矩阵决定token依赖关系的捕获。尽管大量工作关注Transformer的扩展与优化，但对Q、K、V权重初始化方式的关注相对不足，常见做法仍依赖随机初始化、模仿初始化或从教师模型迁移的权重选择。作者认为初始化会引入优化偏置，从根本上影响训练动态。
AI.method: 提出条件初始化（conditioned initialization），一种有原则的初始化方案，将注意力权重初始化为改善注意力层谱性质的值；该方案简单易用，可无缝集成到多种Transformer架构中。
AI.result: 理论上证明条件初始化能降低注意力雅可比矩阵的条件数，带来更稳定的优化；实验上在不同应用中加速收敛并提升泛化性能。
AI.conclusion: 条件化是提升Transformer性能的一个关键但尚未充分探索的方向，条件初始化为其提供了简单而有效的实现途径。

title: Where to Look and What to Use: Retrieve-Localize-Generate for Long-Term Conversational Memory Question Answering
comment: 22 pages, 4 figures, 14 tables. Accepted to the EMNLP 2026 Main Conference
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) enables large language models (LLMs) to answer questions by accessing external knowledge and has been widely adopted for long-term conversational memory question answering. However, existing methods suffer from two key challenges: (1) fragmented evidence scattered across temporally distant sessions, and (2) noisy content within retrieved sessions that triggers the lost-in-the-middle effect. To address these challenges, we propose MemLoc, a unified Retrieve-Localize-Generate framework for long-term conversational memory QA. For retrieval, MemLoc decomposes each session into multi-granularity memory units and performs query routing via an inner-memory graph with entropy-based granularity selection. It further models cross-session semantic and temporal dependencies through a cross-memory graph, enabling coarse-to-fine retrieval of top-K relevant memory candidates. For localization, we introduce a reasoning-based evidence locator trained with Self-reflective Hint Policy Optimization (SHPO), which performs progressive refinement by extracting query-relevant fragments within memory units to suppress noise and reranking across candidates to remove redundancy, producing a compact evidence set with lightweight location IDs. For generation, these IDs act as precise grounding signals that guide the LLM to the correct memory positions, mitigating the lost-in-the-middle effect while preserving original contextual integrity. Extensive experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate that MemLoc achieves state-of-the-art retrieval accuracy and response quality while maintaining efficiency. Our code is available at: https://github.com/Nikol-coder/MemLoc.

AI.tldr: 提出MemLoc统一框架，通过“检索-定位-生成”解决长期对话记忆问答中跨会话证据碎片化与噪声干扰问题，实现SOTA检索与回答质量。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG方法用于长期对话记忆问答时面临两大挑战：（1）证据碎片化分散在时间上相距较远的会话中；（2）检索到的会话内部存在噪声内容，触发“中间迷失”效应。
AI.method: MemLoc包含三个模块：检索阶段将会话分解为多粒度记忆单元，利用内部记忆图进行查询路由并以熵基粒度选择，同时通过跨记忆图建模跨会话语义与时间依赖，实现由粗到细的top-K候选检索；定位阶段提出基于推理的证据定位器，采用自反思提示策略优化（SHPO）训练，逐步提取查询相关片段以抑制噪声，并对候选重排序去冗余，输出紧凑证据集及轻量位置ID；生成阶段以这些ID作为精确锚定信号引导LLM定位正确记忆位置。
AI.result: 在四个基准上的大量实验表明，MemLoc在检索准确率和回答质量上达到SOTA，同时保持效率。
AI.conclusion: MemLoc通过统一的检索-定位-生成框架有效缓解证据碎片化与噪声问题，减轻中间迷失效应并保留原始上下文完整性。

title: CASCADE: A Spatio-Temporal-Causal Reasoning Representation and Dataset for Driving
summary: Reasoning is a promising route to the generalization that autonomous driving requires in the long tail, as it can infer how the elements of a scene depend on one another and traverse those dependencies to conclusions beyond what is observed. Yet it is hard to tell whether a model's conclusions follow the scene's dependencies, because no driving representation makes them explicit enough to test against. Text-based reasoning traces lack spatio-temporal grounding, spatio-temporal scene graphs lack causal links, and reasoning annotations at scale are increasingly model-generated and hard to verify. To this end, we introduce CASCADE (Causal Spatio-Temporal Analysis of Driving Environments), which encompasses two components: (1) a structured scene representation for reasoning in driving scenes and (2) a human-annotated dataset built on it. For every actor that interacts with the ego vehicle, the CASCADE representation records frame-by-frame, for as long as the actor is visible, what action is taken, where it occurs, and how it depends on the actions and states of others. The resulting structure makes reasoning predictions machine-verifiable: they can be scored against it element by element, without relying on (M)LLM judges. The CASCADE dataset provides comprehensive human annotations for 2,066 driving clips of the PhysicalAI dataset, with over 34K elements that establish the spatio-temporal and causal context of each scene, including 8.6K time-stamped ego and agent actions, 3.7K causal links and 2.9K potential influences, and 6.1K annotations for agents, objects, traffic lights, and environments. Being entirely human-annotated, CASCADE provides the reference for this comparison: benchmarking the reasoning abilities of Physical AI models, and verifying the quality of automatically generated reasoning labels. The CASCADE dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/cascade.

AI.tldr: 论文提出CASCADE，一种面向自动驾驶推理的结构化场景表示及其人类标注数据集，使推理预测可被机器逐元素验证。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶需在长尾场景中泛化，推理是很有前景的路径，因为它能推断场景元素间的依赖关系并沿依赖链得出结论。但现有表示难以判断模型结论是否遵循场景依赖：文本推理轨迹缺乏时空接地，时空场景图缺乏因果链接，而大规模推理标注多为模型生成、难以验证。
AI.method: CASCADE包含两部分：(1) 用于驾驶场景推理的结构化场景表示；(2) 基于该表示构建的人工标注数据集。对每个与自车交互的actor，在其可见期间逐帧记录所采取的动作、发生位置，以及该动作如何依赖其他actor的动作与状态。
AI.result: 该结构使推理预测可机器验证：可逐元素对照结构打分，无需依赖(M)LLM评判。CASCADE数据集为PhysicalAI数据集的2,066个驾驶片段提供全面人工标注，含超34K元素，包括8.6K时间戳化的自车与agent动作、3.7K因果链接、2.9K潜在影响，以及6.1K关于agent、物体、交通灯和环境的标注。
AI.conclusion: 由于完全人工标注，CASCADE为比较提供参照：可用于对Physical AI模型的推理能力进行基准测试，并验证自动生成推理标签的质量。数据集已公开于 https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/cascade。

title: Risk Is Not Review Value: Wrong-Answer Exposure Under Bounded Review Budgets
summary: LLM assistants often produce more answers than humans can review before users see them. Most evaluations ask whether an answer is wrong, unsupported, or low-confidence. Bounded review budgets instead ask which answers should be checked first under a fixed review budget. Risk alone is not enough: a high-risk answer may be hard to repair, while a moderately risky answer may be directly correctable from available evidence. For generated-answer evaluation, we model review prioritization as exposure reduction, where review value combines estimated wrongness, intervention affordance, impact, and cost. We evaluate review queues with Wrong-Answer Exposure Ratio (WAER), the fraction of wrong answers left unreviewed, and post-repair residual exposure (PRRE), the fraction still exposed after deterministic benchmark-supported repairs. PRRE uses repairability rules that do not numerically reuse the affordance scores used for ranking. On a 720-item TAT-QA/SciFact stress benchmark, review-value ranking keeps answer-level WAER nearly unchanged at 20% budget (0.605 vs. 0.600) but lowers PRRE from 0.881 to 0.716. These results show that trustworthy LLM evaluation should measure not only error detection, but also how limited review capacity reduces exposed wrong answers.

AI.tldr: 针对LLM生成答案审核预算有限的场景，本文提出以“暴露削减”为目标的审核优先级建模，将审核价值综合错误程度、可修复性、影响与成本；用WAER与PRRE两项指标评估。在TAT-QA/SciFact 720项压力基准上，审核价值排序在20%预算下几乎不改变WAER（0.605 vs. 0.600），却将PRRE从0.881降至0.716。
AI.motivation: LLM助手产出答案数量常超出人工可审核容量，而多数评测只判断答案是否错误、无依据或低置信，未解决“固定审核预算下应优先检查哪些答案”的问题。且单看风险不足：高风险答案可能难以修复，中等风险答案却可能依据现有证据直接改正，因此需引入兼顾可修复性的审核排序视角。
AI.method: 将生成答案评测中的审核优先化建模为暴露削减问题，审核价值由估计错误程度、干预可行性（intervention affordance）、影响与成本共同构成。以审核队列为对象，采用两种指标：WAER（未审核错误答案占比）与PRRE（经确定性基准支持修复后仍暴露的错误答案占比）；其中PRRE所用可修复性规则不复用排序时所用的可行性分数，以避免数值上的循环论证。在720项TAT-QA/SciFact压力基准上对比审核价值排序与其他排序策略。
AI.result: 在720项TAT-QA/SciFact压力基准上，20%审核预算下审核价值排序使答案级WAER几乎不变（0.605对0.600），但PRRE由0.881下降至0.716，表明其在同等预算下显著减少了修复后仍暴露的错误答案。
AI.conclusion: 可信的LLM评测不应只衡量错误检测能力，还应衡量有限审核容量在多大程度上削减了暴露的错误答案；引入可修复性的审核价值排序可在不牺牲错误检测的前提下提升暴露削减效果。

title: Ambient @ EgoProactive 2026 : Proactive Egocentric Assistance with Visually Grounded Supervision
comment: Winning solution technical report for the EgoProactive track of the ECCV 2026 Wearable AI Grand Challenge . Updated code and huggingface model / datasets link
summary: We present our submission to the EgoProactive track of the ECCV 2026 Wearable AI Challenge, which ranked first in the large-model division and second in the <=2B division. The task requires a wearable assistant to decide after each eight-second segment of egocentric video whether to intervene or remain silent. Our approach has two main components. First, we reformulate intervention timing as single-token classification. Rather than generating either $interrupt$<utterance> or $silent$, the model predicts yes or no, and we derive the decision from the renormalised probabilities of these two tokens. This formulation improved macro-F1 by 0.249 and G-mean by 0.30 over free-form generation. Second, because labelled data were limited to the released validation set, we generated additional supervision using a tool-calling video agent that inspects each clip and assigns intervention timestamps. A narration-only alternative was four times larger and ten times cheaper, but transferred worse than supervision from an unrelated real corpus, suggesting that visual grounding is more important than annotation volume for this task.

AI.tldr: 本文将可穿戴助手的干预时机判定重构为单token二分类（yes/no），并利用工具调用视频智能体生成额外监督，在ECCV 2026 Wearable AI Challenge的EgoProactive赛道中获得大模型组第一、≤2B组第二。
AI.motivation: 该任务要求可穿戴助手在每段8秒第一视角视频后决定是否介入或保持沉默，但标注数据仅限于官方发布的验证集，监督信号严重不足，因此需要同时解决决策形式与数据稀缺两个问题。
AI.method: 方法含两部分：（1）把干预时机判定重构为单token分类，不生成$interrupt$<utterance>或$silent$，而是预测yes/no，并由这两个token的重归一化概率导出决策；（2）利用工具调用的视频智能体检查每个片段并标注干预时间戳，以生成额外监督数据。
AI.result: 相比自由形式生成，单token分类公式使macro-F1提升0.249、G-mean提升0.30。纯旁白式替代方案数据量为其四倍、成本仅十分之一，但迁移效果不及来自无关真实语料的监督，表明视觉接地比标注数量更重要。
AI.conclusion: 将干预决策简化为二分类token可显著提升性能；在标注受限场景下，基于视觉接地的监督优于大规模纯文本旁白监督。

title: Revisiting Complete Reasoning Traces for Post-Training
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are often post-trained on pre-collected reasoning trajectories to improve their reasoning capability. Such trajectories tend to be long due to complex, interwoven paths, which often include detours on the path toward the answer. However, it has been underexplored whether LLMs indeed benefit from learning complete trajectories in post-training, such as supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Starting from our pilot study, we find that full trajectories provide only limited benefit, while partial trajectories are effective even under heavy truncation. We analyze redundancy in reasoning trajectories through attention-based analyses and controlled token-removal studies, both of which show that intermediate tokens contribute minimally to final reasoning quality. This suggests that avoiding redundant information may allow LLMs to internally infer coherent alternatives by inferring missing steps from their internal knowledge, given known trajectory endpoints. Furthermore, we show that training LLMs using endpoints leads to consistent changes in reasoning behavior, and that it also benefits post-training methods based on reinforcement learning or on-policy distillation, highlighting the need to revisit complete reasoning traces. Code is available at https://github.com/naver-ai/revisiting-trace.

AI.tldr: 该论文质疑LLM后训练是否需要完整推理轨迹，发现完整轨迹收益有限，而高度截断的部分轨迹同样有效；中间token对最终推理质量贡献极小，仅用端点训练即可让模型内部推断缺失步骤，并改善RL和在线蒸馏等后训练方法。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM常基于预收集的长推理轨迹进行后训练（如SFT），但这些轨迹因路径复杂、包含绕路而冗长。论文关注一个尚未充分探索的问题：LLM在后训练中是否真的需要学习完整轨迹。作者从初步研究出发，发现完整轨迹收益有限，从而引发对推理轨迹冗余性的系统分析。
AI.method: 1）初步研究对比完整轨迹与部分/高度截断轨迹的训练效果；2）通过基于注意力的分析和受控token移除实验，分析推理轨迹中的冗余，评估中间token对最终推理质量的影响；3）提出使用端点（endpoints）训练LLM，观察推理行为变化；4）将端点训练应用于强化学习和在线策略蒸馏等后训练方法。
AI.result: 完整轨迹仅带来有限收益，而部分轨迹即使在重度截断下仍然有效。注意力分析与token移除实验均表明中间token对最终推理质量贡献极小。使用端点训练会使模型推理行为发生一致变化，并且能提升基于强化学习或在线策略蒸馏的后训练方法效果。相关代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 推理轨迹中的中间步骤存在大量冗余，LLM可在已知轨迹端点的情况下，依托内部知识推断缺失步骤并生成连贯的替代路径。因此，后训练不必依赖完整推理轨迹，端点训练同样有效并能增强多种后训练方法，提示需要重新审视“完整推理轨迹”的必要性。

title: Discovering Natural Transformation Vulnerabilities in Black-Box Vision Models
summary: Natural adversarial examples (NAEs) reveal that vision models can fail under realistic semantic changes beyond norm-bounded perturbations. However, generating NAEs in a black-box setting remains challenging because existing generative attacks often rely on surrogate models, learned attack priors, or costly query-based optimization, whereas the natural transformations that expose model vulnerabilities are unknown a priori. We propose \textbf{Adversarial Scenario Attack (ASA)}, a query-based black-box framework that searches over natural-language editing scenarios using a multimodal language model and a modern text-guided generative editor. ASA jointly explores background, weather, and material/color transformations through winner--loser feedback, and uses a greedy explorer to compose only attack-improving scenarios. Across diverse ImageNet classifiers, ASA achieves substantially higher attack success rates than prior query-based generative attacks while requiring fewer victim-model queries and preserving competitive perceptual quality. Moreover, ASA exhibits both image-level and prompt-level transferability: its adversarial images remain effective across victim-model architectures, while its discovered editing scenarios can be reused across same-class images and, in some cases, across architectures. These findings suggest that vision models possess reusable vulnerabilities to natural transformation patterns, which ASA can efficiently identify in a black-box setting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Adversarial Scenario Attack (ASA)，一个基于查询的黑盒框架，利用多模态语言模型与文本引导生成编辑器搜索自然语言编辑场景，以生成自然对抗样本。
AI.motivation: 自然对抗样本 (NAEs) 表明视觉模型在真实语义变化下会失效，但在黑盒设置下生成 NAEs 仍然困难：现有生成式攻击依赖代理模型、学习到的攻击先验或昂贵的基于查询的优化，而暴露模型脆弱性的自然变换先验未知。
AI.method: ASA 使用多模态语言模型和现代文本引导生成编辑器，在自然语言编辑场景上搜索；通过 winner-loser 反馈联合探索背景、天气和材质/颜色变换，并使用贪心探索器仅组合能提升攻击效果的场景。
AI.result: 在多种 ImageNet 分类器上，ASA 相比先前基于查询的生成式攻击实现了显著更高的攻击成功率，同时需要更少的受害者模型查询并保持有竞争力的感知质量。此外，ASA 展现图像级和提示级可迁移性：对抗图像跨受害者模型架构仍有效，发现的编辑场景可跨同类图像复用，某些情况下跨架构复用。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现表明视觉模型对自然变换模式具有可复用的脆弱性，而 ASA 能在黑盒设置下高效识别这些脆弱性。

title: The Illusion of Debiasing: Persona Steering Redistributes Rather Than Reduces Bias in LLMs
summary: Prompt-based interventions: system prompts, personas, role instructions, reliably reshape what a language model says, but it is unclear which layer they reach. Do they reconfigure internal structure, or only modulate the output channel? We use persona conditioning as a controlled probe, measuring its effects along a depth axis from self-report, through open-ended generation, to word-level parametric association, across three instruction-tuned models. We find a graded dissociation. Personas are legible but not structural: models follow single-trait instructions yet fail to reproduce human inter-trait covariance. The dissociation deepens with depth: personas hold or amplify closed-form QA bias, shift absolute tone while leaving between-group disparity unchanged, and barely perturb an already saturated associative baseline. Prompt-based steering thus operates in the output channel and has a structural reach limit that surface manipulability can mask.

AI.tldr: 本文以人格化条件（persona conditioning）作为受控探针，在三个指令微调模型上沿"自陈→开放式生成→词级参数化联想"的深度轴测量提示干预效果，发现一种"梯度式分离"：人格提示可读但非结构性，其影响随深度加深而衰减，提示式引导只能作用于输出通道，存在结构性触达上限。
AI.motivation: 基于提示的干预（系统提示、人格设定、角色指令）能可靠改变语言模型的输出，但其究竟作用于哪一层尚不明确：是重构内部结构，还是仅调节输出通道？作者希望厘清提示干预的作用深度，以判断其可操控性的真实边界。
AI.method: 以人格化条件作为受控探针，在三个指令微调模型上沿一条"深度轴"测量效应，该轴依次为：自陈式报告、开放式生成、词级参数化联想。具体通过单特质指令遵循测试、人际特质协方差复现测试、封闭式问答偏差测量、绝对语气与组间差异对比、以及联想基线扰动实验来逐层检验。
AI.result: 出现梯度式分离（graded dissociation）。人格是"可读但非结构性"的：模型能遵循单特质指令，却无法复现人类特质间协方差。分离随深度加深：人格提示维持甚至放大了封闭式问答偏差；改变了绝对语气，但组间差异（between-group disparity）保持不变；对已饱和的联想基线几乎无扰动。
AI.conclusion: 基于提示的引导作用于输出通道，具有结构性触达上限（structural reach limit），而这种上限会被表面的可操控性所掩盖。因此，仅凭输出层面的行为变化不足以推断模型内部结构已被改变。

title: PTCG: Persona-guided Tree-based Counterargument Generation
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 30 pages, 13 figures, 15 tables
summary: The ability to generate counterarguments is important for critical thinking and balanced discourse, yet existing approaches typically produce only a single counterargument, failing to capture the diversity and persuasiveness required in real-world debates. To address this limitation, we propose Persona-guided Tree-based Counterargument Generation (PTCG), a framework that combines Tree-of-Thoughts-inspired step-wise generation and pruning with speaker persona selection. By estimating the author's persona from the original argument and incorporating speaker personas representing distinct perspectives, PTCG operationalizes perspective-taking and enables the generation of diverse counterarguments. Results from LLM-as-a-Judge, classifier-based assessment, and human evaluations indicate that PTCG shows consistent improvements in both the diversity and persuasiveness of counterarguments compared to baseline methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PTCG框架，通过思维树式逐步生成与剪枝结合说话者人格选择，生成多样化且具说服力的反驳论点。
AI.motivation: 现有反驳论点生成方法通常只产生单一论点，无法满足真实辩论中对多样性和说服力的需求。
AI.method: PTCG框架：从原始论点估计作者人格，引入代表不同视角的说话者人格，结合思维树启发的逐步生成与剪枝机制，实现视角采择与多样反驳生成。
AI.result: LLM-as-a-Judge、基于分类器的评估和人工评估均表明，PTCG在反驳论点多样性和说服力上相较基线方法持续提升。
AI.conclusion: 人格引导与思维树相结合能有效提升反驳论点生成的多样性与说服力。

title: A Two-Stage Framework for Ego-Centric Key Object Identification via Object State Prediction
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Accepted and presented at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA 2026)
summary: This paper presents a novel framework designed to enhance key object identification in autonomous driving. Existing methods primarily focus on either detecting objects independently or leveraging visual relationships, but they do not explicitly consider the ego vehicle's perspective in determining object importance. To address this gap, we propose a structured approach that integrates a virtual ego-vehicle representation and a modular object state predictor, enabling a more accurate estimation of object behaviors relative to the ego-vehicle. Subsequently, our framework employs spatial-temporal reasoning to refine key object identification, prioritizing objects based on their states and relative spatial information rather than relying solely on visual relationships. Experimental results on real-world driving datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in accurately detecting critical objects in complex traffic environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种融合虚拟自车表示与模块化目标状态预测器的框架，通过时空推理实现自动驾驶中的关键目标识别。
AI.motivation: 现有方法要么独立检测目标，要么依赖视觉关系，未显式考虑自车视角在判断目标重要性中的作用，导致关键目标识别不够准确。
AI.method: 构建结构化框架：引入虚拟自车（virtual ego-vehicle）表示与模块化目标状态预测器，估计目标相对自车的行为；再通过时空推理（spatial-temporal reasoning）细化关键目标识别，依据目标状态与相对空间信息进行优先级排序，而非仅依赖视觉关系。
AI.result: 在真实驾驶数据集上的实验结果表明，该方法能在复杂交通环境中准确检测关键目标，验证了其有效性。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模自车视角并结合时空推理，可有效提升自动驾驶场景下关键目标识别的准确性。

title: Line-Coupled Language Model
summary: Autoregressive language models generate one token per decoding step, limiting the useful output of each forward pass. Although diffusion models, insertion-based decoding, and multi-token prediction enable parallel generation, they either incur additional training-time token traffic or struggle to predict strongly dependent future tokens. We introduce the Line-Coupled Language Model (LCLM), an autoregressive model that advances multiple text lines together by predicting the next token for every active line while coupling the lines through shared causal context. LCLM interleaves line tokens into a single causal sequence and uses line-staggered rotary positions, retaining the standard next-token objective and causal attention. Controlled experiments show that cross-line targets are substantially less dependent than consecutive same-line targets, supporting lines as parallel generation units. With 881M parameters, LCLM produces an average of 2.94 content tokens per forward pass with a validation cross-entropy loss of 2.44, compared with 1.00 token per forward pass and a loss of 2.39 for the vanilla autoregressive baseline. Most notably, even when LCLM generates 16 tokens per forward pass, its loss is only 0.09 higher than that of the vanilla autoregressive baseline (2.34 vs. 2.25).

AI.tldr: 本文提出行耦合语言模型（LCLM），通过将多条文本行的token交错进单一因果序列并使用行错位旋转位置编码，在保持标准next-token目标与因果注意力的前提下并行推进多行生成。在881M参数下，LCLM每次前向平均生成2.94个内容token，验证交叉熵为2.44，而基线为1.00个token与2.39；即使每次前向生成16个token，其损失(2.34)也仅比基线(2.25)高0.09。
AI.motivation: 自回归语言模型每步仅解码一个token，限制了单次前向推理的有效输出。现有并行生成方案（扩散模型、插入式解码、多token预测）要么带来额外训练期的token流量开销，要么难以预测依赖性强 的未来token，因此需要一种兼顾并行效率与依赖建模能力的生成范式。
AI.method: 提出LCLM：将多条文本行的token交错为单一因果序列，对每条活跃行预测其下一个token，并通过共享因果上下文实现行间耦合；采用"行错位旋转位置"（line-staggered rotary positions）编码位置信息。该方法保留标准next-token训练目标与因果注意力机制，无需额外训练期token流量。
AI.result: 受控实验表明，跨行目标之间的依赖度显著低于同一行内连续目标，支持"行"作为并行生成单元。881M参数模型每次前向平均产出2.94个内容token，验证交叉熵2.44，基线则为1.00个token、2.39。当每次前向生成16个token时，LCLM损失为2.34，仅比基线2.25高0.09。
AI.conclusion: 以文本行为并行生成单元可在保持标准自回归训练目标与因果注意力的同时实现多token并行解码，且跨行目标依赖较弱这一特性为并行化提供了依据。LCLM在显著提升单次前向产出token数的同时，损失仅小幅上升，展现出并行效率与建模质量之间良好的权衡。

title: Retrieval-Augmented Multi-Prompt Ensemble for Minor-Grain Breeding Information Extraction
comment: Accepted at CCL 2026 (China National Conference on Computational Linguistics)
summary: This paper presents our system for CCL2026-Eval Task 5: Minor-Grain Breeding Information Extraction (MGBIE), which jointly extracts 12 entity types and 6 relation types from minor-grain breeding literature. We propose RAME (Retrieval-Augmented Multi-Prompt Ensemble), a training-free framework that elicits multiple LLM outputs under controlled diversity and aggregates them by majority voting to obtain high-confidence predictions. RAME combines (i) retrieval-augmented few-shot selection via a hybrid BM25-embedding retriever, (ii) a three-prompt ensemble (Strict, Relaxed, Balanced) spanning the precision to recall spectrum, and (iii) large-scale repeated sampling with majority voting to filter noisy predictions. Built on DeepSeek-V4-Flash, RAME achieves a Total Score of 0.499 (NER 0.730, RE 0.346) on the leaderboard, ranking 1st and surpassing the official Track-A baseline powered by GPT-5.5 (0.448), representing an 11.4% relative improvement. Code is available at https://github.com/king-wang123/CCL26-RAME.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RAME（检索增强多提示集成）框架，用于CCL2026-Eval任务5细粒度育种信息抽取，联合抽取12类实体与6类关系。该方法免训练，通过混合检索少样本示例、三种提示集成与大规模重复采样投票聚合，在排行榜上以总分0.499（NER 0.730，RE 0.346）排名第一，超过GPT-5.5驱动的官方基线0.448，相对提升11.4%。
AI.motivation: 细粒度育种文献中实体与关系类型繁多（12类实体、6类关系），标注数据稀缺且模式复杂，训练专用抽取模型成本高、泛化难；而直接使用LLM提示存在输出噪声大、单一提示偏差明显的问题，因此需要一种免训练、可控多样性且能过滤噪声的高置信度抽取方案。
AI.method: RAME由三部分构成：(i) 基于混合BM25-嵌入检索器的检索增强少样本示例选择；(ii) 覆盖精确率—召回率谱系的三提示集成（Strict、Relaxed、Balanced）；(iii) 大规模重复采样配合多数投票以过滤噪声预测。整个框架免训练，在限定多样性下激发多路LLM输出并聚合为高置信结果，底座模型为DeepSeek-V4-Flash。
AI.result: 在CCL2026-Eval Task 5排行榜上，RAME总分0.499，其中NER 0.730、RE 0.346，排名第1；超过官方Track-A基线（GPT-5.5，0.448），相对提升11.4%。
AI.conclusion: 免训练的检索增强多提示集成策略可在细粒度育种信息抽取任务中超越更大规模模型驱动的强基线，验证了检索增强少样本、提示谱系集成与多数投票聚合的有效性；代码已开源。

title: NutriBench-Kitchen: Benchmarking Embodied AI for Nutrition Management
summary: An embodied kitchen assistant must do more than recognize food in isolated frames. It must track ingredient states over time and integrate visual observations with recipe and nutritional knowledge to support constraint-aware decision-making. We formalize this capability as \emph{Embodied Nutrition Management}: perceiving nutrition-relevant events, maintaining a persistent food state, and using it for knowledge-grounded planning. Existing benchmarks evaluate static food understanding or embodied cooking actions, but do not measure whether an agent can continuously update and use nutrition-relevant states in dynamic kitchens. To fill this gap, we introduce \textbf{NutriBench-Kitchen}, a benchmark containing 1,500 manually verified question--answer pairs from 160 cooking videos. It covers five task families: Ingredient Entry, Memory Management, Recipe Query, Long-Term Planning, and Short-Term Planning, spanning food-state construction, maintenance, knowledge retrieval, and decision-making across different planning horizons. Evaluations of proprietary and open-source large vision-language models reveal a substantial gap from human performance, particularly in quantitative ingredient estimation, long-term state tracking, and reasoning under interacting constraints. We further introduce \textbf{Nutri-Vgent}, a diagnostic long-video agent with separate episodic, food-state, and recipe memories. Its consistent improvements demonstrate the value of explicit state representations and structured memory for nutrition management. Together, NutriBench-Kitchen and Nutri-Vgent provide a testbed for studying persistent state tracking and knowledge-grounded reasoning in dynamic kitchens. Code is available at https://github.com/V1ol1n/NutriBench-Kitchen.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Embodied Nutrition Management 任务，并发布 NutriBench-Kitchen 基准（1500 条人工校验 QA，来自 160 个烹饪视频，覆盖五类任务），同时提出诊断性长视频智能体 Nutri-Vgent，验证显式状态表示与结构化记忆对营养管理的价值。
AI.motivation: 现有基准只评估静态食物识别或具身烹饪动作，无法衡量智能体是否能在动态厨房中持续更新并利用营养相关状态；具身厨房助手需要跟踪食材状态并融合食谱与营养知识进行约束感知决策。
AI.method: 形式化 Embodied Nutrition Management（感知营养相关事件、维护持久食物状态、用于知识驱动规划）；构建 NutriBench-Kitchen，含 1500 条人工验证 QA、160 个烹饪视频、五个任务族（Ingredient Entry、Memory Management、Recipe Query、Long-Term Planning、Short-Term Planning），覆盖状态构建、维护、知识检索与不同规划时域决策；评测专有与开源大型视觉语言模型；提出 Nutri-Vgent，采用情景记忆、食物状态记忆和食谱记忆分离的长视频智能体架构。
AI.result: 专有与开源 LVLM 与人类表现存在显著差距，尤其在定量食材估计、长期状态跟踪以及交互约束下推理方面；Nutri-Vgent 在各项任务上取得一致性提升。
AI.conclusion: NutriBench-Kitchen 与 Nutri-Vgent 共同构成研究动态厨房中持久状态跟踪与知识驱动推理的测试平台；显式状态表示与结构化记忆对营养管理具有明确价值。

title: Flow3D-OPD: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for 3D Geometry Generation with Flow-Matching Diffusion Transformer
summary: Recent image-to-3D generation models built on flow-matching diffusion Transformers (DiT) can produce high-fidelity meshes, yet their post-training strategy remains largely unexplored. There exist several critical bottlenecks in reinforcement learning: the inherent difficulty of defining comprehensive rewards for 3D geometric quality, and the gradient interference that arises when jointly optimizing heterogeneous objectives. Inspired by the practicability of on-policy distillation (OPD) in large language models and image generation, we propose \textbf{Flow3D-OPD}, a two-stage post-training framework that introduces multi-teacher distillation into 3D geometry generation. In the first stage, we utilize the semi-policy to enhance the foundational capability of the pretrained model and then design an agentic verifier for 3D geometric quality evaluation. Based on the verifier, we could cultivate domain-specialized teacher models via direct preference optimization (DPO). In the second stage, we consolidate heterogeneous expertise into a unified student model through on-policy distillation with hard task-routing sampling and gradient accumulation, which could mitigate the gradient interference in joint optimization. Without relying on elaborate modifications, our straightforward yet effective design achieves consistent improvements across all geometric quality dimensions and surpasses all teacher models in the average metric. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach provides an effective paradigm for reinforcement learning in 3D generation.

AI.tldr: 提出 Flow3D-OPD 两阶段后训练框架，将多教师在线策略蒸馏引入 3D 几何生成，缓解 3D 几何奖励难定义与异构目标梯度干扰问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 flow-matching 扩散 Transformer 的图像到 3D 生成虽能产出高保真网格，但后训练策略几乎未被探索；强化学习在此面临两大瓶颈：一是 3D 几何质量难以定义全面奖励，二是异构目标联合优化时产生梯度干扰。
AI.method: 两阶段后训练框架。第一阶段用 semi-policy 增强预训练模型基础能力，并设计 agentic verifier 评估 3D 几何质量，据此通过 DPO 培育领域专用教师模型；第二阶段以硬任务路由采样与梯度累积进行在线策略蒸馏，把异构专长整合进统一学生模型，以缓解联合优化的梯度干扰。
AI.result: 在无需复杂改动的情况下，方法在所有几何质量维度上取得一致提升，且平均指标超过所有教师模型；大量实验表明该框架为 3D 生成中的强化学习提供了有效范式。
AI.conclusion: 将多教师在线策略蒸馏用于 3D 几何生成后训练是可行且有效的，能够统一异构教师专长并实现几何质量全面提升。

title: Encoded Early, Used Late: Where Transformers Begin to Act on an Inferred Partner's Expertise
comment: Published at the Scientific Understanding of Foundation Models (Sci-FM) Workshop at COLM 2026
summary: A transformer can make an attribute linearly decodable in its residual stream at a depth where that attribute does not yet influence the output. This gap between where information is readable and where it is used has been shown for attributes stated directly in the input. We ask whether it also holds for an attribute the model must infer gradually over a conversation, namely how expert its dialogue partner is. Using ExpertCollab, a corpus of multi-turn research-planning dialogues between model-played personas at four expertise levels, we find that partner expertise is most decodable in the early layers and falls to near chance before the midpoint of the network. Counterfactual patching shows that injecting the expertise difference at the layer of peak decodability barely changes a fixed late-layer readout, whereas the same difference injected past the midpoint propagates almost completely, a separation of more than an order of magnitude. A content-matched random control and a probe-free diagnostic place the transition at the same early layer, and a statically specified control attribute stays decodable throughout. An inferred relational attribute is therefore represented well before it becomes causally active, which bounds where any attempt to read out or steer partner-conditioned behavior must intervene. We use one model on a synthetic corpus as an initial demonstration.

AI.tldr: 本文用多轮科研规划对话语料 ExpertCollab 检验"推断型关系属性"（对话伙伴的专业度）在 Transformer 残差流中的可解码性与因果作用深度是否分离，发现该属性在早期层最可解码但直到网络中点之后才产生因果影响，二者相差一个数量级以上。
AI.motivation: 已有研究证明，直接在输入中陈述的属性存在"可读深度"与"被使用深度"之间的鸿沟（可线性解码的层早于该属性影响输出的层）。但是否同样适用于需要模型在对话中逐步推断的属性尚不清楚。本文选取"对话伙伴的专业度"这一必须在对话中逐渐推断的关系属性，检验上述鸿沟是否依然成立。
AI.method: 构建 ExpertCollab：由模型扮演四种专业度人格进行多轮科研规划对话的合成语料。使用线性探针检测各层专业度的可解码性；用反事实激活修补（counterfactual patching）检验在不同层注入专业度差异后对固定晚期读出层的影响；并设置内容匹配的随机对照属性以及无探针诊断（probe-free diagnostic）定位转变层；另设一个静态指定的控制属性作对照。
AI.result: 伙伴专业度在早期层最可解码，并在网络中点之前降至接近随机水平。反事实修补显示：在可解码性峰值层注入专业度差异几乎不改变固定的晚期读出层结果，而在中点之后注入同样差异则几乎完全传导，二者相差超过一个数量级。内容匹配随机对照与无探针诊断将该转变定位在同一早期层；静态指定的控制属性则自始至终保持可解码。
AI.conclusion: 推断型关系属性在被因果使用之前很早就已被表征，这限定了任何读取或操控"以伙伴为条件"的行为时必须介入的深度范围。本文以单一模型和合成语料作为初步验证。

title: Stable-MM-R1: Anchoring Multimodal Reasoning Dynamics via Entropy-Guided Stratification
summary: While Reinforcement Learning (RL) effectively incentivizes reasoning in Large Language Models, current pipelines are hindered by training instability and rapid entropy collapse. These limitations often stem from "Rollout Silencing" and low-quality gradient signals in standard sampling procedures. In this work, we propose a robust, data-centric framework to stabilize RL training. We first introduce Potential-Aware Query Mining (PAQM), which filters data dynamically to focus on the "Distillation Zone"---samples with high potential for capability elicitation. Furthermore, we present Hybrid Stratified Replay (HSR), a novel mechanism that restructures batches by stratifying rollouts based on Path Entropy, a rollout-level confidence proxy, and outcome reward. Within each optimization step, HSR reuses current-policy "Stability Anchors" and "Hard Negatives" to construct high-contrast optimization groups, then clears its buffers before the next step. This approach mitigates entropy collapse while improving the utilization of learning signals under limited compute. Our method outperforms strong baselines on complex reasoning tasks, offering a principled solution for stable and efficient RL fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出以数据为中心的强化学习稳定框架，通过PAQM动态筛选高潜力样本、HSR按路径熵与结果奖励分层重放构建高对比优化组，缓解熵坍塌并提升有限算力下学习信号利用率。
AI.motivation: 当前用于激励大语言模型推理能力的强化学习流程存在训练不稳定与熵快速坍塌的问题，根源在于"Rollout Silencing"以及标准采样过程中梯度信号质量低。
AI.method: 提出稳健的数据中心框架：1) Potential-Aware Query Mining (PAQM)，动态过滤数据，聚焦于具备高能力激发潜力的"蒸馏区"样本；2) Hybrid Stratified Replay (HSR)，依据 Path Entropy（rollout级置信度代理）与结果奖励分层重构批次，在同一步内复用当前策略的"稳定性锚点"与"难负样本"构建高对比优化组，并在下一步前清空缓冲区。
AI.result: 在复杂推理任务上优于强基线，提供了一种稳定且高效的强化学习微调方案。
AI.conclusion: 以数据为中心的动态筛选与分层重放机制能够在缓解熵坍塌的同时提升学习信号利用率，为强化学习微调的稳定性与效率提供了原则性解决方案。

title: Vishing-Tactics-Bench: Forecasting Exploitation Trajectories in Voice Phishing Calls
comment: 16 pages, 3 figures. Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026
summary: Voice phishing (vishing) unfolds in real time; by the time a call has ended and post-hoc classification is possible, the harm has already been done. The more actionable question is which concrete harm (Information Gathering or Financial Exploitation) an ongoing call is tactically progressing toward. We present Vishing-Tactics-Bench, a benchmark grounded in Endsley's situation-awareness (SA) framework that recasts vishing defense from after-the-fact fraud classification to harm projection: predicting at each turn whether the call will reach either terminal harm. We adapt MITRE ATT&CK to vishing as a 6-tactic taxonomy (Vishing-Tactics) and label 35,340 scammer utterances across 5,645 synthetic Chinese calls. We define Exploitation Trajectory Forecasting, a survival-style protocol over the two terminal harms with three metrics: AP@k, C-index, and divergence error. Baselines ranging from a Markov heuristic to fine-tuned LLMs show that the tactical trajectory serves as an interpretable representation of the call's tactical state, supporting harm-specific forecasting, which can then be used for the downstream application of intervention selection; a stratified lead-time analysis at a tight false-alarm budget further identifies at what point in a call the trajectory signal yields early warning.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Vishing-Tactics-Bench，将语音钓鱼防御从通话结束后的事后欺诈分类，转变为通话进行中的危害投影，预测每轮对话将走向信息收集还是经济剥削。
AI.motivation: 语音钓鱼实时发生，等通话结束再分类时损害已造成，因此更具可操作性的问题是在通话进行中判断其正朝哪种具体危害推进。
AI.method: 基于 Endsley 态势感知框架构建基准；将 MITRE ATT&CK 适配为 6 战术分类体系，标注 5,645 通合成中文通话中的 35,340 条诈骗话术；定义 Exploitation Trajectory Forecasting，一种针对两类终端危害的生存式协议，采用 AP@k、C-index 与散度误差三项指标；基线从马尔可夫启发式到微调 LLM。
AI.result: 战术轨迹可作为通话战术状态的可解释表示，支持分危害预测，并可用于下游干预选择；在严格误报预算下的分层提前期分析明确了轨迹信号何时能提供早期预警。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将语音钓鱼防御重构为危害投影任务，验证了战术轨迹在早期预警与干预选择中的实用价值。

title: FreqBLiMP: Frequency-Controlled Minimal Pairs Reveal Robustness and Fragility of LLMs Under Lexical Rarity
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Main Conference. Repo link: https://github.com/TimeTravelerTy/freqblimp-generation
summary: Minimal-pair benchmarks such as BLiMP evaluate linguistic knowledge by testing whether language models (LMs) prefer acceptable sentences over minimally different unacceptable ones. However, these benchmarks largely ignore lexical frequency variation, despite lexical frequency being a pervasive and highly skewed property of natural language use. Consequently, existing evaluations do not test whether grammatical preferences remain stable when contrasts involve rare lexical items. We introduce FreqBLiMP, a frequency-controlled extension of BLiMP that regenerates all 67 paradigms under explicit Zipf-frequency regimes while preserving each minimal-pair's grammatical contrast. Evaluating multiple open-weight LLM families across scales, we find that decreasing lexical frequency produces a consistent, monotonic decrease in sentence likelihood, but only a modest reduction in overall contrastive acceptability accuracy. However, this aggregate stability masks substantial variation across linguistic phenomena, with LLMs remaining robust on overt morphosyntactic generalization while degrading on phenomena that require lemma-specific information.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FreqBLiMP，一个频率受控的 BLiMP 扩展基准，在保持最小对立对语法对比的前提下，将全部 67 个范式按显式 Zipf 频率区间重新生成。结果显示：词频下降会单调降低句子似然度，但总体对比接受度准确率仅小幅下降；这一总体稳定性掩盖了语言学现象间的显著差异。
AI.motivation: 现有最小对立对基准（如 BLiMP）评估语言模型的语法知识时，基本忽略了词汇频率这一自然语言中普遍且高度偏斜的属性。因此，无法判断当对比涉及罕见词项时，模型的语法偏好是否依然稳定，评测覆盖存在盲区。
AI.method: 构建 FreqBLiMP：以 BLiMP 为基础做频率受控扩展，在显式 Zipf 频率区间下重新生成全部 67 个范式，同时保持每个最小对立对的语法对比不变；随后在多个开放权重 LLM 家族及不同规模上进行评测。
AI.result: 降低词汇频率会一致且单调地降低句子似然度，但对总体对比接受度准确率仅造成适度下降。总体稳定性的背后存在显著的现象异质性：模型在显性形态句法泛化上保持稳健，而在依赖词元特化信息的现象上出现退化。
AI.conclusion: 词汇频率是评测语言模型语法能力时不可忽视的变量；总体准确率会掩盖现象层面的脆弱性，频率受控基准有助于更细致地刻画语法知识的稳健性与边界。

title: Ambient @ EgoLongQA 2026: Distilling Long-Video perception into a Sub-2B Model
comment: Winning solution technical report for the EgoLongQA track of the ECCV 2026 Wearable AI Grand Challenge
summary: We describe our entry to the EgoLongQA track of the Wearable-AI Challenge in ECCV 2026, which placed first in the <=2B parameter division with 0.8279 on the held-out test set. Our system is a single 2B vision-language model that answers multiple-choice questions about ten-minute egocentric videos in one greedy forward pass; It is obtained by distilling the junior perception module of a tool-using agentic pipeline, not the agent itself into a small student, using teacher traces filtered to those that answered correctly. it reaches 89% of the accuracy of the large agentic pipeline using 1.1% of its parameters. This raises a 27.1% base model to 81.4% on our held-out questions. The 2B backbone has 2.2132B parameters and therefore over the divisional limit, to make the entry admissable we prune the multilingual embedding table from 248,320 to 143,469 rows, reaching 1.9985B with provably identical logits on retained rows.

AI.tldr: 提出一个2B视觉语言模型，通过蒸馏工具使用型智能体流水线的初级感知模块，在EgoLongQA赛道中以单次前向传播回答十分钟第一视角视频选择题，并以0.8279的成绩获得<=2B参数组第一。
AI.motivation: 长时第一视角视频的问答通常依赖工具使用型智能体流水线，但这类系统参数量巨大、推理成本高；本文旨在将其中真正负责感知的能力压缩进小型学生模型，以在严格参数预算下实现高效推理。
AI.method: 采用蒸馏策略：不蒸馏整个智能体，而只蒸馏其初级感知模块到一个2B学生模型，教师轨迹经筛选仅保留回答正确的样本。学生模型以单次贪婪前向传播完成多项选择问答。为满足参数限制，将多语言嵌入表从248,320行剪枝至143,469行，使参数量由2.2132B降至1.9985B，并保证保留行上的logits完全一致。
AI.result: 在留出测试集上取得0.8279，位列<=2B参数组第一；达到大型智能体流水线准确率的89%，而参数量仅为其1.1%；将基础模型的27.1%提升至留出问题上的81.4%。
AI.conclusion: 仅蒸馏感知模块而非整个智能体，即可用极小参数规模逼近大型流水线性能；嵌入表剪枝可在保持logits不变的前提下满足参赛参数约束，证明了该高效蒸馏与剪枝方案的可行性与有效性。

title: Mind the Approximation: Fisher-Weighted SVD Compression for ViTs
summary: Model compression is key to mitigate deployment challenges of ever growing machine learning models. In this area of research, singular value decomposition (SVD)-based compression offers a compelling trade-off between computational efficiency and model accuracy. Fisher-weighted SVD in particular provides principled, loss-aware compression. However, we find that improving the fidelity of Fisher approximation used in the compression is poorly predictive of post-compression accuracy for Vision Transformers (ViTs). Motivated by this observation, we propose FACTS, a structured Fisher Approximation tailored to Compressing ViTs with Fisher-weighted SVD, which enforces token-local aggregation while preserving within-token activation-gradient dependence. Additionally, we introduce a fast Constrained Rank Search (CoRS), that optimizes layer-wise rank allocation while adhering to a fixed floating point operation (FLOP) constraint. Extensive experiments across ViTs and hybrid architectures demonstrate that FACTS consistently improves accuracy-efficiency trade-offs without requiring finetuning. Notably, it outperforms the strongest SVD baseline by up to +5.8 percentage points (p.p.) Top-1 on Swin-B, with further gains driven by our search method. Code is available at https://github.com/MoritzTho/FACTS.

AI.tldr: 提出FACTS：面向ViT的Token局部化Fisher近似结构化压缩方法，并配套FLOP约束下的快速秩搜索CoRS，无需微调即可提升精度-效率权衡。
AI.motivation: 模型压缩对缓解机器学习模型部署挑战至关重要；SVD类压缩（尤其Fisher加权SVD）能提供有原理的、loss-aware的压缩，但在ViT上提升Fisher近似的保真度并不能可靠预测压缩后精度，说明直接沿用原有Fisher近似存在问题。
AI.method: 提出FACTS：针对ViT压缩的结构化Fisher近似，在保留token内激活-梯度依赖的同时强制token局部聚合；同时提出快速的Constrained Rank Search（CoRS），在固定FLOP约束下优化逐层秩分配。
AI.result: 在多种ViT与混合架构上，无需微调即可持续改善精度-效率权衡；在Swin-B上相较最强SVD基线最高提升+5.8个百分点Top-1，配合搜索方法进一步增益。
AI.conclusion: 针对ViT的Fisher近似应匹配其token结构特性；FACTS+CoRS可作为无需微调的SVD压缩方案，显著优于现有SVD基线，代码已开源。

title: Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Symbol Spotting in Historical Encrypted Manuscripts
summary: The decipherment of historical encrypted manuscripts poses a fundamental challenge in Digital Humanities: before any transcription can begin, the symbol inventory of the underlying cipher alphabet must first be identified and characterized. We address this challenge through symbol spotting: given a candidate alphabet specified as a set of rendered font glyphs, the task is to determine whether and where its characters appear in an unseen handwritten document, without any labeled examples from the target script. The main difficulty lies in the domain gap between clean, digitally rendered font queries and degraded handwritten manuscript symbols. We propose a three-stage pipeline that bridges this gap without manual annotation, combining a joint SimCLR+DANN encoder for domain-invariant glyph representations with an embedding-space style-adaptation mechanism applied at retrieval time, requiring no re-training. Experiments on fourteen pages from seven encrypted manuscript collections show that our method outperforms zero-shot foundation models, including CLIP and DINOv2, by a large margin ($+0.194$ P@1 over CLIP ViT-L/14), and surpasses task-specific trained baselines by $+0.138$ P@1. We further demonstrate that the Raw-Cover metric, computed in a fully unsupervised setting, provides a meaningful script-family fingerprint that identifies the underlying alphabet of an unknown document. This capability is of direct practical relevance to palaeographers, historians, and other researchers working with undeciphered manuscripts.

AI.tldr: 提出三阶段无监督符号定位流水线，弥合渲染字体查询与手写手稿符号间的域差距，用于历史加密手稿的字母表破译。
AI.motivation: 历史加密手稿的破译需先识别并刻画底层密码字母表的符号清单，但目标书写系统缺乏标注样本，且干净的数字渲染字体查询与退化的手写手稿符号之间存在巨大域差距。
AI.method: 提出三阶段流水线，无需人工标注：结合 SimCLR+DANN 联合编码器学习域不变字形表示，并在检索阶段应用嵌入空间风格自适应机制（无需重新训练）；任务被形式化为符号定位（symbol spotting）。
AI.result: 在7个加密手稿合集共14页上，方法大幅超越零样本基础模型（较 CLIP ViT-L/14 提升 +0.194 P@1），并超过任务专用训练基线 +0.138 P@1；提出的 Raw-Cover 指标在完全无监督设置下可提供有意义的书写系统族指纹，识别未知文档的底层字母表。
AI.conclusion: 该无监督符号定位方法能有效匹配渲染字体与退化手写符号，且 Raw-Cover 指纹可用于识别未知手稿字母表，对古文字学家、历史学家及未破译手稿研究者具有直接实用价值。

title: In-Place Instruction Following in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) generate text via bidirectional iterative denoising, naturally supporting user-specified constraints anchored at arbitrary output positions, a paradigm known as In-place Prompting (IPP). We formalize this as the In-place Instruction Following (IIF) task and construct IIF-Bench, a hierarchical benchmark spanning literal, style, and discourse-function constraints, paired with a rubric-based local-global evaluation protocol. An inference-time attention-bias probe suggests that vanilla dLLMs often under-prioritize constraint spans during denoising. We then propose GRAFT, an IPP-oriented post-training framework combining constraint-aware SFT and preference optimization. On four representative dLLMs, GRAFT raises the average IIF score from 57.75 to 73.10 (+15.35 points), with absolute gains of 15.91 and 15.57 points on literal and discourse-function constraints, while preserving general generation ability.

AI.tldr: 论文形式化"原位指令遵循"（IIF）任务，构建IIF-Bench基准，并提出面向原位提示（IPP）的后训练框架GRAFT，将四个dLLM的IIF平均分从57.75提升至73.10。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型（dLLM）通过双向迭代去噪生成文本，天然支持在任意输出位置锚定用户约束（即In-place Prompting, IPP），但该能力缺乏形式化定义与评测基准；同时注意力偏置探测表明，原生dLLM在去噪过程中往往低估约束span的重要性，导致约束遵循不足。
AI.method: 1) 将上述能力形式化为"原位指令遵循"（IIF）任务；2) 构建IIF-Bench分层基准，覆盖字面、风格、话语功能三类约束，并配套基于评分细则的局部-全局评估协议；3) 通过推理期注意力偏置探针诊断原生dLLM对约束span的关注不足；4) 提出GRAFT后训练框架，结合约束感知的SFT与偏好优化。
AI.result: 在四个代表性dLLM上，GRAFT将IIF平均得分从57.75提升至73.10（+15.35）；字面约束与话语功能约束分别获得15.91和15.57的绝对增益，同时保持通用生成能力。
AI.conclusion: IPP是dLLM的独特优势，但需专门的对齐手段才能充分发挥；GRAFT通过约束感知的SFT与偏好优化有效提升IIF能力，且不损害通用生成性能，为dLLM的约束遵循提供了可行路径与评测基础。

title: Legal text classification in Korean sexual offense cases: from traditional machine learning to large language models with XAI insights
comment: 22 pages, 3 figures. Published in Artificial Intelligence and Law
summary: The advancement of natural language processing (NLP) has expanded AI-based text classification in the legal domain. However, accurately classifying legal documents remains challenging due to the complexity of legal texts and subtle differences between legal categories. This study evaluates legal text classification models ranging from traditional machine learning techniques to large language models (LLMs) using ten categories of Korean sexual offense precedents. The results show that fine-tuning small-scale models such as KLUE-BERT on legal data outperforms general-purpose models such as GPT-3.5 and GPT-4.0, as well as traditional machine learning models. KLUE-BERT achieved the highest accuracy of 99.3%, indicating that domain adaptation and fine-tuning can be more important than model size for legal document classification. We further employ explainable AI (XAI) techniques to analyze model predictions and misclassification cases. XAI analysis identifies linguistic features influencing model decisions and limitations in capturing subtle textual cues. Using KICS data, which closely resembles real-world legal case records, we further evaluate the model's generalization capabilities and find that it struggles to interpret implicit contextual cues. These findings highlight the importance of both performance and interpretability in legal AI and demonstrate how XAI can improve transparency in legal text classification. AI-assisted tools can support legal professionals in tasks including document classification, legal information retrieval, and case assessment.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了从传统机器学习到LLM的韩国性犯罪判例文本分类模型，发现微调小模型KLUE-BERT（99.3%）优于GPT-3.5/4.0，并借助XAI分析可解释性与泛化局限。
AI.motivation: 法律文本复杂、类别间差异细微，导致法律文书分类困难；同时需明确模型规模与领域适应孰更关键，并提升法律AI的透明性与可解释性。
AI.method: 构建十个类别的韩国性犯罪判例数据集，对比传统机器学习、通用LLM（GPT-3.5、GPT-4.0）与小型预训练模型（KLUE-BERT）的分类性能；采用可解释AI（XAI）技术分析模型预测与误分类；并使用贴近真实案卷的KICS数据进行泛化能力评估。
AI.result: KLUE-BERT经法律数据微调后取得最高准确率99.3%，优于通用LLM与传统机器学习模型；XAI揭示影响模型决策的语言特征及捕捉细微文本线索的局限；泛化评估显示模型在处理隐式语境线索时表现不佳。
AI.conclusion: 在法律文书分类中，领域适应与微调比模型规模更重要；性能与可解释性并重，XAI有助于提升法律文本分类透明度，AI辅助工具可支持文书分类、法律信息检索与案件评估等任务。

title: Weakly-supervised Kidney Tumor Classification from CT Scans with Multi-Instance Learning and Anatomical Filtering
summary: Deep learning models for CT scan analysis are often limited by the scarcity of precise pixel-level annotations, which require significant radiologist effort to produce. Training on scan-level labels alone reduces annotation requirements but introduces challenges: low supervision ratios and large input volumes make models prone to overfitting and shortcut learning. In this work, we investigate two complementary methods to address these challenges: multi-instance learning (MIL) and anatomical filtering. MIL divides CT volumes into 2D slice instances, enabling efficient 2D architectures with ImageNet pretraining rather than computationally demanding 3D models. Anatomical filtering uses Compass, our self-supervised body part regression model, to crop scans to pathology-relevant subregions without requiring segmentation masks. We evaluate two MIL frameworks - Attention-based MIL (ABMIL) and FocusMIL - on kidney tumor classification across one internal dataset (TUH) and two external datasets (KiTS23 and TCGA-KiRC). Our best models achieve F1 = 0.83 on the internal test set using only scan-level labels. We further show that anatomical filtering with the Compass model is critical for the out-of-distribution generalization of embedding-based ABMIL, while instance-based FocusMIL demonstrates greater inherent robustness to distribution shift. While evaluated on kidney tumors, we consider this a proof-of-concept for a broader weakly supervised CT classification pipeline applicable to other organs and pathologies.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对CT扫描分析中像素级标注稀缺的问题，仅使用扫描级标签，结合多实例学习（MIL）与基于自监督Compass模型的解剖过滤，在肾肿瘤分类任务上实现F1=0.83，并揭示了解剖过滤对提升嵌入式ABMIL分布外泛化的关键作用。
AI.motivation: CT扫描的深度学习分析通常依赖精确的像素级标注，而这类标注需要放射科医生投入大量精力。仅使用扫描级标签虽可降低标注需求，却带来监督比例低、输入体积大等问题，导致模型易过拟合和出现捷径学习（shortcut learning）。因此需要探索在弱监督条件下提升模型性能与泛化能力的方法。
AI.method: 作者采用两种互补方法：1）多实例学习（MIL）：将CT体数据划分为2D切片实例，从而使用带ImageNet预训练的高效2D架构，替代计算成本高的3D模型；2）解剖过滤：利用自监督身体部位回归模型Compass，在无需分割掩码的情况下将扫描裁剪至与病理相关的子区域。评估了两种MIL框架——基于注意力的MIL（ABMIL）与FocusMIL，在肾肿瘤分类任务上进行验证，涵盖一个内部数据集（TUH）和两个外部数据集（KiTS23、TCGA-KiRC）。
AI.result: 最佳模型仅使用扫描级标签，在内部测试集上达到F1=0.83。基于Compass模型的解剖过滤对嵌入式ABMIL的分布外（OOD）泛化至关重要；而基于实例的FocusMIL对分布偏移具有更强的固有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 尽管仅在肾肿瘤上验证，该工作可作为更广泛的弱监督CT分类流程的概念验证，可推广至其他器官和病理。其核心启示是：结合MIL与自监督解剖过滤可在低标注成本下实现有效且具有一定泛化能力的CT分类。

title: Deep Learning for Biopsy-Free Subtyping of Basal Cell Carcinoma from Dermatoscopic Images
summary: Basal Cell Carcinoma (BCC) is the most common type of skin cancer, accounting for nearly 80% of skin cancer di- agnoses. Its optimal clinical management is guided by the distinct histopathologic subtype, with aggressive variants requiring more drastic measures. In current clinical practice, subtyping relies on skin biopsies, a procedure both costly and invasive. In this paper, we conduct a preliminary investigation into using deep learning for BCC subtyping, solely from a single dermatoscopic image of the lesion. Given the limited data at our disposal, we employ pre-trained vision transformers (ViTs), a state-of-the-art family of models highly effective for challenging downstream tasks with limited labeled data. Through repeated stratified k-fold cross-validation, we demonstrate that ViTs can achieve superior performance (AUC 0.784 on a dataset of 1271 dermatoscopic images of various BCC subtypes) over standard CNN-based baselines as well as previously-reported human reader perfor- mance, on the task of differentiating aggressive BCCs from other subtype families. These initial findings highlight the potential of combining deep learning and dermatoscopy to provide a biopsy- free alternative for BCC subtyping, thus aiding in improving treatment planning and patient outcomes.

AI.tldr: 利用预训练ViT从单张皮肤镜图像对BCC进行亚型分型，AUC达0.784，优于CNN基线及人类阅片者。
AI.motivation: BCC是最常见皮肤癌（约占皮肤癌诊断80%），其最优临床管理依赖组织病理亚型，侵袭性亚型需更激进的治疗。但当前亚型判定依赖皮肤活检，成本高且有创，因此需要一种无创的替代方案。
AI.method: 仅基于病灶的单张皮肤镜图像，开展深度学习BCC亚型分型的初步研究。鉴于数据有限，采用预训练视觉Transformer（ViT），并通过重复分层k折交叉验证进行评估，与标准CNN基线对比。
AI.result: 在包含1271张不同BCC亚型皮肤镜图像的数据集上，ViT在区分侵袭性BCC与其他亚型家族的任务中取得AUC 0.784，优于标准CNN基线以及此前报道的人类阅片者表现。
AI.conclusion: 深度学习结合皮肤镜有望为BCC亚型分型提供免活检的替代手段，从而辅助改善治疗规划与患者预后，但该研究仍属初步探索。

title: CircuitLens: Reasoning Circuits as Data Selection Signals for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026 Findings. Long paper. 9 pages + references + appendix
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is sensitive to which problems a model trains on, yet existing selection criteria--difficulty filtering, hand-curation, reward-trajectory scoring--assess data value as an intrinsic property of problems, independent of the model that will learn from them. We introduce Circuit Reasoning Score (CRS), a selection signal derived from 46 reasoning-sensitive attention heads identified via contrastive ablation, computed in a single forward pass on the frozen base model without reward labels or rollouts. CRS runs against the intuitive hypothesis that stronger reasoning-circuit engagement produces better training data: on Qwen2.5-Math-7B, the lowest-engagement decile improves over random selection on three medium-difficulty benchmarks (GSM8K +2.0 pp, OlympiadBench +1.6 pp, Minerva +2.9 pp), while the highest-engagement decile gains less and is indistinguishable from the middle decile. The advantage has boundary conditions: on a domain-curated pool no selection method separates from the others; at 1.5B scale the useful direction differs; and the lowest-reward training condition produces the strongest downstream generalization. Within the Qwen2.5-Math settings tested, RLVR data selection appears regime-dependent rather than reducible to a static ranking of problem quality.

AI.tldr: 提出Circuit Reasoning Score (CRS)，用46个推理敏感注意力头的激活作为RLVR数据选择信号，在Qwen2.5-Math-7B上发现"低参与度十分位"反而优于随机选择，表明RLVR数据选择是regime-dependent而非静态问题质量排序。
AI.motivation: 现有RLVR数据选择标准（难度筛选、人工策展、奖励轨迹打分）将数据价值视为问题的内在属性，与被训练的模型无关。作者希望引入一种依赖模型内部推理机制的、无需奖励标签或rollout的选择信号。
AI.method: 通过对比消融（contrastive ablation）识别出46个推理敏感注意力头，据此定义CRS（Circuit Reasoning Score）。CRS在冻结基模型上单次前向传播即可计算，无需奖励标签或rollout。随后用不同CRS十分位的数据训练RLVR，与随机选择等方法对比。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-Math-7B上，最低参与度十分位优于随机选择（GSM8K +2.0pp、OlympiadBench +1.6pp、Minerva +2.9pp）；最高参与度十分位增益更小，与中间十分位无显著差异。存在边界条件：领域策展数据池上各选择方法无差异；1.5B规模下有用方向不同；最低奖励训练条件产生最强的下游泛化。
AI.conclusion: 在测试的Qwen2.5-Math设定内，RLVR数据选择是regime-dependent的，不能简化为问题质量的静态排序；CRS作为模型相关的选择信号揭示了与直觉相反的数据价值规律。

title: SIFTING: A Novel LLM-Based Framework for Structured and Transparent Information Extraction from Clinical Free-Text Reports, with Application to Tumor Staging in Lung Cancer
summary: Background: Large language models (LLMs) show promise for extracting information from clinical free-text documents, but their outputs are often unstructured and lack traceability, complicating validation and adoption in clinical workflows. In this work we introduce SIFTING, an LLM-based framework designed to address these shortcomings. Methods: SIFTING combines the language comprehension capabilities of LLMs with segment-level processing and structured prompts with strict output control, linking findings to the source text to enable both accurate and transparent information extraction. To demonstrate its capabilities, we applied the framework to the task of extracting tumor T-stage information from 130 lung cancer radiology reports (SIFTING-T-stage). A compact 4-bit quantized version of the open-source LLM Llama-3.3-70B (35 GB) was used in a fully self-hosted setup, providing full control over data and model. Performance was evaluated against a reference standard created by four clinical experts and compared with a range of LLMs as used in a conventional single-prompt approach, using bootstrap resampling to estimate confidence intervals. Results: SIFTING-T-stage achieved an accuracy of 90% (95% CI: 84-95) against the reference standard. We found its performance to be comparable to even the largest state-of-the-art LLMs with reasoning capabilities and to be interchangeable with clinical experts (p < 0.001), while at the same time offering full traceability through source text references. Conclusion: SIFTING enables accurate, structured, and traceable information extraction from clinical free-text documents. It ensures data control, reproducibility, and verifiable outputs that can support clinical validation and workflow integration.

AI.tldr: 提出SIFTING框架，结合LLM语义理解、分段处理与严格约束的结构化提示，实现对临床自由文本的可溯源信息抽取，并在肺癌放射报告T分期任务上验证。
AI.motivation: LLM虽可从临床自由文本中抽取信息，但输出多为非结构化且缺乏可追溯性，导致验证困难，难以嵌入临床工作流。
AI.method: SIFTING将LLM语言理解能力与片段级（segment-level）处理、结构化提示及严格输出控制相结合，把抽取值与源文本片段关联以实现可追溯。应用于130份肺癌放射报告的肿瘤T分期抽取（SIFTING-T-stage）；采用全自托管部署的4-bit量化开源模型Llama-3.3-70B（35 GB）。以四位临床专家建立的参考标准为基准，采用bootstrap重采样估计置信区间，并与常规单提示方式下的多种LLM对比。
AI.result: SIFTING-T-stage准确率90%（95% CI：84–95），性能与具备推理能力的最先进大模型相当，且与临床专家可互换（p < 0.001），同时提供源文本引用级别的完整可追溯性。
AI.conclusion: SIFTING实现了临床自由文本准确、结构化且可追溯的信息抽取，保障数据可控性、可复现性与可验证输出，支持临床验证与工作流整合。

title: CHILD: Human-in-the-Loop OOD Detection for Safe Clinical Deployment
summary: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection is critical for safe deployment of medical AI systems. Recently, test-time adaptation (TTA) has emerged as a new paradigm for OOD detection, automatically adjusting detector behavior during deployment. However, such automatic adaptation mechanisms may raise safety concerns in safety-critical clinical environments. While physician oversight can mitigate these risks, it is resource-intensive and must be judiciously allocated. To reconcile safety with efficiency, we propose CHILD, a training-free framework designed to enhance streaming OOD detection via sparse human feedback. Operating under strict budget constraints, CHILD employs an adaptive risk-aware sample selection mechanism to pinpoint only the most decision-uncertain samples for review. Crucially, it maximizes the utility of this sparse feedback through a retrieval-based score calibration module, which refines model predictions using a compact feature cache without any parameter updates. Extensive experiments on four medical benchmarks demonstrate that CHILD turns limited supervision into significant reliability gains: with a sparse feedback budget of only 5%, it reduces the average FPR95 from 72.63% to 60.26% and improves AUROC from 75.53% to 81.85%, consistently outperforming state-of-the-art baselines. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/figec/CHILD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CHILD，一个无需训练、依托稀疏人类反馈的流式 OOD 检测框架，在仅 5% 反馈预算下显著提升医学 OOD 检测可靠性。
AI.motivation: 医疗 AI 部署中 OOD 检测至关重要，测试时自适应（TTA）虽可自动调整检测器，但在安全攸关的临床环境中其自动适应机制存在安全隐患；而完全依赖医生监督成本高昂，需在安全性与效率之间取得平衡。
AI.method: CHILD 为免训练框架：在严格预算约束下，采用自适应风险感知样本选择机制，仅挑出决策最不确定的样本送审；并利用检索式分数校准模块，通过紧凑特征缓存细化预测，全程不更新模型参数。
AI.result: 在四个医学基准上，仅 5% 稀疏反馈预算即可将平均 FPR95 从 72.63% 降至 60.26%，AUROC 从 75.53% 提升至 81.85%，持续优于当前最优基线。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏人类反馈可被高效转化为可靠性增益，CHILD 在有限监督下兼顾临床安全性与标注效率，为流式 OOD 检测提供了免训练、低成本的解决方案。

title: KABURI-TTS: Phoneme-Keyed Activity-conditioned Bi-channel Utterance Rendering for Interaction
summary: Realizing full-duplex spoken dialogue requires large amounts of two-channel, one-speaker-per-channel conversational speech data. Although conversational text-to-speech (TTS) engines have been developed, they are not necessarily robust to two-party simultaneous phenomena such as backchannels, interruptions, and overlaps that occur while the interlocutor is speaking. In this work, aiming at conversational speech synthesis that reproduces human-like overlap, we propose KABURI-TTS. KABURI-TTS takes a per-speaker phoneme raster as input and renders the speech of the two speakers on separate channels, conditioned on the per-frame phonemes and the voice activity derived from them. Because the phoneme raster is supplied by a separate module, the proposed method enables controllable generation of one-speaker-per-channel, two-party spoken dialogue. A user evaluation shows that, compared with strong baselines, the proposed method attains higher naturalness at both the utterance and the interaction level. Furthermore, an analysis of voice activity confirms that the proposed method produces more overlap and more frequent turn-taking.

AI.tldr: 提出KABURI-TTS，一种以逐说话人音素光栅为输入的双声道对话语音合成方法，可控制生成含重叠与打断的人类式对话。
AI.motivation: 全双工口语对话系统需要大量双声道、每声道一位说话人的对话语音数据；现有对话式TTS对同时说话现象（backchannel、打断、重叠）不够鲁棒，难以复现人类式重叠。
AI.method: 以每位说话人的音素光栅（phoneme raster）为输入，条件于逐帧音素及其导出的语音活动（VAD），将两位说话人的语音分别渲染到不同声道；音素光栅由独立模块提供，从而实现可控的每声道一人的双方对话生成。
AI.result: 用户评测显示，相比强基线，所提方法在话语层级与交互层级的自然度均更高；语音活动分析表明该方法产生了更多重叠和更频繁的话轮转换。
AI.conclusion: 基于音素光栅与语音活动条件的双声道对话TTS能够可控地生成更具人类交互特征的双方对话语音，在自然度与重叠/话轮行为上优于基线。

title: Unraveling the Real Working Mechanism and Inherent Flaws of GAE: A Method for Interpreting Transformer Processes from an Economic Perspective
summary: We observe a phenomenon that current algorithmic research in the field of explainable artificial intelligence primarily pursues better performance on several proxy metrics. On the one hand, these proxy metrics themselves are more or less flawed and cannot properly measure the quality of methods. On the other hand, metric-oriented research approaches often lead to the neglect of the rationality and interpretability of the methods themselves. Explainable artificial intelligence is abbreviated as XAI. The metric-driven research paradigm has resulted in a lack of interpretability of the relevant XAI methods themselves. Accordingly, there is a need for interpretability research on XAI methods, which can be playfully referred to as XXAI. This paper is one of our works on XXAI. This paper takes Generic Attention-model Explainability (GAE), a widely influential model interpretation method , or rather, XAI method that represents an important technical route, as the research object, and explores the real working mechanism and flaws of this method as well as the technical route it represents. Based on the conclusions of this study, it may be necessary to re-examine or verify GAE-related methods and their domain applications. We argue that GAE is an interpretation method that focuses on the attention process. After pointing out the working mechanism and flaws of GAE, we propose Cumulative Asset Holdings (CAH), a more reasonable Transformer interpretation method integrating both process-based and feature-based ideas from an economic zero-sum games perspective. In addition, it is worth noting that our method is applicable to models with special tokens, where existing methods may suffer from limitations. The model simplification research method and the analysis of additive operations adopted in this study may provide inspiration for other research works in XAI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"XXAI"（对XAI方法本身的可解释性研究），以GAE为对象剖析其真实机制与缺陷，并从经济零和博弈视角提出新的Transformer解释方法CAH。
AI.motivation: 当前XAI研究以代理指标为导向，而这些指标本身存在缺陷，且指标驱动范式导致方法自身的合理性与可解释性被忽视，因此需要对XAI方法本身开展可解释性研究（XXAI）。
AI.method: 以GAE（Generic Attention-model Explainability）为研究对象，通过模型简化研究与加性操作分析，揭示其真实工作机理与不足；在此基础上，融合过程型与特征型解释思路，从经济零和博弈视角提出Transformer解释方法CAH（Cumulative Asset Holdings）。
AI.result: 指出GAE是一种聚焦注意力过程的解释方法，并揭示其机制与缺陷；据此提出更合理的CAH方法，且该方法适用于含特殊token的模型——现有方法在此类模型上可能存在局限。基于研究结论，GAE相关方法及其领域应用或需重新审视与验证。
AI.conclusion: XAI方法本身也需要可解释性研究（XXAI）；GAE的原理与局限需被正视，CAH为Transformer解释提供了融合过程与特征、适用于特殊token模型的新思路，其模型简化与加性操作分析可为XAI其他研究提供启发。

title: The Price of Consistency: Exploiting Visual Anchors for Multimodal Jailbreaking in Video Generation
comment: This paper has been accepted to ACM MM 2026
summary: The rapid evolution of video generation has shifted the paradigm from pure text-driven to multi-conditional controllable generation, with reference images now widely adopted as conditional inputs to achieve superior spatiotemporal consistency. While these reference images serve as powerful visual anchors that significantly enhance controllability, their impact on safety remains largely unexplored. In this work, we reveal the visual anchoring effect: by enforcing consistency, the mechanism prevents the generated content from drifting away from the original harmful intent, thereby eliminating the model's natural safety escape route from harmful to benign content. Consequently, visual anchors inherently increase the safety risk---this is the price of consistency. Building on this insight, we propose Decoupling Intent via Visual Anchors (DIVA), a training-free multimodal jailbreak framework for video generation that exploits this vulnerability. DIVA decouples harmful intent into a static visual anchor image and a dynamic motion text prompt, and employs dual-criteria selection to balance attack stealthiness with semantic preservation. Extensive experiments across various leading commercial platforms and mainstream open-source video generation models demonstrate that DIVA achieves a substantially higher Attack Success Rate than existing text-only methods. To facilitate future research, we additionally contribute TI2VSafetyBench, the first safety benchmark for multi-conditional video generation.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示视频生成中参考图像带来的"视觉锚定效应"会消除模型从有害到良性内容的自然安全逃逸路径，从而提升安全风险；并提出免训练的越狱框架DIVA及首个多条件视频生成安全基准TI2VSafetyBench。
AI.motivation: 视频生成已从纯文本驱动转向多条件可控生成，参考图像被广泛用作条件输入以提升时空一致性，但参考图像对安全性的影响尚未被探索。
AI.method: 提出免训练的多模态越狱框架DIVA：将有害意图解耦为静态视觉锚定图像与动态运动文本提示，并采用双标准选择以平衡攻击隐蔽性与语义保持。
AI.result: 在多种领先商用平台与主流开源视频生成模型上的实验表明，DIVA的攻击成功率显著高于现有纯文本方法。
AI.conclusion: 视觉锚定以牺牲安全性为代价换取一致性；DIVA验证了该漏洞的可利用性，并贡献了首个多条件视频生成安全基准TI2VSafetyBench。

title: Proximity-CLIP: Text-Guided Semantic Proximity Learning for Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Including supplementary material
summary: Vision-language models offer a promising approach for zero-shot anomaly detection (ZSAD). However, due to object-centric bias, normal and anomalous text prototypes exhibit a high semantic overlap. While enforcing strict orthogonality between them improves discriminability, mapping highly contiguous visual inputs onto drastically orthogonal prototypes introduces a geometric dilemma, disrupting the pre-trained structural continuity. To address this problem, we propose Proximity-CLIP, a framework that visually calibrates the semantic margin to guide visual adaptation. First, we introduce a visually-calibrated semantic proximity learning mechanism that uses a bounded dynamic regularization to learn an appropriate semantic margin, ensuring discriminative separation while preserving structural alignment. Second, we design an Anomaly Query Module (AQM) driven by these text priors. Using the calibrated anomalous prototype as a semantic query, the AQM actively retrieves localized defect cues from contextual visual patches, mitigating the dilution of subtle anomalies during global pooling. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Proximity-CLIP outperforms current state-of-the-art methods across multiple ZSAD benchmarks with minimal architectural modifications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Proximity-CLIP 框架，通过视觉校准的语义邻近度学习与异常查询模块，在保持预训练结构连续性的同时提升零样本异常检测的判别能力。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型用于零样本异常检测时存在物体中心偏置，导致正常与异常文本原型语义高度重叠；强制二者严格正交虽提升判别性，却造成几何困境：高度连续的视觉输入被映射到极度正交的原型上，破坏预训练的结构连续性。
AI.method: 提出视觉校准语义间隔的框架 Proximity-CLIP，包含两部分：一是视觉校准的语义邻近度学习机制，利用有界动态正则化学习合适的语义间隔，兼顾判别性分离与结构对齐；二是由文本先验驱动的异常查询模块（AQM），以校准后的异常原型作为语义查询，从上下文视觉图块中主动检索局部缺陷线索。
AI.result: 在多个零样本异常检测基准上，Proximity-CLIP 以极小的架构改动优于当前最先进方法，缓解了全局池化对细微异常的稀释问题。
AI.conclusion: 通过视觉校准语义间隔来引导视觉适配，可在不破坏预训练结构连续性的前提下实现有效的零样本异常检测。

title: CEDAR: Error-Bounded Residual Routing for Efficient Long-Context Attention
summary: Post-hoc sparse attention accelerates long-context prefill by routing each query to a small set of token-level interactions. Hard selection, however, assigns zero probability to every omitted chunk: a routing miss cannot be recovered, and a fixed expansion budget spends the same work on easy and ambiguous queries. We introduce Coarse-to-fine Error-aware Dynamic Attention Routing (CEDAR), a coarse-to-fine method that keeps the language model frozen while preserving global coverage. Each semantic chunk contributes a cheap key--value summary to a residual attention path; chunks with high estimated approximation error are then expanded to exact token attention. Exact and summarized contributions are combined in a single softmax normalization, so refinement replaces, rather than duplicates, coarse evidence. We derive an output-error bound governed by within-chunk key/value dispersion and use it to allocate a variable refinement budget. A controlled clustered-attention study shows that residual summaries reduce reconstruction error by more than 98% relative to hard dropping at equal exact-chunk budgets. Experiments on long-context benchmarks demonstrate that CEDAR recovers most of the quality lost by hard sparse routing while maintaining approximately $3\times$ kernel speedup at 128K context.

AI.tldr: CEDAR是一种保持语言模型冻结的由粗到细动态注意力路由方法：为每个语义块构建廉价KV摘要作为残差注意力路径，对高误差块扩展为精确token注意力，并在单一softmax中融合，实现可变细化预算，在128K上下文下获得约3倍核加速并挽回硬稀疏路由的质量损失。
AI.motivation: 后验稀疏注意力通过将每个query路由到少量token级交互来加速长上下文prefill，但硬选择会给被省略块分配零概率，导致路由失误不可恢复；且固定扩展预算对简单与歧义query花费相同计算量，缺乏自适应性。
AI.method: 提出CEDAR：1）每个语义块向残差注意力路径贡献廉价的key-value摘要，保证全局覆盖；2）根据估计近似误差，将高误差块扩展为精确token注意力；3）精确与摘要贡献在单一softmax归一化中合并，使细化是替换而非重复粗粒度证据；4）推导由块内key/value离散度决定的输出误差上界，并据此分配可变细化预算。
AI.result: 受控聚类注意力实验表明，在相同精确块预算下，残差摘要相较硬丢弃将重构误差降低98%以上。长上下文基准实验显示，CEDAR挽回了硬稀疏路由损失的大部分质量，同时在128K上下文下保持约3倍核加速。
AI.conclusion: CEDAR通过残差摘要与误差感知的动态细化，在冻结模型的前提下兼顾全局覆盖与计算效率，有效缓解硬稀疏路由不可恢复的路由失误问题，实现质量与速度的良好折中。

title: BEACON: Behavior and Appearance Control for Subject-Specific Video Generation
summary: Generating human-centric videos that preserve both visual identity and person-specific expressive behavior remains a fundamental challenge. In addition to reproducing appearance, a model must replicate the facial behaviors that characterize how a subject expresses emotion over time. However, most state-of-the-art methods condition generation on a single reference image, which contains no information about these temporal dynamics. As a result, they tend to preserve the subject's visual identity but often produce expressions with limited variation and weak subject specificity. To mitigate this issue, we introduce BEACON, a lightweight framework for person-specific video generation that produces more expressive videos by disentangling visual identity from expressive behavior. BEACON conditions generation on two complementary signals: a reference image encoding the identity and a reference video capturing subject-specific facial dynamics. By conditioning on these complementary signals, BEACON generates videos that better preserve both the subject's appearance and characteristic facial dynamics, while also supporting identity-expression transfer. Our experiments on the MEAD and RAVDESS datasets show that by fine-tuning on approximately 2,000 pairs and updating about 1% of the pretrained Wan video diffusion model, BEACON improves facial expressivity over state-of-the-art video generation methods while maintaining competitive identity preservation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BEACON，一个轻量级的人物特定视频生成框架。它通过将视觉身份与表达行为解耦，以参考图像（身份）和参考视频（面部动态）双条件驱动生成，从而在保持身份的同时提升面部表达力，并支持身份-表情迁移。
AI.motivation: 以人为中心的视频生成需同时保持视觉身份与人物特有的表达行为（面部表情随时间变化的动态）。然而，现有主流方法多以单张参考图像为条件，图像不包含时间动态信息，因此往往只能保持视觉身份，生成的表情变化有限、人物特异性弱。
AI.method: BEACON是一个轻量级人物特定视频生成框架，核心是解耦视觉身份与表达行为。它使用两个互补条件：一张编码身份的参考图像，以及一段捕捉人物特定面部动态的参考视频。基于该双条件，模型在生成中同时保留外观特征与特有的面部动态，并支持身份-表情迁移。实现上基于预训练的Wan视频扩散模型进行微调。
AI.result: 在MEAD和RAVDESS数据集上，仅用约2,000对样本微调、更新约1%的预训练Wan视频扩散模型参数，BEACON在面部表达力上优于现有最先进视频生成方法，同时保持有竞争力的身份保持能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过以身份图像和动态视频解耦建模，并以极低微调成本实现，BEACON有效缓解了单图像条件下表达力不足、人物特异性弱的问题，验证了双条件解耦策略在人物特定视频生成中的有效性。

title: MV-STRIDE: Enabling MLLMs to Master Multi-View Spatial Reasoning via Hierarchical Capability Modeling
summary: Despite the rapid progress of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) in 2D vision-language tasks, robust multi-view spatial reasoning remains a fundamental bottleneck due to the lack of structured 3D cognitive pathways in existing datasets. To address this, we introduce MV-STRIDE, a Multi-View hierarchical SpaTial Reasoning dataset with Interdependent and DEcomposed capabilitiEs.
