Moving beyond flat data structures, MV-STRIDE explicitly models the dependency relationships between foundational perception, scene understanding, and complex contextual reasoning, providing a coherent learning pathway aligned with human spatial cognition. We develop a systematic QA generation pipeline leveraging diverse 3D scene sources that enforces cross-view dependency constraints to prevent single-view solvability, generating multi-level spatial reasoning tasks supported by cognitively grounded chain-of-thought supervision for complex inference. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our multi-stage training framework based on our hierarchical dataset achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple spatial reasoning benchmarks, notably the multi-view oriented MMSI-Bench. Our approach enables MLLMs to maintain robust, 3D-consistent spatial reasoning across diverse viewpoints. The code and dataset are available at https://co1dspring.github.io/MV-STRIDE/.

AI.tldr: 论文提出MV-STRIDE，一个多视角层次化空间推理数据集，通过显式建模能力间依赖关系与跨视角约束，并配套多阶段训练框架，使MLLM在多视角空间推理基准上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型在2D视觉-语言任务上进展迅速，但多视角空间推理仍是瓶颈；根本原因在于现有数据集缺乏结构化的3D认知路径，数据多为扁平结构，未体现基础感知、场景理解与复杂情境推理之间的依赖关系，且存在单视角即可求解的捷径问题。
AI.method: 构建MV-STRIDE数据集，显式建模基础感知、场景理解、复杂情境推理之间的层级依赖，形成符合人类空间认知的学习路径；设计系统性QA生成流水线，利用多样3D场景源并施加跨视角依赖约束，防止单视角可解性；生成多层级空间推理任务，并为复杂推理提供具认知依据的思维链监督；基于该层次化数据集提出多阶段训练框架。
AI.result: 大量评测表明，基于该层次化数据集的多阶段训练框架在多个空间推理基准上取得SOTA性能，尤其是在多视角导向的MMSI-Bench上表现突出；模型能够在多样视角下保持稳健且3D一致的空间推理能力。
AI.conclusion: MV-STRIDE通过层次化、依赖建模与跨视角约束的数据构造及配套多阶段训练，有效弥补了MLLM多视角3D空间推理的认知路径缺失，提升了跨视角空间推理的稳健性与一致性；代码与数据集已开源。

title: LightSplat: Real-Time High-Fidelity 3D Gaussian SLAM with Loop Closure
comment: Accepted to 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS)
summary: SLAM systems based on 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have recently demonstrated promising reconstruction accuracy for dense 3D scene representations. However, current 3DGS systems struggle to meet the strict demands of real-world deployments due to severe limitations in operational performance and map adaptability. To this end, we propose LightSplat, a hybrid-representation RGB-D SLAM framework. It synergizes local sparse features for robust and fast tracking with a dual-thread backend that progressively constructs dense Gaussian submaps. Crucially, we enable online loop closure through feature-accelerated 3DGS registration, refining overall map consistency through pose graph optimization. Ultimately, LightSplat achieves the online reconstruction of high-fidelity Gaussian map. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets and real-world robotic platform demonstrate that our method achieves near state-of-the-art reconstruction quality and the capability to accommodate practical camera motions, maintaining an average framerate of 8 FPS. Overall, LightSplat provides an efficient and robust foundation for deploying high-fidelity 3DGS in real-world environments.

AI.tldr: LightSplat是一种混合表示RGB-D SLAM框架，结合稀疏特征跟踪与双线程高斯子图后端，通过特征加速的3DGS配准实现在线回环，可在8 FPS下获得接近SOTA的重建质量。
AI.motivation: 现有基于3DGS的SLAM系统虽然重建精度高，但在运行性能和地图适应性方面存在严重不足，难以满足真实场景部署的严格要求。
AI.method: 提出LightSplat混合表示RGB-D SLAM框架：前端利用局部稀疏特征实现快速鲁棒跟踪；后端采用双线程渐进式构建稠密高斯子图；并借助稀疏特征加速3DGS配准实现在线回环检测，通过位姿图优化全局地图一致性。
AI.result: 在多数据集和真实机器人平台上的实验表明，方法达到接近SOTA的重建质量，能适应实际相机运动，平均帧率达8 FPS。
AI.conclusion: LightSplat为在真实环境中部署高保真3DGS提供了高效且鲁棒的基础，兼顾在线重建质量与运行效率。

title: Separating Stream Stability from Long-Term Recall in Language Models
summary: Methods for streaming language models are often discussed alongside long-context and memory systems, although they solve different problems. An attention sink can stabilize autoregressive generation over an indefinitely long stream while the model remains unable to use content that has left its recent-token cache. We argue that this distinction should be explicit in system claims and evaluation. We introduce three horizons: the stability horizon, over which predictive behavior remains well behaved; the access horizon, over which past content can still causally affect the output; and the utility horizon, over which a task retains acceptable performance. We show constructively that the stability horizon can be infinite while the access and utility horizons are finite. We then propose ThreeH, an evaluation contract that measures all three horizons under a common state and compute budget. Applying the framework to attention-sink streaming clarifies its strength, constant-memory, stable generation, without treating anchor tokens as semantic memory. The framework exposes roles for cache policies, recurrent state, retrieval, and external memory. Experiments on 128K-token streams, delayed binding recall, and delayed decisions show that attention sinks preserve local modeling but not content beyond the active cache; recurrent and retrieval state extend the semantic horizon.

AI.tldr: 本文提出流式语言模型的三个"视界"（稳定性、可访问性、效用），论证稳定性视界可无限而可访问与效用视界有限，并提出评估契约 ThreeH 在统一状态与计算预算下测量三者，实验表明注意力汇仅保持局部建模能力。
AI.motivation: 流式语言模型常与长上下文、记忆系统混为一谈，但二者解决不同问题：注意力汇能在无限长流上稳定自回归生成，模型却无法使用已离开近期 token 缓存的内容。作者主张在系统主张与评估中必须明确区分这一差异，避免将锚点 token 误当作语义记忆。
AI.method: 引入三个视界概念：稳定性视界（预测行为保持良好）、可访问性视界（过去内容仍能因果影响输出）、效用视界（任务保持可接受性能）。建设性地证明稳定性视界可无限而可访问性与效用视界有限。提出 ThreeH 评估契约，在共同的状态与计算预算下测量三个视界，并据此厘清缓存策略、循环状态、检索与外部记忆的作用。
AI.result: 在 128K token 流、延迟绑定回忆与延迟决策实验上，注意力汇保持局部建模能力，但无法保留活跃缓存之外的内容；循环状态与检索状态可扩展语义视界。
AI.conclusion: 稳定性、可访问性与效用三类视界应被显式区分与评估，ThreeH 框架为流式语言模型提供了统一的评估契约，并澄清了注意力汇的边界：其优势在于常量内存与稳定生成，而非语义记忆。

title: TAD: Token-Adaptive Contrastive Decoding with Confidence-Guided Gating for Hallucination Mitigation in Large Audio-Language Models
summary: Large audio-language models (LALMs) can hallucinate audio objects, answering "yes" to absent sound events, thus undermining reliability in audio question answering. We propose Token-Adaptive Decoding (TAD), a training-free strategy for hallucination mitigation that grounds the initial yes/no decision by contrasting logits under real audio with a matched silent reference. TAD introduces a token-adaptive, confidence-guided gate that is decision-critical at the first decoding step and class-conditional on affirmative tokens, using the audio-silent margin to avoid overcorrection when evidence is weak or already sufficient. Experiments on AudioCaps-Hallucination show that, relative to Audio-Aware Decoding (AAD), a contrastive baseline with fixed contrast strength, TAD improves F1 for Qwen2 by 0.059 to 0.117 across Popular, Adversarial, and Random splits, and for Gemma by 0.025 to 0.064, while on Clotho-AQA it raises F1 from 0.810 to 0.816 on Qwen2 and remains comparable to AAD on Gemma.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的Token-Adaptive Decoding (TAD)，通过真实音频与静音参考的logits对比，缓解大音频语言模型的幻觉，在AudioCaps-Hallucination上F1较AAD显著提升。
AI.motivation: 大音频语言模型(LALMs)会产生音频对象幻觉，对不存在的声事件回答"yes"，从而削弱音频问答的可靠性。已有对比式解码(如AAD)采用固定对比强度，在证据微弱或已充分时易造成过度纠正。
AI.method: TAD为免训练策略：以真实音频与匹配静音参考下的logits对比来锚定初始yes/no判断；引入token-adaptive、置信度引导的门控，该门控在首个解码步具有决策关键性，并针对肯定token做类别条件化；利用音频-静音margin在证据弱或已充分时避免过度纠正。
AI.result: 在AudioCaps-Hallucination上，相较固定对比强度的AAD：Qwen2在Popular、Adversarial、Random三个划分上F1提升0.059–0.117，Gemma提升0.025–0.064；在Clotho-AQA上Qwen2的F1由0.810升至0.816，Gemma与AAD相当。
AI.conclusion: TAD是一种免训练、token自适应的解码策略，能有效缓解LALMs的音频对象幻觉并提升问答可靠性，且对多种模型与数据集具有泛化性。

title: Probing the Structure and Dynamics of LLM Value Expression through Value Conflicts
comment: Code and data are available at https://github.com/ZeroGen-Lab/CFProbe
summary: Ethical evaluation of Large Language Models (LLMs) often characterizes model values as static and monolithic. In contrast, we argue that LLM value expression is better understood as a structured yet dynamic phenomenon. To investigate this, we introduce Conflict-driven Value Probing, a controlled framework that places LLMs in value conflicts and implements four types of interventions that perturb these conflicts to probe LLM value expression. Applying this framework to ten LLMs, we identify three recurring patterns. (1) Expression duality: models shift from broad idealistic orientations in abstract assessment toward more pragmatic priorities in concrete conflicts. (2) Functional steerability: models readily reconfigure their expressed value profiles toward task-defined value objectives. (3) Bounded plasticity: such reconfiguration is not without constraints, i.e. pressure induces a security- and goal-oriented priority shift while negative framing distinguishes protected values from those more amenable to redirection. Together, these findings characterize both the structure and dynamics of LLM value expression: context flexibly reconfigures expressed priorities, yet within behavioral boundaries. This behavioral account provides a foundation for understanding controllability, alignment, and safety in LLMs. Code and data are available at https://github.com/ZeroGen-Lab/CFProbe.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"冲突驱动价值探测"框架，将大模型价值表达视为结构化且动态的现象，通过四种干预手段在十个模型上揭示出表达二元性、功能可操控性与有限可塑性三大规律。
AI.motivation: 既有LLM伦理评估多将模型价值观视为静态、单一的，忽视了其在不同情境下的动态变化。作者主张LLM价值表达实为"结构化但动态"的现象，需通过受控的价值冲突情境加以考察。
AI.method: 提出冲突驱动价值探测（Conflict-driven Value Probing）框架：将LLM置于价值冲突情境中，并施加四类扰动冲突的干预方式，以探测其价值表达。该框架应用于十种LLM进行实证分析。
AI.result: 识别出三类反复出现的模式：（1）表达二元性——模型从抽象评估中的宽泛理想主义取向，转向具体冲突中的务实优先项；（2）功能可操控性——模型可依任务设定的价值目标重新配置其表达的价值画像；（3）有限可塑性——重配置受行为边界约束，压力引发安全与目标导向的优先级转移，负面框架则可区分受保护价值与易被重定向的价值。
AI.conclusion: LLM价值表达兼具结构与动态性：情境可灵活重构其表达优先级，但始终处于行为边界之内。该行为学视角为理解LLM的可控性、对齐与安全性提供了基础。

title: KODAMA: Multimodal Digital Twin Reconstruction for Urban RF Propagation Modelling
summary: 3D reconstruction typically strives for geometric fidelity or visual plausibility. Radio frequency digital twins (RFDT) are instead judged by whether communication channels behave in them as they do in the real world. RFDTs promise site-specific channel prediction but current practice forces a choice between coarse automated scenes and hand-built, measurement-calibrated models that take weeks to construct per-site. We present KODAMA, an automated pipeline that reconstructs ray tracing-ready RFDTs at city scale from off-the-shelf geospatial data alone: aerial imagery, LiDAR, and photogrammetry yield terrain and watertight building meshes, while exposure-weighted multi-view fusion of street-level imagery recovers façade relief, electromagnetic materials, and clutter---all without site visits or calibration. Across three sites spanning 3.6 to 28 GHz, KODAMA's uncalibrated predictions achieve single-digit RMSE, reducing point-to-point error by up to 5.35 dB over automated baselines and coming within 0.22 dB of a measurement-calibrated, hand-built RFDT.

AI.tldr: 提出KODAMA，一种仅用现成地理空间数据（航拍、LiDAR、街景）自动构建城市级射频数字孪生（RFDT）的流水线，无需实地测量与校准，在3.6–28 GHz三个站点实现单元数dB级RMSE，较自动基线最多降低5.35 dB点对点误差。
AI.motivation: RFDT的评价标准不是几何保真或视觉逼真，而是信道行为是否与真实世界一致。当前RFDT构建面临两难：自动化场景粗糙，而手工建模+测量校准的模型每站点需数周。因此需要一种兼顾精度与可扩展性的自动化构建方案。
AI.method: KODAMA为全自动流水线，仅依赖现成地理空间数据：由航拍影像、LiDAR与摄影测量生成地形与封闭建筑网格；通过曝光加权的多视角融合街景影像，恢复立面起伏、电磁材料参数与杂乱体（clutter）；全流程无需实地访问或校准，输出可直接用于射线追踪的RFDT。
AI.result: 在3.6–28 GHz的三个站点上，KODAMA未校准预测达到个位数dB的RMSE，点对点误差较自动化基线最多降低5.35 dB，与经测量校准的手工RFDT差距仅0.22 dB。
AI.conclusion: KODAMA证明无需实地测量与校准，仅凭现成地理空间数据即可在城市尺度自动重建射线追踪可用的RFDT，精度接近人工校准模型，为站点特定信道预测提供了可扩展的低成本方案。

title: Marginal Fidelity Does Not Establish User Simulation in Demographic Synthetic Survey Panels: Response Contracts, Support Collapse and Conditioning Failure
summary: Demographic synthetic survey panels are often validated by matching aggregate answers to published surveys. We test what that certificate establishes across six multiselect batteries from four survey organisations in three countries. The headline analysis is restricted to three instruments whose synthetic cohort and human target share the stated population frame; three other batteries remain sensitivity analyses. The response contract dominates measured fidelity. In the aligned instruments, committed sets leave 66 of 128 model-battery option slots empty in panels of up to 500 respondents, versus 0 of 128 under per-option probability elicitation. Across eight uncapped model-instrument comparisons, probabilities reduce option-marginal MAE by 4.53 to 7.30 points. The capped instrument reverses on two models until the vectors are projected onto its stated maximum. These are measurement effects: human targets are realised check-all responses, whereas the vectors are latent inclusion propensities. Published marginal agreement also fails to discriminate respondent simulation from direct population estimation. On nine aligned model-battery pairs, a no-persona population-prevalence query averages 6.27 MAE versus 12.39 for committed panels and wins all nine comparisons. Constraint-aware probability vectors average 5.34 and beat the query on four of nine, so the baseline challenges the validation criterion rather than proving direct estimation uniformly best. On three unpublished demographic cells, neither approach beats reciting the national distribution. Population-marginal agreement is therefore evidence about an elicitation contract and an estimand obtainable without simulated respondents, not evidence of individual simulation.

AI.tldr: 该论文论证：合成调查面板与已发布调查的"总体边际一致性"并不证明个体层面的模拟能力，它主要反映的是响应契约（重复抽取是否被允许）与估计目标（潜在纳入倾向 vs 实际勾选结果）的差异。
AI.motivation: 人口学合成调查面板（synthetic survey panels）常用"聚合答案与已发布调查匹配"作为验证凭证。作者质疑这一验证标准的效力：边际一致性究竟证明了什么？是否存在无需模拟个体即可达到同样边际匹配的替代方式？因此需要拆解响应契约、估计目标与验证指标三者的混淆。
AI.method: 选取三个国家、四家调查机构的六个多选题目组（batteries）进行实验。主分析仅保留合成队列与人类目标共享同一总体框的三个工具，其余三个作为敏感性分析。对比两类响应契约：允许重复的"承诺集合"（committed sets）与逐选项概率elicitation（per-option probability）。在八个无上限模型-工具比较中考察选项边际MAE；对有上限工具进行向量投影处理。另设九组对齐的模型-题目对，比较三种策略：无persona的总体流行率查询（population-prevalence query）、承诺面板、约束感知概率向量；并在三个人口学单元上测试"复述全国分布"基线。
AI.result: 响应契约主导测量保真度：在对齐工具中，最多500名respondent的承诺面板在128个模型-题目选项槽中留空66个，而逐选项概率elicitation为0/128。八个无上限比较中，概率方法将选项边际MAE降低4.53–7.30个百分点。有上限工具在两个模型上出现反转，直到向量投影到其声明上限才纠正。人类目标是"勾选全部"的实际响应，而向量是潜在纳入倾向，属测量效应。发布边际一致性无法区分respondent模拟与直接总体估计：九个对齐对中，无persona查询平均MAE为6.27，承诺面板为12.39，前者九战全胜；约束感知概率向量平均5.34，九对中四胜查询。在三个未发布人口学单元上，两种方法均不如直接复述全国分布。
AI.conclusion: 总体边际一致性是关于elicitation契约与一个无需模拟respondent即可获得的估计目标的证据，而非个体模拟能力的证据。该结果挑战了以边际匹配作为合成面板验证标准的做法，但也不主张直接估计在所有情形下最优。

title: RouteRelay: Event-Triggered Cross-Layer Route Reuse for Efficient Dynamic Sparse Attention
summary: Dynamic sparse attention reduces long-context prefill cost by routing each query chunk to a small set of key chunks at every Transformer layer. The sparse attention kernel avoids most token interactions, but the router still rebuilds a chunk--chunk score matrix layer after layer, even when the selected routes change little. We introduce RouteRelay, a router-agnostic method that reuses only route metadata across depth while continuing to compute attention with the current layer's queries, keys, and values. Anchor layers perform full routing. Intermediate layers rescore the previous top-$k$ route and a compact sentinel set of near-miss and randomly probed chunks. A query row is rerouted only when a sentinel challenges its weakest selected chunk. We give a top-$k$ stability condition, a probabilistic bound on missed challengers, and a row-selective GPU execution design. In a reproducible empirical evaluation, RouteRelay retains at least 99.99% route recall while rerouting 25.0%, 55.4%, and 78.2% of rows under low, moderate, and high cross-layer drift, respectively. Across routing scales, RouteRelay retains 100.0% recall while evaluating 38.4--51.6% of full-routing score pairs as the key-chunk count grows from 128 to 1024. Its unfused CPU execution remains slower than dense matrix multiplication, exposing row compaction and ledger updates as the main kernel-engineering targets.

AI.tldr: RouteRelay 是一种与路由器无关的方法，通过跨层复用路由元数据（而非重建完整 chunk-chunk 分数矩阵）来降低长上下文预填充中动态稀疏注意力的开销：锚层执行完整路由，中间层仅对上一层 top-k 路由及哨兵集重打分，仅在哨兵挑战最弱已选块时重路由该查询行。
AI.motivation: 动态稀疏注意力虽减少 token 交互，但路由器逐层重建 chunk-chunk 分数矩阵，即使所选路由变化很小，仍构成显著开销。
AI.method: 跨深度复用路由元数据，注意力仍用当前层的 Q/K/V 计算；锚层完整路由，中间层对上一层 top-k 路由及由近失块与随机探测块组成的紧凑哨兵集重打分，仅当哨兵挑战最弱已选块时重路由该行；给出 top-k 稳定性条件、漏检挑战者的概率界，以及行选择式 GPU 执行设计。
AI.result: 保留至少 99.99% 的路由召回率，在低/中/高跨层漂移下分别重路由 25.0%、55.4%、78.2% 的行；关键块数从 128 增至 1024 时保留 100.0% 召回率，仅评估 38.4--51.6% 的完整路由分数对；未融合 CPU 执行仍慢于稠密矩阵乘法。
AI.conclusion: RouteRelay 以极小召回损失大幅减少路由计算；未融合 CPU 执行慢于稠密矩阵乘法，说明行压缩与账本更新是主要内核工程优化目标。

title: SPARROW: Scalable Taxonomy Induction via Structure-Preserving Partitioning and Constraint-Guided Merging
summary: Taxonomy induction aims to organize concept sets into coherent hierarchical structures. Recent LLM-based methods can induce taxonomies directly from flat term lists, avoiding the need for corpora, but degrade sharply as concept sets scale up. We argue that this degradation stems not only from context length limitations, but also from structural failures in hierarchical reasoning. To address this, we adopt a divide-and-merge paradigm that partitions concepts into smaller subsets, induces local taxonomies, and merges them into a global hierarchy. However, we identify two structural failure modes inherent to this paradigm: Structural Fragmentation, where partitioning weakens local hierarchical signals, and Parent Displacement, where locally plausible relations are misplaced in the global hierarchy. To address both, we propose SPARROW, a scalable taxonomy induction framework that combines structure-preserving spectral partitioning to retain hierarchical connectivity within each block, and constraint-guided incremental fusion that treats block-level relations as structural constraints rather than ground truth for global placement. Experiments on large-scale benchmarks show that SPARROW consistently achieves the strongest global structural quality across backbones. The code is available at https://github.com/rebeccazyr/SPARROW.

AI.tldr: 提出SPARROW框架，通过保结构谱划分与约束引导增量融合，解决大规模概念集下分类体系归纳的结构性失效问题。
AI.motivation: 近期基于大语言模型的方法可直接从扁平术语列表归纳分类体系，无需语料库，但随着概念集规模扩大性能急剧下降。作者认为该退化不仅源于上下文长度限制，还源于分层推理中的结构性失效。
AI.method: 采用分治-合并范式：将概念划分为较小子集、归纳局部体系、再合并为全局层次。针对该范式固有的两种结构失效模式——结构碎片化（划分削弱局部层次信号）与父节点错位（局部合理关系在全局中被误置）——提出SPARROW：结合保结构谱划分以保留块内层次连通性，并采用约束引导的增量融合，将块级关系视为结构约束而非全局放置的真值。
AI.result: 在大规模基准上，SPARROW在不同骨干模型上均持续取得最强的全局结构质量。
AI.conclusion: SPARROW通过结构保持与约束引导融合有效缓解分治-合并范式的结构失效，实现可扩展且全局结构质量最优的分类体系归纳，代码已开源。

title: LANTERN: Language Model Assessment on Noisy and Transformed Tasks for Understanding Error and Robustness Nuances
summary: Robustness evaluation of large language models (LLMs) remains a critical challenge, particularly in assessing their sensitivity to perturbations in input data. In this work, we systematically evaluate LLM robustness across multiple dimensions, including word error rate, character repetition and duplication, modifications in choices, and variability in instruction following. To facilitate this evaluation, we construct a synthetic and augmented dataset encompassing a diverse set of LLM benchmarks, specifically targeting multiple-choice question (MCQ) datasets and instruction-following tasks. We conduct extensive experiments on LLMs of varying scales-small, medium, and large-as well as across base and instruction-tuned variants. Our analysis quantifies the variability in model responses under perturbed conditions and highlights discrepancies relative to baseline models. The findings provide insights into the stability of LLMs across different evaluation scenarios contributing to the development of more robust and reliable language models as well as robust evaluation methodologies.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了大语言模型（LLMs）在多种输入扰动下的鲁棒性，涵盖词错误率、字符重复与冗余、选项修改以及指令跟随变化等维度，并构建合成增强数据集进行多尺度、多类型模型实验。
AI.motivation: LLMs的鲁棒性评估仍是关键挑战，尤其是其对输入数据扰动的敏感性尚需系统量化；现有评估缺乏跨维度、跨模型规模与变体的统一分析。
AI.method: 构建面向多种LLM基准的合成与增强数据集，重点覆盖多项选择题（MCQ）与指令跟随任务；在小型、中型、大型LLM以及基础版与指令微调版上进行广泛实验，量化扰动条件下模型响应的变异并与基线对比。
AI.result: 实验量化了扰动条件下模型响应的变异性，并揭示了相对于基线模型的性能差异；不同规模与变体在各类扰动维度上的稳定性表现存在差异。
AI.conclusion: 研究为理解LLMs在不同评估场景下的稳定性提供洞见，有助于推动更鲁棒、更可靠的语言模型及鲁棒评估方法的发展。

title: Weakly supervised neural network: segmentation of complex structures in X-ray microCT
summary: Segmentation of complex structures in X-ray tomographic data is a fundamental task in biomedical research, but it often requires large amounts of precisely annotated data, making fully supervised approaches costly and difficult to scale. In this study, weakly supervised deep learning is investigated as a strategy to reduce annotation effort while maintaining accurate segmentation. A two-dimensional convolutional neural network based on the nnU-Net framework was adapted to a weak supervision setting using sparse dot-based annotations, complemented by a limited number of fully segmented images. The approach was evaluated on high-resolution microCT slices of rat kidneys, targeting the segmentation of renal glomeruli, which are small, low-contrast anatomical structures. Results indicate that weak supervision provides a meaningful learning signal, enabling reliable localization of glomeruli even in the absence of dense labels. Incorporating a small set of high-quality annotations substantially improves segmentation performance, approaching that of a fully supervised model. These findings highlight the potential of weakly supervised learning as an annotation-efficient strategy for the analysis of complex structures in X-ray tomographic data, and suggest that alternative loss formulations tailored to sparse annotations may further enhance performance.

AI.tldr: 本研究探索弱监督深度学习在X射线断层数据分割中的应用，采用稀疏点标注配合少量全标注图像，基于nnU-Net的2D CNN用于大鼠肾脏微CT中肾小球分割，证明弱监督可提供有效学习信号并接近全监督性能。
AI.motivation: X射线断层数据中复杂结构的分割是生物医学研究的基础任务，但全监督方法依赖大量精确标注，成本高且难以规模化，因此需要降低标注负担的策略。
AI.method: 将基于nnU-Net框架的二维卷积神经网络适配至弱监督设置，使用稀疏点标注并辅以少量全分割图像，在高分辨率大鼠肾脏microCT切片上评估，目标为分割小型、低对比度的肾小球结构。
AI.result: 弱监督提供了有意义的学习信号，即使缺乏密集标签也能可靠定位肾小球；加入少量高质量标注后分割性能显著提升，接近全监督模型水平。
AI.conclusion: 弱监督学习是X射线断层数据中复杂结构分析的一种标注高效策略，且针对稀疏标注设计替代损失函数有望进一步提升性能。

title: Content-Based Addressing for Long Context
summary: Rotary position embedding (RoPE) uses each token's integer position to determine the rotation applied inside attention. This works well for local token order, but increasing context length creates a positional train-test mismatch: RoPE produces relative rotations at offsets not seen during training. Methods that rescale, interpolate, randomize, or bias positions specify how attention handles those offsets, but still derive positional information from a growing token counter. We instead divide a token stream into units, retain ordinary RoPE positions within each unit, and assign every completed unit an address computed from its content. Adding units then applies the same learned map to new content rather than extending a positional range or an identifier table. We prove that this construction preserves local RoPE exactly, leaves the attention comparison between two fixed tokens unchanged when other units are inserted or reordered, and does not create new relative rotations merely because more units are added. In a character-level Tiny Shakespeare diagnostic, all-token validation perplexity remains approximately constant from contexts of 256 to 4096 characters. A second diagnostic shows that content-based addressing can retrieve and use information from multiple serialized facts. These are controlled shallow experiments, not scale benchmarks, but they support a direct prescription: use position to address locally and content to address across units.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种将token流划分为单元、单元内保留普通RoPE位置、单元间用内容计算地址的位置编码构造，从而避免上下文增长带来的位置训练-测试失配。
AI.motivation: RoPE用整型位置确定注意力中的旋转，在局部token顺序上表现良好，但上下文变长会造成位置训练-测试失配：RoPE在训练未见过的偏移上产生相对旋转。现有重缩放、插值、随机化或偏置位置的方法仍需依赖不断增长的位置计数器，因此作者希望用内容地址替代跨单元的位置范围扩展。
AI.method: 将token流划分为单元（units），单元内部保留普通RoPE位置；每个完成的单元根据其内容计算一个地址。新增单元时，对新的内容应用同一个学习到的映射，而不是扩展位置范围或标识符表。
AI.result: 证明：该构造精确保留局部RoPE；当插入或重排其他单元时，两个固定token之间的注意力比较保持不变；不会仅因增加更多单元而产生新的相对旋转。字符级Tiny Shakespeare诊断实验中，256到4096字符上下文的全体token验证困惑度基本恒定；第二个诊断表明基于内容的寻址可检索并使用多个序列化事实中的信息。
AI.conclusion: 这些是受控的浅层实验，并非规模基准，但支持一个直接建议：在局部使用位置寻址，在跨单元时使用内容寻址。

title: CRISP: Corneal Confocal Microscopy Real-Time Image Stitching Pipeline
summary: Morphology of the sub-basal nerve plexus (SNP) reflects peripheral nerve health, and corneal confocal microscopy (CCM) provides an important means for in vivo, real-time, non-invasive observation of the SNP. However, mainstream CCM devices offer a limited field of view per frame, whereas the SNP is spatially non-uniform; discrete image sampling is therefore sensitive to sampling location and frame selection, which limits the reproducibility and clinical adoption of CCM as a quantitative assessment tool. Wide-field stitching can reconstruct larger SNP mosaics by integrating sequentially acquired CCM images, but existing methods largely rely on offline post-processing, additional hardware, or specific acquisition protocols, and lack open-source real-time solutions for conventional CCM video streams. This paper presents CRISP (Corneal confocal microscopy Real-time Image Stitching Pipeline), an open-source real-time SNP wide-field stitching framework for conventional CCM examination video streams. CRISP excludes defocused and discontinuous segments via focus-aware gating, propagates poses through local pairwise registration, and maintains non-redundant spatial coverage with a sparse anchor map; when local temporal continuity is interrupted, the system completes relocalization and subgraph merging through global appearance retrieval followed by geometric verification. The framework prioritizes low-latency coverage feedback during examination while outputting accepted frames, poses, and anchor information to initialize offline fine stitching. To our knowledge, CRISP is the first open-source real-time SNP wide-field stitching framework released for conventional CCM video streams. By lowering the barrier to adoption and reproduction of wide-field stitching, CRISP may help move SNP wide-field imaging from a research tool into routine clinical examination workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CRISP——首个面向常规角膜共聚焦显微镜视频流的开源实时角膜上皮下神经丛（SNP）宽场拼接框架。
AI.motivation: SNP形态反映周围神经健康，CCM可无创实时观察，但主流设备单帧视野有限，而SNP空间非均匀，离散采样受采样位置和选帧影响，限制其可重复性与临床推广。宽场拼接可重建更大SNP镶嵌图，但现有方法多依赖离线后处理、额外硬件或特定采集协议，缺乏面向常规CCM视频流的开源实时方案。
AI.method: CRISP通过聚焦感知门控剔除失焦与不连续片段，利用局部成对配准传播位姿，并以稀疏锚点图维持非冗余空间覆盖；当局部时间连续性中断时，通过全局外观检索与几何验证完成重定位与子图合并。框架优先提供检查过程中的低延迟覆盖反馈，同时输出被接受帧、位姿与锚点信息以初始化离线精细拼接。
AI.result: 作为首个面向常规CCM视频流发布的开源实时SNP宽场拼接框架，CRISP降低了宽场拼接的采用与复现门槛。
AI.conclusion: CRISP有望推动SNP宽场成像从研究工具走向常规临床检查流程。

title: From Explicit References to Scene Manifolds: Distributional Fidelity and Realism for Radiance Field Quality Assessment
summary: Radiance field representations such as 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enable high-quality novel view synthesis but can introduce complex, view-dependent artifacts from reconstruction, rendering, and compression. Reliable perceptual quality assessment (QA) is thus essential for evaluating rendered views and guiding the design of perceptually faithful scene representations. Existing full-reference QA metrics require an aligned reference image, while recent cross-reference metrics relax this requirement by comparing a test view with non-aligned references. However, under wide-baseline radiance field settings, selecting a reliable nearby reference can be difficult, particularly when evaluating views along arbitrary trajectories and poses. We propose SCODA, a lightweight scene-conditioned objective QA method that shifts QA from explicit image-to-image comparison to scene-manifold modeling. High-quality observations of each scene are represented as a multivariate Gaussian distribution in deep feature space, producing a semantic fidelity score that measures deviation from the scene distribution. A weakly-supervised distortion-aware patch discriminator provides a complementary realism signal, and both cues are combined through an unsupervised bounded fusion strategy. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show strong agreement with human judgments and robust generalization across GS- and NeRF-generated views and trajectories. Code is publicly available at https://gitlab.com/saeedmp/scoda.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCODA，一种轻量级场景条件化客观质量评估方法，将质量评估从显式图像对比转向场景流形建模，通过深度特征空间中的多元高斯分布生成语义保真度分数，并结合弱监督失真感知块判别器的真实性信号，在多个基准上与人主观判断高度一致。
AI.motivation: 辐射场表示（如3DGS）虽能实现高质量新视角合成，但会引入复杂的视角相关伪影，因此需要可靠的感知质量评估。现有全参考QA需对齐参考图，跨参考QA虽放宽要求但依赖非对齐参考，而在宽基线辐射场设置下，沿任意轨迹和姿态评估时难以选取可靠的邻近参考。
AI.method: 提出SCODA，一种轻量级场景条件化客观QA方法。将每个场景的高质量观测表示为深度特征空间中的多元高斯分布，得到衡量偏离场景分布的语义保真度分数；同时用弱监督失真感知块判别器提供互补的真实性信号；两种线索通过无监督有界融合策略结合。
AI.result: 在多个基准上的实验表明，该方法与人类主观判断高度一致，并在GS和NeRF生成的视角与轨迹上具备稳健的泛化能力。代码已公开。
AI.conclusion: SCODA通过场景流形建模而非显式图像对比，提供了一种无需可靠邻近参考的场景条件化质量评估方案，适用于任意轨迹和姿态下的辐射场渲染视图评估。

title: D3ARC: Time-Critical Distributed Disaster Detection for Asynchronous Cooperative Multi-Robot Systems
summary: Climate change is increasing the severity and unpredictability of natural disasters. In time-critical crises such as wildfires, traditional monitoring practices remain limited by coverage, cost, and personnel risk, paving the way for autonomous and adaptive monitoring solutions. Within this context, this paper introduces D3ARC, an asynchronous distributed hierarchical framework for time-aware and reliable wildfire detection. D3ARC integrates multiple robotic agents that cooperate under uncertainty through distributed perception, shared situational awareness and coordinated actions. A remote controller asynchronously decides upon each robot's motion, while each robotic agent senses the environment and decides where and how to execute the wildfire detection. All robotic operations require time, and as time progresses, wildfires continue to spread, reducing the opportunity for early intervention. As such, all agents share a common objective: to detect a wildfire with a certain performance threshold as fast as possible and within a time limit. D3ARC integrates mechanisms for safe navigation, coverage efficiency, cooperation and reliability. It introduces a forward-looking capability that allows agents to anticipate the future by evaluating candidate strategies before execution. The framework is evaluated through realistic robotics simulations, ablation studies, and baseline comparisons, achieving an overall mission success up to 94% with 89.4% detection confidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出D3ARC——一种用于野火检测的异步分布式分层框架，通过多机器人协同、分布式感知与前瞻式策略评估，在时限内以尽可能快的速度实现高可靠性野火检测。
AI.motivation: 气候变化加剧了自然灾害的严重性与不可预测性。在林火等时间紧迫的危机中，传统监测手段受限于覆盖范围、成本与人员风险，因此需要自主且自适应的监测方案；同时野火随时间持续蔓延，早期干预窗口不断缩小，对快速、可靠检测提出迫切需求。
AI.method: D3ARC采用异步分布式分层架构，集成多个机器人在不确定环境下通过分布式感知、共享态势感知与协同行动进行合作。远程控制器异步决策各机器人的运动，各机器人智能体感知环境并自主决定野火检测的位置与方式。框架融合安全导航、覆盖效率、协作与可靠性机制，并引入前瞻能力，在执行前评估候选策略以预判未来。
AI.result: 通过真实机器人仿真、消融实验与基线对比进行评估，整体任务成功率达94%，检测置信度为89.4%。
AI.conclusion: D3ARC验证了异步分布式分层多机器人框架在时间受限野火检测任务中的有效性与可靠性，前瞻式策略评估与协同机制有助于提升任务成功率与检测置信度。

title: BlueprintAgent: Constraint-Triggered Targeted Revisits for Simulation-Ready Generation from Scanned Structural Blueprints
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 14 pages, 4 figures
summary: Converting in-service reinforced-concrete (RC) building blueprints into simulation-ready models---structured frame representations that support deterministic FEM export and qualified-engineer review---underpins safety assessment and seismic retrofit, but the process remains manual. Direct prompting of a multimodal large language model (MLLM) over a scanned sheet is unreliable: outputs often violate engineering constraints on beam--column support, span count, or 3D continuity. We present BlueprintAgent (BPA), a constraint-triggered multimodal agent for simulation-ready frame extraction from scanned blueprints. BPA treats the MLLM as the primary reader and decision maker, with OCR and computer vision supplying localized evidence. Its central mechanism realizes engineering constraints as callable validators whose entity-level conflict reports trigger targeted MLLM revisits over the local region---an inference-time control distinct from fixed pipelines and free-form self-reflection. We evaluate BPA on 300 real scanned blueprint sheets from 20 anonymized RC frame projects, against five baselines and six ablations. BPA reaches a macro-averaged Beam F1 of 0.994, against 0.301 for single-MLLM zero-shot and 0.820 for a fixed pipeline; removing MLLM-led axis adjudication collapses Beam and Column F1 on complex multi-sheet projects. For dense technical drawings, engineering constraints are best deployed as triggers for entity-level targeted revisits rather than as post-hoc output filters.

AI.tldr: 提出 BlueprintAgent（BPA），一种约束触发的多模态智能体，将扫描蓝图转换为仿真就绪的RC框架模型；以工程约束作为可调用验证器触发实体级局部重访，在300张真实扫描图纸上取得宏平均Beam F1=0.994。
AI.motivation: 将既有RC建筑蓝图转为仿真就绪的框架模型是安全评估与抗震加固的基础，但目前仍靠人工。直接提示MLLM读取扫描图纸不可靠，输出常违反梁柱支承、跨度数量或三维连续性等工程约束。
AI.method: BPA以MLLM为主读者与决策者，OCR与计算机视觉提供局部证据；核心机制是把工程约束实现为可调用验证器，其实体级冲突报告触发对局部区域的定向MLLM重访，属于推理时控制，区别于固定流水线与自由式自反思。
AI.result: 在来自20个匿名RC框架项目的300张真实扫描图纸上，对比5个基线与6项消融：BPA宏平均Beam F1达0.994，单MLLM零样本为0.301，固定流水线为0.820；移除MLLM主导的轴线判定后，复杂多图纸项目的Beam与Column F1大幅下降。
AI.conclusion: 对密集技术图纸，工程约束更适合用作实体级定向重访的触发器，而非事后输出过滤器。

title: DF26: We Cannot Tell Fake From Real Anymore
summary: We introduce DF26, a novel benchmark for detecting AI-generated videos containing fully synthetic clips produced by recent text-to-video and image-to-video models. The videos capture single-person public-speaking scenarios, spanning direct-to-camera recordings, official statements, and studio interviews - 271 real and 2,420 synthetic videos generated by seven modern video models. The study on DF26 shows that human performance in detecting AI-generated videos, as well as state-of-the-art deepfake detectors, is close to random chance. Our results highlight the limitations of current evaluation protocols and motivate the need for benchmarks that explicitly measure robustness to modern generative model distribution shifts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DF26基准，用于检测包含完全合成片段的AI生成视频，揭示现有检测器与人类表现接近随机水平。
AI.motivation: 现有深度伪造检测评测协议存在局限，缺乏针对现代生成模型分布漂移的鲁棒性评测基准。
AI.method: 构建DF26基准，涵盖单人演讲场景（直面镜头录制、官方声明、演播室访谈），包含271个真实视频与由七种现代视频模型生成的2,420个合成视频。
AI.result: 人类与最先进深度伪造检测器在DF26上的检测表现均接近随机猜测水平。
AI.conclusion: 结果凸显当前评测协议的不足，表明亟需能显式衡量对现代生成模型分布漂移鲁棒性的评测基准。

title: Beyond Fluent Generation: A CPU Reliability Benchmark for MCP-Style Tool Calling in Sub-2B Small Language Models for Edge Deployment
summary: Resource constrained single-board computers including Raspberry Pi, NVIDIA Jetson Nano, Arduino UNO Q, Orange Pi, and LattePanda motivate on-device small language model (SLM) agents that reduce cloud dependence, improve data locality, and tolerate intermittent connectivity. Model Context Protocol (MCP)-style tool invocation demands more than fluent generation: an agent must emit machine-readable JSON, select the correct tool, supply all required arguments, and avoid unintended actions. We establish a platform-agnostic CPU baseline by evaluating five open-weight models below two billion parameters Phi-1.5, Pythia-1.4B, TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat, Qwen2.5-0.5B, and Qwen2.5-1.5B on 100 prompts spanning weather retrieval, web search, calculation, email composition, and task creation, under greedy decoding and nucleus sampling. A recovery parser strips Markdown fences, extracts brace-delimited substrings, and scores parseability, tool-name correctness, argument completeness, and value agreement. Under this criterion, Qwen2.5-1.5B achieves 75% (greedy) and 79% (sampling); Qwen2.5-0.5B achieves 72% (greedy) but drops to 32% under sampling. Phi-1.5 scores 0%; Pythia and TinyLlama reach at most 7%. A strict post-hoc audit finds only 5 of 1,000 raw responses directly parseable as JSON, exposing near-total dependence on output recovery. A CPU resource probe shows Qwen2.5-1.5B requires 7,960 MiB and 30.782 s mean latency; Qwen2.5-0.5B uses 3,637 MiB and 10.627 s, revealing a reliability-resource trade-off for edge deployment. These results do not cover the named boards directly or a full MCP implementation. Safe deployment requires schema validation, constrained generation, least-privilege execution, and human escalation for consequential actions.

AI.tldr: 在树莓派等资源受限单板计算机上部署小于20亿参数的本地小语言模型(SLM)代理，评估其MCP式工具调用的可靠性。100条提示下，Qwen2.5-1.5B以75%(贪心)/79%(采样)领先，Phi-1.5为0%；原始响应仅5/1000可直接解析为JSON，暴露对输出恢复的近乎完全依赖。资源探测显示1.5B需7960MiB、30.8s延迟，0.5B需3637MiB、10.6s，存在可靠性—资源权衡。
AI.motivation: 资源受限单板计算机（树莓派、Jetson Nano、Arduino UNO Q、Orange Pi、LattePanda）驱动机上SLM代理，以减少云依赖、改善数据本地性并容忍间歇性连接。MCP式工具调用不仅要求流畅生成，还要求输出机器可读JSON、选对工具、补齐所需参数并避免误操作，因此需建立平台无关的CPU基线评估其可行性。
AI.method: 选取五个<2B开放权重模型（Phi-1.5、Pythia-1.4B、TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat、Qwen2.5-0.5B、Qwen2.5-1.5B），在覆盖天气检索、网络搜索、计算、邮件撰写与任务创建的100条提示上，分别采用贪心解码与核采样。使用恢复式解析器去除Markdown围栏、提取花括号子串，并对可解析性、工具名正确性、参数完整性与取值一致性打分；另进行严格的原始响应JSON可直接解析的事后审计及CPU资源探测。
AI.result: Qwen2.5-1.5B达75%(贪心)/79%(采样)；Qwen2.5-0.5B贪心72%但采样降至32%；Phi-1.5为0%；Pythia与TinyLlama最高7%。严格事后审计发现1000条原始响应中仅5条可直接解析为JSON，说明几乎完全依赖输出恢复。资源探测显示Qwen2.5-1.5B需7960MiB、平均延迟30.782s，Qwen2.5-0.5B需3637MiB、10.627s，体现可靠性—资源权衡。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果未直接覆盖所提及的单板硬件，也未实现完整MCP。面向边缘安全部署，需引入模式校验、约束生成、最小权限执行，并对高后果操作保留人工升级机制。

title: TRAIL: Trajectory-Aware Visual Place Recognition against Unordered Databases
summary: Modern Visual Place Recognition (VPR) methods excel on standard benchmarks yet remain brittle in feature-poor environments. By treating each query image in isolation, they discard the sequential context in any real trajectory. We formalize a task that exploits this context: given a query sequence, localize the final image against an unordered reference database -- which, unlike sequence-to-sequence methods, requires no sequential structure in the database. We propose TRAIL (TRajectory-Aware Image Localization), a principled framework based on Conditional Random Fields (CRF) that combines learned functions for visual similarity and for camera-motion consistency, refining a distribution over candidate references as each query arrives. A lightweight post-processing layer atop any pre-trained VPR backbone, TRAIL improves a state-of-the-art baseline by up to 8.3 percentage points on our primary benchmark, transfers to unseen datasets without retraining, and delivers its largest gains where visual cues are scarce.

AI.tldr: 提出TRAIL框架，利用查询序列的时序上下文和CRF建模，在无序参考库上定位序列末帧，显著提升特征稀疏环境下的VPR性能。
AI.motivation: 现代视觉地点识别（VPR）方法在标准基准上表现优异，但在特征稀疏环境下依然脆弱。现有方法孤立处理每张查询图像，丢弃了真实轨迹中固有的序列上下文信息。
AI.method: 形式化了一个利用序列上下文的新任务：给定查询序列，将末帧在无序参考库中定位（不同于序列到序列方法，无需参考库具备序列结构）。提出TRAIL（轨迹感知图像定位），基于条件随机场（CRF），融合视觉相似度与相机运动一致性的学习函数，随查询逐帧到来不断细化候选参考分布。作为可加载于任意预训练VPR骨干上的轻量后处理层。
AI.result: 在主基准上将最先进基线提升最多8.3个百分点，无需重训练即可迁移至未见数据集，并在视觉线索稀缺时增益最大。
AI.conclusion: TRAIL作为一种通用的轻量后处理框架，有效利用轨迹时序上下文缓解VPR在特征稀疏环境下的脆弱性，且具备良好的泛化能力与迁移性。

title: Beyond Single-Negative Preference: Multi-Negative DPO for LLM-Centric Historical Entity Linking
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have recently shown promise for historical entity linking, but preference optimization for this task is often formulated with only one negative candidate per training instance. This discards information from the remaining candidates retrieved for the same mention. We introduce multi-negative direct preference optimisation (MDPO), a reference-based pairwise objective that compares the correct entity with all valid rejected candidates associated with each mention. MDPO preserves the Bradley-Terry formulation of DPO while exploiting the complete candidate set through masked, length-normalised sequence scores. We evaluate MDPO on hipe-2020 and newseye, covering French, German, English, Swedish, and Finnish historical newspaper text. Experiments show that MDPO improves over supervised fine-tuning and single-negative DPO, with particularly strong gains for NIL mentions, semantic ambiguity, OCR noise, and historically difficult names. Further analyses disentangle candidate-generation and selection errors, showing that candidate retrieval remains a key bottleneck for end-to-end entity linking. These results demonstrate that incorporating all within-instance negative candidates is a simple and effective improvement for LLM-based historical entity linking.

AI.tldr: 提出多负例直接偏好优化（MDPO），用同一提及的所有有效拒绝候选替代单一负例，在历史实体链接任务上超越监督微调和单负例DPO。
AI.motivation: 历史实体链接中，LLM的偏好优化通常每个训练实例只用单个负例候选，丢弃了同一提及其余候选的信息，浪费了检索到的完整候选集。
AI.method: MDPO是一种基于参考的成对偏好目标，将正确实体与每个提及对应的所有有效拒绝候选进行比较。它保留DPO的Bradley-Terry形式，并通过带掩码、长度归一化的序列分数来利用完整候选集。
AI.result: 在hipe-2020和newseye数据集（涵盖法语、德语、英语、瑞典语、芬兰语历史报纸文本）上，MDPO优于监督微调和单负例DPO，在NIL提及、语义歧义、OCR噪声和历史难名上增益尤为显著。进一步分析分解了候选生成与选择误差，表明候选检索仍是端到端实体链接的关键瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 利用实例内全部负例候选是提升基于LLM的历史实体链接的一种简单而有效的改进。

title: MoM: Memory of Memory
summary: For a long-horizon LLM agent, the memory question is not what was once recorded but what \emph{currently holds}. Most designs answer it only indirectly: every interaction is stored, and the present is reconstructed at query time by retrieving and reconciling records, so stale values re-enter and the same conflicts are re-litigated. Committing the current value at write time avoids this, but existing write-time (CRUD) memories overwrite, so a wrong update is unrecoverable and prior state is lost. We take the missing combination---\emph{commit on arrival while retaining what is displaced}---and formalize it as \textsc{Memory of Memory} (MoM): memory tracks not only content but the provenance, status, and history of its own entries. We instantiate MoM as \textsc{Provenant Memory} (P-Mem), a typed provenance graph whose \emph{active frontier} exposes one current value per resolved key while displaced values are retained as provenance; typed operations decide whether a new observation supports, supersedes, contests, rejects, revokes, or resolves an existing value. P-Mem's decisive gain is validity rather than accuracy: its turn-level read matches the strongest retrieval memory in accuracy at $\sim$4$\times$ fewer read tokens---a retrieval-granularity effect---while graph-guided turn pruning cuts the knowledge-update stale-answer rate (19.4\%$\rightarrow$10.9\%); on revision chains it stays at 100\% where query-time reading collapses to 25\%, and, because displaced values are retained rather than overwritten, it recovers committed errors a CRUD memory cannot (100\% vs.\ 0\%).

AI.tldr: 该论文提出记忆之记忆（MoM）概念，并将其实例化为带类型溯源图P-Mem，通过"抵达即提交、保留被替换值"的方式维护记忆的当前有效值与历史溯源，在准确率、令牌消耗、时效性与可恢复性上均优于检索式与覆盖式记忆。
AI.motivation: 长时程LLM智能体的记忆问题不是"曾经记录了什么"，而是"当前成立的是什么"。主流设计把每次交互都存下来，查询时再检索与调和来重建当下状态，导致陈旧值回流、同一冲突反复裁决；而写时提交的CRUD记忆采用覆盖，错误更新不可恢复、先前状态丢失。
AI.method: 作者取两种范式缺失的交集——"抵达即提交、同时保留被替换内容"，形式化为Memory of Memory（MoM）：记忆不仅追踪内容，还追踪自身条目的来源、状态与历史。实例化为Provenant Memory（P-Mem），一种带类型的溯源图，其"活跃前沿"为每个已解决键暴露唯一当前值，被替换的值作为溯源保留；类型化操作判断新观测对既有值是支持、取代、争议、拒绝、撤销还是解决。
AI.result: P-Mem的决定性收益在于有效性而非准确率：其轮级读取在准确率上匹配最强检索式记忆，而读取令牌约少4倍（检索粒度效应）；图引导的轮剪枝将知识更新场景的陈旧答案率从19.4%降至10.9%；在修订链上保持100%，而查询时读取则跌至25%；由于被替换值被保留而非覆盖，它能恢复CRUD记忆无法恢复的已提交错误（100% vs. 0%）。
AI.conclusion: 将当前值在写入时提交、同时保留被替换值的溯源，可同时获得写时提交的时效性与检索式的可追溯性；记忆的元层信息（来源、状态、历史）是解决长时程智能体陈旧与冲突问题的关键，并带来令牌效率与错误可恢复性。

title: Hi-Singers: A Comprehensive High-Quality Dataset for Expressive Audio-Driven Singing Head Synthesis
comment: 7 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Accepted to the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM '26). Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/CharlesZhang-USTC/Hi-Singers
summary: State-of-the-art models for audio-driven digital human generation have achieved photo-realistic results in talking-head synthesis. However, extending these models to singing-head synthesis remains challenging due to a significant Domain Gap: singing requires more exaggerated expressions, vivid jaw openings, and precise rhythmic synchronization. Current models, primarily trained on speech datasets, often struggle with "rhythmic drift" and constrained dynamics. To address this, we introduce Hi-Singers, the first large-scale, high-quality, in-the-wild video dataset specifically tailored for singing head synthesis. Hi-Singers undergoes a rigorous automated and manual filtering pipeline, ensuring strict thematic adherence, high-resolution rendering, and stable motion, resulting in 29,608 video segments totaling approximately 170 hours. We further establish a dedicated evaluation benchmark balanced across linguistic and musical styles. Extensive experiments across diverse architectures, including 3D-coefficient and diffusion-based models, demonstrate that Hi-Singers consistently and significantly improves performance across all dimensions. Specifically, it enables models to achieve superior visual realism, enhanced lip-sync consistency, and more precise rhythmic dynamics, effectively bridging the domain gap and setting a new performance standard for the singing synthesis task. The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/CharlesZhang-USTC/Hi-Singers

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Hi-Singers，首个面向歌唱头部合成的大规模高质量野生视频数据集，包含 29,608 个视频片段、约 170 小时，并配套构建跨语言与音乐风格平衡的评测基准，验证其可显著提升多种架构的合成性能。
AI.motivation: 现有音频驱动数字人生成模型在说话头部合成上已实现照片级真实效果，但扩展到歌唱头部合成仍面临显著域间差距：歌唱需要更夸张的表情、更生动的下颌开合以及精确的节奏同步，而当前主要基于语音数据集训练的模型常出现"节奏漂移"与动态受限问题。
AI.method: 构建 Hi-Singers 数据集，经严格的自动化与人工双重过滤流程，确保主题一致性、高分辨率渲染与稳定运动；同时建立专门评测基准，在语言与音乐风格上保持平衡；并在 3D 系数类与扩散类等多种架构上开展广泛实验。
AI.result: 实验表明 Hi-Singers 在所有维度上持续且显著地提升模型性能，具体表现为更优的视觉真实感、更强的唇音同步一致性以及更精确的节奏动态，有效弥合了域间差距。
AI.conclusion: Hi-Singers 为歌唱头部合成任务设定了新的性能标准，数据集已公开于 https://huggingface.co/datasets/CharlesZhang-USTC/Hi-Singers。

title: Social Intuition vs. Machine Reasoning: Anticipating Human-Robot Interaction from multiple modalities
comment: 5 pages, 4 figures. Workshop paper accepted to The 4th Workshop on Nonverbal Cues for Human-Robot Cooperative Intelligence at IROS 2026
summary: Anticipating whether a person will interact from one's own perspective is a highly intuitive task for humans, that relies on a combination of cues. We investigate how humans perform at predicting a person's intention to interact from a service robot's point of view, using pose-only or full video input, then benchmark different lightweight pose-based models and state-of-the-art vision-language models. We conducted our benchmark on the HUI360 dataset on a fixed pilot subset of 100 test tracks (25 positive, 75 negative). We found that with pose-only input, human annotators outperform lightweight trained pose models but not by large margins (+0.08 in F1-Score). But when given full egocentric video with a target bounding box, human annotators perform substantially better and largely outperform the Vision-Language Models (+0.2 in F1-Score). We also compared VLMs of different size and under different input conditions, and found that the best results do not correlate with model size. Our result confirms that predicting interactions is a challenging task for social robots and that reasoning-capable models are necessary but their actual reasoning capabilities alone do not suffice to match the social intuition of humans.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估人类与模型在服务机器人视角下预测交互意图的表现：仅姿态输入时人类略优于轻量姿态模型（F1 +0.08），而给定完整自我中心视频时人类大幅超越视觉语言模型（F1 +0.2）。
AI.motivation: 人类从自身视角判断他人是否会与自己交互是高度直觉的任务，但对服务机器人而言却极具挑战。该研究旨在量化人机在预测交互意图上的差距，并检验姿态信息与完整视频、模型规模等因素的影响。
AI.method: 在HUI360数据集的固定试点子集（100条测试轨迹，25正、75负）上，分别以仅姿态输入和完整自我中心视频（含目�%标边界框）为条件，对比人类标注者、多种轻量姿态模型与最先进视觉语言模型（VLM）的性能，并比较不同规模VLM在不同输入条件下的表现。
AI.result: 仅姿态输入时，人类标注者优于轻量训练姿态模型，但差距不大（F1高0.08）；给定完整自我中心视频与目标边界框时，人类表现显著更优，大幅超越VLM（F1高0.2）。不同规模VLM的对比显示，最佳结果与模型规模并不相关。
AI.conclusion: 预测交互意图对社会机器人仍是难题；具备推理能力的模型是必要的，但仅靠其推理能力不足以匹敌人��的社会直觉。

title: Federated Binary Gating with Server-Side Vision-Language Inference for Surveillance Anomaly Classification
summary: Privacy-sensitive surveillance systems could benefit from large vision-language models (VLMs), but such models typically require centralized access to raw video. In federated learning settings, this challenge is amplified by non-independent and identically distributed (non-IID) client data, which can make direct multiclass anomaly classification unstable, especially for rare categories. We propose a hybrid two-stage architecture that combines a federated binary convolutional neural network (CNN) gate with server-side zero-shot VLM inference. The lightweight LiteCNN3D gate performs local anomaly screening and forwards only flagged videos to Qwen3-VL-8B, which assigns them to four anomaly metaclasses. We evaluate this design on UCF-Crime grouped into five coarse metaclasses and implement the federated stage in a real three-node heterogeneous deployment. In the studied setting, direct federated multiclass training collapses, whereas the proposed decomposition yields a better trade-off between classification quality and raw-video transmission. With fixed-threshold routing, the federated hybrid pipeline preserves nearly the same macro-averaged F1 score (F1-macro) as its centralized CNN+VLM counterpart while reducing the fraction of transmitted videos to 51.4%, although with a lower proxy macro receiver operating characteristic area under the curve (ROC AUC) than the centralized hybrid system. A complementary sensitivity-oriented routing operating point increases macro ROC AUC from 0.673 to 0.692 and reduces the false negative rate from 29.3% to 22.9%, but decreases F1-macro from 0.503 to 0.485 while increasing transmission from 51.4% to 57.9%. These results suggest that federation is better suited to coarse local screening, while routing rules can be adjusted to trade server-side VLM usage for higher anomaly sensitivity.

AI.tldr: 提出一种"联邦二分类CNN门控 + 服务端零样本VLM推理"的两阶段混合架构：本地LiteCNN3D只做异常筛选，仅将标记视频上传至Qwen3-VL-8B进行四类异常元类别划分。在真实三节点异构联邦部署下，直接联邦多分类训练崩溃，而该分解方案在分类质量与原始视频传输量之间取得更优折衷。
AI.motivation: 隐私敏感的监控系统希望借助大型视觉语言模型（VLM），但这类模型通常需要集中访问原始视频。在联邦学习场景中，客户端数据的非独立同分布（non-IID）特性会进一步放大该矛盾，使直接的联邦多分类异常检测不稳定，罕见类别尤为严重。
AI.method: 将任务分解为两阶段：1）轻量联邦二分类CNN门控（LiteCNN3D）在本地执行异常筛查，仅将判定为异常的视频转发至服务端；2）服务端使用零样本VLM（Qwen3-VL-8B）将转发视频归入四个异常元类别。在UCF-Crime上按五个粗粒度元类别评测，并在真实三节点异构环境中实现联邦阶段。对比直接联邦多分类训练、集中式CNN+VLM混合系统，并设置固定阈值路由与敏感性导向路由两种工作点。
AI.result: 固定阈值路由下，联邦混合管线的F1-macro与集中式CNN+VLM方案几乎持平，同时将传输视频比例降至51.4%，但代理macro ROC AUC低于集中式方案。敏感性导向路由工作点可将macro ROC AUC从0.673提升至0.692，假阴性率从29.3%降至22.9%，但F1-macro由0.503降至0.485，传输比例由51.4%升至57.9%。
AI.conclusion: 联邦学习更适合承担粗粒度本地筛查，而路由规则可调，用以在服务端VLM使用量与更高异常敏感性之间进行权衡。该分解架构缓解了non-IID下联邦多分类崩溃的问题，并兼顾隐私传输开销与分类质量。

title: Impact of canny edge detection preprocessing on performance of machine learning models for Parkinson's disease classification
summary: This study investigates the classification of individuals as healthy or at risk of Parkinson's disease using machine learning (ML) models, focusing on the impact of dataset size and preprocessing techniques on model performance. Four datasets are created from an original dataset: DS_0, (normal dataset), DS_1 (DS_O subjected to Canny edge detection and Hessian filtering), DS_2 (augmented DS_0), and DS_3 (augmented DS_1). We evaluate a range of ML models-Logistic Regression (LR), Decision Tree (DT), Random Forest (RF), Gradient Boosting (GB), XGBoost (XBG), Naive Bayes (NB), Support Vector Machine (SVM), and AdaBoost (AdB)-on these datasets, analyzing prediction accuracy, model size, and prediction latency. The results show that while larger datasets lead to increased model memory footprints and prediction latencies, the Canny edge detection preprocessing supplemented by Hessian filtering (used in DS_1 and DS_3) degrades the performance of most models. In our experiment, we observe that Random Forest (RF) maintains a stable memory footprint of 61 KB across all datasets, while models like KNN and SVM show significant increases in memory usage, from 5.7-7 KB on DS_0 to 102-220 KB on DS_2, and similar increases in prediction time. Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, and Naive Bayes show stable memory footprints and fast prediction times across all datasets. XGBoost's prediction time increases from 180-200 ms on DS_0 to 700-3000 ms on DS_2 (truncated)

AI.tldr: 该研究用8种机器学习模型在4个数据集上区分健康人与帕金森病风险人群，考察数据规模与预处理（Canny边缘检测+Hessian滤波、数据增强）对准确率、模型内存占用和预测延迟的影响。
AI.motivation: 探究数据集大小与预处理技术对帕金森病风险分类ML模型性能（准确性、模型体积、预测延迟）的影响，明确预处理与数据规模在资源受限场景下的权衡。
AI.method: 基于原始数据构建4个数据集：DS_0（常规）、DS_1（对DS_0做Canny边缘检测+Hessian滤波）、DS_2（DS_0增强）、DS_3（DS_1增强）；在DS_0~DS_3上评估LR、DT、RF、GB、XGBoost、NB、SVM、AdaBoost，比较预测准确率、模型大小与预测延迟。
AI.result: 数据规模增大导致模型内存占用与预测延迟上升；Canny边缘检测+Hessian滤波（DS_1、DS_3）使多数模型性能下降。RF内存占用稳定在61 KB；KNN与SVM内存从DS_0的5.7–7 KB增至DS_2的102–220 KB，预测时间类似上升；LR、DT、NB内存与预测时间稳定；XGBoost预测时间从DS_0的180–200 ms增至DS_2的700–3000 ms。
AI.conclusion: 预处理并非总是有益：边缘检测滤波反而降低多数模型表现；增大数据量以牺牲内存与延迟为代价。RF、LR、DT、NB在稳定性上更优，适合资源受限的帕金森病风险筛查部署。

title: Multi-label versus multi-class classification of blood cells and their aggregates in microfluidic channels
summary: Deformability cytometry (DC) is a type of imaging flow cytometry, which uses a camera-equipped device to measure cellular stiffness in addition to other cellular properties at high throughput. Cellular properties such as area and elongation can identify cell types, but this requires prior knowledge of distinguishing properties and cannot be applied to clinically important cell aggregates. Using DC data, we evaluated conventional multi-class (MC) classification and introduced a multi-label (ML) approach for identifying blood cells and their aggregates. In particular, an ML classifier can simultaneously assign multiple cell-type labels to a single imaged event. We show that, unlike MC classification, ML classification can identify cell aggregates not represented in the training data. It also avoids the need for exhaustive, strictly defined aggregate labels, thereby simplifying and speeding up annotation. Since automated blood analyzers do not reliably analyze cell aggregates, our approach may help address this clinical gap.

AI.tldr: 本文基于变形性细胞术（DC）数据，比较了多类分类与多标签分类在血细胞及细胞聚集体识别中的表现，发现多标签分类可识别训练数据中未出现的细胞聚集体，并简化标注流程，有望弥补自动化血液分析仪难以分析细胞聚集体的临床空白。
AI.motivation: 变形性细胞术可在高吞吐量下测量细胞硬度等特性，面积、伸长率等属性虽可识别细胞类型，但依赖先验知识，且难以处理临床上重要的细胞聚集体。此外，现有自动化血液分析仪无法可靠分析细胞聚集体，存在临床空白。
AI.method: 利用变形性细胞术（DC）数据，评估传统多类（MC）分类，并引入多标签（ML）分类方法。ML分类器可对单个成像事件同时赋予多个细胞类型标签，从而识别血细胞及其聚集体。
AI.result: 与多类分类不同，多标签分类能够识别训练数据中未出现的细胞聚集体；同时避免了对聚集体进行穷尽且严格定义的标注需求，简化并加速了标注过程。
AI.conclusion: 多标签分类方法在识别血细胞聚集体方面优于传统多类分类，能够弥补自动化血液分析仪在细胞聚集体分析上的临床不足，具有潜在应用价值。

title: RelightFormer: Feed-forward Generative Transformer for Multiview Object Relighting
comment: SIGGRAPH Asia 2026. Hejun and Jinxi are co-first authors. Code and data are available at: https://github.com/vLAR-group/RelightFormer
summary: Image relighting is traditionally tackled via complex inverse rendering pipelines, which suffer from ill-posed optimization, or single-image generative models that ignore crucial multi-view cues necessary for understanding 3D geometry and material interactions. To address these limitations, we introduce a feed-forward generative Transformer for direct single- and multi-view image relighting that entirely bypasses explicit intrinsic property estimation. Adapted from a video foundation model, our architecture features a latent illumination module that dynamically injects target environment maps into spatial features via cross-attention. Furthermore, we employ permutation-invariant positional encodings to symmetrically process unordered multi-view inputs without sequential bias. To train this robust data-driven model, we construct the massive Laval Objaverse Dataset (LOD), comprising 90K objects and 39K unique illuminations. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art visual quality, photorealistic relighting quality, and strong zero-shot generalization across single-view, multi-view, and novel-view relighting tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种前馈生成式Transformer，直接从单视图或多视图图像进行重打光，绕过显式本征属性估计，并通过潜在光照模块与置换不变位置编码实现高效、泛化的重打光。
AI.motivation: 传统图像重打光依赖复杂的逆向渲染管线，存在病态优化问题；而单图生成模型则忽略了理解3D几何与材质交互所必需的多视图线索。因此需要一种兼顾多视图信息且无需显式本征分解的新方法。
AI.method: 方法基于视频基础模型改造，采用前馈生成式Transformer架构。核心包括：潜在光照模块，通过交叉注意力将目标环境图动态注入空间特征；使用置换不变位置编码，对称处理无序多视图输入以避免顺序偏差；并构建大规模Laval Objaverse数据集（LOD），含9万物体与3.9万种独特光照用于训练。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法在单视图、多视图及新视图重打光任务上均达到最先进的视觉质量与照片级真实感重打光效果，并具备强零样本泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明无需显式本征属性估计的前馈Transformer可有效完成单/多视图重打光，并通过大规模数据集与架构设计实现优越性能与泛化性。

title: Self-Supervised Multi-View 3D Gaze Target Estimation via Probabilistic Ray Marching
summary: We present a self-supervised approach, Self-MVGTE, for estimating 3D gaze targets from multiple camera views. Unlike existing methods that independently estimate 2D gaze targets per camera view, Self-MVGTE predicts gaze targets directly in 3D space for the first time. Moreover, it does not require any ground-truth annotations from the target scene and uses only the multi-view input images from a calibrated camera setup, pseudo 2D gaze target labels from a monocular gaze target estimation model, and 3D gaze vectors from a monocular 3D gaze estimation model. A key challenge is that these pseudo labels are inherently noisy and multi-view inconsistent. To address this, we propose a probabilistic ray marching framework, which models the uncertainty of these pseudo labels and exploits 3D gaze vectors as geometric priors. Specifically, these gaze vectors are first integrated into the monocular gaze target estimation model to improve its generalization to unseen scenes, producing higher-quality pseudo labels. Then, for 3D gaze target estimation, we construct a 3D gaze cone by casting a bundle of rays from the eye position around the gaze vector to strictly constrain the solution space. Within this cone, we propose a depth-guided feature sampling strategy using off-the-shelf DINOv2 and Depth-Anything-3 models, and estimate a spatial likelihood distribution of the gaze target. Finally, we convert the pseudo gaze target labels into a target distribution and softly optimize the network. Extensive experiments on the MVGT dataset show that Self-MVGTE achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing existing fully-supervised baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出自监督多视角3D注视目标估计方法Self-MVGTE，首次直接在3D空间预测注视目标，无需目标场景真值标注，在MVGT数据集上超越全监督基线。
AI.motivation: 现有方法多为单视角独立的2D注视目标估计，缺乏3D空间预测能力，且依赖目标场景的真值标注，难以泛化到未见场景；同时伪标签存在噪声与多视角不一致问题。
AI.method: 输入为标定多相机图像、单目注视目标估计模型的伪2D标签和单目3D注视估计模型的3D注视向量。先利用3D注视向量增强单目模型泛化以提升伪标签质量；再以眼位为中心、沿注视向量构建3D注视锥束，约束解空间；在锥内用DINOv2与Depth-Anything-3做深度引导特征采样，估计注视目标的空间似然分布；最后将伪标签转为目标分布并软优化网络。
AI.result: 在MVGT数据集上取得state-of-the-art性能，超过现有全监督基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过概率射线行进框架建模伪标签不确定性并引入3D注视向量几何先验，Self-MVGTE实现了无需目标场景真值的多视角3D注视目标估计，验证了自监督范式在该任务上的有效性。

title: Unified Vision-Centric Pedestrian Crossing Action Prediction via Adaptive Patch Projection and Proactive Spatial Rectification
summary: Vision cues are available and informative for pedestrian action prediction, but obtaining stable target-centric representations from video frames remains challenging without frame-level external perception cues. Thus, most methods rely on additional perception modules or multi-source information fusion, leaving the reliability of vision-centric setting an open question. To this end, we propose ViCross, a vision-centric pedestrian crossing action prediction framework powered by multimodal large language models, which maintains target-centric reasoning from video frames without additional perception modules beyond first-frame target initialization. While multimodal large language models exhibit strong visual understanding, applying them directly to vision-centric action prediction faces two challenges. First, accurately perceiving target pedestrians often requires high resolution inputs and dense visual tokenization, making full-frame encoding computationally prohibitive. ViCross tackles this with Variable Resolution Patch Mapping module for efficient token allocation while preserving key pedestrian details. Second, missing spatiotemporal priors hinder consistent cross frame reasoning. ViCross mitigates this with a Spatial Constraint Enhancement Strategy that captures past motion, future locations, and action semantics for training-time proactive spatial rectification. Extensive experiments show that ViCross delivers clear gains in vision-centric prediction settings and is competitive with multi-source fusion approaches in several settings. Code is available at https://github.com/2tianyao1/ViCross.git.

AI.tldr: 提出ViCross，一个基于多模态大模型的纯视觉行人过街动作预测框架，无需额外感知模块。
AI.motivation: 视觉线索对行人动作预测有用，但从视频帧获得稳定的以目标为中心的表示困难，导致多数方法依赖额外感知模块或多源融合，纯视觉设定的可靠性未明。
AI.method: 以多模态大语言模型为核心，仅用首帧目标初始化。引入可变分辨率Patch映射模块高效分配token并保留行人细节；采用空间约束增强策略，捕捉过去运动、未来位置与动作语义，进行训练期主动空间校正。
AI.result: 实验表明ViCross在纯视觉预测设定下取得明显增益，在多种设定下可与多源融合方法竞争。
AI.conclusion: 纯视觉的行人过街动作预测在大模型支持下具备可行性，ViCross验证了其可靠性。

title: AFID: A Unified Open Framework for Automated Fingermark Identification, Quality Assessment and Feature Extraction
summary: Automated fingermark identification is the foundation of forensic investigation, yet progress in the field is held back by fragmented, closed-source solutions trained on private or discontinued data. We present AFID, a unified open-source framework for friction ridge image processing that performs recognition, quality assessment, and feature extraction based on a single shared encoder, trained exclusively on publicly available data. At its core is a fixed-length representation learned for identity discrimination, trained under heavy augmentation. Despite applying essentially no preprocessing beyond resizing and padding at inference, AFID sets a new state of the art in fixed-length fingermark recognition, leading identification across NIST SD 27 (67.6% rank-1) , SD 302 (54.9% rank-1), and SD 303 (67.6% rank-1), surpassing a commercial matcher on fingermarks. From the same frozen backbone, a quality assessment module predicts recognition utility more accurately than any compared baseline and generalizes across independent matchers, while lightweight decoders recover minutiae, ridge orientation, and segmentation competitive with dedicated methods. The framework proves that a single, efficiently trained encoder can support the full fingermark processing pipeline, from recognition through quality assessment all the way to feature extraction. To accelerate research on fingermark analysis even further, we release the code, models, and annotations to the community.

AI.tldr: 提出开源统一框架AFID，基于单一共享编码器，仅用公开数据训练，实现指纹识别、质量评估与特征提取，在多个NIST数据集上达到新SOTA并开源代码模型。
AI.motivation: 自动指纹识别是法医调查基础，但现有进展受限于碎片化、闭源方案，且训练数据为私有或已停用数据，阻碍研究发展。
AI.method: AFID为统一开源框架，识别、质量评估、特征提取共享同一编码器；核心是重度数据增强下学习固定长度的身份判别表示；推理阶段几乎不做预处理，仅缩放与填充；从同一冻结主干中，质量评估模块预测识别效用，轻量解码器恢复细节特征、脊线方向与分割。
AI.result: 在固定长度指纹识别上达到新SOTA：NIST SD 27 rank-1 67.6%、SD 302 rank-1 54.9%、SD 303 rank-1 67.6%，在指纹上超越商用匹配器；质量评估精度优于所有对比基线并跨独立匹配器泛化；特征提取与专用方法相当。
AI.conclusion: 单一高效训练的编码器可支撑完整指纹处理流水线，从识别到质量评估直至特征提取；研究方开源代码、模型与标注以加速指纹分析研究。

title: An LLM-Associated Register Shift in Korean Journal Abstracts: A Morphology-Aware Excess-Vocabulary Study, 2018-2026
comment: 30 pages, 8 figures, 31 tables. Working paper. Data, code and this version are deposited at Zenodo: doi:10.5281/zenodo.22303588
summary: Excess vocabulary, a word's frequency above its pre-2023 trend, is how the change in scholarly English after 2022 has been measured. We adapt it to Korean with morphological units on 398,296 KCI abstracts (2018-August 2026), with 47,165 Vietnamese abstracts for comparison. Placebo floors are 0.1-2.2 points for the single-word statistic and at most 2.9 for the re-selected split-half set statistic. Korean abstracts show nothing in 2023, onset in late 2024, a rise through 2025 flattening in mid-2026: sisahada "suggest" appears in 21.4% of 2026 abstracts against 5.3% expected; plain verbs like araboda "look into" fall to a quarter of trend. Under stated assumptions the single-word conditional lower bound on LLM-processed abstracts is 3.5%, 10.5% and 16.1% for 2024-2026 and a split-half set bound 7.8%, 20.6% and 33.0%. Holzwarth et al.'s estimator under the same discipline gives 41.9% and 72.1% for 2025-2026. Subject-matter controls reduce but do not remove it: restricting the set to lemmas three language-model annotators all call style leaves 14.7 of the 33.0 points, and pairing each 2026 abstract with its journal's closest base-period abstract leaves 34.1. Tested translation routes do not explain it: the surface marks of translated Korean fall as the markers rise. In the same articles' English abstracts the excess appears a year earlier; where the English side carries none, the Korean shift persists at 30 to 66% of the rate where it does. Control abstracts from three providers reproduce the rising words, with marker turnover consistent with model generations; implied prevalences are scenario-dependent.

AI.tldr: 该研究将"超额词汇"方法适配至韩语形态单位，分析2018年至2026年8月的398,296篇KCI摘要（并对比47,165篇越南语摘要），发现韩语学术摘要在2023年无异动、2024年末出现拐点、2025年上升并于2026年中趋平；在既定假设下，LLM处理过的摘要比例条件下界为2024-2026年3.5%、10.5%、16.1%，分半集合下界为7.8%、20.6%、33.0%。
AI.motivation: 既有研究以"超额词汇"（词汇频率超出2023年前趋势的部分）衡量2022年后学术英语的变化，但该方法尚未适配韩语等形态丰富的语言。作者希望检验LLM对非英语学术写作的影响，并排除主题、翻译、期刊等替代解释。
AI.method: 将超额词汇统计量适配为韩语形态单位，基于398,296篇KCI摘要（2018-2026年8月）计算，并以47,165篇越南语摘要作对照；设置安慰剂下限（单词统计量0.1-2.2点，重选分半集合统计量至多2.9）。采用单词级与分半集合两种条件下界估计，并与Holzwarth等人的估计量对比；进行主题控制（限定为三个语言模型标注者一致认定为风格的词元）、期刊内配对（2026摘要与同刊基期最接近摘要配对）、翻译路径检验，以及来自三家服务商的对照摘要分析。
AI.result: 韩语摘要在2023年无异动，2024年末开始上升，2025年持续升高，2026年中趋平：sisahada（"suggest"）在2026年摘要中出现频率21.4%，而预期为5.3%；araboda（"look into"）等普通动词降至趋势的四分之一。单词级条件下界为2024-2026年3.5%、10.5%、16.1%，分半集合下界为7.8%、20.6%、33.0%；Holzwarth等人估计量在相同规则下给出2025-2026年41.9%与72.1%。主题控制削弱但未消除效应（风格词元限定后33.0点保留14.7点，期刊配对后保留34.1点）。翻译路径无法解释：随着标记上升，翻译韩语的表面特征反而下降。同一文章英文摘要中超额现象提前一年出现；英文侧无超额时，韩语侧仍以30%-66%的速率持续。三家服务商对照摘要复现了上升词汇，标记更替与模型世代一致；隐含流行率依场景而定。
AI.conclusion: 韩语学术摘要中LLM处理痕迹自2024年末起显著上升，2025年加速、2026年中趋平。该现象不能由主题变化、翻译路径或期刊差异完全解释，且与英文摘要中的同类现象存在时间先后关联。隐含LLM使用流行率高度依赖假设场景，估计值具有条件性而非确定性。

title: FramingQA: Does the Question Shape the Answer? Measuring the Compositional Framing Effect
summary: We introduce FramingQA, a benchmark that measures the model sensitivity to question framing across law, medicine, finance, and robotic simulations. Large language models (LLMs) often change their responses to subtle rephrasings that align with an implied stance by users. This can leave users with advice tainted by how they happened to phrase a question rather than by the underlying facts, and the consequences are highly costly in high-stakes domains. Because in the realistic scenarios, both expert practitioners and non-expert users frequently ask LLMs questions containing incomplete or misleading assumptions, models are highly susceptible to those framings. To test this, we inject the framing bias across three nested levels: a framing-biased question phrasing (root), an injected framing-biased premise prepended to a neutral question (propositional), and a premise paired with a framing-biased question (global). Evaluating nine open models (3.8B-70B) across four families, we find that strong per-variant accuracy does not guarantee the robustness across differently phrased questions under the fixed factual information.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FramingQA 基准，通过三级嵌套提问框架（根级、命题级、全局级）衡量大模型在法律、医疗、金融和机器人仿真领域对问题表述框架的敏感性，发现九个开源模型（3.8B–70B）在事实信息固定的情况下，单一变体的高准确率并不能保证跨表述的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型常因用户措辞中隐含的立场而改变回答，使建议受提问方式而非事实本身影响；在专家与非专家都频繁提出含不完整或误导性假设问题的高风险领域（法律、医疗、金融、机器人仿真），这种框架敏感性代价高昂，因此需要专门基准来测量模型对提问框架的敏感度。
AI.method: 构建 FramingQA 基准，在三个嵌套层级注入框架偏差：根级（root，带框架偏差的问题表述）、命题级（propositional，在中性问题上前置带偏差的前提）、全局级（global，偏差前提与偏差问题相结合）；对四个家族、九个开源模型（3.8B–70B）进行评测，考察在固定事实信息下不同表述间的表现差异。
AI.result: 在四个领域、九个开源模型（3.8B–70B）上的评测显示，模型在某一表述变体上的强准确率并不能保证其在事实信息不变、仅表述不同的问题之间具备鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 单变体准确率不足以反映模型的框架鲁棒性，高风险领域需将跨表述稳健性纳入评估；FramingQA 为衡量该属性提供了可控、分层级的基准。

title: Parser-Free VLM Verification for Federated Weakly Supervised Video Anomaly Detection
summary: How can vision-language models help video anomaly detection (VAD) when surveillance data remain distributed, weakly labeled, and resource-constrained? Most weakly supervised VAD methods assume centralized training; recent VLM-based extensions further rely on dense inference, generated explanations, or additional adaptation. We introduce a lightweight federated MIL-VLM cascade in which only a compact MIL scorer is trained across clients, while a frozen VLM verifies high-scoring suspect segments post hoc. We study two VLM feedback interfaces: parsed text-generation decisions and a logit-based interface that extracts a continuous anomaly score from next-token Yes/No probabilities. Experiments on UCF-Crime with InternVL3.5-2B and Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct show that text-generation verification can improve frame-level AUC after diagnostic temporal post-processing, but remains sensitive to prompts, parsers, model choice, and smoothing. In contrast, the logit interface provides a fixed parser-free signal that improves both frame-level AUC and frame-level AP over the MIL baseline across both VLMs, without temporal post-processing in its main configuration. Since suspect segments are updated independently once available, next-token logit feedback provides a simple segment-local alternative to text-generation verification.

AI.tldr: 提出一种轻量级联邦MIL-VLM级联框架：仅训练紧凑的MIL打分器，冻结的VLM事后校验高分疑似片段，并比较文本生成与logit两种反馈接口。
AI.motivation: 监控视频异常检测面临数据分布式、弱标注与资源受限的现实约束；现有弱监督VAD多假设集中式训练，近期基于VLM的扩展又依赖密集推理、生成式解释或额外适配，成本高、难部署。
AI.method: 在联邦设置下训练紧凑MIL打分器，冻结VLM对高分疑似片段进行事后校验。研究两种VLM反馈接口：（1）解析式文本生成决策；（2）基于logit的接口，从下一个token的Yes/No概率中提取连续异常分数。在UCF-Crime上以InternVL3.5-2B和Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct进行评测。
AI.result: 文本生成校验经诊断性时间后处理后可提升帧级AUC，但对提示词、解析器、模型选择和平滑处理敏感；logit接口提供固定、免解析的信号，在两种VLM上同时提升帧级AUC与帧级AP，且主配置下无需时间后处理。
AI.conclusion: 由于疑似片段一旦可用即被独立更新，下一token的logit反馈为文本生成校验提供了一种简单的片段局部替代方案。

title: Latent-to-Latent Flow for Volumetric Stochastic Segmentation
summary: Uncertainty arising from inter-observer variability in medical image segmentation plays an important role in developing treatment plans. Research in this area is inhibited by the lack of multiple annotations for large-scale medical datasets, especially for volumetric data, which suffers from additional scaling and computational complexity challenges. Flow matching has emerged as a powerful framework for generative modelling and has also been demonstrated to maintain strong performance when working with latent representations of images. In this work, we introduce a latent-to-latent flow technique for stochastic segmentation of medical volumes via encoded representations of both the image and label space. We evaluate our method on two challenging applications covering delineation uncertainty for radiotherapy planning and multiple organ structure segmentation, improving efficiency up to 14x compared with full resolution models while maintaining clinically relevant performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种潜在到潜在（latent-to-latent）的流匹配方法，用于医学体积的随机分割，通过编码图像与标签空间表示，在放疗计划和多器官分割任务上实现最高14倍效率提升并保持临床相关性能。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分割中的观察者间差异不确定性对治疗计划制定至关重要，但该领域研究受限于大规模医学数据集缺乏多重标注，尤其是体积数据还面临额外的缩放与计算复杂度挑战。
AI.method: 基于流匹配（flow matching）的生成建模框架，提出潜在到潜在（latent-to-latent）流技术，对图像空间和标签空间分别进行编码表示，从而在潜在空间实现医学体积的随机分割。
AI.result: 在两个具有挑战性的应用中进行了评估：放疗计划中的勾画不确定性，以及多器官结构分割。相比全分辨率模型，效率提升最高达14倍，同时保持临床相关性能。
AI.conclusion: 潜在空间流匹配可有效应对体积医学图像随机分割中的标注稀缺与计算复杂度问题，在保证临床可用性的同时显著提升效率。

title: When Superpixels Fail on Documents: A Study of Segmentation for LIME Explanations
comment: 9 pages, 6 figures, 1 table, XAI Workshop @ IJCAI 2026
summary: Post-hoc explanation methods are widely used to inspect image classifiers, but their reliability depends on design choices that are often treated as implementation details. We study this issue for LIME on document image classification, focusing on the segmentation step that defines the interpretable units being perturbed. Standard image-based LIME typically relies on natural-image superpixels, which are poorly aligned with document structure such as text regions, layout blocks, and identification codes. Using RVL-CDIP, we compare Quickshift and SLIC with document-aware segmentations based on OCR bounding boxes and regular grids. Our results show that segmentation strongly affects explanation consistency, correctness, and local fidelity. Document-aware segmentations produce more stable and faithful explanations, require fewer perturbations to converge, and expose shortcut behaviour based on document identification codes, a known RVL-CDIP bias that superpixel-based LIME often obscures. These findings show that reliable post-hoc explanation requires domain-aware interpretable representations, and that segmentation should be treated as part of the explanation method rather than as neutral preprocessing.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LIME在文档图像分类中的分割步骤，发现分割方式显著影响解释的一致性与忠实度，文档感知分割优于自然图像超像素。
AI.motivation: 后验解释方法的可靠性常被当作实现细节的设计选择所决定。在图像分类中，标准LIME依赖自然图像超像素，与文档结构（文本区域、版式块、识别码）对齐不佳，可能影响解释质量。
AI.method: 在RVL-CDIP数据集上，将Quickshift和SLIC与基于OCR边界框和规则网格的文档感知分割进行对比，评估分割对LIME解释的一致性、正确性和局部忠实度的影响。
AI.result: 分割强烈影响解释的一致性、正确性与局部忠实度。文档感知分割产生更稳定、更忠实的解释，收敛所需扰动更少，并能揭示基于文档识别码的捷径行为——这是RVL-CDIP已知偏差，常被超像素LIME掩盖。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的后验解释需要领域感知的可解释表示；分割应被视为解释方法的一部分，而非中性的预处理步骤。

title: MEMO: Multimodal Evidence Memory Organization for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
summary: Long-running LLM agents rely on external memory to store and reuse information beyond a single context window, yet there is a fundamental tension between the continuous accumulation of interaction trajectories and the limited context capacity. The key challenge in agent memory is therefore not only to retrieve relevant records, but also to select necessary evidence under a given budget and organize it in an appropriate modality. Existing memory readout methods mainly use textual or visual forms. Text preserves high fidelity, but its linear token representation makes contents with different importance compete for the limited context at nearly uniform unit cost. Visual readout renders text into document-like images, which can use two-dimensional layouts to expose structure and emphasize key information, but it may lose fine-grained details during rendering and compression. To address this issue, we propose MEMO, a multimodal evidence memory organization method for LLM agents. MEMO first uses a trained evidence extractor to select relevant memory blocks and form evidence units with source information and presentation requirements. A trained query-conditioned memory manager assigns each unit to a textual, visual, or dual-channel carrier and selects a layout that matches the evidence structure. A deterministic memory construction module then generates the textual package and visual pages. The memory manager is trained with feedback from an offline reader that measures the utility of the guided memory plan, so that retention and presentation decisions align with downstream usage. We evaluate MEMO on four benchmarks, HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, LoCoMo, and ALFWorld, with multiple reader backends. The results show that MEMO presents memory more efficiently with fewer memory tokens, improves downstream task performance, and builds more effective working memory under constrained budgets.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MEMO——一种面向LLM智能体的多模态证据记忆组织方法，通过可训练的证据抽取器与查询条件记忆管理器，将记忆单元分配至文本、视觉或双通道载体并选择合适布局，从而在有限预算下更高效地组织与呈现记忆。
AI.motivation: 长时运行的LLM智能体依赖外部记忆存储超出单次上下文窗口的信息，但交互轨迹的持续累积与有限上下文容量之间存在根本矛盾。核心挑战不仅在于检索相关记录，还在于在给定预算下选取必要证据并以合适模态组织。现有记忆读出方式以文本或视觉为主：文本保真度高，但其线性token表示使不同重要性的内容以近乎均匀的单位成本争夺有限上下文；视觉读出将文本渲染为文档式图像，可利用二维布局暴露结构、强调关键信息，但渲染与压缩过程可能丢失细粒度细节。
AI.method: MEMO包含三个核心模块：(1)训练好的证据抽取器，选取相关记忆块并构成带有来源信息与呈现要求的证据单元；(2)查询条件的记忆管理器，为每个单元分配文本、视觉或双通道载体，并选择与证据结构匹配的布局；(3)确定性的记忆构建模块，生成文本包与视觉页面。记忆管理器通过离线阅读器反馈进行训练，以衡量所生成引导式记忆计划的效用，使保留与呈现决策与下游使用对齐。
AI.result: 在HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA、LoCoMo和ALFWorld四个基准上，配合多种阅读器后端进行评估，结果表明MEMO以更少的记忆token更高效地呈现记忆，提升下游任务性能，并在受限预算下构建更有效的工作记忆。
AI.conclusion: MEMO通过多模态证据记忆组织，在文本与视觉读出之间取长补短，以预算感知的方式实现证据选择、载体分配与布局优化，在多个基准与阅读器后端上验证了其在效率与下游性能上的优势。

title: Where Should Language Sit in a Multimodal Model? Lessons from What Language Does to Human Perception and Cognition
summary: Language models compute over tokens: language is their input, their output, and increasingly their internal representation. Whether language should keep all of these positions depends on what language does to the system that uses it. The one system with a century of data on that question is the human. We review what language does to human perception, the brain, and thought, and read the same evidence against multimodal models and language models. Throughout, we treat language as a compressor that runs on a shared codebook: a word is an index, the content is in the receiver, and a community maintains the codebook. In humans the compression is measurable, learning the codebook reorganizes the senses, and thought survives the loss of language. We then measure the rule that models apply when two cues disagree, with cue-conflict experiments on six vision-language models and two robot policies. Surviving cues are weighted in the order their reliabilities prescribe, at 11 to 82\% of the ideal observer's slope, and many answers copy the text. One policy family drops a cue that adds no information beyond the others rather than down-weighting it, another keeps it at a weight that fails when the cues conflict, and a visual cue that identifies the task in every training frame is never learned, because the language pathway already fits the data. Language models are the best current models of the human language network, and they have entered the human speech community, shifting word frequencies while alignment narrows their conceptual diversity. We close with seven implications for token-based systems. Language belongs at a model's boundary and in the shared codebook, as in the brain, not as its internal representation; the price of leaving the codebook inside is auditability.

AI.tldr: 论文综述语言对人类感知、大脑与思维的作用，并以此对照多模态模型与语言模型，通过线索冲突实验检验模型如何加权冲突线索，提出语言应位于模型边界与共享码本中，而非内部表示。
AI.motivation: 语言模型以token为输入、输出乃至内部表示，但"语言是否应占据所有这些位置"取决于语言对使用它的系统究竟做了什么。人类是唯一拥有百年相关数据的系统，因此作者以人类证据为基准，重新审视多模态模型与语言模型的设计假设。
AI.method: 将语言视为运行在共享码本上的压缩器：词是索引，内容在接收方，码本由社群维护。综述语言对人类感知、大脑与思维影响的证据；并在六个视觉-语言模型与两个机器人策略上开展线索冲突实验，测量当两个线索不一致时模型的加权规则。
AI.result: 存活线索按其可靠性顺序加权，斜率为理想观察者的11%–82%，许多回答直接照抄文本。一策略族会丢弃不提供增量信息的线索而非降权，另一策略族保留该线索但其权重在冲突时失效；若某视觉线索在每帧训练数据中都能标示任务，则该线索从未被学会，因为语言通路已能拟合数据。语言模型是目前最好的人类语言网络模型，并已进入人类言语社群，改变词频，而对齐会收窄其概念多样性。
AI.conclusion: 提出对基于token系统的七点启示：语言应如大脑一样位于模型边界与共享码本之中，而非作为其内部表示；将码本留在模型内部的代价是可审计性的丧失。

title: CosmoH2G: A Hand-to-Gripper Transfer Dataset and Baseline Method for Object Manipulation with Complex Spatial Movements
summary: Transferring human hand demonstrations to robotic grippers has recently emerged as a cost-effective solution for robot learning. However, existing methods are largely confined to simple, planar tasks and fail to handle complex spatial movements (e.g., intricate trajectories involving rotations or flips) that are essential for robot manipulation. Motivated by this gap, we adopt an implicit, data-driven approach guided by fine-grained hand-pose motions. To this end, we introduce a scalable acquisition pipeline to collect hand-gripper paired demonstrations, governed by a rigorous protocol that prioritizes motion complexity and leverages a handheld gripper for seamless action mimicry. This yields a large-scale paired dataset comprising 6,189 episodes across 1,254 unique objects, exhibiting significantly higher spatial complexity than existing benchmarks. However, learning such complex mappings remains challenging. We observe that naive end-to-end generation of full gripper pose sequences is insufficient, as minor trajectory deviations compound rapidly under intricate dynamics. To address this, we propose a two-stage framework: Stage I predicts sparse gripper keyframes (initial and terminal) to simplify the mapping objective, while Stage II generates the full continuous action sequence conditioned on these keyframes. Furthermore, to mitigate cumulative drift, we keep the gripper's orientation being learned while post-optimizing its translation based on the grasping heuristic and kinematic consistency. In both simulation and real-robot experiments, our framework enables stable and precise hand-to-gripper transfer of complex spatial manipulations, significantly outperforming traditional baselines. Project page: https://cosmoh2g.github.io.

AI.tldr: 提出基于手部演示的隐式数据驱动框架，通过两阶段关键帧预测与平移后优化，实现复杂空间动作的手到夹爪迁移，并在仿真与真机上显著超越基线。
AI.motivation: 现有手部演示迁移方法多局限于简单平面任务，难以处理含旋转、翻转等复杂空间轨迹，而这正是机器人操作的核心需求，存在明显空白。
AI.method: 构建可扩展采集流程，借助手持夹爪并按以动作复杂度优先的协议采集手-夹爪配对演示，得到覆盖1,254个物体、6,189条episode的大规模配对数据集；提出两阶段框架：Stage I预测稀疏夹爪关键帧（起始与终止），Stage II以关键帧为条件生成完整连续动作序列；同时保持夹爪朝向学习、基于抓取启发式与运动学一致性对平移做后优化以抑制累积漂移。
AI.result: 在仿真与真机实验中，框架可实现稳定精确的复杂空间操作手到夹爪迁移，显著优于传统基线。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度手部姿态引导的隐式数据驱动方法与关键帧分解+平移后优化策略，可有效破解复杂空间动作迁移难题，为手部演示到夹爪的可扩展学习提供可行路径。

title: CrACK: Adversarial Attacks on Cross-Model Consistency in Collaborative Vision Foundation Models
