summary: Training-free collaborative pipelines that integrate Vision Foundation Models such as CLIP, SAM, and DINO achieve strong open-vocabulary dense prediction and are increasingly deployed in safety-critical applications. The security of these systems is commonly assumed to follow from the robustness of their individual models. We challenge this assumption. We identify a vulnerability shared by every collaborative pipeline: each model consumes the intermediate output of another without verifying semantic consistency, an unverified premise that we term the semantic-spatial alignment dependency. Existing adversarial attacks target a single model and overlook this premise, leaving the inter-model interface entirely unguarded. We propose CrACK (Cross-model Adversarial Consistency attack), an inference-time attack that exploits this interface without modifying any input pixel, model weight, or training data. CrACK operates in two stages: Adversarial Affinity Contradiction Injection corrupts the cross-modal affinity matrix by inverting SAM encoder features under the guidance of CLIP patch-level semantics, and Semantic Interface Poisoning steers the prediction through a max-distance label permutation derived from CLIP text embeddings. Experiments on four collaborative pipelines across eight benchmarks show that CrACK causes catastrophic degradation while every individual model continues to produce its unchanged standalone output, rendering per-model defenses structurally blind. The corruption further cascades into large vision-language model reasoning, driving models such as LLaVA to produce erroneous responses from visually intact inputs. Our results show that the security of a collaborative AI system cannot be reduced to the robustness of its components, and that inter-model feature interfaces must be treated as first-class security boundaries.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示无训练协作式视觉基础模型流水线中普遍存在的“语义-空间对齐依赖”漏洞，并提出推理期攻击方法 CrACK，通过篡改跨模型特征接口引发严重退化，同时使各单模型输出保持不变，证明系统安全不能还原为组件鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有安全假设认为协作流水线（CLIP+SAM+DINO 等）的安全性可由各单模型鲁棒性推出，但该假设未被验证。现有对抗攻击只针对单模型，忽略模型间接口，导致接口毫无防护。
AI.method: 提出 CrACK（Cross-model Adversarial Consistency attack），一种推理期攻击，不修改输入像素、模型权重或训练数据。含两阶段：1）Adversarial Affinity Contradiction Injection：在 CLIP 块级语义引导下反转 SAM 编码器特征，破坏跨模态亲和矩阵；2）Semantic Interface Poisoning：基于 CLIP 文本嵌入生成最大距离标签置换，从而操控预测。
AI.result: 在 4 种协作流水线、8 个基准上，CrACK 造成灾难性性能退化，而每个单模型仍保持其未受影响的独立输出，使逐模型防御在结构上失效。污染进一步级联至大型视觉-语言模型推理，使 LLaVA 等从视觉完好的输入中产生错误回答。
AI.conclusion: 协作式 AI 系统的安全不能还原为组件的鲁棒性；模型间特征接口必须被视为一等安全边界。

title: Mitigating Shortcut Learning: Texture-Penalized Prototype Networks
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at the 22nd IEEE International Conference on Advanced Visual and Signal-Based Systems (AVSS 2026)
summary: Standard Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) exhibit severe performance degradation due to a strong inductive texture bias that prioritizes local, high-frequency patterns over global structural shapes. This dependency causes confident misclassifications during textural changes or environmental effects. To address this flaw, this study introduces the Texture-Penalized Prototype Network (TPPN), a novel architectural framework that shifts this inherent bias without depending on resource-intensive augmented datasets. Specifically, a Texture-Penalization Branch (TPB) imposes a penalty to suppress the extraction of local texture proxies, forcing the network backbone to discard high-frequency cues and extract purified, shape-biased representations. By evaluating similarities within a prototype-based hypersphere derived from the final convolutional features, the approach enforces strict geometric constraints, treating objects as compositions of essential parts to achieve robust classification. Evaluations on texture-shape cue-conflict datasets and synthetic noise benchmarks demonstrate the stronger shape bias of this structural disentanglement. The proposed framework reduces the inherent texture bias of a baseline ResNet-50 from 55.11% to 29.73%, surpassing the texture-suppression capabilities of an off-the-shelf Vision Transformer (ViT-B/16). Furthermore, the approach demonstrates robust generalization under cue-conflict conditions, resisting textural shortcut learning when encountering Out-of-Distribution (OOD) shapes. The model maintains stronger shape accuracy against elevated perturbations. On clean validation data, the architecture incurs a minimal drop in accuracy of 0.90 percentage points. This provides a structural, efficient solution to CNN texture bias.

AI.tldr: 提出TPPN（纹理惩罚原型网络），通过纹理惩罚分支抑制局部纹理表征、结合原型超球面几何约束，将ResNet-50的纹理偏置从55.11%降至29.73%，且干净数据精度仅下降0.90个百分点。
AI.motivation: 标准CNN存在强烈的归纳纹理偏置，偏好局部高频模式而忽视全局形状结构，导致在纹理变化或环境干扰下出现高置信度误分类。现有缓解方案多依赖资源密集的增强数据集，成本高。
AI.method: 在架构层面引入TPPN框架：设计纹理惩罚分支（TPB），对局部纹理代理特征的提取施加惩罚，迫使主干网络丢弃高频线索、提取纯化的形状偏置表征；再基于最终卷积特征构建原型超球面，通过类内相似度评估施加严格几何约束，将目标视为本质部件的组合以实现稳健分类。
AI.result: 在纹理—形状线索冲突数据集与合成噪声基准上验证了更强的形状偏置：基线ResNet-50的纹理偏置由55.11%降至29.73%，优于现成ViT-B/16的纹理抑制能力；在OOD形状的线索冲突条件下抑制纹理捷径学习，在高扰动下保持更高形状精度；干净验证集精度仅下降0.90个百分点。
AI.conclusion: TPPN以结构化的高效方式缓解CNN纹理偏置，在不依赖大规模增强数据的前提下实现形状偏置迁移，兼顾鲁棒性与干净精度，为CNN纹理偏置问题提供了结构性解决方案。

title: PICANet: Physics-Informed Cascaded Asymmetric Network for Infrared Small Target Detection
summary: Infrared small target detection (ISTD) is an important research direction in image processing. However, existing methods are limited by severe background noise propagation and target degradation in high-level semantic features. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a plug-and-play physics-informed cascaded asymmetric network, named PICANet. Specifically, we construct a hierarchical prior decoupling module to explicitly extract low-level and high-level physical information, thereby characterizing target features at different levels rather than relying solely on convolutional extraction. Furthermore, a dual-prior interactive fusion module is developed to dynamically refine target representations while suppressing complex background clutter. Unlike previous work, a multi-level cross-feature attention module with the cascaded asymmetric mechanism is introduced to achieve precise alignment between high-level semantics and low-level spatial details. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed PICANet outperforms state-of-the-art ISTD methods, showing satisfactory detection accuracy even against complex backgrounds. Our code is available at https://github.com/xianchaoxiu/PICANet.

AI.tldr: 提出即插即用的物理信息级联非对称网络PICANet，用于红外小目标检测。
AI.motivation: 现有红外小目标检测方法受限于严重背景噪声传播以及高层语义特征中目标退化问题。
AI.method: 构建分层先验解耦模块显式提取低层与高层物理信息；设计双先验交互融合模块动态优化目标表征并抑制背景杂波；引入多级跨特征注意力模块与级联非对称机制，实现高层语义与低层空间细节的精确对齐。
AI.result: 大量实验表明PICANet优于现有最先进ISTD方法，在复杂背景下仍具满意检测精度；代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: PICANet通过物理信息引导与级联非对称跨特征注意力，有效缓解噪声传播与目标退化，提升复杂背景下的红外小目标检测性能。

title: Topologically Consistent Agricultural Parcel Vectorization with Semantic-Guided Diffusion and Topology-Aware Polygonization
summary: Agricultural parcel polygons play a fundamental role in geospatial applications such as precision agriculture, land administration, and crop monitoring. Beyond regular polygon geometry and low vertex redundancy, practical parcel maps should avoid topological conflicts and preserve common boundaries between adjacent fields. Yet this requirement remains largely unresolved: segmentation-based methods mainly produce parcel masks or raster boundary cues and rely on heuristic raster-to-vector conversion, instance- and contour-based methods reconstruct parcels independently, and recent vector-oriented methods improve polygon regularity but do not explicitly recover adjacent parcels from a shared topological structure. To address this gap, we propose a semantic-guided diffusion framework for topologically consistent agricultural parcel vectorization. It couples joint edge--vertex latent diffusion with supervised multi-cue conditioning to generate geometrically regularised parcel-boundary and vertex primitives while suppressing false-positive responses. A topology-aware parcel polygon reconstruction method then converts these primitives into regular polygons by reconstructing parcel faces from a common planar graph, enabling adjacent predicted parcels to reuse shared boundaries and avoid mutual interior intrusion. Extensive experiments on the AI4SmallFarms and iFLYTEK datasets evaluate parcel vectorization in terms of pixel-level coverage, geometric fidelity, object-level correctness, and topological consistency. The results show strong and competitive performance, with zero measured intrusion ratio and the highest shared-edge recall, demonstrating the potential of the proposed framework for accurate, regular, and topologically consistent agricultural parcel vectorization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种语义引导的扩散框架，用于拓扑一致的农业地块矢量化，通过联合边缘-顶点隐扩散生成边界与顶点基元，再经拓扑感知重建共享边界的规则多边形，在AI4SmallFarms和iFLYTEK数据集上实现零侵入率与最高共享边召回率。
AI.motivation: 农业地块多边形对精准农业、土地管理、作物监测等地理空间应用至关重要。除规则多边形几何与低顶点冗余外，实际地块图还需避免拓扑冲突并保留相邻地块的公共边界。然而该需求尚未解决：基于分割的方法只产生地块掩膜或栅格边界线索，依赖启发式栅格转矢量；实例与轮廓方法独立重建地块；近期矢量化方法虽提升多边形规则性，但未从共享拓扑结构显式恢复相邻地块。
AI.method: 提出语义引导的扩散框架：将联合边缘-顶点隐扩散与监督式多线索条件结合，生成几何规则化的地块边界与顶点基元并抑制假阳性响应；再使用拓扑感知的地块多边形重建方法，通过从共同平面图重建地块面，将基元转换为规则多边形，使相邻预测地块复用共享边界并避免相互内部侵入。
AI.result: 在AI4SmallFarms与iFLYTEK数据集上，从像素级覆盖、几何保真度、目标级正确性与拓扑一致性等方面评估地块矢量化，结果显示性能强劲且具竞争力，实测侵入率为零，共享边召回率最高。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在准确、规则且拓扑一致的农业地块矢量化方面具有潜力。

title: When Semantically Consistent Encoding Meets View-Label Heterogeneity Modeling: A Unified Framework for Incomplete Multi-View Multi-Label Learning
summary: Incomplete multi-view multi-label learning requires not only robust semantic aggregation from partially observed views, but also label-aware exploitation of view-specific evidence. Existing approaches usually emphasize either shared representation learning or decision-level fusion. The former improves robustness against missing views, yet tends to compress label-discriminative view-specific cues into a single latent representation. The latter preserves individual view predictions, but often relies on fixed or globally learned fusion weights, ignoring that different labels of different instances may require different views. To address these limitations, this paper presents V2L, a unified representation-decision framework for incomplete multi-view multi-label classification. On the representation side, V2L constructs semantically consistent variational posteriors from incomplete views through a perturbation-aware encoding mechanism, which provides a stable shared semantic basis. On the decision side, V2L introduces an active view-label relevance modeling strategy that estimates instance-wise and label-wise view contributions, allowing each label prediction to adaptively select useful view-specific evidence. From the perspective of model architecture, these two important strategies are integrated into a unified framework through a hybrid fusion architecture, simultaneously meeting the requirements of cross-view semantic consistency and representational complementarity. Extensive experiments under both incomplete and complete settings show that V2L achieves leading performance on five benchmarks. Code is available at: https://github.com/justsmart/V2L.

AI.tldr: 提出V2L统一表示-决策框架，用于不完整多视图多标签分类，通过扰动感知编码构建语义一致的变分后验，并用主动视图-标签相关性建模实现实例级与标签级的自适应视图选择，在五个基准上取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 不完整多视图多标签学习既需要从部分观测视图中进行鲁棒的语义聚合，又需要标签感知地利用视图特有证据。现有方法或偏重共享表示学习，易将具标签判别力的视图特有线索压缩进单一隐表示；或偏重决策级融合，但采用固定或全局学习的融合权重，忽略了不同实例的不同标签可能需要不同视图。因此需要同时兼顾跨视图语义一致性与表示互补性的统一框架。
AI.method: V2L包含表示侧与决策侧两部分。表示侧通过扰动感知编码机制（perturbation-aware encoding）从不完整视图中构建语义一致的变分后验，提供稳定的共享语义基础。决策侧引入主动视图-标签相关性建模策略（active view-label relevance modeling），估计实例级与标签级的视图贡献，使每个标签预测能自适应选择有用的视图特有证据。二者通过混合融合架构（hybrid fusion architecture）整合为统一框架。
AI.result: 在不完整与完整两种设置下的大量实验表明，V2L在五个基准数据集上均取得领先性能。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: V2L通过表示侧语义一致性与决策侧视图-标签自适应选择的统一建模，有效缓解了共享表示压缩判别线索与固定融合权重忽视视图差异的问题，验证了统一表示-决策框架在（不完整）多视图多标签分类中的有效性。

title: TeMo: Temperature Modulation for Multimodal Contrastive Learning
summary: Contrastive learning approaches achieve strong performance by training models to bring similar samples closer while pushing dissimilar samples apart. A crucial component of contrastive learning is the temperature hyperparameter $τ$, which controls the penalty strength applied to negative samples. However, most existing methods either fix this hyperparameter or learn a global value during training. In this paper, we introduce TeMo, Temperature Modulation framework, a similarity-based modulation approach that adaptively adjusts the temperature for each positive-negative pair according to their similarity, enabling more fine-grained multimodal contrastive learning. Our approach seamlessly integrates temperature-modulated multimodal and unimodal losses with the standard multimodal contrastive loss by gradually transitioning between them. This design allows the model to capture both coarse- and fine-grained semantics at different training stages. Extensive experiments demonstrate that each component of TeMo consistently enhances performance across diverse zero-shot retrieval and classification tasks, establishing new state-of-the-art results.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TeMo框架，通过基于相似度自适应调整温度参数，实现更细粒度的多模态对比学习，在零样本检索与分类任务上取得新SOTA。
AI.motivation: 对比学习中温度超参数τ控制负样本惩罚强度，但现有方法多将其固定或在训练中学习为全局值，无法针对不同正负样本对进行细粒度调节。
AI.method: 提出TeMo（Temperature Modulation）框架，依据每个正负样本对的相似度自适应调制温度；并将温度调制的多模态与单模态损失通过逐步过渡方式融入标准多模态对比损失。
AI.result: 大量实验表明TeMo各组件在多种零样本检索与分类任务上均一致提升性能，刷新SOTA结果。
AI.conclusion: 基于相似度的温度调制可以实现更细粒度的多模态对比学习，兼顾粗粒度与细粒度语义，验证了各组件有效性。

title: Re-engineering SORT-based algorithms for low-cost small object tracking from omnidirectional footage
comment: Accepted by IEEE 28th International Workshop on Multimedia Signal Processing (MMSP)
summary: Multi-object tracking (MOT) has advanced rapidly in urban surveillance and autonomous driving, yet many trackers rely on ReID- and transformer-based appearance encoders and are designed for standard FoV cameras. These assumptions break down for low-cost omnidirectional deployments, where equirectangular projection introduces seam discontinuities and targets appear to be small and fast-moving. We address multi-object tracking of flying animals captured in remote environments using omnidirectional cameras. We propose a lightweight framework that re-engineers SORT-based tracking for this geometry, including (i) a Seam-Aware Motion Model that keeps the Kalman state continuous across the seam, (ii) a composite seam-aware association cost that pairs a wrapped Euclidean term with GIoU, and (iii) OmniSmall, a new benchmark of omnidirectional wildlife footage. On our new dataset, with ground-truth detections, our modifications improved over OCSORT by +8.51 HOTA, +9.41 MOTA, and +10.17 IDF1; with YOLOX detections the gain narrows to +1.95 HOTA. Our proposed methods improved tracking performance on OmniSmall and remained competitive on JRDB without adding appearance encoders while keeping the tracking stage CPU-only. Our dataset and source code are available at: https://github.com/Xin-Shu/OmniSORT.git.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量级OmniSORT框架，将SORT类跟踪器改造以适配全向相机几何，含跨接缝运动模型、复合关联代价与OmniSmall基准，在无外观编码器、跟踪阶段仅用CPU条件下取得提升。
AI.motivation: 现有MOT方法多依赖ReID与Transformer外观编码器，且面向标准视场相机；在低成本全向部署中，等距柱状投影带来接缝不连续，目标小而快，这些假设失效。论文关注远程环境中全向相机拍摄的飞行动物多目标跟踪问题。
AI.method: 对SORT类跟踪进行几何再设计：(i) 接缝感知运动模型，使卡尔曼状态跨接缝保持连续；(ii) 复合接缝感知关联代价，将环绕欧氏项与GIoU结合；(iii) 构建OmniSmall——新的全向野生动物视频基准。
AI.result: 在OmniSmall上使用真值检测时，相对OCSORT提升+8.51 HOTA、+9.41 MOTA、+10.17 IDF1；使用YOLOX检测时增益缩小至+1.95 HOTA。方法在OmniSmall上提升跟踪性能，在JRDB上保持竞争力，未引入外观编码器且跟踪阶段仅需CPU。
AI.conclusion: 通过针对全向几何的轻量改造即可显著提升接缝场景下的MOT性能，避免外观编码器开销，数据集与代码已开源。

title: Qwen-Audio-3.0-ASR Technical Report
comment: 21 pages, 11 figures. Authors are listed in alphabetical order by surname
summary: In recent years, automatic speech recognition (ASR) has witnessed transformative advancements driven by three complementary paradigms: data scaling, model scaling, and deep integration with large language models (LLMs). However, bridging the gap between academic benchmark performance and real-world production utility remains a persistent challenge, particularly in handling diverse regional dialects, dynamic entities and hotwords, long-range contextual information, and disfluent spontaneous speech. In this report, we present Qwen-Audio-3.0-ASR, a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLM-based ASR system designed to address these production demands through a unified, instruction-following framework. The model is built upon the Qwen backbone, and is trained on tens of millions of hours of large-scale speech data. Qwen-Audio-3.0-ASR supports transcription across 30 languages and 16 Chinese dialectal varieties spanning eight major dialect regions. Beyond multilingual and dialectal recognition, the model provides production-oriented capabilities including industry-domain entity recognition, hierarchical hotword customization, native single-pass transcription polishing, and long-audio contextual modeling. We further develop a dedicated streaming variant, Qwen-Audio-3.0-ASR-Streaming, for latency-sensitive applications. Extensive evaluations on Chinese, English, multilingual, and real-world industrial test sets demonstrate state-of-the-art or highly competitive recognition performance across a broad range of evaluation conditions, with strong performance relative to leading commercial and proprietary systems including GPT-4o Transcribe and Gemini 3.1 Pro.

AI.tldr: 该报告提出基于MoE LLM的ASR系统Qwen-Audio-3.0-ASR，以指令跟随框架统一应对真实生产场景需求，覆盖30种语言与16种汉语方言，并具备实体识别、热词定制、单遍转写润色与长音频建模能力，另提供流式变体。
AI.motivation: 近年ASR在数据规模化、模型规模化和与LLM深度融合三方面取得进展，但学术基准性能与真实生产可用性之间仍存在差距，尤其在方言、动态实体与热词、长程上下文以及口语不流畅等方面。因此需要一个面向生产需求的统一ASR系统。
AI.method: 构建基于Qwen骨干的MoE LLM ASR系统Qwen-Audio-3.0-ASR，采用统一指令跟随框架，在数千万小时大规模语音数据上训练；支持30种语言与16种汉语方言（覆盖八大 dialect 区）；提供行业领域实体识别、分层热词定制、原生单遍转写润色、长音频上下文建模等生产导向功能；并开发面向低延迟场景的流式变体Qwen-Audio-3.0-ASR-Streaming。
AI.result: 在中文、英文、多语言及真实工业测试集上的大量评估表明，在广泛评测条件下取得SOTA或极具竞争力的识别性能，相较GPT-4o Transcribe、Gemini 3.1 Pro等领先商业与专有系统表现强劲。
AI.conclusion: Qwen-Audio-3.0-ASR通过MoE LLM与指令跟随的统一设计，将大规模数据、多语言方言覆盖与生产向功能整合，缩小了学术基准与生产实用之间的差距，并通过流式变体满足延迟敏感应用需求。

title: Heat Kernel Textures: the Geodesic Gaussians That Do Not Splat
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting has recently revolutionised novel view synthesis as well as many other 3D vision methods and applications. Drawing inspiration from this representation, we now rethink textures to overcome the main issues of UV mapping while considerably lowering their memory footprint. Heat Kernel Textures (HKTex) eliminate UV unwrapping as well as their persistent issues of wasted UV space, seams, distortions, vertex-duplication, and varying resolution. Grounded in discrete Riemannian geometry and intrinsically defined on any manifold surface discretised as a triangular mesh, HKTex uses anisotropic heat kernels as geodesic equivalents to Gaussians. Like our kernels, also the optimisation of their position and the adaptive densification strategies were redefined to operate on the surface of the object to be textureised. Our novel representation is also fully integrated with a physically based renderer and can be optimised either from existing textures or multi-view images. Our project page and code are available at circle-group.github.io/research/HeatKernelTextures.

AI.tldr: HKTex将3D高斯泼溅思想迁移到纹理表示，用各向异性热核替代高斯，在三角网格表面定义纹理，消除UV展开及其空间浪费、接缝、畸变等固有问题并降低内存占用。
AI.motivation: 受3D Gaussian Splatting启发，重新思考纹理表示，以克服UV映射的主要缺陷，同时大幅降低纹理的内存占用。
AI.method: 提出Heat Kernel Textures（HKTex），基于离散黎曼几何，直接在任意流形表面（以三角网格离散）上定义；使用各向异性热核作为测地等价于高斯的基元，并将核的位置优化与自适应致密化策略重新定义在物体表面上执行；与基于物理的渲染器完全集成，可从已有纹理或多视角图像进行优化。
AI.result: 消除了UV展开及其固有的一系列问题，包括UV空间浪费、接缝、畸变、顶点重复和分辨率不一致，同时显著降低了内存占用。
AI.conclusion: HKTex是一种内蕴于表面的新型纹理表示，兼容物理渲染并可从纹理或多视角图像优化，为替代传统UV映射提供了有效方案。

title: We're Cooked! - Probing LLM Political Alignment Via Conflict-Framed Recipe Translation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for translation tasks, yet their implicit political positioning in such contexts remains understudied. We ask whether a single politically charged framing term, such as aggressor, enemy, neighbour, or coloniser is sufficient to trigger implicit political alignment in an otherwise apolitical task. We present a fully crossed factorial study in which eight models spanning Western, Chinese, and European origins are prompted to translate culturally attributed recipes into a target language left deliberately unspecified. Across 17 languages, four framing conditions, eight models, and 15,680 responses, we find that models do not simply decline or ask for clarification but resolve the ambiguity. Language resolution and reasoning behavior cluster meaningfully along model families: Western models hedge and deflect with vague justifications, Chinese models resolve conflicts silently, and Mistral Large emerges as a distinct profile combining high compliance with conflict-grounded reasoning. Sensitivity to framing terms is consistent across models: even subtle framing variation is sufficient to modulate behavior. Our findings urge caution when deploying LLMs for translation in conflict-adjacent contexts, where implicit political judgments may be made without any signal to the user.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过15,680次翻译实验发现，即便在看似中立的翻译任务中，单个带政治色彩的框架词（如"侵略者""敌人""邻居""殖民者"）也足以触发大语言模型的隐性政治立场，且模型行为沿厂商家族呈系统性聚类。
AI.motivation: LLM被日益广泛用于翻译任务，但其在此类语境中的隐性政治定位缺乏研究。作者希望验证：在本身非政治性的任务中，仅一个带政治立场的框架词是否就足以诱发模型的隐性政治对齐。
AI.method: 采用全交叉因子实验设计：来自西方、中国与欧洲的8个模型，被要求将带有文化归属的食谱翻译成一个刻意未指定的目标语言；实验覆盖17种语言、4种框架条件、8个模型，共收集15,680条回答，并分析其语言选择、推理行为与合规性。
AI.result: 模型既未拒绝也未请求澄清，而是主动消解歧义：西方模型以模糊理由回避与推诿，中国模型静默化解冲突，Mistral Large则呈现"高合规+冲突导向推理"的独特画像；所有模型对框架词均表现出一致敏感性，即便细微的框架变化也足以调节其行为。
AI.conclusion: 在冲突邻近语境下部署LLM进行翻译需保持谨慎，因为模型可能在没有任何用户可见信号的情况下作出隐性政治判断；框架词敏感性跨模型一致，说明该风险具有普遍性。

title: SphereSOD: Geometry-Structure Coupled Learning for 360 Salient Object Detection
summary: 360° salient object detection (SOD) aims to accurately segment salient regions across a full field of view. However, equirectangular projection (ERP) introduces severe spatial distortion when mapping the spherical domain onto a planar representation. Existing methods mainly focus on compensating projection distortion while overlooking the interaction between panoramic geometry and salient object structure during feature perception and prediction refinement. To this end, we propose SphereSOD, an ERP-native framework that couples panoramic geometry with evolving salient structures. Specifically, spherical geometry governs feature sampling and spatial weighting, while coarse-grained saliency and contour prediction influence context aggregation during the progressive decoding process. SphereSOD first initializes deformable sampling based on spherical projection geometry and then employs bounded, content-adaptive offsets, yielding features that are better aligned with the underlying panoramic geometry. Subsequently, the decoder performs structure-guided context aggregation and progressive refinement to recover complete salient regions and accurate boundaries. Extensive experiments on three public 360° SOD benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art performance and a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off, supporting structurepreserving inference directly in ERP space as a promising alternative to projection-heavy panoramic pipelines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SphereSOD，一个ERP原生（ERP-native）的360°显著目标检测框架，将全景几何与演化中的显著结构耦合，在ERP空间直接实现结构保持的推理，在三个公开基准上达到SOTA并具有良好精度-效率权衡。
AI.motivation: 360° SOD需在全视场下分割显著区域，但等距柱状投影（ERP）将球面映射到平面时引入严重空间畸变。现有方法主要补偿投影畸变，却忽视了特征感知与预测精化过程中全景几何与显著目标结构之间的交互。
AI.method: 提出ERP原生的SphereSOD框架，耦合全景几何与演化中的显著结构：球面几何主导特征采样与空间加权，粗粒度显著性与轮廓预测在渐进解码中影响上下文聚合。具体地，首先基于球面投影几何初始化可变形采样，并采用有界、内容自适应的偏移量，使特征更贴合底层全景几何；随后解码器执行结构引导的上下文聚合与渐进精化，以恢复完整显著区域与准确边界。
AI.result: 在三个公开360° SOD基准上的大量实验表明，该方法取得SOTA性能，并具有有利的精度-效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: 支持在ERP空间直接进行结构保持的推理，是替代投影密集（projection-heavy）全景流水线的一种有前景的方案。

title: Validating DBpedia Triple Sets for Natural Language Generation
summary: We present a study of the quality of individual DBpedia triples from the perspective of Natural Language Generation, and propose and evaluate an approach for collecting entity-specific triple sets that filters out questionable triples while minimizing the loss of correct ones. We show in an evaluation against manually annotated data that with validation rules, it is possible to reach 98% precision in triple selection, and with improvements to a few Property definitions, it is possible to improve recall by 40% without harming precision.

AI.tldr: 从自然语言生成视角评估DBpedia三元组质量，提出筛选实体特定三元组集合的方法，在过滤可疑三元组的同时最小化正确三元组损失。验证规则可使三元组选择精度达98%；改进部分属性定义后，召回率提升40%且不损精度。
AI.motivation: DBpedia三元组质量参差不齐，直接用于自然语言生成等下游任务时可能引入错误信息；因此需要从NLG视角评估单个三元组的质量，并构建高质量的实体特定三元组集合。
AI.method: 提出一种实体特定三元组集合的收集方法，通过验证规则（validation rules）过滤可疑三元组，并针对若干Property定义进行改进，以在保证精度的前提下提升召回。
AI.result: 在人工标注数据上的评测显示：采用验证规则时，三元组选择精度可达98%；在改进少数Property定义后，召回率提升40%且精度不受影响。
AI.conclusion: 验证规则与属性定义优化可有效提升DBpedia三元组筛选的质量，实现高精度并显著提高召回，为NLG等下游任务提供更可靠的知识来源。

title: Solution for UCF UrbanTwin LUMPI Track: Sim-to-Real Urban LiDAR 3D Object Detection
summary: We present our solution to the LUMPI track of the UCF UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge at the 6th DriveX Workshop, ECCV 2026. The detector must be trained only on synthetic data and is evaluated on 50 held-out real LiDAR frames; a separate 50-frame synthetic submission is evaluated for point-cloud realism. Our method addresses the Sim2Real gap at three levels. First, we align synthetic scans to the 50k-point test density and build a 30k-record training pool using UT-LUMPI geometry, RangeLDM-based sampling diversification, rare-class copy-paste, and pedestrian-oriented augmentation. Second, complementary DSVT detectors and Car/Bus PointPillars specialists are trained under the same synthetic-only constraint. Third, predictions are integrated by class-aware routing, asymmetric agreement fusion, constrained residual-recall supplementation, class-coverage auditing, and selective box-size calibration. The realism branch is optimized independently with radial-density matching, weak affine calibration, and calibrated set mixing. The final submission obtains a Combined Score of 0.4692, a Detection Score of 0.1797, a Realism Score of 0.9035, and 3D mAP@0.5 of 0.1258.

AI.tldr: 提出面向UCF UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR挑战LUMPI赛道的纯合成数据训练检测方案，通过数据对齐、多检测器互补与类别感知融合，获得综合分0.4692、真实感0.9035。
AI.motivation: 检测器仅能在合成数据上训练，却需在少量真实LiDAR帧上评测，且另有合成提交需评估点云真实感，核心挑战是弥合Sim2Real域差距并兼顾检测与真实感两项指标。
AI.method: 在三个层面应对Sim2Real差距：(1)数据层，将合成扫描对齐至50k点测试密度，基于UT-LUMPI几何构建30k记录训练池，采用RangeLDM采样多样化、稀有类复制粘贴与行人导向增强；(2)模型层，在纯合成约束下训练互补的DSVT检测器与Car/Bus PointPillars专家；(3)集成层，采用类别感知路由、非对称一致性融合、受限残差召回补充、类别覆盖审计与选择性框尺寸校准。真实感分支独立优化，使用径向密度匹配、弱仿射校准与校准集合混合。
AI.conclusion: 多层级数据对齐与类别感知的多模型融合可在纯合成训练条件下提升真实LiDAR检测性能，同时真实感分支的高分表明生成点云分布匹配有效，但检测分仍偏低，Sim2Real差距尚存较大改进空间。

title: Large-Scale User Behavior Analysis in Multimodal AI-Assisted Manual Task Execution
summary: Conversational Task Assistants (CTAs) are multimodal dialogue systems that support users in complex real-world tasks such as cooking and DIY through voice, text, image, and video interactions. Prior user studies have focused on controlled settings, leaving limited understanding of real-world CTA usage at scale. In this work, we present a large-scale study of CTA usage based on thousands of users in-the-wild. Our large-scale real-world data analysis unveils new understandings of (i) user-CTA interaction flows, (ii) user intents, (iii) user conversational traits, and (iv) behavioral factors associated with user satisfaction. Our findings reveal key opportunities for future research in CTAs, particularly in user interaction design and task engagement, concluding with concrete design guidelines.

AI.tldr: 本文基于数千名真实用户的大规模野外观测数据，系统分析了对话式任务助手（CTA）的实际使用情况，揭示了用户交互流程、意图、对话特征及满意度关联因素，并提出设计指南。
AI.motivation: 现有关于CTA的用户研究多局限于受控实验环境，缺乏对其大规模真实使用情况的理解，因此需要开展野外大规模研究以填补这一空白。
AI.method: 对数千名真实用户在自然环境下使用CTA的行为数据进行大规模实证分析，从四个维度展开：(i) 用户与CTA的交互流程，(ii) 用户意图，(iii) 用户对话特征，(iv) 与用户满意度相关的行为因素。
AI.result: 研究发现揭示了CTA在用户交互设计与任务参与度方面的关键研究机遇，并据此总结出具体的设计指南。
AI.conclusion: 大规模真实数据分析为CTA的未来研究提供了新见解，尤其在交互设计和任务参与方面，并给出了可操作的设计建议。

title: Same Problem, Different Field: Cross-Domain Solution Import via Domain-Stripped Computational Fingerprints
comment: Accepted as a full paper at JCDL 2026 (The 2026 ACM/IEEE Joint Conference on Digital Libraries), Frisco, TX, October 13-16, 2026. 10 pages plus references, 2 figures, 8 tables. Code and benchmark: https://github.com/ErykKul/same-problem-different-field ; archived dataset (KU Leuven RDR): https://doi.org/10.48804/W3B9WC
summary: The same underlying computational problem is solved across unrelated fields under different names: recursive Bayesian state estimation appears as a "Kalman filter" in control, "Bayesian forecasting" in pharmacokinetics, and "data assimilation" in geoscience. Topical and citation-based scientific embeddings cannot see this shared problem. We distill each paper once into a domain- and method-name-stripped faceted computational fingerprint, a free-text mechanism skeleton plus controlled computational facets. We define a tunable, facet-selectable similarity over it. The goal is solution import: surface cross-field pairs solving the same problem, so a bespoke implementation can be swapped for another field's standard, specialized solver. On a benchmark of 18 method families across 109 papers, the skeleton lifts cross-domain retrieval average precision over the abstract from 0.222 to 0.513, and the whole fingerprint reaches 0.557. Strikingly, four trained scientific embedders all fall below plain abstract+TF-IDF: they encode topical and citation similarity, the wrong signal for this task. The gain is the representation: the abstract-to-skeleton swap lifts every embedder, and the pipeline is one cached LLM call per paper plus a cheap embedder. An interventional re-skin / math-edit test shows the fingerprint tracks the computation, not the field. On a 501-paper wild corpus, known twins dominate the top of the ranking (23 of the top 30); with planted pairs excluded from the results, three blind LLM judges rate 3 of the top 5 and 8 of the top 30 pairs genuine import candidates, and 0 of 30 random ones. The human verification is the four executed imports: in one, an open standard solver reproduces a bespoke clinical dosing engine's output. We release the benchmark, the code, and the distillation prompt.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"分面计算指纹"表示，剥离领域与方法名称，仅保留机制骨架与受控计算分面，使同一计算问题的跨领域解法可被检索与迁移；在109篇、18个方法族基准上跨域检索AP由摘要的0.222提升至0.557，且验证了4个真实迁移案例。
AI.motivation: 同一底层计算问题在不同学科以不同名称存在（控制论"Kalman filter"、药代动力学"Bayesian forecasting"、地学"data assimilation"），但基于主题与引用的科学嵌入无法识别这种共享问题，导致跨领域解法迁移受阻。
AI.method: 将每篇论文蒸馏为去除领域与方法名称的分面计算指纹（自由文本机制骨架 + 受控计算分面），并定义可调、可分面选择的相似度度量；流程为每篇论文一次缓存LLM调用加一个廉价嵌入器；通过interventional re-skin/math-edit测试检验指纹是否追踪计算而非领域。
AI.result: 在18个方法族、109篇论文基准上，机制骨架将跨域检索平均精度从摘要的0.222提升至0.513，完整指纹达0.557；四个训练过的科学嵌入器均低于plain abstract+TF-IDF。501篇野生语料中已知双生论文占据排名前列（前30中23篇），排除植入对后，三位盲评LLM判定前5中3对、前30中8对为真实迁移候选，随机30对为0；4个人工执行迁移中，一个开放标准求解器复现了定制临床给药引擎的输出。
AI.conclusion: 关键增益来自表示形式本身：摘要到骨架的替换对每个嵌入器均有提升；指纹追踪计算而非领域，可实现跨领域解法导入，并已开源基准、代码与蒸馏提示。

title: I Don't Miss You, but I Do: Self-Explanation Faithfulness of Modality Missingness in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used in settings where some input modalities may be unavailable, yet we know little about whether they can faithfully explain how such missing information affects their own predictions. We introduce an interventional protocol for evaluating self-explanations of modality dynamics: models state what each modality alone would support, whether restoring a missing modality would change their answer, and whether the available evidence is sufficient; we then execute the corresponding intervention and compare these claims with realized behavior. We evaluate ten VLMs spanning open-weight and proprietary models across four tasks covering mixed, redundant, and unique modality regimes. We find a systematic tendency to overstate the sufficiency of available evidence. Models substantially underestimate the effect of restoring missing modalities: executed change exceeds predicted change in 78 of 80 model-task-condition settings, with task-level median executed change rates reaching 70.1\% while median predicted rates remain at most 9.6\%. Insufficiency claims have low recall, leaving many cases in which behavior changes despite a stated claim of sufficiency. Retrospective self-explanations show the same tendency, over-crediting single-input sufficiency in mixed regimes and interchangeability in redundant ones. Together, these results show that VLMs systematically mischaracterize how their predictions depend on available and missing evidence, motivating executable interventions as a behavioral test of multimodal self-explanations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种干预式评估协议，检验视觉语言模型（VLM）对模态缺失如何影响自身预测的自我解释是否忠实。
AI.motivation: VLM 越来越多地应用于部分输入模态可能缺失的场景，但其能否忠实解释缺失信息如何影响自身预测尚不清楚。
AI.method: 提出干预式协议：让模型说明单一模态单独能支持什么、恢复缺失模态是否会改变答案、现有证据是否充分；随后实际执行对应干预，并将模型的声明与实际行为进行对比。评估了十个 VLM（开源权重与闭源），覆盖四项任务、涵盖混合、冗余与唯一模态三种情形。
AI.result: 发现系统性高估现有证据充分性的倾向。模型显著低估恢复缺失模态的影响：在 80 个"模型-任务-条件"设置中有 78 个实际变化超过预测变化，任务级中位实际变化率达 70.1%，而中位预测率最高仅 9.6%。不充分性声明的召回率低，导致许多声称充分却实际发生行为变化的案例。回顾式自我解释表现出相同倾向，在混合情形中过度归功于单输入充分性，在冗余情形中过度归功于可互换性。
AI.conclusion: VLM 系统性地错误刻画其预测对现有与缺失证据的依赖关系，表明应以可执行干预作为多模态自我解释的行为学检验手段。

title: Mapping the Emerging Social Science of Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly shape communication, learning, work, creativity, and decision-making, yet social-science research on these developments remains fragmented. We map this emerging field using a curated corpus of 198 papers reviewed in full and a field-scale corpus of 47,719 published papers from five bibliographic databases. Combining sentence embeddings, K-means clustering, within-cluster Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA), author and LLM classifications, and structural topic modeling, we identify three domains: LLM as Social Minds, examining socially interpretable model behavior; LLM Societies, examining collective dynamics among interacting model-based agents; and LLM-Human Interactions, examining how people perceive, use, and are affected by LLMs. These domains contain 13 subcategories spanning reasoning, personality and bias, behavioral games, collective intelligence, simulation, trust, work, creativity, and education. In the curated corpus, the three-domain solution is highly stable under resampling (adjusted Rand index = 0.952), and K-means assignments agree with author full-text classifications for 77.78% of papers. At field scale, 13 of 15 topics map onto the taxonomy, while K-means and structural-topic-model domains agree for 73.83% of overlapping papers. LLM-Human Interactions accounts for 78.02% of domain-mapped topic mass, but venue analysis reveals a contrasting pattern: Social Minds and LLM Societies together account for 66.37% of highly cited papers in leading conference venues, whereas LLM-Human Interactions accounts for 76.81% in the corresponding journal subset. The resulting taxonomy provides a reproducible framework for understanding how model behavior, agent interaction, and institutional context jointly shape the social consequences of LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文通过整合198篇全文精读论文与47,719篇文献数据库论文，运用句嵌入、K-means聚类、LDA、作者与大模型分类及结构主题模型，构建了LLM社会科学研究的三领域分类体系，并验证了其稳定性与场域尺度一致性。
AI.motivation: 大模型正日益塑造沟通、学习、工作、创造力与决策，但相关社会科学研究高度碎片化，缺乏系统性、可复现的领域地图与分类框架，难以厘清模型行为、智能体互动与制度语境如何共同影响LLM的社会后果。
AI.method: 结合精读语料（198篇全文审阅）与场域规模语料（来自五个文献数据库的47,719篇论文）；采用句嵌入、K-means聚类、簇内LDA、作者与大模型分类、结构主题建模等方法进行主题识别与分类；通过重采样检验分类稳定性，并与作者全文分类、结构主题模型结果进行一致性比对。
AI.result: 识别出三大研究领域：LLM as Social Minds（社会可解释的模型行为）、LLM Societies（模型智能体集体动力学）、LLM-Human Interactions（人对LLM的感知、使用与受影响方式），共含13个子类别。精读语料中三领域解在重采样下高度稳定（ARI=0.952），K-means与作者分类一致率77.78%；场域尺度上15个主题中13个可映射至该分类体系，K-means与结构主题模型领域一致率73.83%。LLM-Human Interactions占领域映射主题质量78.02%；但高被引论文分布呈反差：Social Minds与LLM Societies合计占顶级会议高被引论文66.37%，而LLM-Human Interactions占对应期刊子集76.81%。
AI.conclusion: 该分类体系提供了可复现的分析框架，有助于理解模型行为、智能体互动与制度语境如何共同塑造LLM的社会后果，并为后续跨学科研究提供统一的概念坐标与实证基础。

title: BarkNet-Lite: A Lightweight Texture and Colour Network with the BarkBD Benchmark for Bark-Based Tree Species Recognition in Bangladesh
summary: Tree species recognition supports forest inventory and biodiversity monitoring but still depends on scarce taxonomic expertise. Bark is visible year-round at ground level, yet bark recognition has concentrated on temperate floras and on large ImageNet-pre-trained backbones. We address both gaps. First, we release BarkBD, a bark dataset for Bangladesh: 14,258 uncropped smartphone photographs of 20 native species across four districts and three weather conditions, with a fixed stratified split. Second, we propose BarkNet-Lite, a 2.96M-parameter network trained from random initialisation, pairing a multi-scale texture pathway with a parallel colour-aware pathway. Over five seeds it reaches 96.64+-0.66%accuracyunderstrict single-image inference, within 2.3 points of nine ImageNet-pre-trained backbones fine-tuned under an identical protocol and within one seed-level standard deviation of the smallest ofthem, andtransfers to public benchmarks (95.86% on BarkVN-50, 92.85% on BarkNet 1.0). Grad-CAM, validated by faithfulness and weight-randomisation checks, confirms its decisions rest on bark structure rather than background. The exported single-precision model classifies one photograph in 15.34ms on a commodity smartphone.

AI.tldr: 该论文发布孟加拉国树皮数据集BarkBD（14,258张20类手机照片），并提出从随机初始化训练的2.96M参数轻量网络BarkNet-Lite，融合多尺度纹理与颜色感知双路径，单图推理准确率96.64%±0.66%，接近ImageNet预训练骨干网络，且可跨数据集迁移，手机端推理仅15.34ms。
AI.motivation: 树皮识别可支撑森林资源调查与生物多样性监测，但依赖稀缺的分类学专家。现有树皮识别研究集中于温带植物区系，且普遍依赖大型ImageNet预训练骨干网络，在热带/亚热带区域与轻量化部署方面存在明显空白（孟加拉国等地区尤其缺乏数据）。
AI.method: 1) 构建并公开BarkBD数据集：20种孟加拉国本土树种、覆盖4个地区与3种天气条件，14,258张未裁剪智能手机照片，采用固定分层划分。2) 提出BarkNet-Lite：仅2.96M参数、从随机初始化训练，由多尺度纹理路径与并行的颜色感知路径构成；与9个ImageNet预训练骨干网络在相同协议下微调进行对照。3) 采用Grad-CAM并用忠实性（faithfulness）与权重随机化检验验证模型关注区域。
AI.result: 五个随机种子下严格单图推理准确率为96.64%±0.66%，比9个ImageNet预训练骨干网络的最佳结果低仅2.3个百分点，且落在其中最小骨干网络的一个种子级标准差之内；公开基准迁移表现：BarkVN-50达95.86%，BarkNet 1.0达92.85%。Grad-CAM经忠实性与权重随机化验证，表明模型决策依赖树皮结构而非背景。导出为单精度模型后在普通智能手机上单张照片推理耗时15.34ms。
AI.conclusion: 轻量级、从零训练的双路径网络可在树皮识别上逼近ImageNet预训练大模型，同时兼具跨域泛化能力与移动端实时性；BarkBD填补了热带（孟加拉国）树皮数据的空白，为低资源地区的森林调查与生物多样性监测提供了可行的低成本方案。

title: ObGynLongBench: Revealing the Evidence-to-EHR Gap in Longitudinal EHR Decision-Making
summary: The application of large language models (LLMs) to personalized medical assistants has garnered growing interest. However, existing medical benchmarks largely rely on static question answering with pre-selected evidence, leaving unclear whether LLMs can make reliable clinical decisions from real longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs). To bridge this gap, we introduce ObGynLongBench, a rule-grounded long-context EHR benchmark for obstetric and gynecologic decision-making, comprising 1,500 clinical decision-point cases from 976 real pregnancy EHR histories and traceable rules. Each case is anchored to a patient, a pregnancy-timeline point, and a pre-decision information boundary, enabling Evidence-only, Visit-level EHR, and History-level EHR evaluation. Evaluating 17 LLMs reveals a substantial Evidence-to-EHR Gap: models perform well when evidence is directly provided, but accuracy drops when evidence must be extracted from same-day records or full pre-decision EHR histories. Further analyses identify evidence utilization as a key bottleneck: performance decreases with longer EHR contexts and more complex evidence requirements, and earlier failures often predict later failures within the same patient history. Finally, active-search agents perform best among EHR access strategies, highlighting patient-specific evidence utilization as a central challenge for reliable personalized medical assistants. Resources are available at https://github.com/xiangjun2003/ObgynLongbench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ObGynLongBench，一个基于规则、面向妇产科决策的长上下文电子健康记录（EHR）基准，包含来自 976 份真实妊娠 EHR 病史的 1,500 个临床决策点案例。对 17 个 LLM 的评估揭示了显著的“证据—EHR 差距”，并将证据利用识别为关键瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有医学基准多依赖静态问答与预先选定的证据，无法反映模型能否从真实纵向 EHR 中做出可靠临床决策，因此需要更贴近真实临床流程的评测手段。
AI.method: 构建 ObGynLongBench，每个案例锚定患者、妊娠时间线节点与决策前信息边界，支持 Evidence-only、Visit-level EHR、History-level EHR 三种评测设置，并包含可追溯规则；对 17 个 LLM 进行系统评估，并分析上下文长度、证据复杂度及患者病史内失败传播等影响因素。
AI.result: 实验显示明显的 Evidence-to-EHR Gap：直接提供证据时模型表现良好，但当需从当日记录或完整决策前 EHR 病史中提取证据时准确率下降；性能随 EHR 上下文变长和证据需求复杂度上升而降低，同一患者病史中的早期失败往往预示后续失败；主动搜索代理在各类 EHR 访问策略中表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: 个性化医学助手可靠性提升的核心挑战在于患者特定的证据利用能力，而非仅靠扩大上下文或提供更多信息；主动检索策略具有潜力。资源见 https://github.com/xiangjun2003/ObgynLongbench。

title: Search-to-World: Evaluation of 3D World Delivery from User Request through Web Search
summary: Agentic systems can interpret user requests, search the live web, and use external tools, but their ability to transform retrieved web content into a usable 3D world has not been systematically evaluated. No established end-to-end pipeline or benchmark exists for this capability. We introduce Search-to-World, an end-to-end evaluation task covering request understanding, web visual-content retrieval, and 3D-world delivery. We define Observed Retrieval Rate (ORR) and World Delivery Rate (WDR) to distinguish observing relevant content from successfully delivering a request-aligned, perceptually acceptable world. We also present WorldSearcher, a reuse-then-reconstruction harness that connects existing search agents to world delivery: it first retrieves reusable 3D worlds and, when none are available, reconstructs a world from video. A structured recovery controller revises temporal grounding, replaces source videos, or reformulates queries after failure. Using WorldSearcher, we benchmark representative models on Search-to-World and study supervised fine-tuning (SFT) for recovery subagents. Results show that delivery depends on the underlying agentic model, and that relevant-content observation does not ensure world delivery. Jointly training recovery agents improves delivery success and action efficiency. Search-to-World makes agentic 3D-world delivery measurable, while WorldSearcher provides a practical evaluation harness with recovery capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Search-to-World 端到端评测任务与 WorldSearcher 复用-重建框架，用于评估智能体将网络内容转化为可用 3D 世界的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体系统虽能理解请求、检索网页并调用工具，但从检索到的网页内容转化为可用 3D 世界的能力缺乏系统评估，尚无端到端流程或基准。
AI.method: 提出 Search-to-World 任务，涵盖请求理解、网页视觉内容检索与 3D 世界交付；定义 ORR（观测检索率）与 WDR（世界交付率）两个指标。构建 WorldSearcher 框架，采用“先复用、后重建”策略：优先检索可复用 3D 世界，无可用资源时由视频重建世界；并引入结构化恢复控制器，在失败后修正时间定位、替换源视频或重构查询。基于该框架对代表性模型进行基准测试，并对恢复子智能体进行监督微调（SFT）。
AI.result: 交付成功率取决于底层智能体模型；观测到相关内容并不保证世界交付成功；联合训练恢复智能体可提升交付成功率与动作效率。
AI.conclusion: Search-to-World 使智能体式 3D 世界交付变得可度量，WorldSearcher 提供了具备恢复能力的实用评测框架。

title: Solution for UCF UrbanTwin V2X-Real Track: Sim-to-Real Urban LiDAR 3D Object Detection
summary: Bridging the simulation-to-reality gap in roadside LiDAR requires addressing several coupled discrepancies, including scene geometry, sampling density, return patterns, and pedestrian scale. This report presents a multi-source collaborative training and class-aware fusion framework for Sim2Real 3D detection. The method organizes digital-twin scans, diffusion-redrawn scans, density-stabilized scans, and pedestrian morphology-aligned samples into a unified training pool with complementary roles. Within a common DSVT detection formulation, source-specialized expert branches preserve those roles while optimizing for the same detection objective. At inference, a predefined class-aware fusion pathway integrates geometry-stable and calibration-aware branches for vehicles, sampling-complementary branches for trucks, and morphology-consistent evidence for pedestrians. A label-free point-cloud center blend then refines geometric localization. On the UrbanTwin V2X-Real hidden test set, the unified system achieves a combined score of 0.7421, with 3D mAP@0.5 of 0.4518 and a realism score of 0.8871. The results indicate that a stable, interpretable collaboration among data sources is more valuable than unconstrained aggregation of model outputs.

AI.tldr: 提出多源协同训练与类别感知融合框架，弥合路侧LiDAR的Sim2Real差距，在UrbanTwin V2X-Real隐藏测试集取得0.7421综合得分。
AI.motivation: 路侧LiDAR的仿真到现实迁移面临场景几何、采样密度、回波模式与行人尺度等多重耦合差异，单一数据源或简单输出聚合难以同时应对。
AI.method: 构建统一训练池，纳入数字孪生扫描、扩散重绘扫描、密度稳定化扫描与行人形态对齐样本；在统一DSVT检测框架下设置源特化专家分支；推理阶段采用预定义类别感知融合路径（车辆用几何稳定与标定感知分支，卡车用采样互补分支，行人用形态一致证据），并以无标签点云中心混合细化定位。
AI.result: UrbanTwin V2X-Real隐藏测试集综合得分0.7421，3D mAP@0.5为0.4518，真实感得分0.8871。
AI.conclusion: 数据源之间稳定且可解释的协同，优于对模型输出的无约束聚合。

title: AgentIdeaBench: Benchmarking Scientific Ideation in the Agent Era
comment: 25 pages, 9 figures, 8 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/HKUST-KnowComp/AgentIdeaBench
summary: Scientific ideation is the capacity to formulate novel and testable hypotheses from scientific evidence, and autonomous AI scientists depend on it. Existing evaluations largely assess it by asking models to generate ideas from a static, curated set of reference papers. That passive setup departs from the retrieval-and-reasoning workflow of modern AI scientists, and it becomes less discriminative as models improve. We introduce AgentIdeaBench, a multidisciplinary benchmark that evaluates scientific ideation under two matched settings, static observation and active exploration. We report matched Static-Active evaluations for 33 LLMs across 40 densely scored subfields spanning five disciplines, using a multidimensional, literature-verified scoring framework whose critics assess originality against retrieved prior art. Active exploration reveals considerably more capability headroom, and that headroom is unevenly distributed across models. Performance scales about twice as fast as under static observation, and the exploration gain is capability-gated, favoring the strongest models over the weakest. The gain reflects better grounding, improving feasibility, clarity, and specificity while leaving measured originality unchanged under our critics. We further explore Scientific World Modeling, a generation-time loop that refines a draft hypothesis through structured thought experiments. It benefits mid-capability models, and its impact diminishes among frontier models that appear to have internalized such reasoning patterns already. AgentIdeaBench gives future work on scientific ideation a measurement basis suited to the agent era.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AgentIdeaBench，一个多学科基准，在静态观测与主动探索两种匹配设定下评估科学构想能力，对33个LLM在5个学科40个子领域进行评测。
AI.motivation: 现有科学构想评估多依赖静态、精选的参考文献集，要求模型被动生成想法，这与现代AI科学家的检索-推理工作流不符，且随模型能力提升判别力下降。
AI.method: 构建AgentIdeaBench，使用多维、经文献核验的评分框架（评审者基于检索到的先验工作评估原创性），对33个LLM在40个密集评分子领域进行静态-主动匹配评估；并探索Scientific World Modeling生成时循环，通过结构化思想实验精炼假设草稿。
AI.result: 主动探索揭示更大的能力空间且分布不均；性能扩展速度约为静态观测的两倍，探索增益受能力门控，偏向最强模型；增益体现为更好的grounding，提升可行性、清晰度与具体性，但原创性未变。Scientific World Modeling有利于中等能力模型，对前沿模型效果递减。
AI.conclusion: AgentIdeaBench为智能体时代的科学构想研究提供了适配的测量基础。

title: Privacy Leakage from a Thousand Words: Millipixel Location Recovery from Dot Maps
comment: Accepted to the ACM Conference on Computer and Communications Security (CCS), 2026. Code is available at: https://github.com/PuddlesPenguin/AutoLocate/
summary: Dot maps, which visualize individual data points as dots over a geographic region, are widely used across diverse domains to represent spatial patterns in sensitive data. However, the understanding of the privacy risks associated with dot maps remains limited, particularly for maps covering large geographic areas. In this paper, we systematically analyze these risks and present AutoLocate, an automated framework for high-precision location recovery. At its core, AutoLocate exploits anti-aliasing artifacts introduced during map rendering, which inadvertently encode sub-pixel information about dot locations. AutoLocate formulates location recovery as a black-box optimization problem, iteratively refining estimated coordinates by minimizing perceptual discrepancies over these artifacts between the target map and rendered candidate maps. Extensive experiments on both real-world and synthetic datasets, across different attack scenarios and a broad range of map configurations (e.g., map scale, background, resolution), demonstrate the effectiveness of AutoLocate. In particular, it achieves average recovery errors as low as 1 meter (approximately 0.0002 pixel precision) on small-scale maps of the United States, over 200x more accurate than existing approaches. We also propose mitigation strategies and introduce a privacy risk assessment tool to help practitioners evaluate and reduce privacy leakage when publishing dot maps.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析点状地图(dot maps)的隐私风险，提出AutoLocate框架，利用渲染中的抗锯齿伪影编码的亚像素信息，以黑盒优化实现高精度位置恢复，在美国小比例尺地图上平均误差低至1米（约0.0002像素精度），比现有方法准确200倍以上，并提供缓解策略与风险评估工具。
AI.motivation: 点状地图广泛用于可视化敏感空间数据，但其隐私风险理解有限，尤其在大范围地理区域的地图上，缺乏对位置恢复攻击与泄漏程度的系统评估。
AI.method: AutoLocate利用地图渲染时引入的抗锯齿伪影，这些伪影隐含点位置的亚像素信息；将位置恢复建模为黑盒优化问题，通过最小化目标地图与候选渲染地图之间在该伪影上的感知差异，迭代精化估计坐标。
AI.result: 在真实与合成数据集、不同攻击场景及多种地图配置（比例尺、背景、分辨率）下均有效；美国小比例尺地图上平均恢复误差低至1米（约0.0002像素精度），比现有方法准确200倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 点状地图存在严重的隐私泄漏风险，抗锯齿伪影可被利用实现亚像素级定位；论文提出缓解策略与隐私风险评估工具，帮助从业者在发布点状地图时评估并降低隐私泄漏。

title: Open Tabular Insight Extraction: Where Do We Stand, and Where Should We Go?
summary: Democratizing access to the knowledge held in large corpora of tables such as data lakes is emerging as a central research challenge. Research in this space is advancing and broadening in scope, increasingly supplying the components to satisfy a person's insight need end-to-end. Yet these efforts remain fragmented across communities that frame the problem under their own conventions, such as table question answering, text-to-SQL, and data analysis agents, with works six times as likely to cite within the same task label as across labels. To bring these communities onto common ground, we establish a holistic framework for this pursuit, which we refer to as Open Tabular Insight Extraction (OpenTI). We formalize OpenTI from first principles around the analytical knowledge a person needs, the procedure for deriving it from a corpus of tables, and how well a result serves the person who sought it. In doing so we consolidate frameworks and terminology across information retrieval, natural language processing, machine learning, databases, and human-computer interaction, and apply this grounding in a systematic review and analysis of systems and benchmarks that work towards OpenTI. We find that current systems do not cover the end-to-end scope of OpenTI, mainly focusing on the analysis itself, and that benchmarks are largely unfit for evaluations in an open setting as inputs presuppose knowledge of tables, and validation mechanisms do not match the setup. Finally, we distill a research agenda towards OpenTI systems, evaluation, and interaction paradigms that surface the insights users need. An interactive companion to our paper is available at https://open-tabular-insight-extraction.github.io.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"开放表格洞察抽取（OpenTI）"统一框架，并系统梳理跨社区系统与基准，指出其未覆盖端到端范围、基准不适配开放设定，最后给出研究议程。
AI.motivation: 从数据湖等大规模表格语料中获取知识的需求日益重要，但相关研究分散在表格问答、text-to-SQL、数据分析智能体等不同社区，各自沿用自身术语与问题界定（跨任务标签引用远少于同标签引用），缺乏共同基础，阻碍了端到端能力的整合。
AI.method: 从第一性原理形式化OpenTI，围绕三个维度构建：人所需的分析知识、从表格语料中推导该知识的流程、以及结果对用户的服务程度；据此整合信息检索、自然语言处理、机器学习、数据库与人机交互的框架和术语，并对面向OpenTI的系统与基准进行系统性综述与分析。
AI.result: 现有系统未覆盖OpenTI的端到端范围，主要聚焦于分析环节本身；现有基准大多不适合开放场景评估，因为输入预设了对表格的了解，且验证机制与开放设定不匹配。
AI.conclusion: 论文提炼出面向OpenTI的研究议程，涵盖系统、评估与交互范式三方面，以更好地呈现用户所需的洞察，并提供交互式配套资源。

title: The Art of Hierarchical Competing Patterns: Gaussian Process Optimization of Hyphenation
comment: 17 pages, 10 figures, 9 tables. Accepted at EMNLP 2026 (Findings). Code and data: https://github.com/ondrejsojka/pat-gen-opt
summary: Hyphenation patterns remain a compact and widely deployed solution for word breaking in typesetting systems, text processors, and web rendering engines, but their generation still depends on manually tuned patgen program parameter profiles. We formulate patgen profile selection as a black-box hyperparameter optimization problem and evaluate Gaussian-process Bayesian optimization for this task. The search objective combines a precision-oriented F_{1/7}-score with an explicit trie size-accuracy trade-off using a normalized trie-size penalty. We evaluate the method on 17 hyphenated word-list datasets covering 14 languages and multiple scripts. Against two strong hand-tuned profiles regenerated from the same 8/10 training split and evaluated on the same 1/10 held-out test split, the GP-optimized profiles improve F_{1/7} on 16 of 17 datasets and reduce trie size on all 17. The median optimized/baseline trie ratio is 0.407. A dataset-level sign test gives p = 1.37e-4; a separate budget-matched comparison on five representative datasets shows that systematic search is competitive and usually improves over the best hand-tuned profile under the fixed comparison objective. The results show that model-based optimization can make pattern generation more reproducible and less dependent on expert trial-and-error while keeping the accuracy-compactness trade-off explicit.

AI.tldr: 该论文将 patgen 的参数配置选择建模为黑盒超参数优化问题，采用高斯过程贝叶斯优化自动生成连字符断词模式，在 17 个数据集上显著提升了精度并大幅压缩了 trie 规模。
AI.motivation: 连字符模式（hyphenation patterns）是排版、文字处理与网页渲染中广泛使用的紧凑断词方案，但其生成依赖人工调试 patgen 程序参数，费时且难以复现、依赖专家经验。作者希望用自动化优化替代试错，使模式生成更可复现。
AI.method: 将 patgen 参数配置选择形式化为黑盒超参数优化问题，使用高斯过程贝叶斯优化进行搜索。目标函数结合面向精度的 F_{1/7} 分数与显式的 trie 规模—精度权衡（引入归一化 trie 规模惩罚）。实验在 17 个连字符词表数据集、14 种语言、多种文字系统上进行，与由相同 8/10 训练集/1/10 测试集划分重新生成的两个强人工调优配置对比，并额外做了预算匹配的对比实验。
AI.result: GP 优化配置在 17 个数据集中的 16 个上提升了 F_{1/7}，并在全部 17 个上减小了 trie 规模；优化/基线 trie 规模比的中位数为 0.407；数据集级符号检验 p = 1.37e-4；在 5 个代表性数据集上的预算匹配对比显示，系统化搜索具有竞争力，且在固定比较目标下通常优于最佳人工调优配置。
AI.conclusion: 基于模型的优化可使连字符模式生成更可复现、减少对专家试错的依赖，同时保持精度—紧凑度权衡的显式可控。

title: Syntactic Patterns and Stylistic Functions in Narrative Prose: A Rule-Based and Machine-Learning Approach
comment: Submitted as a Discussion Paper to JOHD (Journal of Open Humanities Data), 2026
summary: This paper presents a small-scale quantitative experiment that links syntactic structure to stylistic functions in narrative prose. Starting from a dependency-parsed corpus of 3,300 sentences, we derive sentence-level stylistic labels across five categories --- descriptive, introspective, causal, ideological, and neutral --- using a transparent rule-based procedure that inspects lemmas, universal part-of-speech tags, and syntactic relations. For each sentence we construct a compact representation of its syntactic profile as a sequence of linearised triples combining lemma, POS tag, and dependency relation. These patterns serve as input to standard machine-learning classifiers trained to predict sentence-level style. The best-performing model achieves a macro-F1 of 0.948 under 10-fold cross-validation. The experiment is implemented entirely in Python using open-source tools. Our goal is not to propose a fully fledged stylistic theory, but to offer a reproducible and extensible workflow for exploring how grammatical structure contributes to narrative interpretation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过小规模定量实验，将依存句法结构映射到叙事散文的文体功能，构建可复现、可扩展的句级文体分类工作流。
AI.motivation: 作者希望探索语法结构如何对叙事解读作出贡献，但目标并非提出完整的文体理论，而是提供一个可复现、可扩展的实验流程。
AI.method: 基于3,300句依存句法标注语料，使用透明的规则化程序（检查词元、通用词性标签、句法关系）为句子打上五类文体标签（描写、内省、因果、意识形态、中性）；将每句表示为“词元-POS-依存关系”三元组的线性化序列，作为标准机器学习分类器的输入。
AI.result: 最佳模型在10折交叉验证下取得0.948的macro-F1。实验完全使用Python及开源工具实现。
AI.conclusion: 该实验表明，句子层面的句法轮廓可有效预测文体类别，并提供了一套透明、可复现的流程，用于考察句法结构对叙事解读的贡献。

title: How AI Models Manage Epistemic Authority: A Taxonomy and Comparative Analysis of Responses to User Disagreement
summary: Large language models are increasingly used as sources of advice and information, including in high-stakes settings, yet little is known about how they respond to user disagreement. We study how a model manages its epistemic authority, referring here to its claim to knowledge, competence, or the right to advise, once a user challenges its answer. Building on Conversation Analysis, we introduce a taxonomy of six challenge types and a four-layer framework for analysing each response: whether the original claim is maintained or changed, where authority is located, how the disagreement is socially managed, and what kind of evidential support is offered. We construct a new dataset of 2,310 controlled challenge scenarios and 32,340 corresponding responses from 14 models, and analyse them using our framework with an LLM-as-judge pipeline, providing a vocabulary which future evaluation and benchmark design can build on. We find that models show conflicting behaviour: they validate users in 85% of responses but maintain their original claim in 65%. They explicitly apologise in 33% of responses, yet 59% of those apologies accompany maintenance of the original claim. They transfer authority most often in advice tasks, doing so in 28% of responses and reaching 57% in health advice and 49% in legal advice, compared with 6% in fact and 3% in explanation tasks. Abandonment of the original claim ranges from 0.8% for GPT-5.2 to 40% for DeepSeek 7B, while complete replacement of the original claim is rare overall at 1.5%.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了用户质疑大模型回答的六类挑战分类法与四层回应分析框架，基于2,310个受控场景、14个模型共32,340条回应进行LLM-as-judge分析，揭示模型在维护自身论断与迎合用户之间存在矛盾行为，且权威让渡模式随任务类型差异显著。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型日益被当作建议与信息来源，甚至用于高风险场景，但学界对其在用户提出异议时如何回应知之甚少，尤其缺乏对其"认知权威"（知识与建议资格的主张）如何被管理、维持或让渡的系统考察与评估词汇。
AI.method: 借鉴会话分析（Conversation Analysis），提出六类用户挑战类型分类法与四层回应分析框架：是否维持或改变原始论断、权威定位于何处、分歧如何在社会层面被处理、提供何种证据支持；构建包含2,310个受控挑战场景、来自14个模型的32,340条回应的新数据集，并采用LLM-as-judge流水线结合该框架进行分析。
AI.result: 模型行为呈现矛盾性：85%的回应中对用户表示认可，但65%仍维持原始论断；33%的回应明确道歉，其中59%的道歉同时维持原论断。权威让渡最常出现在建议类任务（28%），健康建议达57%、法律建议达49%，而事实类仅6%、解释类仅3%。放弃原论断的比例从GPT-5.2的0.8%到DeepSeek 7B的40%不等，完全替换原论断整体罕见，仅1.5%。
AI.conclusion: 模型在应对用户分歧时普遍表现出"表面认可、实质坚持"的矛盾模式，且认知权威的让渡高度依赖任务类型。该研究提供的分类法与四层框架为未来评估与基准设计奠定了可复用的分析词汇。

title: Noēsis: Deterministic-First Retrieval with Two-Tier Context Hydration for Factuality-Critical Queries on Small Local Models
comment: Patent pending: Application No. 102026000023146; IT202500035167. Companion to arXiv:2608.15919
summary: A wrong number is worse than no answer. Across factuality-critical domains -- audience metrics, scheduling and rights in media; dosages and lab values in healthcare; figures and citations in finance and legal -- a confident but fabricated value is more damaging than an honest admission of uncertainty. Yet this is the dominant failure mode we observe on small local language models: even when correct evidence is present in context, models fabricate plausible numbers and timestamps. Recent work characterizes a real limit of this regime: below 7B parameters, the bottleneck of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is not retrieval quality but context utilization. We present Noesis, the deterministic-first query plane of the Noesis architecture, which makes every deterministic judgment before generation. Its mechanisms follow from the ingestion architecture (subject of a separate patent application): (a) a producer-side fact layer rendering precomputed metric facts verbatim without ranking; (b) positional addressing with deterministic cross-source alignment, resolved ahead of query time at zero LLM cost; (c) provenance scoping as an attribution constraint with multi-tier named-reference routing; and (d) two-tier context with model-triggered verbatim hydration. Across four ablations, a 2B model reaches parity with a 35B model on factual integrity (exact values in all runs; zero confabulated numbers on absent-entity traps); structured retrieval beats flat RAG by +11.4 points at 2B; skeleton-only context preserves quantitative answers at 20-30% smaller prompts; and hydration recovers verbatim narrative in ~8s versus ~29s. Two properties matter for regulated domains: each query resolves in a single generation call, and every reported value is traceable to its exact source and position by construction.

AI.tldr: Noesis 的查询平面以"确定性优先"策略，用 2B 模型在事实完整性上达到 35B 模型水平，实现精确值零编造与可溯源。
AI.motivation: 在事实性关键领域（媒体指标、医疗剂量、金融法务数字），自信却捏造的数值比承认不确定更有害。小型本地模型即便上下文中存在正确证据，仍会虚构数字与时间戳；且研究表明 7B 以下 RAG 的瓶颈不是检索质量而是上下文利用。
AI.method: 提出 Noesis 的确定性优先查询平面，在生成前完成所有确定性判断，含四项机制：(a) 生产者侧事实层，逐字呈现预计算指标事实且不排序；(b) 位置寻址与跨源确定性对齐，在查询前以零 LLM 成本解析；(c) 溯源范围作为归因约束，配多层级命名引用路由；(d) 双层上下文与模型触发的逐字补水。
AI.result: 四组消融显示：2B 模型事实完整性与 35B 持平（全部运行精确值、无实体陷阱零编造）；结构化检索在 2B 下比扁平 RAG 高 11.4 分；骨架上下文在提示小 20-30% 时保住定量答案；补水约 8s 恢复逐字叙述，对比约 29s。
AI.conclusion: 两个性质利于受监管领域：每次查询仅一次生成调用即可解析，且每个报告值按构造可溯源到确切来源与位置。

title: Harnessing CLIP and DINO: An Uncertainty-Aware Cascaded Fusion Network for Generalizable Deepfake Image Detection
summary: The growing realism and accessibility of manipulated and generated faces threaten the trustworthiness of digital media. To detect such forgeries, deepfake detectors based on vision foundation models have shown promising performance, but they typically rely on a single pretrained representation and are prone to overfitting to particular training distributions. To improve generalization to unseen forgeries, we propose UCF-Net, an uncertainty-aware cascaded fusion network that harnesses CLIP's language-aligned semantic priors and DINO's self-supervised visual-structure priors. UCF-Net extracts hierarchical features across Transformer depths, uses layer-wise expert aggregation to adaptively combine each encoder's multi-level cues, and performs weighted fusion of the resulting representations based on entropy-derived uncertainty. We further consolidate public deepfake datasets into a unified benchmark of approximately 4M images and construct a separate cross-generator evaluation set with over 8K face images from eight recent generators. On the unified benchmark, UCF-Net achieves the best mean AUC among the evaluated methods in both in-domain and cross-domain evaluations. On the cross-generator set, it adapts effectively with limited target-domain data, although zero-shot transfer remains challenging.

AI.tldr: 提出UCF-Net，一种不确定性感知的级联融合网络，融合CLIP语义先验与DINO视觉结构先验，用于提升deepfake检测的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 生成与篡改人脸的逼真度与易获取性不断提升，威胁数字媒体可信度。现有基于视觉基础模型的deepfake检测器多依赖单一预训练表征，易过拟合特定训练分布，难以泛化到未见过的伪造类型。
AI.method: UCF-Net为不确定性感知的级联融合网络，同时利用CLIP的语言对齐语义先验与DINO的自监督视觉结构先验；从Transformer不同深度提取层级特征，采用逐层专家聚合自适应组合各编码器的多层级线索，并基于熵导出的不确定性对所得表征进行加权融合。此外整合公开数据集构建约400万图像的统一基准，并构建含8个近期生成器、逾8千张人脸图像的跨生成器评测集。
AI.result: 在统一基准上，UCF-Net在域内与跨域评测中均取得所评估方法中最佳的平均AUC。在跨生成器集合上，借助有限目标域数据可有效适应，但零样本迁移仍具挑战。
AI.conclusion: 多基础模型先验的级联融合与不确定性加权有助于提升deepfake检测的泛化性，并在大规模统一基准上验证有效性；零样本跨生成器迁移仍是未来待解决的问题。

title: From Citations to Contributions: LLM-Assisted Credit Scoring of Research Articles
summary: Citation-based measures of scientific influence typically treat citations as uniform signals, ignoring the different roles that cited works play in a paper's contribution. We introduce contribution-based credit scoring for research articles: a structured citation analysis that decomposes a paper's credit between its own original contribution and the prior work it builds on. Motivated by a cooperative-game view of scientific credit, we propose the contribution tree, a hierarchical framework that conserves importance across the document structure and separates original from citation-derived contribution. To make this framework scalable, we use LLMs as noisy comparative estimators of local importance. We further extend the model to article collections by propagating contributions through weighted citation graphs, yielding corpus-level contributions and normalized influence scores. Our experiments suggest that our framework captures contribution signals beyond surface-level heuristics. Our code is available at https://github.com/sanaebrahimi/Importance_Scoring/

AI.tldr: 该论文提出基于贡献的学术信用评分方法，用贡献树将论文信用分解为原创贡献与引用衍生贡献，并借助LLM做局部重要性估计，扩展到语料库级影响评分。
AI.motivation: 传统基于引用的科学影响测度把引用视为均一信号，忽略了被引工作在论文贡献中所扮演的不同角色，无法区分论文自身原创贡献与其所依赖的既有工作。
AI.method: 基于合作博弈视角提出贡献树（contribution tree）分层框架，保证文档结构上的重要性守恒，并将原创贡献与引用衍生贡献分离；使用LLM作为局部重要性的噪声比较估计器以提升可扩展性；进一步通过加权引用图传播贡献，得到语料库级贡献与归一化影响分数。
AI.result: 实验表明该框架能够捕捉超出表层启发式信号的贡献信息。
AI.conclusion: 贡献式信用评分可为科研评价提供更细粒度、可扩展的度量，代码已开源。

title: Forward-Facing Near-Infrared Adds Little to Colour for Farm-Machinery Traversability: A Site-Disjoint Evaluation of Sensor-Dependent Spatial Leakage
summary: Near-infrared (NIR) imaging does not consistently outperform standard color cameras for daytime agricultural traversability once spatial data leakage is eliminated. Prior benchmarks suggesting an NIR advantage used sequence-level splits that permitted spatially autocorrelated imagery into test sets, artificially inflating NIR performance, especially on difficult paddy-boundary segmentation. When evaluated across strictly held-out recording sites using the AI Hub autonomous driving corpus, none of the four tested configurations (color, NIR, a luminance control, or their fusion) reliably surpasses standard color across any of the five traversability classes. Furthermore, apparent performance gains observed at a single held-out site completely fail to replicate when the held-out site is rotated, demonstrating that the observed benefits were site-specific artifacts rather than generalizable improvements. Correcting for spatial leakage erases the apparent lead of NIR entirely rather than uniformly degrading performance across all sensor types. Consequently, adding a forward-facing NIR camera to a daylight agricultural vehicle sensor suite remains unproven, and evaluations compromised by location leakage risk distorting sensor rankings and misleading procurement decisions.

AI.tldr: 消除空间数据泄漏后，近红外（NIR）成像在白昼农业可通行性任务中并不优于标准彩色相机；此前报告的NIR优势源于序列级划分导致的空间自相关泄漏，属站点特异性伪影。
AI.motivation: 既有基准显示NIR在农业可通行性分割上优于彩色相机，但其采用序列级数据划分，使空间自相关的影像进入测试集，人为抬高NIR表现（尤其在困难的田埂边界分割上）。本文旨在检验这一优势是否为数据泄漏造成的假象，并为传感器选型提供可靠依据。
AI.method: 基于AI Hub自动驾驶语料，采用严格留出的录制站点（site-level split）进行评估，对比四种配置：彩色、NIR、亮度对照（luminance control）及其融合，并覆盖五类可通行性类别；同时通过轮换留出站点检验性能增益的可复现性。
AI.result: 在任一可通行性类别上，四种配置均未稳定超越标准彩色相机；在单一留出站点上观察到的性能增益，在轮换留出站点后完全无法复现。校正空间泄漏后，NIR的表观领先被彻底消除，而非对所有传感器类型造成一致性的性能下降。
AI.conclusion: 为白昼农业车辆传感器套件加装前向NIR相机仍缺乏证据支持；受位置泄漏影响的评估会扭曲传感器排序，误导采购决策。研究强调需采用站点级严格划分的评估协议。

title: On the Recall Scaling Laws in Mamba: A Theoretical and Mechanistic Study via Hashing
comment: 53 pages, 20 figures. Code and experiments available at: https://github.com/yuvalko1/mamba-recall-scaling-laws
summary: Associative Recall (AR) is the cognitive ability to learn and retrieve links between items in memory. In NLP, AR is used as a benchmark for evaluating the in-context memory capacity of architectures such as Mamba, and has been found to strongly correlate with language modeling performance. This paper explores AR from the perspective of mechanistic interpretability, aiming to reverse-engineer the exact internal algorithm used by Mamba to perform recall. Our key insight is that Mamba performs recall by implicitly learning linear hash functions, and we identify the low-level circuit that enables this behavior. Building on these findings and inspired by theoretical tools in similarity-preserving hashing, such as the Johnson-Lindenstrauss lemma, we develop a theoretical framework for analyzing AR, which we term Recall Scaling Laws. Given the vocabulary size and the number of facts in context, this framework allows us to (1) predict the embedding and state dimensions required for Mamba to achieve perfect recall, (2) predict recall success probability given the model dimensions, and (3) analyze multi-layer models and multi-head SSM patterns. Empirical results show that our theoretical findings are accurate and predictive, offering insights into how AR capacity scales with vocabulary, state, embedding size, and architecture.

AI.tldr: 本文从机制可解释性角度逆向分析Mamba的联想回忆（AR）算法，发现其通过隐式学习线性哈希函数实现回忆，并提出"回忆缩放定律"理论框架，可预测完美回忆所需维度与成功概率。
AI.motivation: AR是评估Mamba等架构上下文记忆能力的基准，且与语言建模性能高度相关，但Mamba内部执行回忆的具体算法尚未被逆向解析，缺乏可预测AR容量的理论工具。
AI.method: 从机制可解释性出发逆向工程Mamba的AR内部算法；结合相似性保持哈希理论工具（如Johnson-Lindenstrauss引理），构建"回忆缩放定律"（Recall Scaling Laws）理论框架，分析嵌入维度、状态维度与回忆成功率及多层/多头SSM模式。
AI.result: 关键发现是Mamba通过隐式学习线性哈希函数完成回忆，并定位了支撑该行为的底层电路；理论框架能准确预测完美回忆所需的嵌入与状态维度、给定维度下的回忆成功概率，且经验结果与理论预测吻合。
AI.conclusion: AR容量随词汇量、状态、嵌入尺寸与架构呈可预测的缩放规律，为理解Mamba的上下文记忆机制及其容量边界提供了理论依据。

title: CrowdTraj: A Benchmark for Dense Crowd Trajectory Prediction in Realistic Crowded Environments
summary: In real-world applications, pedestrian trajectory prediction models rely on inputs from detection and tracking systems. Prior trajectory prediction benchmarks either contain relatively sparse pedestrian interactions, assume perfect tracking inputs, or rely on overhead viewpoints that minimize occlusion and perspective distortion, limiting evaluation in realistic dense-crowd scenarios. We present CrowdTraj, a benchmark for pedestrian trajectory prediction in natural dense crowd scenes. Unlike previous datasets, CrowdTraj supports end-to-end evaluation from detection through tracking to trajectory prediction under severe occlusion in CCTV views. It also captures diverse, natural pedestrian behaviours, including abrupt directional changes rarely observed in existing benchmarks. CrowdTraj includes five diverse scenes, with an average of 1,146 unique pedestrians per scene, maximum frame-level densities ranging from 114 to 372 pedestrians, and over 3.2 million annotated head bounding boxes. CrowdTraj provides pixel and real-world coordinates via per-scene homography matrices for physically meaningful analysis. Our experimental results show that tracking accuracy (IDF1) drops to 0.68 to 0.70 in the densest scenes, compared with approximately 0.90 in less crowded scenes. Trajectory prediction training also becomes substantially more computationally expensive in dense scenes, with training times increasing by up to 8 times. These findings show that CrowdTraj exposes limitations in current trajectory prediction pipelines that remain hidden on existing sparse-crowd benchmarks, particularly in robustness to tracking noise and computational scalability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CrowdTraj——一个面向自然密集人群场景的行人轨迹预测基准，支持在CCTV视角与严重遮挡下从检测、跟踪到轨迹预测的端到端评测，包含5个场景、平均每场景1,146个行人、最大帧级密度114–372人、超320万头部边界框标注，并提供单应矩阵以获取像素与世界坐标。
AI.motivation: 现有行人轨迹预测基准存在三方面局限：行人交互较稀疏、假设跟踪输入完美、或采用俯视视角以规避遮挡与透视畸变，导致无法在真实密集人群场景中评估模型。为暴露当前轨迹预测流水线在跟踪噪声鲁棒性与计算可扩展性上的隐藏缺陷，作者构建了更贴近现实部署条件的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建CrowdTraj基准数据集：采集5个多样化CCTV场景的自然密集人群视频；提供超过320万个头部边界框标注（以头部为标注目标以缓解遮挡下的标注歧义）；通过每场景单应矩阵提供像素坐标与真实世界坐标；设计支持从检测→跟踪→轨迹预测的端到端评测协议，覆盖严重遮挡的密集场景。
AI.result: 在最密集场景中，跟踪精度IDF1下降至0.68–0.70，而较稀疏场景约为0.90；密集场景下轨迹预测训练的计算开销显著增加，训练时间最高可达原来的8倍；同时数据包含现有基准中罕见的突然方向变化等自然多样行为。
AI.conclusion: CrowdTraj揭示了当前轨迹预测流水线在既有稀疏人群基准上被掩盖的局限性，主要体现为对跟踪噪声的鲁棒性不足以及计算可扩展性问题；该基准为面向真实密集人群部署的端到端行人轨迹预测研究提供了更具挑战性的评测平台。

title: Perspectives on Cross-Lingual Consistency in LLMs for Medical Questions
summary: Should multilingual LLMs answer medical questions consistently across input languages, or adapt responses to cultural cues? Existing multilingual medical benchmarks usually assume that medically correct answers should remain consistent across languages and treat cross-lingual variation as model error. In contrast, cultural adaptation research argues that appropriate medical answers may legitimately differ across contexts. We review the multilingual medical NLP literature through these two perspectives, we identify three gaps: limited stakeholder perspectives (e.g., of medical professionals), a lack of empirical evidence on which approach better serves users, and no benchmarks capable of distinguishing universally correct from culture-specific cases. To address the first gap, we survey 356 participants across three stakeholder groups (medical, NLP, and anthropology professionals) in three countries (Germany, Spain, and the United States). Anthropologists consistently favor adaptation, while medical and NLP respondents remain divided, with notable divergence between U.S. and European medical professionals. LLMs prompted with profession and country personas fail to reproduce this variation, overestimating cross-lingual consistency preference among NLP and medical personas. We conclude that neither consistency nor adaptation can currently be considered clearly preferable, highlighting the need for empirical evidence on which approach better serves users across cultural contexts.

AI.tldr: 该论文审视多语言医学NLP中"跨语言一致性"与"文化适应"两种立场，识别三个研究缺口，并通过三国356名利益相关者的调查与LLM角色提示实验加以探索。
AI.motivation: 现有多语言医学基准多默认医学正确答案应跨语言一致，将跨语言差异视为模型错误；而文化适应研究认为合适的医学回答可依语境而不同。文中指出缺乏利益相关者视角、缺乏哪种方式更有利于用户的实证证据、也缺乏能区分普适正确与文化特定案例的基准。
AI.method: 通过两种视角回顾多语言医学NLP文献，梳理三个缺口；针对第一缺口，在德国、西班牙、美国三国调查356名参与者，涵盖医学、NLP、人类学三组专业群体；并让LLM携带职业与国家角色提示，检验其能否复现人群间的偏好差异。
AI.result: 人类学家一致倾向文化适应；医学与NLP受访者态度分歧，美国与欧洲医学专业人员间差异显著。LLM角色提示未能复现上述人群差异，对NLP与医学角色高估了其跨语言一致性偏好。
AI.conclusion: 目前无法认定一致性或文化适应中哪种明显更优，需进一步的实证研究来判定在跨文化语境中哪种方式更能服务用户。

title: Fine PT-PT Web: A High-Quality 41 Billion Tokens Data Collection of the European Portuguese Web
summary: Curating Web corpora for regional language variants like European Portuguese (PT-PT) is heavily bottlenecked by dialectal overlap (mainly with PT-BR) and data processing scale. This paper presents an efficient pipeline to curate a production-ready PT-PT corpus from the Portuguese Web, spanning 411 TB of raw data from Arquivo.pt. We introduce a novel post-scraping block that removes boilerplate and line duplicates prior to filtering. This early-stage intervention increases final document yield by 19.04% by rescuing valid text that standard heuristic filters prematurely discard. Integrated with rigorous language identification, weighted fuzzy deduplication, and neural quality classification, our pipeline offers a scalable framework and a clean, representative corpus optimized for LLM pre-training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套高效流水线，从葡萄牙网页411 TB原始数据中筛选出可用于大模型预训练的欧洲葡萄牙语（PT-PT）语料，通过新增爬取后去模板与行去重模块，使最终文档产出率提升19.04%。
AI.motivation: 区域性语言变体（如PT-PT）的网页语料构建受制于方言重叠（主要与巴西葡萄牙语PT-BR混淆）和数据规模瓶颈，亟需可扩展且高质量的筛选流程。
AI.method: 流水线基于Arquivo.pt的411 TB原始数据，包含：爬取后早期干预模块（去除模板文本与行级重复）；严格的语言识别；加权模糊去重；神经网络质量分类。
AI.result: 早期去模板与行去重使最终文档产出率提升19.04%，挽救了被标准启发式过滤器过早丢弃的有效文本。
AI.conclusion: 该流水线提供了可扩展的框架和干净、具代表性的PT-PT语料，适用于LLM预训练。

title: DeepTable: Structural Attention Biases and Tree Path Encoding for Hierarchical Table Understanding
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance in table understanding. However, they typically process table content and headers as linearized token sequences. This representation weakens the two-dimensional and hierarchical structural relationships encoded by multi-level row and column headers. Existing parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods incorporate basic row and column information but do not explicitly capture the rich structural dependencies induced by hierarchical table headers. We propose DeepTable, a structure-aware approach for table understanding with LLMs. DeepTable comprises two complementary components. Structural Attention Bias (SAB) introduces learnable biases into the attention logits to explicitly represent whether pairs of table tokens share the same row or column. Tree Path Encoding (TPE) represents each table token using the ancestor paths of its row and column headers, preserving its position within the multi-level table structure. We integrate DeepTable with TableLoRA (He et al., 2025) to inject structural information into parameter-efficient adaptation. Across three LLM backbones, DeepTable consistently improves the corresponding TableLoRA baselines on three table question answering benchmarks, achieving average gains of 7.42 points on HiTab, 3.23 points on WikiTQ, and 2.01 BLEU points on FeTaQA. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed structural biases across different LLM backbones.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DeepTable，通过结构注意力偏置（SAB）和树路径编码（TPE）显式建模多级表头的行列层次结构，并与TableLoRA结合，在三个表格问答基准上取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM处理表格时将内容和表头线性化为token序列，削弱了多级行列表头所编码的二维与层次结构关系；现有参数高效微调方法虽引入基础行列信息，但未显式捕获由层次化表头诱发的丰富结构依赖。
AI.method: DeepTable包含两个互补组件：结构注意力偏置（SAB）在注意力logits中引入可学习偏置，显式表示表格token对是否共享同一行或列；树路径编码（TPE）利用行列表头的祖先路径表示每个表格token，保留其在多级表格结构中的位置。二者集成到TableLoRA中以注入结构信息。
AI.result: 在三个LLM骨干和三个表格问答基准上，DeepTable一致优于对应的TableLoRA基线：HiTab平均提升7.42分，WikiTQ提升3.23分，FeTaQA提升2.01 BLEU。
AI.conclusion: 结果验证了所提出的结构偏置在不同LLM骨干上的有效性，表明显式建模层次化表格结构有助于提升表格理解性能。

title: The Emerging AI Paper-Review Arms Race: Adversarial Co-Evolution in Scholarly Publishing
summary: Generative and agentic AI are reshaping both the production and evaluation of scientific research. These developments are often studied separately, as questions of how AI can produce research and how AI can review it. We argue that this separation misses an increasingly important feature of scholarly publishing: changes on one side alter the incentives, constraints, and behavior of the other. We synthesize 230 scholarly publications and institutional records using a taxonomy of six connected dynamics: production scaling, evaluation automation, evaluation manipulation, defense mechanisms and policy responses, evasion and side effects, and long-horizon ecosystem feedback. The literature shows an emerging progression in which cheaper and faster research production increases pressure on evaluation, AI-mediated evaluation becomes more scalable and repeatable, participants can exploit evaluator regularities, and institutions respond with technical safeguards and policy controls. These responses can in turn induce evasion, redistribute errors and workload, and shape the scholarly records reused by future research and evaluation systems. Evidence is strongest for production and evaluation at scale, reproducible manipulation, and institutional response, while post-policy adaptation and artifact-level long-horizon feedback remain less directly observed. This systems view shifts attention from isolated AI capabilities toward how scholarly actors and AI systems adapt to one another over time.

AI.tldr: 该文主张将"AI生成研究"与"AI评审研究"视为耦合系统，综合230项文献与机构记录，提出六类相互关联的动态机制，描述生产—评价—规避—治理—反馈的演化链条。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多把"AI如何生产研究"与"AI如何评审研究"分开讨论，忽视了学术出版中一个关键特征：一侧的变化会改变另一侧的激励、约束与行为。作者希望纠正这一割裂视角。
AI.method: 文献综述与理论综合。系统梳理230项学术出版物与机构记录，构建包含六类动态的分类框架：生产规模化、评价自动化、评价操纵、防御机制与政策响应、规避与副作用、长周期生态反馈。
AI.result: 文献呈现出一条演化路径：研究生产更廉价快速→评价压力上升→AI化评价更可扩展且可重复→参与者利用评审规律性进行操纵→机构以技术防护与政策管控回应→引发规避、错误与工作量的再分配，并影响被后续研究复用的学术记录。证据最强的是规模化生产与评价、可复现的操纵、机构响应；政策后适应与制品层面的长周期反馈则缺乏直接观察。
AI.conclusion: 应将该问题理解为"学术行动者与AI系统长期相互适应"的系统性问题，而非孤立的AI能力清单；研究重心需从能力本身转向共演化机制，并补足长周期反馈的实证证据。

title: Translation Indeterminacy and the Distributional Fallacy
comment: Accepted for publication in Philosophy of Translation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are commonly associated with the distributional hypothesis, according to which (1) semantic meaning is grounded in distributional patterns of linguistic context, and (2) knowledge of cross-linguistic distributional correspondences allows for successful translation. This paper rejects the first claim as a causal inversion: linguistic distributions reflect patterns arising from meaning-making practices rather than constituting their source. At the same time, it accepts the second claim, arguing that translation -human or machine - can succeed without requiring access to meaning or reference. Knowledge of interlingual distributional correspondence and their inferential organization may be sufficient for translation. The paper develops an ecological-enactivist perspective, according to which reference and meaning are grounded in agent-environment interaction and stabilized through action-grounded concepts, forms of world-involving cognition that current LLMs do not possess.

AI.tldr: 本文区分并分别评价了分布假说的两个主张：拒绝"语义源于分布"这一因果倒置，接受"跨语言分布对应知识足以支撑翻译"，并从生态-生成主义视角论证翻译无需通达意义或指称。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型常被与分布假说绑定，该假说包含两个可分离的主张：语义植根于语境分布模式；跨语言分布对应知识足以实现翻译。作者认为二者不可混为一谈，需分别批判与接受，以厘清LLM的能力边界与意义、指称的真正来源。
AI.method: 概念分析与哲学论证。首先指出第一个主张属于因果倒置：语言分布是意义建构实践的产物而非其来源；其次论证翻译（无论人工还是机器）可以无需通达意义或指称，仅凭语际分布对应及其推论组织即可成功；最后引入生态-生成主义（ecological-enactivist）框架，将指称与意义定位于智能体-环境交互，并通过行动奠基的概念加以稳定化。
AI.result: 分布假说的两个主张被成功解耦：其关于翻译的论断成立，而其关于语义来源的论断被驳倒。据此，LLM可凭借分布对应完成翻译，却因缺乏行动奠基的概念而不具备世界卷入式认知，故不拥有指称与意义。
AI.conclusion: LLM的翻译能力与意义理解能力可以分离：分布知识足以支持翻译，但不构成语义基础。指称和意义源于智能体与环境的交互及行动奠基概念，这是当前LLM所不具备的，因而不能将其分布能力等同于语义理解。

title: Spatial Feature-wise Linear Modulation (SpFiLM) for Contrast Agent-Aware Brain Parcellation
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at MLCN 2026 (MICCAI workshop)
