summary: Most automated brain parcellation tools are developed and validated on T1-weighted (T1w) MRI. Yet, some clinical workflows for which parcellation is relevant only use contrast-enhanced T1w (T1ce) MRI, on which T1w-trained models are less accurate. We present a unified network that parcellates both pre- and post-contrast agent T1w MRI reliably, trained on a combination of the two with conditioning that spatially modulates its response differently for each. Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM) is a known approach for input-based modulation in networks. It applies a per-channel scale and shift uniformly across the input. However, the appearance change between pre- and post-contrast varies locally across the brain, making FiLM suboptimal for our use case. In this work, we introduce Spatial FiLM (SpFiLM), a conditioning layer whose modulation varies spatially, assembling a voxel-wise scale and shift from image-derived spatial patterns. Using a cohort of 134 patients with paired T1w and T1ce MRI parcellated into 106 classes, the addition of SpFiLM layers in a UNet increased the mean Dice on the test set of 25 patients from 80.2% to 84.1%, a 4.9% relative improvement. Adding SpFiLM layers led to the best performance on both pre- and post-contrast MRI, even when controlling for network parameter counts.

AI.tldr: 论文提出空间条件调制层 SpFiLM，用于统一网络对增强前后 T1w MRI 的脑分区，Dice 从 80.2% 提升至 84.1%。
AI.motivation: 多数自动脑分区工具基于 T1w MRI 开发验证，但部分临床流程仅使用 T1ce MRI，T1w 训练模型在 T1ce 上精度下降。因此需要一个能同时可靠处理增强前后 T1w 图像的统一模型。
AI.method: 提出 SpFiLM 条件化层，其调制随空间变化，由图像导出的空间模式构建体素级 scale 与 shift，替代 FiLM 的全局逐通道均匀调制；将其加入 UNet，并在增强前后 T1w 配对数据联合训练。数据为 134 例配对 T1w/T1ce MRI，分区为 106 类。
AI.result: 在 25 例测试集上，加入 SpFiLM 后平均 Dice 从 80.2% 提升到 84.1%，相对提升 4.9%；在增强前与增强后 MRI 上均取得最佳表现，且控制网络参数量后仍成立。
AI.conclusion: 空间变化的调制比 FiLM 更适合增强前后局部外观变化差异明显的场景，SpFiLM 使统一网络在增强前后 T1w MRI 上均实现更可靠的脑分区。

title: Better Call CineCrew: Consistent Ultra-Long Narrative-to-Film Generation
comment: Accepted by ECCV 2026 Project page: https://jiabenchen.github.io/cinecrew/
summary: Long-form narrative-to-film generation requires shot-level controllability and cross-clip consistency in both visual identity and character behavior-requirements that remain difficult to satisfy with current prompt-based workflows. A core reason existing workflows remain brittle is the lack of a structured intermediate layer between scripts and video models, especially when screenplays are underspecified at key cinematic decision points. We introduce a structured orchestration layer for film-oriented script-to-video generation, implemented as a multi-agent framework that operates between scripts and off-the-shelf video generators. The layer is centered on FilmDSL, a film-oriented domain-specific language that makes cinematic constraints explicit, including shot and camera directives, asset and continuity requirements, and persona cues, so that agents coordinate through a shared structured specification for planning, generation, critique, and repair. Specifically, a generation agent constructs asset packs and storyboard keyframes that anchor composition before clip-by-clip synthesis, while a critic agent produces structured QA signals and triggers targeted refinement without retraining the base model. Experiments on TV-style segments show improved controllability and consistency over text-only and reference-only baselines.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出面向影视剧本到视频生成的结构化编排层，以多智能体框架和影视领域特定语言FilmDSL为核心，在脚本与现成视频生成模型之间显式化电影约束，从而提升镜头级可控性与跨片段一致性。
AI.motivation: 长篇幅叙事到影视的生成需要镜头级可控性，以及跨片段的视觉身份与角色行为一致性，而现有基于提示词的工作流难以满足。其根本原因在于脚本与视频模型之间缺乏结构化中间层，尤其当剧本在关键电影化决策点上描述不足时，现有工作流表现脆弱。
AI.method: 提出一个面向影视的脚本到视频生成的结构化编排层，实现为介于脚本与现成视频生成器之间的多智能体框架。核心是FilmDSL这一影视领域特定语言，显式表达电影约束，包括镜头与机位指令、资产与连续性需求、角色人设线索，使智能体通过共享的结构化规范进行规划、生成、评审与修复。其中生成智能体先构建资产包与故事板关键帧以锚定构图，再进行逐片段合成；评审智能体产出结构化质量信号并触发针对性优化，且无需重训练基础模型。
AI.result: 在电视剧风格片段上的实验表明，相比仅文本和仅参考的基线方法，该方法在可控性与一致性上均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入FilmDSL结构化中间层与多智能体协作的编排机制，可在不微调基础视频模型的前提下，有效增强影视化长叙事生成的镜头级控制与跨片段一致性。

title: Zero-Shot 3D Plant Organ Segmentation with SAM3 and Semantic NeRFs
comment: Submitted to CVPPA Workshop at ECCV 2026
summary: Accurate 3D plant organ segmentation is fundamental to automated phenotyping. Existing approaches rely on annotated training data or species-specific model configurations. We present an annotation-free pipeline for 3D plant organ segmentation, combining text-prompted SAM3 segmentation with semantic neural radiance fields (NeRFs). Given only multi-view RGB images and a list of class names, our zero-shot pipeline produces semantically labeled 3D point clouds without manual annotation, per-species fine-tuning, or domain-specific preprocessing. Multi-view NeRF fusion acts as effective implicit consensus mechanism that lifts imperfect per-frame masks into accurate 3D labels. On a controlled Begonia maculata testbed the SAM3 pipeline achieves 92.6% mIoU, reaching 95.9% of the oracle upper bound established with perfect ground-truth masks. The pipeline was further evaluated on a new dataset spanning ten diverse plant point clouds reaching an average 0.856 mIoU, with leaf and pot IoU above 0.91 and 0.90 for every species, respectively. These results demonstrate that annotation-free 3D plant organ segmentation is now feasible and approaching the range of supervised methods.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需标注的3D植物器官分割流程，结合文本提示SAM3与语义NeRF，仅用多视图RGB图像和类别名即可生成语义标注点云，在秋海棠测试台达92.6% mIoU，跨10种植物平均0.856 mIoU。
AI.motivation: 准确的3D植物器官分割是自动表型分析的基础，但现有方法依赖标注训练数据或物种特定模型配置，泛化性差且成本高。作者希望实现无需人工标注、无需逐物种微调、无需领域特定预处理的零样本分割。
AI.method: 提出无标注流程：将文本提示驱动的SAM3分割与语义神经辐射场（NeRF）结合。输入仅为多视图RGB图像和类别名列表，通过多视图NeRF融合作为隐式一致性机制，将不完美的逐帧掩码提升为准确的3D标签。
AI.result: 在受控的秋海棠（Begonia maculata）测试台上，SAM3流程达到92.6% mIoU，相当于以完美真值掩码建立的oracle上限的95.9%。在覆盖10种不同植物点云的新数据集上平均达0.856 mIoU，各物种叶片IoU均高于0.91，花盆IoU均高于0.90。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，无需标注的3D植物器官分割现已可行，且性能接近有监督方法的水平。

title: TV-SGS: Gaussian Splatting with Geometric Information Propagation via Tensor Voting under sparse views
summary: Gaussian Splatting has been effective in inferring scene representations that excel in novel view synthesis. Multiple splats cooperate seamlessly to synthesize the pixels of novel views and are jointly optimized even though they only affect each other indirectly, via pixels they project to in common. We present an approach that enables direct communication among splats to enhance the geometric structures they form in 3D. This is accomplished by Tensor Voting, which was originally designed to infer structures from noisy inputs and has been adapted here to provide supervision during test-time optimization, leading to more accurate scene geometry. We introduce a new class of 3D losses that do not rely on rendering and can be combined with essentially all losses previously reported in the literature. Our 3D losses are especially effective when the input views are sparse and geometric regularization is essential due to limited supervision from the images. Our method is easy to integrate with a diverse set of backbones, and our experiments on the DTU and Tanks-and-Temples datasets demonstrate that TV-SGS improves the geometry of the outputs compared to the backbone, while maintaining or improving rendering quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TV-SGS，利用张量投票（Tensor Voting）在测试时优化中对3D高斯泼溅（Gaussian Splatting）的图元施加直接通信与监督，引入不依赖渲染的新型3D损失，在稀疏视图下显著提升场景几何精度。
AI.motivation: 高斯泼溅在新视角合成中表现优异，但多个splat仅通过共同投影到的像素间接相互影响，缺乏直接通信，导致其形成的3D几何结构不够准确；尤其在输入视图稀疏、图像监督有限时，几何正则化尤为关键。
AI.method: 将原本用于从噪声输入中推断结构的张量投票机制适配为测试时优化中的监督信号，使splat之间能够直接通信以增强3D几何结构；提出一类不依赖渲染的新3D损失，可与现有文献中的几乎各类损失组合使用，并可方便集成到多种骨干网络中。
AI.result: 在DTU和Tanks-and-Temples数据集上的实验表明，TV-SGS相比骨干方法改善了输出几何质量，同时保持或提升了渲染质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过张量投票实现splat间的直接通信与非渲染3D损失，可有效增强高斯泼溅的场景几何，尤其适用于稀疏视图场景，且具备良好的兼容性与可扩展性。

title: The Hidden Frame: How Large Language Models Impact Democratic Society
summary: Large language models are rapidly becoming an interface between citizens and political information. They are often regarded as "a better Google." While this analogy might work for some instances, it is unintuitively problematic for democratic politics. A search engine retrieves human-authored documents, while a language model generates novel text that necessarily embeds invisible framing decisions. Because conveying knowledge involves framing, a system that generates answers cannot serve as a neutral conduit to "all human knowledge." Instead, these systems are becoming a new kind of political intermediary. Mechanistic evidence shows that partisan identity is encoded as a locatable geometric direction inside the Llama 3.1 8B model, and that alignment training masks rather than removes this structure. Building on that evidence, we use the model's training cutoff in 2023 to make those frames visible. This cutpoint auspiciously falls just before a dramatic realignment in American politics marked by the second Trump administration and the MAHA transformation of health politics, providing us with a natural experiment. We find that the model presents temporally contingent partisan alignments as {\em knowledge}, with no reliable mechanism for distinguishing fact from opinion. Because citizens judge political claims by who made them and when, an answer that carries neither cue hampers the judgment on which self-governance depends. Large language models purporting to summarize "all human knowledge" are, in actuality, simply magnifying the cultural and partisan divides inherent in their training data.

AI.tldr: 大语言模型并非"更好的搜索引擎",而是生成嵌入隐性框架内容的新型政治中介;以Llama 3.1 8B为对象,通过对齐训练前后的机制证据与2023年训练截止点作为自然实验,发现模型将时间上相对化的党派立场呈现为"知识",且缺乏区分事实与意见的可靠机制。
AI.motivation: 公民日益通过大语言模型获取政治信息,而"更好的Google"这一类比掩盖了检索与生成之间的本质差异:搜索引擎返回人类撰写的文档,语言模型则生成嵌入了不可见框架决策的新文本。由于知识传递本身必然涉及框架,生成式系统无法充当通向"全人类知识"的中立管道。作者据此认为需要揭示模型内部的政治结构,并检验其如何在没有来源与时间线索的情况下影响公民的政治判断。
AI.method: 采用机制可解释性方法,证明党派身份在Llama 3.1 8B内部被编码为可定位的几何方向,且对齐训练只是掩盖而非移除该结构。利用模型2023年训练截止点构建自然实验:该节点恰好落于美国政治剧烈重组(第二届特朗普政府与健康政治MAHA转向)之前,从而使训练时点前后的框架差异得以显影。
AI.result: 模型将时间上具有条件性的党派立场呈现为"知识",且不存在可靠机制区分事实与意见;由于公民依据"谁提出、何时提出"来判断政治主张,而模型的回答既不携带来源线索也不携带时间线索,从而削弱了自治所依赖的政治判断能力。
AI.conclusion: 声称总结"全人类知识"的大语言模型,实际上只是放大了其训练数据中固有的文化与党派分歧,而非提供中立的知识通道。

title: TFTrack: A Template-Free Framework for Efficient 3D Point Cloud Tracking
summary: LiDAR-based 3D Single Object Tracking (3D SOT) is critical for robotic perception and navigation and aims to localize dynamic objects across frames in sparse point clouds. Existing methods, rooted in the Siamese tracking paradigm from 2D vision, rely on costly dual-input designs and excessive motion modeling guided by template priors, hindering their efficiency. Our in-depth analysis reveals: (i) the template paradigm is redundant, as the previous bounding box center encodes sufficient historical context; (ii) complex motion modeling is unnecessary, as geometric alignment provides adequate motion priors. Based on the above findings, we propose the first Template-Free Tracking framework (TFTrack). The novel framework eliminates the need for template-search pairings and operates directly on the current frame guided solely by the prior bounding box center and size. We instantiate this paradigm into three variants: TFTrack-Voxel, TFTrack-Pillar, and TFTrack-Point, to explore different 3D representations under a unified framework, ensuring flexibility across sparse and dense scenes. Extensive experiments on KITTI and nuScenes benchmarks show that TFTrack is competitive with leading template-based trackers, while reducing FLOPs by approximately 50% and running at approximately 120 FPS. By simplifying overcomplicated motion-centric designs, TFTrack establishes a new minimalist paradigm for efficient 3D point cloud tracking, paving the way for real-time and resource-efficient deployment in embedded robotic systems, such as autonomous vehicles. The code is available at https://github.com/tftrack-anonymous/TFTrack/tree/main.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出首个无模板3D单目标跟踪框架TFTrack，摒弃模板-搜索配对与复杂运动建模，仅凭上一帧边界框中心与尺寸引导，在KITTI和nuScenes上性能媲美主流模板法，FLOPs减少约50%，速度约120 FPS。
AI.motivation: 现有3D SOT方法沿用2D视觉的Siamese范式，依赖昂贵的双输入设计，并借助模板先验进行过度运动建模，导致效率低下。作者通过深入分析发现：(i) 模板范式冗余，前一帧边界框中心已编码足够的历史上下文；(ii) 复杂运动建模并非必要，几何对齐即可提供充分的运动先验。
AI.method: 提出首个无模板跟踪框架TFTrack，无需模板-搜索配对，仅由先验边界框中心与尺寸引导直接在当前帧上操作。统一框架下实例化为三种变体：TFTrack-Voxel、TFTrack-Pillar、TFTrack-Point，以探索不同3D表示在稀疏与稠密场景中的适应性。
AI.result: 在KITTI与nuScenes基准上的大量实验表明，TFTrack与领先的模板类跟踪器性能相当，同时FLOPs降低约50%，运行速度约120 FPS。
AI.conclusion: 通过简化过于复杂的以运动为中心的设计，TFTrack为高效3D点云跟踪建立了新的极简化范式，为自动驾驶等嵌入式机器人系统的实时、资源高效部署铺平了道路。

title: LLM Forensics: Where Do Backdoors Hide? Localizing and Controlling Trigger Mechanisms with Sparse Autoencoders
summary: Even though backdoors in LLMs have been a growing concern, their inner workings are still under heavy scrutiny. Trigger-based backdoors are easy to define behaviorally, a rare input that makes the model switch to a chosen response pattern, but the mechanism between triggers and their responses is less clear. We study this mechanism in a controlled, harmless language-switching setting, where fixed trigger sequences make 1B and 8B language models continue English prompts in French or German. For this, we train sparse autoencoders (SAEs) across layers and transformer components, then compare triggered prompts with translation and pretraining controls to identify trigger-relevant feature directions. We show how SAE features separate triggered prompts from controls with near-perfect F1, but features that detect the trigger do not necessarily control the behavior. In intervention tests, attention and MLP features often fire reliably on triggered prompts, making them good detectors, but ablating them rarely suppresses the language switch and activating them rarely induces it. In contrast, residual-stream features can suppress triggered generation when ablated, and some selected features can induce target-language continuations without the trigger. In short, these token-trigger mechanisms decompose into distinct SAE feature directions, with separate features for trigger detection, residual-stream propagation, and later language tracking. This role-level decomposition is the part most likely to transfer to other trigger-based backdoors, even when the payload, layers, or circuit locations differ.

AI.tldr: 该论文在可控的语言切换设定下研究LLM触发器后门的内部机制，用稀疏自编码器（SAE）分解出触发检测、残差流传播与后续语言跟踪等不同角色特征。
AI.motivation: 触发器后门行为上易定义（罕见输入使模型切换到特定响应模式），但触发器与响应之间的内部机制尚不清楚，现有研究对其内部运作的审视仍不充分。
AI.method: 在无害的语言切换设定下，用固定触发序列使1B与8B模型将英语提示续写为法语或德语；跨层及Transformer各组件训练SAE，并将触发提示与翻译、预训练对照进行比较以识别触发相关特征方向；进一步做干预实验（消融与激活）区分检测性特征与控制性特征。
AI.result: SAE特征能以近乎完美的F1将触发提示与对照区分开，但能检测触发器的特征未必控制行为。注意力与MLP特征常能可靠地在触发提示上激活，是好的检测器，但消融它们很少抑制语言切换、激活它们也很少诱发切换；相比之下，残差流特征被消融时可抑制触发式生成，部分选定特征无需触发器即可诱发目标语言续写。
AI.conclusion: 令牌触发机制可分解为不同的SAE特征方向，分别负责触发检测、残差流传播与后续语言跟踪；这种角色层面的分解最有可能迁移到其他触发器后门，即使载荷、层数或电路位置不同。

title: Structure-Token Evidence-Anchored Reasoning for Scientific Chart Understanding
summary: Scientific charts encode quantities in axes, legends, and geometric marks, yet large vision-language models still treat them as natural photographs. Visual in-context examples do not expose the coordinate frame; unconstrained chain-of-thought can name a plausible number that was never read from a bar. We present STEER (Structure-Token Evidence-anchored Reasoning), which freezes a Llama-3.2-Vision encoder and inserts three modules: a chart structure graph encoder (CSGE) that binds ticks, legend items, and marks; evidence-anchored step reasoning (EASR) that forces every arithmetic step to cite a graph node; and weak-parser strong-reasoner alignment (WPSR) that uses a specialized table extractor only as a teacher of node attributes. On ChartQA, STEER reaches 82.70 average relaxed accuracy versus 80.16 for ChartGemma and 76.40 for a LLaVA-CoT backbone trained on the same mix. Gains widen on CharXiv reasoning (33.60 vs. 29.20 InternVL Chat V1.5) and ChartQAPro CoT (40.70 vs. 37.17 Qwen2-VL-7B), where OCR shortcuts disappear. Ablations show that dropping node serialization or numeric candidate constraints undoes most of the reasoning lift.

AI.tldr: 提出STEER框架，通过图表结构图编码、证据锚定步骤推理与弱解析器强推理器对齐三模块，使冻结的Llama-3.2-Vision在ChartQA、CharXiv与ChartQAPro上超越多个专用图表模型与通用VLM。
AI.motivation: 现有大型视觉语言模型仍将科学图表当作自然照片处理，视觉上下文示例无法显式暴露坐标框架，无约束的思维链可能凭空生成看似合理但并未从图中读取的数值，导致推理缺乏可验证的依据。
AI.method: STEER冻结Llama-3.2-Vision编码器，插入三个模块：图表结构图编码器（CSGE）绑定刻度、图例项与几何标记；证据锚定步骤推理（EASR）强制每一步算术引用一个图节点；弱解析器强推理器对齐（WPSR）将专用表格抽取器仅作为节点属性的教师模型。
AI.result: ChartQA上STEER取得82.70平均松弛准确率，高于ChartGemma的80.16与同数据混合训练的LLaVA-CoT骨干的76.40；CharXiv推理上33.60优于InternVL Chat V1.5的29.20；ChartQAPro CoT上40.70优于Qwen2-VL-7B的37.17。消融实验显示，去除节点序列化或数值候选约束会抵消大部分推理增益。
AI.conclusion: STEER表明，将图表结构显式编码为图节点并以证据锚定约束推理步骤，可有效抑制OCR捷径与臆造数值，在图表问答与推理基准上稳定超越专用图表模型和通用VLM，且节点序列化与数值候选约束是性能提升的关键。

title: Replicating a Disjoint-Set Union Experiment over Various Notions of Micro Units to assess Translation Effort
summary: The paper describes a replication experiment to assess "the distribution of editing procedures across micro and macro units as an indicator of the strain of text production". We investigate various pause thresholds to isolate Micro and Macro units and conclude that process-based units might be more suitable entity.

AI.tldr: 本文通过复现实验检验"编辑操作在微观与宏观单元间的分布可作为文本产出压力的指标"这一观点。研究比较多种停顿阈值以切分微观与宏观单元，发现基于过程的单元可能是更合适的研究实体。
AI.motivation: 原研究将编辑操作在微观与宏观单元间的分布视为文本产出压力的指标，但其单元划分依赖停顿阈值，阈值选择可能影响结论的稳健性。因此有必要通过复现实验检验该指标的可靠性，并探讨何种单元界定方式更为合理。
AI.method: 采用复现实验设计：设置并考察多种停顿阈值，据此将写作过程切分为微观单元与宏观单元，统计编辑操作在各单元类型间的分布，并比较不同阈值下结果的一致性；在此基础上评估"基于过程的单元"作为替代性分析实体的适用性。
AI.result: 不同停顿阈值会改变微观与宏观单元的切分结果，进而影响编辑操作分布这一指标的稳定性；相比固定的阈值划分，"基于过程的单元"在刻画文本产出过程方面表现更为合适。
AI.conclusion: 以阈值切分的微观/宏观单元来指示文本产出压力存在局限，研究者在复现与推广该指标时需谨慎对待单元定义；建议采用基于过程的单元作为分析实体，以提高写作过程研究的效度与可比性。

title: Cross-modal learning for SAR target recognition using optical vision foundation models
comment: Accepted for presentation at SPIE Sensors + Imaging 2026
summary: Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) is an important modality in a wide range of imaging applications due to its versatile, long range and near all weather operating capabilities. However, Automatic Target Recognition (ATR) remains a challenging problem due to limited labelled data, the strong speckle in SAR images and the significant domain gap between SAR and more abundant optical imagery. In contrast, electro-optical (EO) imagery benefits from massive datasets, clearer visual structure and powerful foundation models. In this work, we investigate how vision foundation models trained on optical data can provide class level supervision for SAR classification. We propose a cross-modal EO to SAR prototype alignment framework in which a frozen EO encoder, based on a DINOv3 vision foundation model, is used to construct class level optical prototypes without requiring strict EO/SAR pairs. A SAR model is then trained to classify SAR images while aligning its embeddings to the corresponding EO class prototype. At inference time, the SAR model operates independently, without access to optical imagery. We evaluate our approach on the UNICORNv2 dataset, an EO and SAR dataset of civilian vehicles with heavily speckled images and severe class imbalance. EO prototype alignment improves SAR classification accuracy over frozen DINOv3, SAR only finetuning and unpaired distribution alignment baselines, and t-SNE visualizations provide qualitative evidence of clearer separation among classes in the trained SAR embedding space. These results suggest that optical vision foundation models, despite being trained on visible spectrum imagery, provide transferable information for SAR image classification, offering a practical method for using large scale pretrained vision foundation models across challenging sensing modalities.

AI.tldr: 提出跨模态EO-to-SAR原型对齐框架，用冻结的DINOv3光学编码器构建类别级光学原型，监督SAR分类器训练，无需严格EO/SAR配对；在UNICORNv2数据集上提升了SAR分类精度，且推理时仅需SAR模型。
AI.motivation: SAR的ATR面临标注数据有限、斑点噪声强、与光学影像存在显著域差距等困难；而EO影像数据量大、结构清晰且有强大基础模型，因此希望借助光学视觉基础模型为SAR分类提供类别级监督。
AI.method: 构建跨模态EO到SAR的原型对齐框架：使用基于DINOv3的冻结EO编码器，在不要求严格EO/SAR配对的前提下，生成类别级光学原型；训练SAR模型在分类SAR图像的同时，将其嵌入对齐到对应EO类别原型；推理阶段SAR模型独立运行，不使用光学影像。
AI.result: 在UNICORNv2（民用车辆EO与SAR数据集，斑点噪声严重且类别不平衡）上，EO原型对齐优于冻结DINOv3、仅SAR微调以及非配对分布对齐基线；t-SNE可视化显示训练后的SAR嵌入空间中类别分离更清晰。
AI.conclusion: 即使光学视觉基础模型在可见光谱影像上训练，也能为SAR图像分类提供可迁移信息，为在挑战性传感模态中利用大规模预训练视觉基础模型提供了实用方法。

title: Capability-Routed Visual Retrieval and Evidence Threading for Long-Context Document Question Answering
summary: Annual reports, diligence packs, and infographic dashboards bury numbers in page images: axes, cell grids, and footnotes that OCR pipelines flatten and that page-level visual retrievers still treat as interchangeable in-context examples. We keep a frozen Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct generator and a ColPali / VisRAG-Ret page index, and insert three modules. A capability-aware visual router (CAVR) tags each retrieved page as text, table, chart, layout, or mixed and mixes specialist experts before generation. Weak-to-strong page selection (WSPS) distils a frozen 7B answerability teacher into a 3B selection head so ranking is no longer a single InfoNCE score. Visual evidence threading (VET) builds layout-anchored paths of length at most three and lets the generator read the thread rather than a flat top-$k$ list. On gold-page DocVQA / ChartQA / InfographicVQA the 7B system reaches 96.3 / 90.1 / 85.4. Under the VisRAG top-3 protocol the mean generation accuracy is 62.74 versus 59.39 for the same backbone with concatenation. On MMLongBench-Doc retrieve-then-read, F1 moves from 19.2 to 22.6 and multi-page accuracy from 16.4 to 21.2. ViDoRe nDCG@5 after WSPS reranking is 83.6, with TAT-DQA financial reports at 70.4.

AI.tldr: 在冻结的Qwen2.5-VL-7B生成器与ColPali/VisRAG-Ret页面索引之上，插入CAVR、WSPS、VET三个模块，使文档视觉问答在DocVQA/ChartQA/InfographicVQA、VisRAG top-3、MMLongBench-Doc及ViDoRe等基准上取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 年报、尽调资料与信息图仪表盘将关键数值埋在页面图像中（坐标轴、单元格网格、脚注），OCR流水线会将其压平，页面级视觉检索器仍把页面当作可互换的上下文示例。作者希望提升视觉文档检索与生成的证据利用精度。
AI.method: 保持生成器与页面索引冻结，插入三个模块：(1) 能力感知视觉路由器CAVR，将检索页面标记为文本/表格/图表/布局/混合，并在生成前混合专家；(2) 弱到强页面选择WSPS，将冻结的7B可回答性教师蒸馏为3B选择头，替代单一InfoNCE打分排序；(3) 视觉证据串接VET，构建布局锚定的长度≤3路径，让生成器读取线索而非扁平top-k列表。
AI.result: 金页DocVQA/ChartQA/InfographicVQA上7B系统达96.3/90.1/85.4。VisRAG top-3协议下平均生成准确率62.74，同骨干拼接为59.39。MMLongBench-Doc retrieve-then-read中F1由19.2升至22.6，多页准确率由16.4升至21.2。ViDoRe经WSPS重排后nDCG@5为83.6，TAT-DQA财务报告为70.4。
AI.conclusion: 通过能力感知路由、弱监督重排与布局锚定证据串接，可在不训练生成器与索引的前提下显著改善视觉文档检索与问答的证据选择与生成质量。

title: Bag of Tricks or Bag of Myths? Reducing Modeling Complexity with Task Knowledge in Explainable Suicide Risk Assessment
comment: This work was shaped by the IEEE Big Data Cup, where our team, NIDHI, ranked 3rd overall. NIDHI (Neurosymbolic Intelligent Diagnostics for Holistic Trauma-Informed Care) is an effort from IAIRO.ai . 21 pages, 6 Tables, 4 Figures
summary: Assessing suicide risk from social media text is a small-data, high-stakes setting requiring not only severity prediction but also supporting evidence and clinically relevant risk and protective factors. Yet common NLP techniques, including model scaling, synthetic data, loss reweighting, ensembling, and threshold tuning, are often applied without testing whether their gains hold up under severe class imbalance, coupled outputs, and limited author-level data. We study 1,635 clinician-annotated posts and audit 31 pre-specified techniques from 7 methodological families through roughly 300 controlled experiments on author-disjoint partitions. We found no prior audit of this playbook in this regime. The findings guide a task-grounded system for three outputs: 4-level suicide risk, evidence spans, and 24 clinical risk and protective factors. Only 5 of 31 comparisons produced reliable gains. We reformulate factor prediction as entailment between each post and its codebook definitions, using an architecturally diverse ensemble with class-balanced training and score rescaling. Risk predictions condition a 7-model evidence tagger ensemble; evidence restricts symbolic risk rules; and a difficult risk class is routed separately. The factor predictor remains independent because risk evidence provides no additional factor signal. We also correct a mismatch between validation scores used for threshold fitting and test-time ensemble scores through deployment-consistent calibration, yielding the largest improvement to the factor system. The final system achieves 0.8203 for risk, 0.7953 for evidence, and 0.7045 macro-F1 for factors, with a 0.7781 composite, ranking third among 53 teams. We call the underlying principle task-conditioned technique selection: retain techniques only when task-specific knowledge, structure, or empirical evidence justifies them.

AI.tldr: 本文在1635条临床标注帖子、作者不重叠划分上开展约300个受控实验，审计31项常用NLP技术；仅5项带来可靠增益，据此提出"任务条件化技术选择"原则并构建三级输出系统，获0.7781综合分、排名第3/53。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体自杀风险评估属小数据、高风险场景，不仅需要严重程度预测，还需证据片段与临床风险/保护因素；但模型缩放、合成数据、损失重加权、集成、阈值调优等常用NLP技巧常被默认采用，未经检验其在严重类别不平衡、耦合输出与作者级数据有限条件下是否仍有效，且该场景下缺乏此前审计。
AI.method: 在1635条医生标注帖子上，于作者不重叠划分中进行约300个受控实验，审计7个方法族共31项预设技术；对因素预测重构为帖子与码本定义之间的蕴涵任务，采用架构多样化集成、类别平衡训练与分数重标定；风险预测条件化7模型证据标注集成，证据约束符号化风险规则，对困难风险类别单独路由；因素预测保持独立（风险证据无额外因素信号）；并通过部署一致性校准修正阈值拟合验证分数与测试时集成分数的不匹配。
AI.result: 31项比较中仅5项产生可靠增益；部署一致性校准为因素系统带来最大提升。最终系统风险F1为0.8203、证据0.7953、因素宏F1为0.7045，综合分0.7781，在53支队伍中排名第3。
AI.conclusion: 提出"任务条件化技术选择"原则：仅当任务特定知识、结构或实证证据支持时才保留某项技术；为小数据高风险NLP任务提供了可复用的审计式技术筛选范式。

title: Frame-Synchronous Hand Gesture Detection by Projected Winding Order
comment: 17 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Implementation, evaluation and figure-generating code: https://github.com/Amey-Thakur/GESTURE-FX. Live deployment: https://amey-thakur.github.io/GESTURE-FX/. The evaluation runs in a browser against the shipped modules, so every figure can be reproduced by opening a page
summary: Gesture recognition on video is normally posed as classification: label each frame, then act on the label. That is adequate for control, where a command may be obeyed several frames late without a user noticing, and inadequate for synchronisation, where an output must be aligned to the frame on which the gesture physically occurred. We take the synchronisation problem for one common movement, the rotation of an open hand about its long axis, and show that it admits an exact solution needing no classifier, no training data and no calibration. Let s be the normalised two-dimensional cross product of the two palm edges at the wrist and the outer knuckles, under the projection the camera already performs. We prove that s factorises as k(theta)cos(theta) with |k| > 0 everywhere, so s vanishes exactly when the palm is edge-on and its sign tracks the face presented to the camera. Detection is therefore a zero crossing of one scalar, which yields an instant rather than an interval, and we prove the criterion invariant to image mirroring, hand scale and handedness, all from its algebraic form rather than from the landmark estimator. A two-handed interaction uses four fingertips as a window onto a restyled version of the same scene. We give a coverage predicate that stays correct when the hands cross, where the usual triangulation does not, and derive each free parameter of the three stylisation operators from a noise statistic rather than by inspection. Against a corpus with exact ground truth the criterion detects 95% of flips with no false positive in 240 near-miss sequences, and places each within 6.7 ms on average of the instant it occurred, a sixth of the interval at which the hand is observed, against 23.0 ms for reporting the bracketing sample. Reporting an event more finely than one samples follows from treating a gesture as the zero of a continuous quantity rather than a label.

AI.tldr: 该论文将手势识别从分类范式转向同步问题，针对开掌绕长轴旋转这一动作，提出一个无需分类器、训练数据与标定的精确解：以腕部两条掌边与外指节归一化二维叉积 s 作为判据，证明 s=k(θ)cosθ 且 |k|>0，使 s 的零交叉精确对应掌心侧对的瞬间。
AI.motivation: 视频手势识别通常被当作分类任务：逐帧打标签再据此行动。这对控制类应用足够（命令延迟数帧用户难以察觉），但对同步类应用不足——输出必须与手势实际发生的帧对齐。因此作者面向同步问题寻求一个无需分类器、训练数据与标定的精确方案。
AI.method: 取腕部两条掌边与外指节在相机投影下的归一化二维叉积 s，证明其可分解为 k(θ)cosθ 且 |k|>0，从而 s 恰在手掌侧对时为零且符号反映朝向相机的面。由此把手势检测转化为单一标量的零交叉，得到瞬时而非区间。作者从代数形式（而非依赖关键点估计器）证明该判据对镜像、手部尺度与左右手性不变。双手交互中以四个指尖作为窗口观察同一场景的再风格化版本，给出在双手交叉时仍正确的覆盖谓词，并将三个风格化算子的自由参数由噪声统计量导出。
AI.result: 在具有精确真值的语料上，该判据检测到 95% 的翻转，在 240 条近似序列中无误报；平均定位误差 6.7 ms，为手部观测间隔的六分之一，而报告所跨采样样本的误差为 23.0 ms。
AI.conclusion: 以比采样间隔更细的粒度报告事件，源于把手势视为连续量的零点而非标签；该精确解无需分类器、训练与标定，且对镜像、尺度与手性具有不变性。

title: CodeTD: Topology of Attention Detects Hallucinations in Code LLMs
summary: As AI-code assistant tools become widespread, automatic assessment of the correctness of generated code becomes a significant challenge. Code LLMs are prone to hallucinations, which may lead to code that does not solve the required problem, or even to code with severe security vulnerabilities. In this paper, we introduce CodeTD -- the first approach to pre-execution assessment of code correctness based on topological data analysis (TDA) of Code LLMs' attention maps. Our method quantifies prompt-generation mismatch using topological patterns of attention maps. We carry out experiments with common benchmarks (HumanEval, MBPP, BigCodeBench, MultiPL-E), 5 programming languages and 10 Code LLMs of size up to 34B parameters. The experimental results show that the proposed method outperforms recent baselines. Moreover, CodeTD is transferable between coding benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CodeTD，首个基于注意力图拓扑数据分析（TDA）的代码生成正确性预执行评估方法。通过注意力图的拓扑模式量化提示-生成不匹配程度，在多个基准、5种编程语言、10个代码大模型上超越现有基线，且具备跨基准迁移性。
AI.motivation: 随着AI代码助手广泛使用，对生成代码正确性进行自动评估成为重要挑战。代码大模型易产生幻觉，导致代码无法解决目标问题，甚至引入严重安全漏洞，因此需要在代码执行前评估其正确性。
AI.method: CodeTD基于代码大模型注意力图的拓扑数据分析（TDA），利用注意力图的拓扑模式量化提示与生成代码之间的不匹配程度，从而在代码执行前判断其正确性。
AI.result: 在HumanEval、MBPP、BigCodeBench、MultiPL-E等常用基准上，覆盖5种编程语言与10个规模至34B参数的代码大模型进行实验，结果显示该方法优于近期基线，并且可在不同编程基准之间迁移。
AI.conclusion: CodeTD首次将注意力图拓扑分析用于代码正确性的预执行评估，验证了其有效性与跨基准迁移能力，为代码大模型幻觉检测提供了新思路。

title: DroneGround: Open-Vocabulary Drone Payload Characterization Using Synthetic Data and Grounded Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted at RVS-SE, British Machine Vision Conference, 2026
summary: Automated drone surveillance has become increasingly important for public safety, critical infrastructure protection,and restricted airspace monitoring. While existing vision-based systems achieve strong performance for drone detection and tracking, reliable payload characterization remains highly challenging under long-range imaging conditions due to limited availability of annotated real-world datasets, and substantial distribution shifts encountered during deployment. Existing approaches formulate payload characterization as a closed-set object detection problem, limiting their ability to recognize previously unseen payloads and generalize beyond the training distribution. To address these challenges, we generate a photorealistic synthetic drone-payload dataset using Unreal Engine 5 and Cosys-AirSim and propose DroneGround: Grounded Vision-Language Payload Characterization, a two-stage framework for robust open-vocabulary payload analysis. DroneGround first employs a YOLO26s detector to localize drones and extract drone-centric image crops, followed by a LoRA-fine-tuned PaliGemma vision-language model that generates seman- tic descriptions of the detected drones and their attached payloads, enabling open-vocabulary payload characterization beyond predefined categories. An occlusion-based grounding module further provides interpretable payload localization by identifying image regions responsible for the generated descriptions. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world drone imagery demonstrate that DroneGround substantially improves robustness under synthetic-to-real distribution shifts, outperforming a conventional closed-set payload detector by improving the F1-score from 82.5% to 96.3%, while achieving significantly better generalization to previously unseen payload categories (80.4%versus 42.7% F1). Dataset and code will be released upon request.

AI.tldr: 提出 DroneGround 两阶段开放词汇无人机载荷表征框架，结合合成数据集与视觉语言模型，显著提升跨域鲁棒性与未见载荷泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 自动化无人机监视对公共安全、关键基础设施保护和空域监控日益重要。现有视觉系统虽在检测与跟踪上表现良好，但在远距离成像下载荷表征仍极具挑战：真实标注数据稀缺、部署时存在显著分布偏移。已有方法将载荷表征建模为闭集目标检测，难以识别未见载荷、泛化能力受限。
AI.method: 1) 使用 Unreal Engine 5 与 Cosys-AirSim 生成照片级真实的合成无人机-载荷数据集；2) 提出 DroneGround 两阶段框架：第一阶段用 YOLO26s 检测器定位无人机并裁剪以无人机为中心的图像块；第二阶段用 LoRA 微调的 PaliGemma 视觉语言模型生成无人机及其挂载载荷的语义描述，实现超越预定义类别的开放词汇载荷表征；3) 引入基于遮挡的 grounding 模块，通过识别对生成描述负责的图像区域，提供可解释的载荷定位。
AI.result: 在合成与真实无人机图像上的大量实验表明：DroneGround 在合成到真实的分布偏移下鲁棒性显著提升，F1 从传统闭集载荷检测器的 82.5% 提升至 96.3%；对未见载荷类别的泛化性能显著更优，F1 为 80.4% 对比 42.7%。
AI.conclusion: DroneGround 通过合成数据生成与视觉语言模型结合的两阶段开放词汇框架，有效缓解了数据稀缺与域偏移问题，实现了更强的载荷表征鲁棒性与泛化能力。数据集与代码将应请求发布。

title: Signed Rescue Routing: Harm-Aware Cascades for Efficient LLM Inference
summary: Large language model (LLM) cascades answer easy requests with a small model and escalate selected requests to a larger model. Most routers prioritize examples on which the small model appears uncertain or likely to be wrong. This proxy ignores a decisive fact: escalation is useful only when the large model corrects the small model, and it is harmful when the large model replaces a correct answer with an incorrect one. We introduce Signed Rescue Routing (SRR), a budgeted routing method that predicts these two events separately and ranks requests by their difference. We show that this signed conditional gain is the Bayes-optimal routing score under a fixed escalation budget. SRR requires only the small model's output statistics at deployment and adds a lightweight two-head router. We evaluate SRR with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B on TBD examples from MMLU, HellaSwag, and ARC-Challenge. Across the accuracy-compute curve, SRR reaches an area of TBD, compared with TBD for a learned small-model error predictor and TBD for entropy routing. These results show that predicting incremental value, rather than model uncertainty, is a simple and effective objective for efficient LLM cascades.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Signed Rescue Routing (SRR)，一种预算受限的路由方法，通过分别预测"大模型纠正小模型"和"大模型破坏正确结果"两个事件，并按二者差值排序请求，实现LLM级联的高效路由。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM级联路由器大多优先选择小模型表现出不确定或可能出错的样本，但这一代理指标忽略了关键事实：升级只有在大模型能纠正小模型时才有利，当大模型把正确回答替换为错误回答时则有害。因此，基于不确定性的路由目标并非最优。
AI.method: 作者提出Signed Rescue Routing (SRR)：一种预算受限的路由方法，分别预测两个事件（大模型纠正、大模型破坏），并按二者的差值对请求排序。理论上证明该带符号的条件增益在固定升级预算下是Bayes最优路由分数。SRR在部署时仅需小模型的输出统计量，并添加一个轻量级双头路由器。
AI.result: 作者使用Qwen3-4B与Qwen3-8B，在MMLU、HellaSwag和ARC-Challenge的TBD样本上评估SRR。在准确率-计算量曲线上，SRR达到的曲线下面积为TBD，而学习型小模型错误预测器为TBD，熵路由为TBD（原文数值缺失）。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，预测增量价值（而非模型不确定性）是构建高效LLM级联的简单而有效的目标。

title: LLM Agents as Computational Typologists
summary: Linguistic typology relies on expert analysis of reference grammars across languages, making large-scale crosslinguistic comparison labor-intensive and unscalable. We introduce AUTOTYPOLOGIST, an LLM agent for evidence-grounded typological analysis over reference grammars. The agent is capable of retrieving relevant grammar sections, analyzing interlinear glossed text (IGT), and iteratively reasoning over typological hypotheses using a ReAct-style workflow. We evaluate the system on TYPOLOGICAL FEATURE CODING against expert annotations and TYPOLOGICAL HYPOTHESIS TESTING with typological universals using 25 open-source reference grammars. Operating under different information constraints in TYPOLOGICAL FEATURE CODING, the agent can synthesize information from reference grammar prose but still faces challenges with only IGTs in the target language. In TYPOLOGICAL HYPOTHESIS TESTING, the agent can synthesize crosslinguistic evidence and identify both supporting cases and counterexamples. These findings suggest that LLM agents can support scalable and inspectable typological analysis, while still requiring expert validation.

AI.tldr: 提出 LLM 智能体 AUTOTYPOLOGIST，基于参考语法进行有证据支撑的类型学分析，在特征编码与假设检验两项任务上验证其可行性与局限。
AI.motivation: 语言类型学依赖专家对跨语言参考语法的人工分析，大规模跨语言比较成本高、难以规模化。
AI.method: 构建 AUTOPOLOGIST：检索相关语法章节、分析行间注释文本（IGT），并以 ReAct 式工作流对类型学假设进行迭代推理。
AI.result: 在 25 部开源参考语法上评估：特征编码任务中，智能体能综合语法散文信息，但在仅有目标语言 IGT 时仍面临困难；假设检验任务中，能综合跨语言证据并识别支持案例与反例。
AI.conclusion: LLM 智能体可支持可扩展、可检验的类型学分析，但仍需专家验证。

title: Does Syntax Matter? A Graph-Augmented Variational Topic Model for Computational Social Sciences
summary: Topic modeling is widely used in computational social sciences to identify latent themes in large text corpora. Traditional approaches rely on Bag-of-Words representations and generative models such as LDA, while recent methods like BERTopic operate on dense document embeddings. This paper introduces the Structural Contextual Probabilistic Topic Model (SCPTM), an architecture that incorporates syntactic dependency relations into topic inference. SCPTM represents a corpus as a heterogeneous graph of documents and words connected by lexical and syntactic edges, processed through a Graph Attention Network within a Variational Autoencoder to produce probabilistic, mixed-membership topic distributions. We evaluate seven topic modeling techniques (including four SCPTM ablations) across four corpora differing in register and discourse structure. Our framework combines coherence (C_V, C_NPMI), topic diversity, clustering-label alignment (NMI), and phrase-level diagnostics (complementarity and valence gap). Results show that SCPTM's neural architecture yields substantial gains in document-topic alignment over generative baselines, but these gains are attributable to the variational encoder rather than to syntax. Syntax contributes to topic diversity, where graph-augmented variants outperform the no-graph baseline across all corpora, and to descriptor quality: dependency paths capture predicate-argument structures and stance in deliberative registers, while proving redundant in technical and institutional corpora. The valence gap is positive across all variants, but driven primarily by phrase grouping rather than syntactic filtering. We conclude that syntactic encoding matters conditionally: it benefits action-oriented, argumentative texts, but introduces noise in informational or administrative registers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出结构上下文概率主题模型SCPTM，将句法依存关系引入主题推断，并在四个语料上结合一致性、多样性、聚类对齐与短语级诊断进行评估，发现神经架构带来的文档—主题对齐提升主要源于变分编码器而非句法，句法的作用是条件性的。
AI.motivation: 传统主题模型依赖词袋与LDA等生成模型，近期BERTopic等方法基于稠密文档嵌入，均未显式利用句法结构信息。作者希望检验将句法依存关系纳入主题推断能否提升主题质量，并厘清性能增益究竟来自神经架构还是句法信息本身。
AI.method: 提出SCPTM：将语料表示为文档与词构成的异构图，节点间由词汇边和句法边连接，通过变分自编码器中的图注意力网络处理，输出概率化、混合成员的主题分布。实验对比七种主题建模技术（含四种SCPTM消融），在语域与篇章结构不同的四个语料上评估，指标包括一致性（C_V、C_NPMI）、主题多样性、聚类—标签对齐（NMI）以及短语级诊断（互补性与效价差）。
AI.result: SCPTM的神经架构在文档—主题对齐上较生成式基线有显著提升，但提升归因于变分编码器而非句法。句法提升了主题多样性，图增强变体在所有语料上均优于无图基线；在描述符质量上，依存路径能捕捉审议语域中的谓词—论元结构与立场，但在技术性和机构性语料中呈冗余。效价差在所有变体中均为正，但主要由短语分组而非句法过滤驱动。
AI.conclusion: 句法编码的作用是条件性的：对行动导向、论辩性文本有益，而在信息性或行政语域中会引入噪声。因此，是否引入句法结构应视语域与话语类型而定，而非普遍适用。

title: Climate-ModernBERT: Revisiting Corpus Composition for Domain-Adaptive Continued Pretraining
summary: Natural Language Processing (NLP) in the climate domain requires models to process heterogeneous text sources, including scientific literature, policy disclosures, and synthetic reports. However, how to effectively combine diverse domain corpora during continued pretraining (CPT) remains underexplored. We introduce Climate-ModernBERT, a family of climate-adapted encoder models obtained through continued pretraining of ModernBERT-Base on three climate corpora: academic climate text, climate-filtered web data, and synthetic climate documents. We systematically compare joint continued pretraining on corpus mixtures with parameter-space merging of independently specialized checkpoints. Across nine climate NLP benchmarks, our best model achieves 76.3 average F_1, improving significantly over a vanilla ModernBERT baseline by 2.8 points. Within the climate NLP setting, the results show that academic climate corpora provide the strongest adaptation signal among the evaluated sources, while parameter-space merging improves over joint multi-source training and better preserves complementary information from heterogeneous climate corpora. We release all Climate-ModernBERT variants and training checkpoints to support future research in climate NLP and domain-adaptive pretraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Climate-ModernBERT系列气候领域编码器模型，通过在学术气候文本、气候过滤网页与合成气候文档三类语料上对ModernBERT-Base进行继续预训练，并系统比较联合多源训练与参数空间合并两种策略。最佳模型在九个气候NLP基准上取得76.3平均F_1，较基线提升2.8分，且参数合并优于联合训练并更好保留异构语料的互补信息。
AI.motivation: 气候领域NLP需处理科学文献、政策披露与合成报告等异构文本源，但在继续预训练（CPT）中如何有效融合多样领域语料尚缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 以ModernBERT-Base为基础，在学术气候文本、气候过滤网页数据、合成气候文档三类语料上进行继续预训练，构建Climate-ModernBERT系列模型；对比"多语料混合的联合继续预训练"与"独立特化检查点的参数空间合并"两种策略。
AI.result: 在九个气候NLP基准上，最优模型达76.3平均F_1，比原始ModernBERT基线显著提升2.8分；学术气候语料在评估来源中提供最强适应信号；参数空间合并优于多源联合训练，且更能保留异构气候语料的互补信息。
AI.conclusion: Climate-ModernBERT验证了领域继续预训练在气候NLP中的有效性，表明参数合并是多源异构语料融合的优选策略，并公开全部模型变体与训练检查点以支持后续气候NLP与领域自适应预训练研究。

title: You Can't Prefer Emotions You Don't Sample: Intensity Undershoot in DPO-Tuned LLMs
comment: Accepted to INLG 2026 (poster). Both authors contributed equally
summary: Ask a language model to respond "very excitedly," and its output is typically only mildly more energetic. We quantify this effect. We condition an instruction-tuned LLM on a continuous Valence-Arousal (VA) target, where valence measures how pleasant a state is and arousal how activated it is, measure the achieved affect with a frozen regressor, and sweep the requested target from -1 to +1. The response moves far less than asked: the gain, the slope of achieved against requested affect, is only 0.26 for valence and 0.13 for arousal on Llama-3.1-8B, where a faithful controller would score 1. The model systematically undershoots requested emotional intensity, which puts a number on the qualitative observation of Fazzi et al. (2025). Our experiments trace this to the preference-learning pipeline. Training targets from natural corpora such as EmoBank are neutral-heavy, and the sampled candidates themselves rarely reach extreme affect, so Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) is left with no extreme exemplar to prefer. If instead we cover the target space uniformly and sample a hotter, larger candidate pool, valence gain rises from 0.26 to 0.40 +/- 0.02 (3 seeds) and extrapolation error drops, at only a modest in-distribution cost (EmoBank-test VA distance 0.092 to 0.107). The same recipe reproduces on Qwen3-8B (gain_v 0.44, with in-distribution accuracy preserved). Arousal is harder and less reliable: its gain barely moves on average and swings across seeds (0.14 +/- 0.07, against valence's tight +/- 0.02), because raising arousal needs candidates the base model is reluctant to generate. The evidence indicates that faithful intensity is bottlenecked by the extremity of the candidate pool rather than by the conditioning format.

AI.tldr: 本文量化了LLM情感强度"欠冲"现象：用连续VA(效价-唤醒度)目标条件化指令模型，实测gain仅0.26(效价)/0.13(唤醒度)，远低于理想值1；根因是偏好学习流程中候选样本自身触及极端情感的极少，通过均匀覆盖目标空间并扩大"更热"的候选池可将效价gain提升至0.40±0.02。
AI.motivation: 已有定性观察指出，让语言模型"非常兴奋地"回答，输出往往仅比平常略富活力，但缺乏定量刻画。作者希望量化这种情感强度欠冲，并进一步定位其成因，以回答"忠实的情感强度控制为何困难"。
AI.method: (1) 以连续Valence-Arousal(VA)目标对指令微调LLM进行条件化，请求目标从-1扫到+1，并用冻结的情感回归器测量实际达成的情感，定义gain为"实际情感对请求情感的斜率"，忠实控制器应为1；(2) 以自然语料(如EmoBank)训练偏好数据，分析训练目标分布与候选样本的情感覆盖；(3) 改用均匀覆盖目标空间的采样，并构建"更热、更大"的候选池重做DPO；(4) 在Llama-3.1-8B与Qwen3-8B上跨3个随机种子重复，比较gain、外推误差与分布内精度。
AI.result: Llama-3.1-8B上gain_效价=0.26、gain_唤醒度=0.13。根因指向偏好学习流程：EmoBank等自然语料的训练目标偏中性，采样候选本身极少达到极端情感，DPO缺乏可偏好的极端样本。改为均匀覆盖目标空间并采样更大更热的候选池后，效价gain从0.26升至0.40±0.02(3 seeds)，外推误差下降，分布内代价有限(EmoBank-test VA距离0.092→0.107)。Qwen3-8B上复现(gain_效价0.44，分布内精度保持)。唤醒度更难且更不稳定：平均gain几乎不动且随种子波动(0.14±0.07，对比效价的±0.02)，原因是提升唤醒度需要基座模型不愿生成的候选。
AI.conclusion: 忠实的情感强度控制瓶颈在于候选池的情感极端性，而非条件化格式本身。为DPO提供覆盖极端情感的训练目标与更热的候选池，可显著改善效价的强度跟随能力；唤醒度受限于基座模型的生成意愿，仍是更难的开放问题。

title: CANAL: Channel-Aware Noise Allocation for Differentially Private Feature Distillation in Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Medical image segmentation needs diverse training data, but hospitals hold complementary scans they cannot share for privacy and regulatory reasons. Knowledge distillation can bridge this gap by exporting learned feature representations instead of images, but those representations still encode patient-specific anatomy and remain vulnerable to membership-inference and feature-inversion attacks. Adding calibrated Gaussian noise restores a differential-privacy guarantee, yet three issues have been overlooked. First, prior DP feature-distillation pipelines re-sample noise at every student iteration, so each patient image is released many times and the privacy cost composes over those releases, growing by orders of magnitude. We present a sample-once-per-image release, realized by a single precomputation pass, under which each patient contributes one release. Second, uniform noise is wasteful because channels differ in task importance. Using task-gradient energy as the importance measure, we derive CANAL, a closed-form water-filling allocation that gives important channels proportionally less noise, and prove it strictly minimizes importance-weighted distortion at a fixed budget. Third, the clipping caps and importance scores that drive the allocation are themselves data-dependent, so releasing them in the clear silently breaks the guarantee. We give a DP-honest budget split that charges each to the privacy budget, so the reported epsilon is the true epsilon. Across three medical segmentation benchmarks spanning dermoscopy, colonoscopy, and ultrasound, CANAL retains more task-relevant signal than uniform noise at the same privacy budget.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对医学图像分割中的差分隐私特征蒸馏，提出“每图一次释放”机制、基于任务梯度能量的闭式注水噪声分配方案 CANAL 及隐私预算诚实拆分，在相同隐私预算下保留更多任务相关信号。
AI.motivation: 医院间因隐私与监管无法共享互补的医学影像数据，知识蒸馏虽可导出特征而非图像来弥合数据缺口，但特征仍编码患者特异性解剖信息，易受成员推断与特征反演攻击。加 calibrated Gaussian 噪声可提供 DP 保证，但既有 DP 特征蒸馏流程存在三个被忽视的问题：每次学生迭代重采样噪声导致隐私成本组合放大、均匀噪声忽视通道任务重要性、裁剪上限与重要性分数本身数据相关却被明文释放从而破坏保证。
AI.method: 1）提出 sample-once-per-image 释放机制，通过单次预计算实现每名患者仅贡献一次释放；2）以任务梯度能量为重要性度量，推导 CANAL 闭式注水分配，使重要通道获得按比例更少的噪声，并证明其在固定预算下严格最小化重要性加权失真；3）设计 DP-honest 预算拆分，将裁剪上限与重要性分数对隐私预算的消耗计入，使报告的 epsilon 为真实 epsilon。
AI.result: 在涵盖皮肤镜、结肠镜与超声三种模态的三个医学分割基准上，CANAL 在相同隐私预算下比均匀噪声保留更多任务相关信号。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将 DP 特征蒸馏从“每次迭代释放”改为“每图一次释放”，并用任务感知的最优噪声分配与诚实预算核算，提升了隐私-效用权衡的可信度与有效性。

title: VoT: Vision-of-Thought for Unified Multimodal Representation Alignment
summary: Current text-to-image systems typically employ a "text encoder plus diffusion decoder" paradigm, in which text semantics directly modulate continuous latent noise. Despite their success, these methods lack an explicit, interpretable intermediate representation that effectively bridges high-level linguistic semantics and low-level visual signals. In this paper, we propose Vision-of-Thought (VoT), a framework that introduces a discrete visual-thinking layer between vision-language models (VLMs) and diffusion transformers (DiTs). Instead of treating VLMs merely as text encoders, we use them as multimodal planners that generate discrete VoT tokens representing high-level visual plans, such as objects and layouts, before rendering pixels. We train a specialized VoT tokenizer in the VLM semantic space with a closed-loop objective that combines VLM alignment, feature reconstruction, and vector-quantization losses. These objectives make the tokens semantically readable by the VLM while preserving the visual information needed for generation. Experimental results demonstrate that VoT improves semantic alignment and provides a structured interface for interpretable and controllable generation.

AI.tldr: 提出 Vision-of-Thought (VoT) 框架，在 VLM 与 DiT 之间引入离散视觉思维层，以离散 token 作为可解释的中间表示，提升语义对齐与可控生成。
AI.motivation: 现有"文本编码器+扩散解码器"范式让文本语义直接调制连续隐噪声，缺少显式、可解释的中间表示来衔接高层语言语义与低层视觉信号。
AI.method: 不再把 VLM 仅当作文本编码器，而是作为多模态规划器，在渲染像素前生成表示物体、布局等高层视觉规划的离散 VoT token；在 VLM 语义空间中训练专用 VoT tokenizer，采用包含 VLM 对齐损失、特征重建损失与向量量化损失的闭环目标，使 token 既语义可读又保留生成所需视觉信息。
AI.result: 实验表明 VoT 提升了语义对齐，并为可解释、可控生成提供了结构化接口。
AI.conclusion: 引入离散视觉思维层作为中间表示，可在 VLM 与 DiT 之间建立可解释桥梁，兼顾语义可读性与生成保真度，为可控生成提供结构化接口。

title: A*-Thought-V2: Efficient Latent Reasoning via Geometric Dynamics of LLM
summary: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) improves the reasoning ability of Large Language Models (LLMs) but incurs substantial computation and context costs. Existing methods either lose intermediate information through hard pruning or lack a principled criterion for continuous compression. We present A*-Thought-V2, a geometric dynamics of LLM guided framework that models CoT as a hidden-state trajectory and replaces hard deletion with an explicit-implicit interleaved latent architecture. After projecting question, step, and solution representations into a 3D PCA space, it measures alignment between each local transition and global question-to-solution direction. Aligned steps remain explicit text, whereas deviating steps are compressed into continuous latent tokens. Directional angles capture both local semantics and reasoning dynamics: small angles indicate direct execution and answer formation, while large angles more frequently involve checking, correction, and branch exploration; their temporal variation reveals exploration, convergence, and refinement stages. To train this architecture, we introduce stepwise embedding forcing, which pools each redundant step into a single latent embedding, and label forcing, which supervises that latent token with a soft multi-modal vocabulary distribution instead of a hard one-hot label. Experiments on Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.6-27B across six in-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks show that A*-Thought-V2 improves average accuracy by up to 2.6% while reducing response length by up to half, increasing Accuracy per Computation Unit by 2.29$\times$, and reducing preprocessing and training time by 94.6% and up to 80.3%, respectively. Representation analyses suggest that latent states form a compact region distinct from textual states, while higher entropy at latent-token positions reflects broader soft targets that encourage richer step-level feature learning.

AI.tldr: A*-Thought-V2 将 CoT 建模为隐状态轨迹，用"显式-隐式交错"潜空间架构替代硬剪枝，并按局部转移与全局问题-解方向的对齐程度决定"保留文本 / 压缩为潜 token"，配合逐步嵌入强制与标签强制训练，在准确率、响应长度与计算效率上均有提升。
AI.motivation: CoT 提升了大模型推理能力，但带来显著的计算与上下文开销。现有压缩方法要么通过硬剪枝丢失中间信息，要么缺乏对连续压缩的原则性判据。
AI.method: 把 CoT 视为隐状态轨迹，将问题、步骤与解的表示投影到 3D PCA 空间，度量每个局部转移与全局"问题→解"方向的方向角；对齐的步骤保留为显式文本，偏离的步骤压缩为连续潜 token，形成显式-隐式交错的潜在架构。训练上引入 stepwise embedding forcing（把冗余步骤池化为单个潜嵌入）与 label forcing（用软多模态词表分布而非 one-hot 监督潜 token）。方向角同时编码局部语义与推理动态：小角对应直接执行与答案形成，大角多对应检查、纠错与分支探索，其时间变化揭示探索、收敛与精炼阶段。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3.5-9B 与 Qwen3.6-27B 上，覆盖六个域内与域外基准：平均准确率最高提升 2.6%，响应长度最多减半，单位计算量的准确率提升 2.29$\times$，预处理时间降低 94.6%，训练时间最多降低 80.3%。表示分析显示潜状态形成区别于文本状态的紧凑区域，潜 token 位置熵更高，反映更宽的软目标，促进更丰富的步骤级特征学习。
AI.conclusion: 以几何动态为指导的显式-隐式交错潜空间压缩，能在保留推理信息的同时显著降低 CoT 的计算与上下文成本，实现准确率与效率的双重改进。

title: SAFIRE: Safety-Critical Benchmark for Fine-grained Fire and Smoke Understanding in Multimodal LLMs
comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026 Findings. Project page: https://risys-lab.github.io/SAFIRE/ | Github: https://github.com/RISys-Lab/SAFIRE
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) show strong progress on vision-language tasks, yet their reliability in safety-critical settings remains underexplored. Fire-smoke understanding is central to public safety and disaster response, but most existing benchmarks lack diverse real-world scenarios and context-aware evaluation. We introduce SAFIRE, a large-scale benchmark for fire-smoke understanding in MLLMs, comprising 83K captioned images from 20 scenarios and 193K multiple-choice VQA (MCVQA) generated from a 9.7K-image subset, spanning 10 evaluation dimensions from basic perception to higher-order reasoning. A GPT-5.4-assisted multi-stage verification pipeline with MLLM majority voting ensures annotation quality. Evaluating ten open-source MLLMs (8B-38B) yields an average accuracy of 61.9%, exposing major gaps in safety-critical reasoning. We further show that adapting vision encoders with only 7% of our domain-specific data boosts fire-scene classification accuracy from 20.1% to 64.5%, indicating that carefully curated data can yield substantial gains even when data volume is limited. All datasets, models, and code are available at https://risys-lab.github.io/SAFIRE/.

AI.tldr: 提出SAFIRE基准，用于评估多模态大模型在火灾烟雾场景下的理解能力，包含83K图像和193K MCVQA，覆盖10个维度；十个开源模型平均准确率仅61.9%，且用7%领域数据适配视觉编码器可将火灾场景分类准确率从20.1%提升至64.5%。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型在视觉语言任务上进展显著，但在安全攸关场景中的可靠性仍缺乏探究。火灾烟雾理解对公共安全与灾害响应至关重要，而现有基准普遍缺乏多样化真实场景与上下文相关评估。
AI.method: 构建大规模基准SAFIRE：来自20个场景的83K带标注图像，并从9.7K图像子集中生成193K多选VQA题，涵盖从基础感知到高阶推理的10个评估维度；采用GPT-5.4辅助的多阶段验证流程结合MLLM多数投票以保证标注质量；评测十个开源MLLM（8B-38B），并开展领域视觉编码器适配实验。
AI.result: 十个开源MLLM平均准确率为61.9%，在安全攸关推理上存在明显差距；仅用7%领域特定数据适配视觉编码器，即可将火灾场景分类准确率从20.1%提升至64.5%。
AI.conclusion: SAFIRE揭示当前MLLM在火灾烟雾等安全关键理解任务上的可靠性不足，同时表明精心构建的小规模领域数据也能带来显著性能提升；数据集、模型与代码已公开。

authors: the LSST Dark Energy Science Collaboration
title: Neural Posterior Estimation for Tomographic Weak Lensing Mass Mapping
summary: Weak gravitational lensing shear and convergence trace the distribution of baryonic and dark matter across space, making them a powerful probe of cosmic structure. Inferring shear and convergence from images is a challenging inverse problem. The prevailing approach to this task estimates shear from weighted averages of galaxy ellipticities, calibrates these estimates to account for systematic biases, and transforms them to reconstruct convergence, a multistage procedure that requires substantial computational resources and meticulous handling of statistical uncertainties. As an alternative, we propose a probabilistic approach to field-level weak lensing inference in which we train a deep neural network to directly map a multiband image to a variational distribution over the underlying tomographic shear and convergence fields. This neural posterior estimation (NPE) procedure implicitly marginalizes over nuisance variables in the cosmological forward model and does not require evaluating the likelihood function. It is also amortized, so it enables rapid posterior inference for astronomical surveys once the neural network is trained. When evaluated on synthetic images from the LSST-DESC DC2 Simulated Sky Survey, NPE produces well-calibrated variational distributions for shear and convergence that are consistent with the ground truth. We describe how maps sampled from these variational distributions could be used in a subsequent simulation-based inference procedure to approximate the posterior distribution over cosmological parameters.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于神经后验估计(NPE)的概率方法，将多波段图像直接映射为层析剪切与收敛场的变分分布，实现场级弱引力透镜推断。
AI.motivation: 弱引力透镜的剪切与收敛可示踪重子与暗物质分布，是探测宇宙结构的强有力手段。但传统方法分多阶段：先从星系椭率的加权平均估计剪切，再校准系统偏差，最后转换重建收敛，流程繁琐、计算开销大且统计不确定度处理复杂。因此需要更高效、端到端的替代方案。
AI.method: 采用神经后验估计(NPE)的概率推断框架，训练深度神经网络直接将多波段图像映射为潜在层析剪切与收敛场的变分分布。该方法隐式边缘化宇宙学前向模型中的冗余变量，无需评估似然函数；且具有摊销性，网络训练完成后可对巡天数据快速推断。
AI.result: 在LSST-DESC DC2模拟巡天数据生成的合成图像上评估，NPE能给出良好校准的剪切与收敛变分分布，且与真值一致。
AI.conclusion: NPE为场级弱引力透镜推断提供了有效替代方案；从变分分布中采样的图后续可用于基于模拟的推断，以近似宇宙学参数的后验分布。

title: Scene Graph-Driven Haptic Feedback for Safety Enhancement in Robotic Ophthalmic Surgery via Physically Simulated iOCT
comment: 7 pages, 9 figures, 2 tables. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE RAS/EMBS 11th International Conference on Biomedical Robotics and Biomechatronicsnics (BioRob 2026)
summary: Robotic ophthalmic surgery offers high precision but introduces a "sensory gap" by decoupling the surgeon from their instrument, resulting in a loss of tactile feedback. This paper presents a novel haptic feedback system for subretinal injection tasks leveraging Scene Graphs (SG). The system bridges the sensory gap by analyzing a physically simulated intraoperative Optical Coherence Tomography (iOCT) feed to construct a real-time surgical SG. The SG serves as a semantic abstraction layer for the surgical scene, which is then utilized by a deterministic, rule-based engine to generate state-dependent haptic feedback on a robotic input device. The system was evaluated in a user study (N=16) using an anthropomorphic head phantom and a custom-built surgical robot. Results demonstrate that the SG-driven haptic feedback improved surgical precision, reducing needle alignment error by 14% (p = 0.044) and improving System Usability Scale (SUS) scores by 8% (p = 0.015), while maintaining comparable task completion times. A needle trajectory analysis revealed the emergence of a safer "Align-then-Approach" strategy, in which our haptic negative reinforcement prompted users to fine-tune the tool's trajectory before approaching the retinal target. This work suggests that SGs can effectively serve as the direct computational foundation for real-time, safety-enhancing context-aware haptic feedback in robotic microsurgery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于场景图（SG）的触觉反馈系统，用于机器人视网膜下注射任务，通过物理仿真iOCT构建实时手术场景图并驱动规则引擎生成状态相关触觉反馈，用户研究（N=16）表明其提升了手术精度与可用性。
AI.motivation: 机器人眼科手术虽精度高，但将术者与器械解耦，导致触觉反馈缺失，形成"感知鸿沟"（sensory gap）。
AI.method: 分析物理仿真的术中OCT（iOCT）数据流，构建实时手术场景图（SG）作为手术场景的语义抽象层；由确定性、基于规则的引擎利用该SG，在机器人输入设备上生成状态相关的触觉反馈。
AI.result: 在拟人头部体模与自研手术机器人上开展用户研究（N=16）：针尖对准误差降低14%（p=0.044），SUS评分提升8%（p=0.015），任务完成时间无显著差异；针轨迹分析显示出现更安全的"先对准后接近"（Align-then-Approach）策略。
AI.conclusion: 场景图可有效作为机器人显微外科中实时、增强安全性、情境感知触觉反馈的直接计算基础。

title: LLM Layers Immediately Correct Each Other
summary: Recent methods in language model interpretability employ techniques such as sparse autoencoders to decompose residual stream contributions into linear, semantically meaningful features. Such methods are commonly interpreted as identifying features that persist in the residual stream and that subsequent layers build upon. We challenge this view by identifying the Transformer Layer Correction Mechanism (TLCM), wherein adjacent transformer layers systematically counteract portions of each other's contributions. TLCM appears in 5 out of 7 major open-source model families and activates across nearly all tokens in diverse texts. We show that TLCM emerges during pretraining, operates most strongly on contextually dependent tokens, and adaptively calibrates its correction strength based on the preceding layer's output. Using the layer Jacobian, we further show that TLCM selectively corrects specific subspaces while reinforcing others, which we interpret through a ``propose-and-reject'' framework in which layers propose candidate features and subsequent layers selectively remove inappropriate ones. This dynamic suggests that the residual stream at any layer contains transient proposals alongside persistent features, helping explain why SAE feature descriptions often have low specificity, why effective model steering requires extreme feature amplification, and why transcoders hold a theoretical advantage over SAEs.

AI.tldr: 本文识别出Transformer层间校正机制（TLCM），即相邻层系统性地相互抵消部分贡献，并揭示残差流中同时存在短暂提议与持久特征。
AI.motivation: 主流可解释性方法（如稀疏自编码器）假设残差流特征为线性、持久且被后续层继承，但该假设可能不准确，需检验层间贡献的真实关系。
AI.method: 在7个主流开源模型家族中进行观测，追踪TLCM在预训练中的出现过程、对上下文依赖token的作用强度及基于前层输出的自适应校正；利用层雅可比矩阵分析子空间的校正与强化模式。
AI.result: TLCM存在于5/7个模型家族，几乎在所有token上激活；于预训练中出现，对上下文依赖token作用最强，并自适应调节校正强度；对特定子空间选择性校正。
AI.conclusion: 提出"提议-拒绝"框架：层提出候选特征，后续层选择性剔除不当特征；残差流含短暂提议与持久特征，可解释SAE特征描述特异性低、转向需极端放大、以及transcoder相对SAE具理论优势的原因。

title: Deadline-Aware Adaptive Prefill Chunking for Efficient Large Language Model Serving
summary: Continuous batching improves large language model (LLM) serving throughput, but long prompt prefills can delay decode iterations and violate inter-token latency objectives. Chunked prefill mitigates this interference, yet its chunk size is normally fixed: small chunks protect decode latency but repeatedly pay launch overhead, while large chunks improve prefill efficiency but create latency spikes. We introduce SLOWeave, an online scheduling method that selects the largest prefill chunk predicted to finish before the earliest active decode deadline. The decision requires no workload-specific chunk-size tuning and is computed by a logarithmic-time search over a monotone iteration-cost model. We prove that, whenever a decode-only iteration is feasible and the cost predictor is accurate, SLOWeave maximizes immediate prefill progress among decisions that preserve every active request's next-token deadline. We evaluate the method in a reproducible event-driven simulator and an iteration-level GPU runtime across chat, mixed-context, long-context, and bursty workloads. Under a 25ms time-per-output-token objective, SLOWeave improves goodput over the strongest fixed-chunk baseline by 39% on mixed requests and 38% on long-context requests. Under a stricter 10ms objective, the gains rise to 3.3$\times$ and 2.4$\times$, respectively. These results isolate adaptive chunk sizing as a useful serving primitive and provide an implementation-ready controller for integration with iteration-level LLM runtimes.

AI.tldr: 提出SLOWeave在线调度方法，自适应选择prefill分块大小以兼顾解码延迟与预填充效率，在多个负载下显著提升goodput。
AI.motivation: 连续批处理提升LLM服务吞吐，但长prompt预填充会延迟解码迭代、违反inter-token延迟目标；分块预填充可缓解干扰，但固定块大小存在两难：小块保护解码延迟却反复付出启动开销，大块提升预填充效率却造成延迟尖峰。因此需要无需负载特调的自适应分块调度。
AI.method: SLOWeave在线选择在最早活跃解码截止时间前完成的最大prefill分块；基于单调迭代成本模型进行对数时间搜索，无需工作负载相关的块大小调参。并证明在仅解码迭代可行且成本预测准确时，该方法在所有保住活跃请求下一token截止时间的决策中最大化即时预填充进展。评估采用可复现事件驱动模拟器及迭代级GPU运行时，覆盖chat、混合上下文、长上下文和突发负载。
AI.result: 在25ms每输出token目标下，SLOWeave相比最强固定分块基线在混合请求上提升goodput 39%，长上下文请求提升38%；在更严格的10ms目标下，提升分别达3.3倍和2.4倍。
AI.conclusion: 结果将自适应分块大小确立为一种有用的服务原语，并提供了可集成至迭代级LLM运行时的、可落地的控制器。

title: Are Image Generators Zero-Shot Perceivers? A Rigorous Evaluation
summary: Recent work, such as Vision Banana, shows that lightweight instruction tuning can enable an image generator to achieve state-of-the-art performance across multiple visual perception tasks. Motivated by this perspective, we ask how far image generators can go on public visual perception benchmarks in a zero-shot setting. We introduce ProbeGen, a benchmark for zero-shot generative perception that casts monocular depth estimation, referring/reasoning segmentation, and object counting as conditional generation tasks specified through text prompts, and compares 20 models in total---including proprietary and open-weight image generators, specialist perception models, and MLLMs---across 11 published benchmarks. We observe that pretrained image generators show measurable zero-shot perceptual competence, but with a clear trade-off: specialist models remain stronger for in-distribution accuracy and efficiency, while generative models are often more robust under distribution shift and better at compositional semantic reasoning. We hope this study helps establish zero-shot generative perception as a meaningful research direction and provides a useful foundation for future work at the intersection of visual generation and understanding.

AI.tldr: 提出 ProbeGen 基准，将深度估计、指代/推理分割和计数任务统一为文本条件生成任务，在 11 个公开基准上零样本对比 20 个模型，揭示生成模型在分布偏移鲁棒性与组合语义推理上更具优势。
AI.motivation: 受 Vision Banana 等工作启发——轻量指令微调即可让图像生成器在多个视觉感知任务上达到 SOTA，因此作者追问：在零样本设定下，图像生成器在公开视觉感知基准上究竟能走多远。
AI.method: 构建 ProbeGen 零样本生成式感知基准，将单目深度估计、指代/推理分割、目标计数三类任务统一建模为通过文本提示指定的条件生成任务；共比较 20 个模型，涵盖闭源与开源权重图像生成器、专用感知模型和多模态大模型（MLLM），覆盖 11 个已发表基准。
AI.result: 预训练图像生成器展现出可测量的零样本感知能力，但存在明显权衡：专用模型在同分布精度与效率上仍更强，而生成模型在分布偏移下往往更鲁棒，且在组合式语义推理上表现更好。
AI.conclusion: 该研究确立了零样本生成式感知作为一个有意义的研究方向，为视觉生成与理解交叉领域的后续工作提供了有用基础。

title: JEDI: JEPA-to-Edge Distillation for Efficient Cropland Segmentation from Satellite Imagery
summary: Large vision models provide useful representations for remote-sensing segmentation but are often too expensive for deployment at the satellite or field edge. Existing feature-level distillation methods also tend to assume similar teacher and student architectures and often stop feature alignment when task training begins. We introduce JEDI (JEPA-to-Edge Distillation), a two-stage framework that transfers representations from a large I-JEPA Vision Transformer teacher to a compact SegFormer student. First, JEDI aligns the student's terminal representation with the teacher's token space using cross-architecture projection and spatial alignment. It then jointly optimizes supervised segmentation, temperature-scaled response distillation, and persistent feature alignment throughout task adaptation. On CalCROP21, JEDI-B0 achieves 68.0 mean Intersection-over-Union (mIoU) with 4.04M parameters, improving over the standalone student by 16.0 points and coming within 2.0 points of the 70.0 mIoU achieved by the 639M-parameter teacher. We evaluate SegFormer B0, B1, and B2 students with 4.04M, 14.33M, and 28M parameters, respectively. Across all three variants, JEDI consistently outperforms response-, structure-, channel-, and relational-distillation baselines under the same teacher-student setting. These results show that persistent representation alignment is especially valuable under aggressive compression, substantially reducing model size and computation while preserving segmentation performance.

AI.tldr: JEDI 是一个两阶段蒸馏框架，将大型 I-JEPA ViT 教师模型的表征迁移到紧凑的 SegFormer 学生模型，通过跨架构投影、空间对齐及任务适配期间的持续特征对齐，在遥感分割上实现大幅压缩下的性能保持。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉模型虽能提供有效的遥感分割表征，但在卫星或边缘端部署代价过高；现有特征级蒸馏方法通常假设教师与学生架构相似，且在任务训练开始后便停止特征对齐，限制了跨架构与激进压缩场景下的效果。
AI.method: 提出 JEDI（JEPA-to-Edge Distillation）两阶段框架：第一阶段用跨架构投影与空间对齐，将学生模型的终端表征与教师的 token 空间对齐；第二阶段在任务适配过程中联合优化监督分割、温度缩放响应蒸馏和持续特征对齐。教师为大型 I-JEPA ViT，学生为紧凑 SegFormer（B0/B1/B2）。
AI.result: 在 CalCROP21 上，JEDI-B0 以 4.04M 参数达到 68.0 mIoU，比独立学生提升 16.0 点，与 639M 参数教师（70.0 mIoU）仅差 2.0 点。评估了 4.04M、14.33M、28M 参数的 B0/B1/B2 三种学生，JEDI 在相同师生设定下均持续优于响应、结构、通道和关系蒸馏基线。
AI.conclusion: 持续表征对齐在激进压缩下尤为有价值，能在显著降低模型规模与计算量的同时保持分割性能，为遥感分割的卫星与边缘部署提供了有效的跨架构蒸馏方案。

title: Poisson Image Denoising Using Minimax Concave and Reweighted $\ell_1$ Penalties: Nonblind and Blind Approaches
summary: Images are important tools in various sciences. Despite the development of photo-taking tools, creating clear and image without noise remains challenging in practice. In particular, Poisson noise has an effect on medical and astronomical images, and reduces their quality. Additionally, blur is another factor that has an effect on image quality. The problem of image restoration becomes very complicated when we have no information about the Point Spread Function (PSF). These types of problems are known as blind case. However, in some images, such as some astronomical images, the type of PSF can be specified, and these types of problems are known as nonblind problems. Total Variation (TV) is a widely used method for solving such inverse problems, where the selection of the penalty function is the most critical factor that affects the method's performance. In this paper, to improve edge preservation, we employ a reweighted $\ell_1$-regularization of the fractional order derivative. Furthermore, we propose a nonblind and blind image deblurring approach under Poisson noise using the Minimax Concave Penalty (MCP), which is a continuous, sparsity promoting, and nearly unbiased regularizer. This formulation leads to a nonconvex optimization model. To solve the proposed model, we introduce an efficient numerical algorithm based on the Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) and provide an analysis of its convergence. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm are demonstrated through extensive experiments on various images.

AI.tldr: 本文针对泊松噪声下的非盲与盲图像去模糊问题，提出基于分数阶导数重加权ℓ1正则化与Minimax Concave Penalty（MCP）的非凸优化模型，并采用ADMM求解，附收敛性分析，实验验证了算法有效性。
AI.motivation: 医学与天文图像常受泊松噪声与模糊影响，质量下降。传统全变分（TV）方法在正则项选择上对性能影响显著，且盲情形下缺乏PSF信息使问题更复杂。为了在泊松噪声下去模糊并改善边缘保持，需要更优的稀疏正则化方案。
AI.method: 采用分数阶导数的重加权ℓ1正则化以提升边缘保持；引入连续、促进稀疏且近似无偏的Minimax Concave Penalty（MCP），构建非盲与盲图像去模糊的非凸优化模型；基于交替方向乘子法（ADMM）设计高效数值算法，并进行收敛性分析。
AI.result: 在多种图像上的大量实验表明，所提算法在泊松噪声下的去模糊效果有效（摘要未给出具体量化指标）。
AI.conclusion: 所提基于分数阶重加权ℓ1与MCP的非凸模型及ADMM算法，可同时处理泊松噪声下的非盲与盲去模糊，改善边缘保持，并通过实验验证其有效性。

title: Prevalence calibration as shortcut mitigation
comment: Accepted at the 17th International Workshop on Machine Learning in Medical Imaging (MLMI 2026), held in conjunction with MICCAI 2026. 11 pages, 2 figures
summary: Shortcut learning denotes the widespread situation in which a classifier exploits spurious correlations rather than diagnostic features. Existing mitigation strategies mostly aim to learn shortcut-invariant representations; their empirical success is limited and they cannot be applied to classifiers using frozen foundation model encoders. We propose to reframe shortcut learning as fundamentally a calibration problem: unconstrained learning implicitly calibrates each shortcut group to its training set disease prevalence, rendering the resulting classifier necessarily over-confident in one group and under-confident in the other. Building on this insight, we prevalence-equalize calibration between shortcut groups through two encoder-agnostic methods, an in-processing regularizer and a post-hoc prevalence-equalized recalibration step. Across chest-drain-pneumothorax benchmarks on CheXpert and SIIM-ACR, spanning fine-tuned CNNs and frozen foundation-model backbones, both methods substantially outperform all baselines. Post-hoc recalibration of a standard ERM-trained DenseNet raises misaligned-group AUROC from 0.23 to 0.73, indicating that shortcut reliance degrades the classification head rather than the underlying representation. Besides two new state-of-the-art shortcut mitigation approaches, our findings more fundamentally connect shortcut learning to calibration theory and algorithmic fairness.

AI.tldr: 将捷径学习重构为校准问题，通过患病率均衡校准（正则化与事后重校准）缓解捷径依赖，在胸管气胸基准上显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 现有缓解捷径学习的方法多致力于学习捷径不变表示，经验效果有限，且无法应用于使用冻结基础模型编码器的分类器。
AI.method: 将捷径学习视为校准问题：无约束学习会隐式地把每个捷径组校准到其训练集疾病患病率，导致分类器在一组过度自信、另一组信心不足。据此提出两种与编码器无关的方法实现捷径组间的患病率均衡校准：训练中正则化器、事后患病率均衡重校准。
AI.result: 在CheXpert与SIIM-ACR的胸管气胸基准上，涵盖微调CNN与冻结基础模型骨干，两种方法均大幅优于所有基线。对标准ERM训练的DenseNet做事后重校准，使错配组AUROC从0.23提升至0.73。
AI.conclusion: 提示捷径依赖损害的是分类头而非底层表示；不仅提出两种新的最优捷径缓解方法，更在根本上将捷径学习与校准理论及算法公平性联系起来。

title: TDDN: Text-aligned Diffused DINO Network for Puzzle Understanding
summary: Structured visual reasoning, such as image puzzles, demands fine-grained visual perception, which current Vision Language Models (VLMs) often lack. VLMs built on CLIP-based ViT backbones tend to trade fine-grained visual details for high-level semantics. We show that this deficit propagates downstream, affecting various vision and language tasks. To address this, we fuse DINOv3 and CleanDIFT representations into a perception encoder (DiffusedDINO), and align it with RoBERTa-L, yielding a text-aligned model (TDDN) that preserves this perceptual advantage: with frozen backbones and only ~590K alignment pairs, TDDN surpasses CLIP ViT-L/14 in image-text retrieval tasks: text-to-image on Flickr30K and both directions on MS-COCO-2014. TDDN more than triples CLIP's dense-prediction accuracy (ADE20K 5.20 -> 18.11 mIoU, COCO-Stuff 7.35 -> 24.44), despite CLIP's massive training corpus. TDDN leads on segmentation benchmarks among general-purpose contrastive encoders, including SigLIP 2. We further introduce PuzzlePerception, a segmentation and visual question answering dataset that probes fine-grained spatial understanding, on which TDDN doubles CLIP's segmentation accuracy (11.04 -> 22.51 mIoU). Our code and data are available at https://github.com/adityaSomak/TDDN.

AI.tldr: 本文针对CLIP系VLM细粒度视觉感知不足的问题，提出融合DINOv3与CleanDIFT的感知编码器DiffusedDINO，并与RoBERTa-L对齐得到TDDN，在检索、分割与细粒度空间理解任务上显著超越CLIP。
AI.motivation: 结构化视觉推理（如图像谜题）需要细粒度视觉感知，而当前基于CLIP-ViT骨干的视觉语言模型为追求高层语义而牺牲了细粒度细节，且该缺陷会向下游多种视觉与语言任务传播。
AI.method: 融合DINOv3与CleanDIFT表示构建感知编码器DiffusedDINO，再与RoBERTa-L对齐，得到文本对齐模型TDDN；冻结骨干，仅使用约590K对齐对训练；同时构建PuzzlePerception数据集用于探测细粒度空间理解。
AI.result: TDDN在图文检索上超过CLIP ViT-L/14（Flickr30K文到图、MS-COCO-2014双向）；稠密预测精度大幅提升（ADE20K 5.20→18.11 mIoU，COCO-Stuff 7.35→24.44）；在通用对比编码器中分割领先（含SigLIP 2）；PuzzlePerception上分割精度翻倍（11.04→22.51 mIoU）。
AI.conclusion: 通过保留细粒度感知的编码器对齐策略，TDDN以极小对齐数据量在检索、分割与空间理解任务上全面超越CLIP系模型，验证了细粒度视觉感知对下游任务的关键价值。

title: Bottom-up Modeling of Repeated Elements via Single Image Analysis-by-Synthesis
summary: We address the problem of discovering repeated elements from a single image. In contrast to existing approaches that depend on large annotated datasets, curated multi-image collections, or object segmentation masks, we show that a single image can suffice to learn a meaningful object model in a completely bottom-up fashion, without any prior knowledge beyond a coarse scale prior. Our method learns a tunable image-space prototype of the repeated elements through a reconstruction objective, enabling the model to identify and synthesize consistent object instances within the same image. Experiments on 116 real images from the FSC-147 dataset demonstrate that our method successfully learns coherent element models and captures intra-category variation on challenging images. Qualitative results reveal superior reconstructions and interpretable decompositions compared to classical decomposition, joint alignment, and 3D object modeling methods, while maintaining a simple 2D formulation. These results suggest that meaningful object discovery can emerge from single image learning alone.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种纯自底向上的方法，仅用单张图像即可学习重复元素的图像空间原型，实现重复元素发现与重建，在FSC-147数据集上优于经典分解、联合对齐和3D建模方法。
AI.motivation: 现有重复元素发现方法依赖大规模标注数据集、精心整理的多图像集合或目标分割掩码，成本高且限制适用性。作者希望探索在几乎无先验知识（仅粗尺度先验）条件下，单张图像是否足以学习有意义的物体模型。
AI.method: 方法通过重建目标学习一个可调的图像空间原型（image-space prototype）表示重复元素，完全自底向上，无需分割掩码或外部标注，仅使用粗尺度先验，使模型能识别并合成同一图像内一致的物体实例。采用简单的2D公式。
AI.result: 在FSC-147数据集的116张真实图像上，方法成功学习到连贯的元素模型并捕捉类内变化。定性结果显示，相比经典分解、联合对齐和3D物体建模方法，重建效果更优、分解更具可解释性，同时保持简单的2D形式。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，有意义的物体发现可以仅通过单图像学习实现，为重复元素发现提供了无需大规模标注或多图像集合的新思路。

title: ReactVAU: A Slow-Fast Decoupled Framework for Streaming Video Anomaly Understanding
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Project page: https://huiyuiui.github.io/ReactVAU/
summary: In this paper, we propose ReactVAU, a Slow-Fast Decoupled Framework for real-time streaming Video Anomaly Understanding (VAU). Existing VAU methods rely on offline inference with global temporal sampling, which violates causality and prevents deployment in live surveillance streams. Conversely, general streaming video models satisfy causal access but dilute rare transient anomalies during memory compression and often invoke heavyweight MLLMs uniformly over long normal intervals. React VAU addresses this gap with three synergistic components: a lightweight Fast Detection Module based on Spatial Grid Folding (SGF) for continuous anomaly filtering; an Anomaly-Aware Persistent Memory (AAPM) that protects critical visual cues from temporal decay; and a heavyweight Slow Reasoning Module that remains dormant during normal streams and is awakened only by suspicious events for semantic verification and causal description. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that ReactVAU operates under strict streaming constraints while simultaneously achieving competitive performance in both anomaly detection and causal reasoning, alongside significantly enhanced computational efficiency by minimizing heavyweight MLLM invocations. Project page is available at https://huiyuiui.github.io/ReactVAU/

AI.tldr: 提出 ReactVAU，一种用于实时流式视频异常理解（VAU）的慢-快解耦框架，在严格流式约束下兼顾检测与因果推理，并显著降低重载 MLLM 调用开销。
AI.motivation: 现有 VAU 方法依赖离线推理与全局时间采样，违背因果性，无法部署于实时监控流；而通用流式视频模型虽满足因果访问，却在记忆压缩中稀释稀有瞬态异常，并对长时正常区间无差别调用重载 MLLM，算力浪费严重。
AI.method: 设计三个协同组件：1）基于空间网格折叠（SGF）的轻量快速检测模块，实现连续异常过滤；2）异常感知持久记忆（AAPM），保护关键视觉线索免受时间衰减影响；3）重载慢速推理模块，正常流期间休眠，仅被可疑事件唤醒以进行语义验证与因果描述。
AI.result: 在多个基准上的大量实验表明，ReactVAU 在严格流式约束下运行，于异常检测与因果推理两项任务上均取得有竞争力的性能，同时通过最小化重载 MLLM 调用显著提升计算效率。
AI.conclusion: ReactVAU 通过慢-快解耦与事件触发式推理，弥合了因果流式访问与高质量异常理解之间的鸿沟，为实时监控场景下的 VAU 提供了高效可行方案。

title: CausalVerify: End-to-End Verification of Causal Analyses by Language Models
comment: 38 pages, 14 figures, 19 tables. v2 is a substantially revised version with a new title: it adds the layered verification framework and the paired paper-to-execution study with an oracle substitution arm. Code and data of the v1 release: https://github.com/causalverify/causalverify
summary: Language models increasingly perform empirical analyses end to end, yet existing evaluations assess the written explanation or whether generated code executes, not whether the executed workflow recovers the intended causal estimand. We introduce CausalVerify, an execution-grounded benchmark for end-to-end causal analysis that follows a model from research-context interpretation to estimand recovery. It scores this workflow at four distinct layers: method recognition, design specification, executable implementation, and estimand recovery. It combines 259 real-paper contexts, 100 fixed-seed synthetic scenarios with executable reference estimates, and 23 paper-twin pairs in which a model commits to a design before seeing the data and its executed analysis is scored against a canonical estimator on the same realised dataset. Execution is not correctness. Among 426 model-written workflows that run without error, 15.5% fail verification, and a keyword score of the effect direction stated in the text is a poor proxy for recovery. In a 23-pair, nine-model paired study, replacing a model's committed design with the reference design and its execution conventions raises joint recovery of the point estimate and standard error from 15.0% to 51.5%; yet 48.5% of eligible seeds still fail under the reference design. The direction replicates on six pairs built afterwards under a frozen construction protocol, although on the two newest pairs the gain is confined to models from the family that built the references. Design specification is consequential but not sufficient: a plausible method and runnable code do not guarantee recovery, and even supplying the reference design and its conventions leaves substantial downstream failure. CausalVerify evaluates the executed workflow rather than its surface plausibility, and every reported number is recomputed from frozen artifacts by a single script.

AI.tldr: 提出CausalVerify——一个以执行为基础的端到端因果分析基准，从研究情境解读到估计量恢复全过程评分，揭示"代码能跑≠因果正确"。
AI.motivation: 现有评估只考察文字解释或生成代码能否运行，而不检验所执行的工作流是否恢复了预期的因果估计量，缺乏对端到端因果分析真实正确性的评测。
AI.method: 构建四层评分框架（方法识别、设计规格、可执行实现、估计量恢复），整合259个真实论文情境、100个固定随机种子且带可执行参考估计的合成场景，以及23对"论文孪生"（模型先承诺设计再见数据，其执行分析在同一实际数据集上与规范估计量对比）；所有数字由单一脚本从冻结产物重算。
AI.result: 426个无报错运行的工作流中15.5%未通过验证，文本中效应方向的关键词得分是恢复效果的差代理；23对、9个模型的配对研究中，将模型承诺设计替换为参考设计及其执行约定，使点估计与标准误的联合恢复率从15.0%升至51.5%，但仍有48.5%的合格种子失败；方向在后续按冻结流程构建的6对上可复现，但最新2对的增益仅局限于构建参考的模型家族。
AI.conclusion: 设计规格虽有决定性影响但不充分：合理方法与可运行代码无法保证估计量恢复，即便给出参考设计及其约定，下游仍存在大量失败；应评估实际执行的工作流而非其表面合理性。

title: Subagents vs Agent Skills: Executing Reusable Knowledge for Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks
summary: How can language model agents effectively leverage libraries of reusable knowledge to solve long-horizon tasks? Recent work has increasingly focused on agent skills: reusable capabilities represented as skill packages, i.e., multi-file bundles containing instructions, scripts, and other resources that help agents perform specific tasks. Agent skills are typically executed by loading their skill instructions into an agent's context and relying on the agent to follow them. As task horizons grow, however, this approach becomes increasingly brittle, because reasoning quality degrades as more information accumulates in the context window. We investigate an alternative approach in which skill packages are instead invoked as subagents. Rather than loading skill instructions into the main context, subagent execution spawns fresh context windows dedicated to solving individual subtasks. We show that subagent execution outperforms agent-skill execution when skill packages expose clear input-output contracts and their instructions encode the procedural knowledge needed to fulfill those contracts. The tradeoff is additional communication overhead, as extra tokens are required to coordinate between the main agent and its subagents. Our results show that the benefit of reusable knowledge depends not only on its content, but also on how it is organized and invoked.

AI.tldr: 该论文探索将agent skills（可复用技能包）以subagent方式调用，而非把指令加载进主上下文；在技能包具有明确输入输出契约且指令编码程序性知识时，subagent执行优于agent-skill执行，代价是额外的通信开销。
AI.motivation: 长时程任务中，主agent上下文窗口会随任务推进不断累积信息，导致推理质量下降；传统做法是把技能指令加载进上下文并依赖agent自行遵循，随着任务horizon变长变得愈发脆弱。因此需要研究可复用知识应如何被组织和调用。
AI.method: 对比两种执行范式：一是agent-skill执行，即把技能包指令载入主agent上下文；二是subagent执行，即为每个子任务开新的上下文窗口，将技能包作为subagent调用。技能包为多文件捆绑包，包含instructions、scripts及其他资源。分析在何种条件下subagent执行更优。
AI.result: 当技能包暴露清晰的输入—输出契约，且其instructions编码了完成该契约所需的程序性知识时，subagent执行优于agent-skill执行。代价是额外的通信开销：主agent与subagent之间协调需要消耗额外tokens。
AI.conclusion: 可复用知识带来的收益不仅取决于其内容本身，还取决于它如何被组织与调用（即组织方式与调用方式）。
