title: $α$-Graph: Attention-Infused Normalizing Flow Approach to Tractable Graph Modeling
summary: Graph modeling, a crucial task for representing complex relationships in graph-structured data, has achieved significant success in recent years. However, current graph modeling methods rely on traditional Graph Neural Networks and pre-training approaches to implicitly learn the underlying relational structure of graph data. Thus, these prior methods cannot capture the complex graph structure and correlations among inputs. In this paper, we introduce a novel Attention-based Normalizing Flow-based Approach\footnote{Our implementation and models will be released publicly for research reproducibility.} (ANFA or $α$) that provides an explicit, interpretable, and tractable Graph Modeling ($α$-Graph). In particular, we propose a new Unconditional Graph Normalizing Flow with an Invertible Attention Mechanism to capture the complex relational structure of graph data. To further enhance the expressiveness of the model, we introduce Conditional Graph Normalizing Flow with Learnable Queries that enables efficient modeling of correlations in graph-structured data. We show that our Conditional Graph Normalizing Flows behave similarly to Unconditional Graph Normalizing Flows, enhancing expressiveness while maintaining training stability and efficiency. Our experimental results on three benchmarks will illustrate the effectiveness and the state-of-the-art (SoTA) performance of the proposed $α$-Graph method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于注意力机制的正则化流方法ANFA（α），通过可逆注意力机制与可学习查询的条件图正则化流，实现显式、可解释且可 tractable 的图建模（α-Graph），在三个基准上取得SoTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有图建模方法依赖传统图神经网络与预训练手段，仅能隐式学习图数据底层关系结构，无法充分捕捉复杂的图结构与输入间的相关性，缺乏显式性与可解释性。
AI.method: 提出ANFA框架：1）设计带可逆注意力机制的无条件图正则化流，以捕捉图数据的复杂关系结构；2）引入带可学习查询的条件图正则化流，提升模型表达能力并高效建模图结构数据中的相关性；并证明条件流与无条件流行为相似，在增强表达能力的同时保持训练稳定性与效率。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集上的实验结果表明，所提出的α-Graph方法有效，并达到当前最先进（SoTA）性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入基于注意力机制的正则化流，可在显式、可解释且可 tractable 的框架下完成图建模，条件图正则化流在保持稳定与高效训练的同时增强了表达能力，验证了该方法的有效性与优越性。

title: Rethinking Sign Language Translation: The Impact of Signer Dependence on Model Evaluation
comment: 13 pages. Published in Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2025
summary: Sign Language Translation has advanced with deep learning, yet evaluations remain largely signer-dependent, with overlapping signers across train/dev/test. This raises concerns about whether models truly generalise or instead rely on signer-specific regularities. We conduct signer-fold cross-validation on GFSLT-VLP, GASLT, and SignCL, three leading, publicly available, gloss-free SLT models, on CSL-Daily and PHOENIX14T. Under signer-independent evaluation, performance drops sharply: on PHOENIX14T, GFSLT-VLP falls from BLEU-4 21.44 to 3.59 and ROUGE-L 42.49 to 11.89; GASLT from 15.74 to 8.26; and SignCL from 22.74 to 3.66. We also observe that in CSL-Daily many target sentences are performed by multiple signers, so common splits can place identical sentences in both training and test, inflating absolute scores by rewarding recall of recurring sentences rather than genuine generalisation. These findings indicate that signer-dependent evaluation can substantially overestimate SLT capability. We recommend: (1) adopting signer-independent protocols to ensure generalisation to unseen signers; (2) restructuring datasets to include explicit signer-independent, sentence-disjoint splits for consistent benchmarking; and (3) reporting both signer-dependent and signer-independent results together with train-test sentence overlap to improve transparency and comparability.

AI.tldr: 本文对GFSLT-VLP、GASLT、SignCL三个无 gloss 手语翻译模型在CSL-Daily与PHOENIX14T上进行 signer-fold 交叉验证，发现在 signer-independent 评估下性能大幅下降，且部分数据划分存在同句跨训练/测试的重叠，导致评分被高估。
AI.motivation: 现有手语翻译评估大多与说话人（签名者）相关，训练/验证/测试集中存在签名者重叠，难以判断模型是真正泛化还是依赖签名者特有规律；此外 CSL-Daily 中同一目标句可能由多位签名者演绎，常见划分会把相同句子同时放入训练与测试，通过奖励对重复句的召回抬高绝对分数。
AI.method: 在 CSL-Daily 与 PHOENIX14T 上，对 GFSLT-VLP、GASLT、SignCL 三个公开的无 gloss 手语翻译模型开展以签名者分组的交叉验证（signer-fold cross-validation），进行签名者独立评估；同时分析训练—测试句子重叠情况。
AI.result: 签名者独立评估下性能急剧下降：PHOENIX14T 上 GFSLT-VLP 的 BLEU-4 由 21.44 降至 3.59，ROUGE-L 由 42.49 降至 11.89；GASLT 由 15.74 降至 8.26；SignCL 由 22.74 降至 3.66。CSL-Daily 中存在大量同一目标句由多签名者演绎、训练与测试重复出现的情况。
AI.conclusion: 签名者相关评估会显著高估手语翻译能力。建议：(1) 采用签名者独立协议以检验对未见签名者的泛化；(2) 重构数据集，提供显式的签名者独立、句子不相交划分以支持一致的基准测试；(3) 同时报告签名者相关与独立结果，并披露训练—测试句子重叠，以提升透明度与可比性。

title: Reasoning Beyond Transcription: Audio Language Models on Child Stuttering Speech
summary: Child speech differs from adult speech in acoustics, prosody, and linguistic structures. Speech disfluencies (such as repetitions) further challenge automatic understanding. While Audio Language Models (ALMs) show strong semantic reasoning from speech audio, their ability to reason about disfluent child speech in mixed-speaker settings remains unexplored. We investigate this through two tasks: child-focused semantic summarization and speech entailment. Experiments use recordings of children who stutter in mixed speaker interviews without explicit speaker separation. Models are instruction-guided to focus on the child, preserve clinically relevant disfluencies, and avoid adult-speech leakage. Evaluation combines LLM-based judges and reference-based metrics, anchored by transcript-oracle baselines to isolate errors. Results show that while ALMs extract high-level meaning from stuttered speech, reasoning degrades significantly with increased

AI.tldr: 本文研究音频语言模型（ALMs）在混合说话人场景下对儿童口吃语音的语义推理能力，设置儿童聚焦摘要与语音蕴含两项任务，结果显示ALMs能提取高层语义，但随口吃程度增加推理性能显著下降。
AI.motivation: 儿童语音在声学、韵律与语言结构上均与成人语音不同，且语音不流畅（如重复）进一步增加自动理解难度。尽管ALMs在语音语义推理上表现强劲，但其在混合说话人、含不流畅现象的儿童语音上的推理能力尚未被探索。
AI.method: 采用两项任务：儿童聚焦语义摘要与语音蕴含。实验使用未做显式说话人分离的混合说话人访谈录音，受试为口吃儿童。通过指令引导模型聚焦儿童、保留临床相关的不流畅现象并避免成人语音泄漏。评估结合LLM评判与基于参考的指标，并以转录文本oracle基线为锚点以隔离错误来源。
AI.result: ALMs能从口吃语音中提取高层语义，但随着不流畅程度（口吃程度）增加，推理性能显著下降。
AI.conclusion: 当前ALMs在处理混合说话人、含不流畅现象的儿童语音时仍存在明显局限，尤其在口吃严重时语义推理退化显著，表明该方向需进一步发展。

title: MeRoTune: RoPE-Safe Merging with a Tunable Dial
summary: When you merge two fine-tuned models from the same base checkpoint by simply averaging their weights, you implicitly assume their attention subspaces are still aligned. Recent work attempts to fix misalignments by learning an invertible correction matrix, $M$, for each model's query and key projections. This correction cancels out---using $M$ on the query side and $M^{-T}$ on the key side---right before the dot product. However, this cancellation is only exact if nothing sits between the projection and the dot product. In reality, almost all modern open-weight language models put a rotary position embedding (RoPE) exactly there. In this paper, we show that this cancellation is exact under RoPE if and only if $M$ commutes with RoPE's per-position rotation. We derive the specific class of matrices where this holds: a scaled rotation acting independently within each RoPE frequency pair. This forms a strict, low-dimensional subset of the unconstrained matrices that current methods normally train. Building on this, we turn this constrained matrix class into a new merging method. While keeping the base weights entirely frozen, two fine-tunes each learn their own RoPE-compliant correction matrices. We optimize these corrections against a chosen blend ratio so the final result can be adjusted post-hoc like a dial, rather than locked into a single fixed merge. Our default approach trains at one fixed blend ratio, similar to how LoRA sets its scaling hyperparameter in advance. We also experiment with resampling the blend ratio randomly at every training step, and we report the results of both approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文指出在RoPE存在时，现有通过可逆校正矩阵对齐注意力子空间的模型合并方法只在M与RoPE逐位置旋转可交换时才精确成立；满足条件的M构成"每个RoPE频率对内独立的缩放旋转"这一低维约束类。作者据此提出一种新的合并方法：冻结基座权重，让两个微调模型各自学习RoPE兼容的校正矩阵，并围绕选定混合比例优化，使最终合并可在事后像旋钮一样调节。
AI.motivation: 直接对同源微调模型做权重平均隐含假设注意力子空间已对齐，而近期工作用可逆校正矩阵M修正失配：查询侧用M、键侧用M^{-T}，在校点积前相互抵消。但该抵消只有在投影与点积之间没有任何算子时才严格成立；现实中几乎所有现代开放权重语言模型恰好在此处放置了RoPE，因此原有推导在真实架构下并不严格，需要重新刻画在RoPE下校正能精确抵消的条件。
AI.method: 首先给出理论条件：在RoPE下校正精确抵消当且仅当M与RoPE的逐位置旋转可交换；进而推导出满足该条件的矩阵类——在每个RoPE频率对内独立作用的缩放旋转，这是当前方法通常训练的无约束矩阵的一个严格低维子集。随后把该受限矩阵类构造为新的合并方法：保持基座权重完全冻结，两个微调模型各自学习RoPE兼容的校正矩阵，并面向选定的混合比例进行优化，使结果可在事后调节。默认做法是在一个固定混合比例上训练（类似LoRA预先设定缩放超参数），另实验了每步随机重采样混合比例，并报告两种方案的结果。
AI.result: 论文推导出RoPE下校正精确抵消的充要条件，即M与逐位置旋转可交换，并刻画了对应矩阵类为各RoPE频率对内独立的缩放旋转，证明其是当前无约束训练矩阵的严格低维子集。方法层面实现了冻结基座、两微调各自学习RoPE兼容校正并支持事后混合比例调节的合并流程，报告了固定混合比例训练与每步随机重采样混合比例两种方案的实验表现。
AI.conclusion: 现有的可逆校正合并方法忽略了RoPE位于投影与点积之间这一事实，其精确抵消仅在受限条件下成立。将校正矩阵限制为RoPE兼容的缩放旋转类，既能保持理论上的精确性，又能把合并结果变为可事后调节的"旋钮"，为同源微调模型的合并提供了更契合现代架构的途径。

title: TaskGuard: Task-Conditioned Restoration Utility for Risk-Aware Object Detection
comment: 15 pages total: 9-page main paper with 4 figures and 4 tables; 6-page supplementary material with 2 figures and 8 tables
summary: Image restoration is commonly applied before object detection under adverse conditions, yet a visually improved image need not improve the downstream task. We study this mismatch as restoration utility prediction: given a degraded image and its candidate restoration, should the restoration be used or should the original observation be preserved? We introduce TaskGuard, a post-hoc controller for frozen restoration and detection pipelines. TaskGuard characterizes the realized restoration residual through its interaction with detector sensitivity and predicts whether the intervention is task-beneficial. Exact regional counterfactuals reveal substantial within-image utility heterogeneity, while a deployable pseudo-gradient preserves statistically reliable directional information. Feature-group ablation further shows that task-conditioned evidence contributes information beyond detector-response and residual statistics. The TaskGuard utility predictor is trained only on Gaussian degradation and frozen before final evaluation, then transferred to unseen motion blur, rain, and defocus. Across these unseen families, TaskGuard reduces lossnegative interventions by 54.2% (family macro) and practical per-image detection deteriorations by 37.0% (pooled), while preserving 98.8% of the Always-Restore COCO AP. On natural-rain DAWN, it reduces loss-negative interventions by 97.9% while retaining 77.8% of the AP improvement obtained by deraining. These results support restoration utility as a task-conditioned property of the specific intervention rather than image appearance alone.

AI.tldr: 提出TaskGuard：一个后置控制器，用于预测先复原后检测流程中"该复原结果是否对下游检测任务有益"，从而决定采用复原图还是保留原退化观测。
AI.motivation: 图像复原常用于恶劣条件下的目标检测，但视觉上改善的图像未必提升下游任务性能，这种"复原—任务不匹配"问题缺乏系统性研究。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为复原效用预测；TaskGuard对冻结的复原与检测流程做后置控制，通过复原残差与检测器敏感性的交互刻画效用。用精确区域反事实刻画图内效用异质性，用可部署的伪梯度保留方向信息，并通过特征组消融验证任务条件证据的额外贡献。预测器仅在高斯退化上训练并在评测前冻结，再迁移到运动模糊、雨、失焦等未见退化。
AI.result: 在未见退化族上，损失为负的干预减少54.2%（族宏平均），逐图实际检测退化减少37.0%（合并），保留Always-Restore COCO AP的98.8%；在自然雨DAWN上，损失为负的干预减少97.9%，同时保留去雨带来的77.8% AP增益。
AI.conclusion: 复原效用是特定干预的任务条件属性，而非仅由图像外观决定；验证了在不改动现有流程的前提下选择性采用复原结果的有效性。

title: A Black-Box Adversarial Attack on Human Pose Estimation and Keypoint-Based Action Recognition Models
summary: Human pose estimation and keypoint-based action recognition models are increasingly deployed as components of video understanding pipelines, yet their vulnerability to adversarial attacks remains insufficiently studied. Temporally coherent black-box attacks have been previously studied in visual object tracking, where the attack feedback can be defined using bounding-box overlap measures such as Intersection over Union (IoU). However, human pose estimation produces keypoint configurations rather than enclosing boxes, making box-level similarity poorly suited for measuring pose degradation. We propose OKS Attack, a decision-based black-box attack that uses Object Keypoint Similarity (OKS) as the attack feedback signal, directly targeting the spatial structure of human poses rather than their enclosing boxes. Experiments on the Penn Action dataset show that OKS Attack consistently reduces pose quality across evaluated pose estimators, with mean OKS decreases ranging from 0.0802 to 0.1494. In a downstream cross-dataset action-recognition evaluation, the attack reduces accuracy by 6.18 to 13.86 percentage points and outperforms query-matched random-noise perturbations. The attack is effective across both top-down and single-stage pose estimation models. The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/KacperM33/OKS_attack

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OKS Attack，一种基于决策的黑盒攻击方法，直接以 Object Keypoint Similarity（OKS）作为攻击反馈信号，针对人体姿态估计的关键点空间结构进行攻击，并在下游动作识别任务中验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 人体姿态估计与基于关键点的动作识别模型日益被用于视频理解流水线，但其对抗攻击脆弱性研究不足。已有的时序相干黑盒攻击主要针对视觉目标跟踪，其攻击反馈依赖边界框重叠度量（如 IoU）；然而姿态估计产生的是关键点构型而非包围框，框级相似度无法有效衡量姿态退化。
AI.method: 提出 OKS Attack，一种基于决策的黑盒攻击方法，采用 OKS 作为攻击反馈信号，直接针对人体姿态的空间结构而非包围框。方法无需模型内部信息，属于决策式黑盒范式。
AI.result: 在 Penn Action 数据集上，OKS Attack 在各评估的姿态估计器上持续降低姿态质量，平均 OKS 下降 0.0802 至 0.1494。在下游跨数据集动作识别评估中，准确率下降 6.18 至 13.86 个百分点，且优于查询次数匹配的随机噪声扰动。该攻击对自顶向下和单阶段姿态估计模型均有效。
AI.conclusion: OKS 作为攻击反馈信号可有效指导黑盒攻击，跨模型与跨任务（姿态估计到动作识别）均表现出攻击迁移与下游影响，代码将开源。

title: Eliciting Self-Verification in Multimodal Reasoning Agents with Reinforcement Learning
comment: To appear in ECCV 2026. 11 main pages. 7 figures
summary: Reasoning agents increasingly rely on external tools such as web search to answer complex queries. Reinforcement learning (RL) finetuning algorithms such as GRPO have improved long-form reasoning in text-only language models, particularly for coding and mathematics. Reliable tool use in multimodal agents, however, remains challenging because models must interpret text and images while integrating noisy retrieved evidence, often under sparse outcome-level supervision without explicit verification signals. We present Self-Verification via Reinforcement Learning (SVRL), an RL-only finetuning framework that trains multimodal agents to verify and filter retrieved evidence within their own reasoning traces, reducing reliance on external verifiers at inference time. SVRL also introduces a search-aware penalty that discourages unnecessary tool calls and a query-diversity reward that encourages diverse, well-formed search queries, providing fine-grained feedback on when and what to search. Finetuning Qwen-2.5-VL-7B with SVRL on only 5{,}000 visual question answering examples yields consistent gains in multi-hop VQA generalization and tool efficiency across benchmarks. Overall, SVRL narrows the gap between compact agents and much larger proprietary models while requiring substantially lower training and inference cost.

AI.tldr: SVRL是一种仅依赖强化学习的微调框架，训练多模态智能体在自身推理轨迹内验证与过滤检索证据，仅在5000条VQA样本上微调Qwen-2.5-VL-7B即提升了多跳VQA泛化性与工具使用效率。
AI.motivation: 多模态智能体在可靠使用外部工具（如网络搜索）方面仍具挑战：模型需同时理解文本与图像、整合含噪检索证据，且通常仅有稀疏的结果级监督，缺乏显式验证信号。已有RL微调方法（如GRPO）主要改进纯文本模型的长程推理，未解决多模态工具使用中的验证与效率问题。
AI.method: 提出SVRL（Self-Verification via Reinforcement Learning），一种仅用RL的微调框架，训练多模态智能体在自己的推理轨迹中验证并过滤检索到的证据，从而在推理时减少对外部验证器的依赖。此外引入搜索感知惩罚以抑制不必要的工具调用，以及查询多样性奖励以鼓励多样且规范的搜索查询，从而对“何时搜索、搜索什么”提供细粒度反馈。基于5000条视觉问答样本对Qwen-2.5-VL-7B进行微调。
AI.result: 在多跳VQA泛化能力和工具效率方面，跨多个基准取得一致性提升；缩小了紧凑型智能体与更大专有模型之间的差距，同时显著降低了训练与推理成本。
AI.conclusion: SVRL通过将自验证能力内化到推理轨迹中，并辅以搜索效率与查询质量的奖励设计，为多模态智能体的可靠工具使用提供了高性价比的RL微调方案。

title: BanglaMemeX: Advancing Cultural Metaphoric Image Interpretation in Bangla with a Multimodal Explainable Dataset
comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026 Findings - 37 pages, 17 figures, 19 tables, including appendices
summary: Vision Language Models have achieved strong performance on multimodal benchmarks, yet their ability to reason about culturally grounded and metaphor-rich content remains insufficiently studied. Internet memes present a challenging setting where meaning emerges from implicit interactions between image, overlaid text, sarcasm, and shared socio-cultural knowledge rather than literal visual recognition. This challenge is amplified in low-resource languages such as Bangla, where code-mixing, stylized scripts, and culturally specific symbolism introduce substantial distribution shift. In this work, we introduce BanglaMemeX, a culturally grounded multimodal benchmark comprising 3,000 Bangla memes annotated with multi-dimensional labels (humor, sarcasm, offensiveness, motivational intent, and overall sentiment) and human-written explanations that explicitly describe textual and visual metaphors. We systematically evaluate modern VLMs on both classification and explanation generation, revealing that current models struggle to interpret implicit cultural cues despite reasonable surface-level accuracy. Our results highlight the need for culturally-aware multimodal systems capable of grounded reasoning under linguistic and cultural distribution shift.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 BanglaMemeX——一个包含3000条孟加拉语模因、带多维标注与人工解释的文化情境多模态基准，系统评测现代视觉语言模型（VLM），发现其在隐式文化线索推理上表现不足。
AI.motivation: VLM在多模态基准上表现强劲，但对文化情境化、隐喻丰富内容（如网络模因）的推理能力研究不足；孟加拉语等低资源语言中，语码混合、风格化文字与文化特定符号带来显著分布偏移，凸显文化感知多模态系统的需求。
AI.method: 构建 BanglaMemeX 基准：采集/整理3000条孟加拉语模因，标注幽默、讽刺、冒犯性、激励意图、整体情感等多维标签，并配以人工撰写的解释，明确描述文本与视觉隐喻；随后在该基准上对现代VLM进行情感/意图分类与解释生成两类任务的系统评测。
AI.result: 当前模型在表层准确率尚可，但难以解读隐式文化线索；在分类与解释生成任务上均暴露出对文化特定象征、语码混合与风格化文本的推理缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 现有VLM在语言与文化分布偏移下缺乏接地推理能力，亟需发展文化感知的多模态系统，以处理隐喻与文化情境丰富的低资源语言内容。

title: Flexible Motion Generation from Language and Style References
summary: We introduce FlexMoGen, a novel framework for flexible human motion synthesis conditioned on both natural language descriptions and motion style references. Text prompts are effective at defining semantic content, but they are often limited in capturing fine-grained style details such as timing, limb articulation, and expressive dynamics. A style example clip supplements the text by conveying these nuanced motion characteristics directly, enabling the model to preserve high-level intent while reproducing the desired stylistic traits. Given a text prompt and a style example clip, FlexMoGen generates high-quality motions that preserve semantic content while faithfully reflecting the target style, offering users greater control over the animation generation process. Unlike prior methods that rely on discrete style labels and do not generalize to long or multi-style generation, FlexMoGen learns a variational style encoder without style supervision and supports long, time-varying, multi-style synthesis. Our framework jointly pre-trains the style encoder and a text-to-motion latent diffusion model within a unified architecture, modulating motion style through a lightweight adaptation module. It integrates an efficient relative positional encoding scheme and is trained on both stylized and non-stylized datasets, enabling strong generalization to unseen text-style combinations. Experiments show that FlexMoGen achieves the best balance between content fidelity and style reflection.

AI.tldr: FlexMoGen：一种以自然语言描述和动作风格参考为条件的灵活人体动作合成框架，无需风格监督，支持长时、时变、多风格生成。
AI.motivation: 文本提示擅长定义语义内容，但难以捕捉细粒度风格细节（如时序、肢体关节、表现力动态）；先前方法依赖离散风格标签，无法泛化到长时或多风格生成。
AI.method: 学习无风格监督的变分风格编码器；在统一架构中联合预训练风格编码器与文本到动作的潜在扩散模型；通过轻量适配模块调制动作风格；集成高效的相对位置编码方案；在风格化与非风格化数据集上训练。
AI.result: 在内容保真度与风格反映之间取得最佳平衡，并能强泛化到未见过的文本-风格组合。
AI.conclusion: FlexMoGen 在保留语义内容的同时忠实反映目标风格，为用户提供更强的动画生成控制能力，并支持长时、时变、多风格合成。

title: SAFER-Activities: A Dataset for Smart Assessment of Fall Events and Routine Activities
summary: Smart healthcare monitoring systems require precise action recognition to ensure well-being and timely intervention in critical situations such as falls, particularly for mobility-challenged individuals. Existing datasets are often clip-based, lacking the frame-level detail needed to recognize actions online, as they unfold. To address this, we introduce SAFER-Activities, a dataset for fall detection and physical activity monitoring, with a dedicated subset for wheelchair use scenarios. It comprises over 66 hours of video data captured by multiple cameras, with 85,310 action instances and frame-level annotations for 30 action classes. We benchmark action recognition on SAFER-Activities with 2D and 3D skeleton models, RGB models with frozen backbones, and multimodal fusion strategies, and evaluate on in-lab, out-of-distribution, and cross-dataset test sets. Skeleton-based models generalize best under domain shift; fusing frozen RGB features with the skeleton stream improves in-domain recognition over the baseline CNN1D, most clearly on the wheelchair subset, but degrades out of distribution. Cross-dataset and qualitative evaluations confirm that models trained on SAFER-Activities transfer well to unseen environments and external fall data. To support research on robust fall detection and activity monitoring, we release the dataset and code at https://safer-activities.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SAFER-Activities数据集，用于跌倒检测与身体活动监测，包含66小时以上多摄像头视频、85,310个动作实例和30类帧级标注，并基准测试了骨架、RGB及多模态融合方法。
AI.motivation: 智能医疗监测系统需要精准的动作识别以保障行动不便人群的安全并及时干预跌倒等紧急情况。现有数据集多为片段级（clip-based），缺乏在线识别所需的帧级细节。
AI.method: 构建SAFER-Activities数据集，含轮椅使用场景专用子集。使用2D和3D骨架模型、冻结骨干的RGB模型及多模态融合策略进行动作识别基准测试，并在实验室内、分布外及跨数据集测试集上评估。
AI.result: 骨架模型在域偏移下泛化最佳；将冻结RGB特征与骨架流融合可提升域内识别（优于CNN1D基线），在轮椅子集上最明显，但会降低分布外性能。跨数据集与定性评估证实模型可良好迁移至未见环境和外部跌倒数据。
AI.conclusion: SAFER-Activities支持稳健跌倒检测与活动监测研究，数据集与代码已公开。

title: MamMA: A Mamba-Based Pedestrian Trajectory Prediction Algorithm Considering Occupancy Map and Pedestrian Awareness States
comment: Accepted at the 2026 International Joint Conference on Neural Networks (IJCNN 2026). 7 pages, 5 figures
summary: Many pedestrian trajectory prediction algorithms have been proposed to improve the safety of navigation for mobile robots working in human-robot coexistence environments. Some pedestrian trajectory prediction algorithms extract information about obstacles near pedestrians from top-down view images to improve the accuracy of trajectory prediction. However, mobile robots typically create local occupancy maps using LiDAR, rather than top-down view images. Meanwhile, the vision sensors on board robots provide egocentric view images, which contain fine-grained behavioral information about the pedestrians near the robot. To better use the information collected by LiDAR and on-board vision sensors, we propose MamMA, a Mamba-based pedestrian trajectory prediction algorithm considering occupancy maps and pedestrian awareness states. MamMA divides the occupancy map by patches and extracts obstacle features from each patch to create map features. Pedestrian awareness states are divided and considered, as some studies show that awareness states affect the perception and speed of pedestrians. Furthermore, a Mamba-based model is proposed to predict the future trajectories of pedestrians based on different types of features. Experiments on the STCrowd, SiT, JRDB, ETH, and UCY datasets show that MamMA achieves better average displacement error and final displacement error than the state-of-the-art algorithms.

AI.tldr: 提出MamMA——一种基于Mamba的行人轨迹预测算法，融合占据栅格地图与行人意识状态信息，在五个数据集上优于现有最优算法。
AI.motivation: 现有部分行人轨迹预测算法从俯视图像中提取行人周边障碍信息以提升精度，但移动机器人通常使用LiDAR构建局部占据栅格地图而非俯视图像；同时机器人视觉传感器提供的是第一视角图像，包含行人细粒度行为信息。因此需要一种能更好利用LiDAR与车载视觉传感器所采集信息的方法。
AI.method: MamMA将占据栅格地图分块（patch），从每个patch提取障碍特征以构建地图特征；对行人意识状态进行划分与建模（因意识状态影响行人的感知与速度）；并采用基于Mamba的模型，融合多类特征预测行人未来轨迹。
AI.result: 在STCrowd、SiT、JRDB、ETH、UCY五个数据集上的实验表明，MamMA的平均位移误差（ADE）与最终位移误差（FDE）均优于当前最优算法。
AI.conclusion: MamMA通过结合占据栅格地图特征与行人意识状态，并借助Mamba模型，有效提升了人机共存环境下移动机器人导航中的行人轨迹预测精度。

title: A Quantitative Evaluation Framework for Temporal Explainability in Echocardiographic Video Segmentation
summary: Deep learning has achieved state-of-the-art performance in echocardiographic video segmentation, with an increasing number of models incorporating temporal information. However, quantitative evaluation of temporal explainability remains largely unexplored. We propose a quantitative framework for evaluating Grad-CAM explanations using four complementary metrics measuring temporal consistency, saliency motion, anatomical overlap, and temporal overlap. Using EchoNet-Dynamic, we compare a baseline 2D U-Net with ConvLSTM U-Net models trained across multiple temporal strides. While segmentation performance remained comparable across all models, intermediate ConvLSTM explanations exhibited substantially lower saliency consistency and greater centroid motion than final prediction explanations. Temporal Bottleneck explanations were significantly more stable than Encoder Bottleneck explanations across all strides, while final ConvLSTM Decoder3 explanations were broadly comparable to those of the 2D U-Net. Importantly, conventional frame-wise explanation metrics cannot determine whether variation in intermediate explanations reflects meaningful temporal feature evolution or explanation instability. These findings establish a preliminary quantitative framework for temporal explainability and motivate temporal-aware XAI methods that explicitly account for evolving representations in medical video models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个量化评估Grad-CAM时序可解释性的框架，含四个互补指标（时序一致性、显著性运动、解剖重叠、时序重叠），并比较2D U-Net与不同时序步长ConvLSTM U-Net在心脏超声视频分割中的表现。
AI.motivation: 深度学习（含时序信息的模型）在超声心动图视频分割中已达SOTA，但对"时序可解释性"的定量评估几乎空白；传统逐帧解释指标无法判断中间层解释的变化究竟反映有意义的时序特征演化还是解释不稳定。
AI.method: 提出包含四个互补指标的Grad-CAM量化评估框架：时序一致性、显著性运动（质心运动）、解剖重叠、时序重叠；基于EchoNet-Dynamic数据集，将基线2D U-Net与在多个时序步长（temporal stride）上训练的ConvLSTM U-Net进行对比，分别评估中间层与最终预测的解释。
AI.result: 各模型分割性能相当；中间层ConvLSTM解释相比最终预测解释具有显著更低的显著性一致性和更大的质心运动；在所有步长下Temporal Bottleneck解释显著比Encoder Bottleneck更稳定；最终ConvLSTM Decoder3解释与2D U-Net大体相当。
AI.conclusion: 建立了初步的时序可解释性量化框架；指出现有逐帧解释指标不足以判别中间解释的时序意义，呼吁发展显式考虑表征演化的时序感知XAI方法，用于医学视频模型。

title: RFS-UNet: Decoder-Conditioned High-Resolution Skip Recalibration for Bone-Selective DRR Synthesis
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, and 3 tables. Manuscript prepared for ICASSP 2027
summary: Bone-selective synthesis from digitally reconstructed radiographs (DRRs) requires separating skeletal signal from overlying tissue while preserving anatomical detail. U-Net skip connections supply fine encoder features, but their transfer is independent of decoder context. We introduce RFS-UNet, which lets the decoder participate in high-resolution channel recalibration. Pooled encoder and decoder features jointly predict a bounded residual scale, initialized to preserve the original skip transfer. The module operates at the two finest resolutions and integrates directly into the backbone. On a rebuilt patient-unique cohort, RFS improves test PSNR over U-Net-64 by 0.10 dB. A three-seed comparison with encoder-only recalibration supports the contribution of decoder context. RFS also offers a lower-latency alternative to CBAM, with 2.25 times faster inference in matched profiling. Decoder-conditioned reuse thus improves bone-selective synthesis through a compact architectural change.

AI.tldr: 提出RFS-UNet，通过让解码器参与高分辨率通道重校准（预测有界残差缩放）来改进UNet的跳跃连接传递，实现骨选择性合成。
AI.motivation: DRR骨选择性合成需分离骨骼信号与覆盖组织并保留解剖细节。UNet跳跃连接虽提供精细编码器特征，但其传递与解码器上下文无关，缺乏上下文自适应性。
AI.method: RFS-UNet：在最高两级分辨率上，将编码器与解码器池化特征联合预测一个有界残差缩放（初始化为保持原始跳跃传递），使解码器参与高分辨率通道重校准，并直接集成进骨干网络。对比仅编码器重校准的三种子实验，并与CBAM做推理延迟比较。
AI.result: 在重建的患者唯一队列上，相比UNet-64，测试PSNR提升0.10 dB；相比仅编码器重校准，解码器上下文的贡献得到验证；推理延迟低于CBAM，匹配剖析下快2.25倍。
AI.conclusion: 解码器条件化的特征复用通过紧凑的架构改动，有效提升骨选择性合成性能，并兼具低延迟优势。
